### [207] [Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16756)
*Tianyu Zhu,Ying Fu,Hesong Li,Gengchen Zhang,Xin Yuan,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BinRVR，一个二值化RAW视频恢复框架，通过二值信息交互模块（BIIM）统一建模时空信息，以及分布感知二值卷积（DAB-Conv）利用全精度激活统计量减少量化误差，在降低约96%计算量和参数量的同时仅造成约4%性能退化，并支持多比特量化以实现精度-效率灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAW视频恢复是高质量底层视觉感知的基础，但二值神经网络（BNN）在视频场景下难以有效建模时序连贯性和激活值分布，导致其应用于RAW视频恢复时效果不佳。需要一种既能高效轻量部署又能保持视频恢复性能的二值化方法。

Method: 提出BinRVR框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 二值信息交互模块（BIIM），以高效统一的方式联合建模空间和时间信息；2) 分布感知二值卷积（DAB-Conv），利用全精度激活的统计量来缓解量化误差。框架同时支持多比特量化，可在不同硬件约束下实现灵活的精度-效率权衡。

Result: BinRVR在RAW视频恢复任务（低光增强、去噪、去模糊、超分辨率）上相比最先进的二值化方法取得了有竞争力的性能，计算量和参数量减少约96%，性能仅下降约4%。此外在下游视频应用（目标检测和单目深度估计）上也探索了其潜力。

Conclusion: BinRVR证明了二值化方法在RAW视频恢复场景中的可行性，通过有效的时空建模和量化误差缓解策略，在极低的计算和存储成本下保持了接近全精度方法的性能，并展现出对下游视觉任务的良好支持能力。

Abstract: RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value distributions hinder their effectiveness when applied to video scenarios. In this paper, we propose BinRVR, a binarized RAW video restoration framework that reduces computation and parameters by approximately 96% while incurring only about 4% performance degradation. Specifically, we present a Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM) to jointly model spatial and temporal information in an efficient and unified manner. Moreover, we develop a Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv) that leverages the statistics of full-precision activations to mitigate quantization errors. The proposed framework further supports multi-bit quantization, enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different hardware constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our BinRVR achieves competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art binarized methods on RAW video restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution. We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.

</details>


### [208] [TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16765)
*Haoran Wang,Chaofan Ma,Ran Yi,Lizhuang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TRACE-Bench基准，通过四个原子算子（Anchor、Disentangle、Apply、Compose）对多参考图像生成任务进行形式化分解，构建约1600个评估案例，实现按能力评分和递归失败定位的诊断评估。评估9个模型发现主要瓶颈在解耦与属性绑定，而非场景级合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态多参考图像生成基准按预定义任务类型（如"主体组合"）组织，难以适应组合性设置，导致覆盖碎片化、复杂度不可控、诊断价值低。需要一种能力导向的视角来统一形式化多参考任务。

Method: 形式化四个原子算子：Anchor (f)、Disentangle (g)、Apply (⊕)、Compose (C)，将任意多参考提示表示为这些算子的组合公式，以算子槽位数量量化结构复杂度。据此构建TRACE-Bench，含约1600个评估案例（槽位1-8）、631个公式模板和约4000张参考图像。公式结构驱动算子对齐的评估协议（按能力评分）和诊断树分析（递归失败定位）。

Result: 评估9个领先模型发现传统整体评分难以揭示的洞见：主要瓶颈在解耦（g）和属性绑定（⊕）而非场景级合成（C），最佳模型在属性保真度上仅得0.74。

Conclusion: 能力导向的算子化形式化为多参考生成提供了更具诊断价值的评估框架，揭示了技术瓶颈的真正所在，为后续模型改进指明了方向。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench

</details>


### [209] [Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16785)
*Gaofeng Su,Keya Li,Raja Sengupta,Kara M. Kockelman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需相机标定的框架，通过36关键点车辆模板和逐帧更新的单应矩阵，从单目视频中可靠估计车速，在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉的车速估计方法严重依赖道路特征、相机标定或基于道路特征的参考物体，限制了其在实际场景（如行车记录仪、智能手机等便携设备）中的部署与应用，亟需一种免标定、低成本的通用方案。

Method: 框架包含三个核心组件：基于YOLO的关键点检测模块（在多样化数据集上训练，提取36个车辆关键点）、逐帧更新的单应矩阵用于将像素位移映射到公制空间，以及两种速度估计策略（纯关键点跟踪与形变光流配合密集空间聚合）。通过投影位移到度量空间计算车速。

Result: 在400多个视频片段（覆盖30-100 mph）上验证，形变光流方法在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed上分别达到15.0%和9.7%的MAE，77.9%和93.1%的估计落在±20%误差内。经10%裁剪去除边缘离群值后，MAE提升至11.7%和7.6%，±20%内准确率提升至85.3%和95.4%。

Conclusion: 该框架解决了现有视觉方法的关键局限，支持使用行车记录仪和智能手机等便携设备进行低成本高效的速度执法，为基于公民的交通安全执法计划提供了技术支撑。

Abstract: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.

</details>


### [210] [Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16786)
*Artem Sergievskii,Artyom Turevich,Sergey Kastryulin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统性地重新评估了八种训练无关的推理时质量增强方法（大多源于Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG)），将其应用于两个开源的rectified-flow transformer模型，并使用三个组合对齐基准进行评测。结果显示，没有任何方法能持续优于CFG，APG虽获得若干名义最佳分数但多数增益在评测不确定度之内，注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上有零星增益但在FLUX.2上更多表现为性能下降，CFG仍是竞争力强且成本更低的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时质量增强方法大多在较老的U-Net扩散模型上提出，且评估指标仅关注图像质量的孤立评价，忽略了生成图像与文本提示之间的组合对齐和语义对应关系。作者希望在现代rectified-flow transformer架构及组合对齐基准下重新验证这些方法的有效性。

Method: 在固定的每模型协议下，对八个训练无关的方法（概念上植根于CFG）在两个开源的rectified-flow transformer模型上进行统一评测，并使用三个组合对齐基准来衡量生成图像与文本提示的语义一致性，而非仅看图像质量的孤立指标。

Result: 没有任何方法在所有评测标准上持续优于CFG。APG获得了若干名义上的最佳分数，但这些增益往往落在估计的评测不确定度范围内。注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上提供了零星的增益，而在FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base上表现出更频繁的退化。CFG仍是具有竞争力且成本更低的基线。

Conclusion: 在更新的transformer架构和组合对齐评测下，声称优于CFG的训练无关方法并不具备跨模型、跨标准的通用优势；研究结果呼吁在更现代的架构和以语义对齐为核心的评测协议下重新审视此类方法的理论依据和实际价值。

Abstract: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.

</details>


### [211] [Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16791)
*Ye Lu,Shen Wang,Zhaoyang Zhang,Yihan Yan,Li Liu,Runze Liu,Fanghui Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SFMI（Steering Flow Model Inversion），一种两阶段白盒模型逆向攻击方法，将模型反演重构为轨迹引导任务。第一阶段预训练通用Flow Matching模型作为人脸流形先验，第二阶段通过渐进式引导调度器（PGS）在采样过程中注入时间相关的目标特定梯度，将生成流从随机噪声引导至目标类别的高密度区域。在CelebA数据集的身份不相交交叉评估设置下，ArcFace目标上达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型逆向攻击方法依赖间接或高度随机的引导，难以稳定地将生成轨迹优化到目标人脸图像方向，攻击成功率和视觉保真度受限。

Method: SFMI包含两个阶段：第一阶段预训练无条件Flow Matching模型，编码人脸流形作为稳健先验；第二阶段采用渐进式引导调度器（PGS），在采样过程中通过目标模型反向传播获取中间生成状态的梯度，并随时间注入自适应的目标特定引导信号到向量场中，从而引导生成流从随机噪声定向移动至目标类别高密度区域。

Result: 在CelebA数据集的身份不相交交叉评估设置下，ArcFace目标上ACC为0.9248，FID为22.61，LPIPS为0.3874。在多个目标模型上的广泛实验表明，SFMI在白盒协议下取得了竞争性的最先进攻击成功率与视觉保真度。

Conclusion: SFMI通过将模型逆向攻击重构为轨迹引导任务，结合Flow Matching先验与渐进式引导调度，有效解决了现有方法生成轨迹不稳定的问题，在白盒场景下实现了攻击成功率与视觉质量的均衡提升。

Abstract: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

</details>


### [212] [PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16793)
*Lingchen Sun,Rongyuan Wu,Xiangtao Kong,Jixin Zhao,Qiaosi Yi,Yujing Sun,Shuaizheng Liu,Zhengqiang Zhang,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixRestore是一个无VAE、基于像素空间的扩散Transformer（DiT）统一图像复原模型，完全从头训练，无需T2I预训练。它直接在patch化的像素上进行流匹配，保持细节完整性；通过LQ-HQ DINO特征相似度预测层特征可靠性，灵活适应不同退化类型；并可通过DINO对抗目标微调为单步生成器。仅约5000万参数即可在公开基准上实现最佳的整体保真度、感知质量和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一图像复原方法大多依赖预训练的文生图(T2I)潜空间扩散模型，但存在两个根本问题：一是潜空间VAE可能丢弃复原敏感的细节信息；二是开放式合成先验可能引入与内容不一致的伪影。因此需要一种不依赖T2I预训练、能保留精细细节的统一复原方案。

Method: PixRestore采用无VAE的像素空间DiT作为扩散主干，从头训练。具体包括：(1) 直接在patchified像素上进行流匹配(flow matching)，兼顾细节保留与token序列的可控性；(2) 通过LQ-HQ DINO特征相似度学习预测各层特征的可靠性——可靠层特征作为稠密条件融合，不可靠层则接受更强的HQ特征监督以推动退化去除；(3) 在大规模多场景多退化语料上训练；(4) 使用基于DINO对抗目标微调为单步生成器以提升推理效率。

Result: 在公开基准与真实世界测试集上，PixRestore仅约5000万参数且采用单步推理，即在整体保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性上全面优于竞品UIR模型，同时效率大幅提升。更大规模的变体可进一步提升性能，验证了像素空间设计的可扩展性。

Conclusion: PixRestore证明了摒弃T2I预训练和潜空间VAE，直接在像素空间训练扩散Transformer即可实现更优的统一图像复原性能与效率。其DINO引导的层可靠性自适应机制有效平衡了细节保留与退化去除，单步生成能力进一步缩小了模型规模与推理成本，为UIR提供了兼具高质量与可扩展性的新范式。

Abstract: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.

</details>


### [213] [Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16805)
*Yuanzhi Xu,Qian Gao,Jun Fan,Guohui Ding,Zhenyu Yang,Yuteng Xiao,Sixue Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DSCAM问题（密集同类属性错误绑定，即模型把属性错误分配给同一类别中的另一个实例），并发布InstaBind-Lite基准：包含524张图像、529组3-6个同类实体、1773个框选实例，提供4个互补问题层级共9580个确定性评估问题。通过源实例标注区分“属性来自其他可见实体”的错误类型。实验表明开源系统平均错误绑定率19.84%，API系统7.55%，其中80%以上转移来自相邻实例，这些错误被聚合准确率所掩盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型能识别拥挤场景中的物体和属性，却常将属性错配给同类别的另一个实例。现有通用VQA准确率将这类回答判为错误，而物体幻觉指标又可能认为物体和属性都被图像支持，两者都无法揭示这类属性转移错误——这是现有评估体系的盲区。

Method: 形式化定义DSCAM问题并构建InstaBind-Lite受控基准：精心设计的524张图像含529组3-6个同类实体及1773个带框实例，具备有序邻居和可区分的颜色类属性，设计了四个互补问题层级，生成9580个确定性评估问题。通过源实例标注机制区分无依据生成、识别失败和从其他可见实体复制属性三类错误；提出绑定专属指标量化转移频率、邻接关系、序数距离和干预效果。

Result: 在五个开源和两个商业/API模型上，开源系统平均错误绑定率19.84%，API系统为7.55%，且这些错误被聚合准确率所掩盖。在可识别的属性转移中，开源与API系统分别有80.70%和81.51%来自相邻实例。定位和实例优先干预对部分模型有效，但并非普遍解决方案。

Conclusion: InstaBind-Lite将原本无法区分的错误答案转化为可溯源识别来源的失败类别，检验了传统基准无法确定的一个可靠性维度：模型不仅要知道“什么可见”，还要知道“每个属性归属于哪个实例”。

Abstract: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. Unlike existing protocols, source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from an attribute copied from another visible entity. Binding-specific metrics further quantify transfer frequency, adjacency, ordinal distance, and intervention effects. Across five open-source and two commercial/API models, the open-source systems average 19.84% Misbinding Rate and the API systems 7.55%; these errors are hidden by aggregate accuracy. Among identifiable transfers, 80.70% and 81.51%, respectively, originate from adjacent instances. Localization and instance-first interventions help selected models but are not universal remedies. InstaBind-Lite therefore turns previously undifferentiated wrong answers into source-identifiable failure categories and tests a reliability dimension that conventional benchmarks cannot determine: whether a model knows not only what is visible, but which instance owns each attribute.

</details>


### [214] [Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16810)
*Ziwen Liu,Martin Weigert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于粗到精路由金字塔的无监督细胞实例分割与表型分类方法，无需人工标注即可从显微镜图像中识别细胞/核实例并编码细胞形态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的细胞实例分割与表征依赖于监督学习，需要大量人工标注，且将实例分割与细胞表征视为两个独立阶段，缺乏无监督的统一解决方案。

Method: 使用粗到精路由金字塔（coarse-to-fine routing pyramid）重构每张图像，将像素与空间稀疏的潜在来源相关联。像素到潜在来源的关联生成实例掩膜，而潜在来源编码细胞形态。

Result: 在多种细胞形态和成像模态下，实例分割性能具有竞争力；同时能够在扰动条件下对细胞表型进行生成建模。

Conclusion: 提出了一种统一的、无监督的细胞实例分割与表型表征方法，在无需标注的情况下达到有竞争力的分割性能，并能进行细胞表型的生成建模。

Abstract: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.

</details>


### [215] [Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16812)
*Long Cui,Xiaoqian Liu,Qi Qin,Yi Xin,Tao Lin,Jianguo Li,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大规模知识库的图像编辑训练框架，包括超过1,000个细粒度编辑概念的层次化分类法、1200万高质量编辑对数据集ConceptEdit-12M、密集监督训练策略以及用于细粒度评估的ConceptEdit-Bench基准，有效解决了现有图像编辑模型在概念粒度和训练效率方面的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像编辑框架遵循文本到图像扩散模型的训练范式，但这在扩展到图像编辑任务时存在两个固有缺陷：一是对编辑概念粒度的关注不足，导致模型难以处理细粒度的编辑指令；二是训练过程中监督信号稀疏，造成训练效率低下。这些问题阻碍了图像编辑模型的性能提升。

Method: 本文通过三方面创新解决问题：(1) 构建包含1,000多个细粒度编辑概念的层次化分类法，并基于改进的合成框架构建包含1200万高质量编辑对的大规模数据集ConceptEdit-12M，有效纠正生成数据的分布坍塌并保证数据保真度；(2) 提出密集监督训练策略，将多个互不干扰的概念合成到单个图像对中，提供更丰富的学习信号；(3) 提出ConceptEdit-Bench细粒度评估套件，用于在大量真实场景中诊断模型能力。

Result: 训练结果验证了所提出策略的有效性，显著优于先前的工作。密集监督训练策略大幅提升了训练效率和整体模型性能。

Conclusion: 基于知识库驱动的方法（层次化分类法+大规模数据集+密集监督策略）能有效解决图像编辑中的概念粒度不足和训练效率低下的问题，为图像编辑领域提供了更高质量的基准和训练框架。

Abstract: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [216] [Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16855)
*Anna Mrukwa,Marek Socha,Aleksandra Suwalska,Agata Durawa,Malgorzata Jelitto,Katarzyna Dziadziuszko,Edyta Szurowska,Pawel Bozek,Michal Marczyk,Witold Rzyman,Rafal Dziadziuszko,Joanna Polanska*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为RONALD的支气管血管束分割流程，用于低剂量CT图像中肺部血管和支气管的分割，通过精确去除血管与气道结构来提升早期肺癌筛查中肺结节的可视性和保留率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球致死率最高的癌症，常因诊断过晚而预后不佳。放射科医生数量有限且患者众多导致诊断等待时间过长。极早期肺癌中，结节因与相邻血管和气道壁相连或被其供血而难以辨别，因此对支气管血管束进行任务特异性分析并予以去除，对提高结节检出率至关重要。

Method: RONALD流程首先进行预处理，包括肺、肺叶和纵隔分割，随后分别进行血管和支气管树分割，最终在CT图像上输出肺实质内血管和支气管的二值掩膜。

Result: 在DLCS数据集中，结节保留率从93.98%和90.36%提升至100%；在Pomeranian数据集中，从83.16%和62.36%提升至99.92%，优于其他分割方法。

Conclusion: RONALD生成的支气管血管束分割结果能够改善极早期肺癌的肺结节检测能力。

Abstract: Background
  Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening.
  Materials and Methods
  To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation.
  Results
  The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset.
  Conclusion
  The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.

</details>


### [217] [HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16859)
*Weiliang Chen,Haowen Sun,Jun Gao,Jiawei Chi,Hanyang Wang,Qiyu Dai,Yihao Li,Hao Li,Jingnan Gao,Yi-Hsin Hung,Xingzhuo Guo,Shangchen Miao,Zhiyuan Shi,Xiang Li,Fengrui Tian,Weihua Du,Ziqi Huang,Shenyuan Gao,Siqiao Huang,Mingyu Liu,Yifei Li,Shizun Wang,Xi Wang,Tianqi Zhang,Xue Luo,Xiyin Ren,Jinshan Ren,Xiaoyang Shen,Xiaobo Hu,Zhiyang Dou,Mingyu Ding,Yichao Yan,Xinchao Wang,Yizhou Wang,Shilong Liu,Wenzhao Zheng,Yueqi Duan,Yuan Gong,Ziwei Liu,Ming-Yu Liu,Jialong Wu,Jiangran Lyu,Fangfu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HarnessEval-W是一个将LLM生态中的"harness"范式引入世界模型评估的智能代理化流水线，通过层级式推理树（父代理分解任务+子代理专项诊断）替代固定规则的暴力计算评分，在18个世界模型、330个评估案例上实现了与人类偏好高度一致的判断，并提供可验证的细粒度诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准评估仅输出标量分数，缺乏支撑评分结论的推理链。对于世界模型而言，判断rollout是否正确涉及物理因果与世界状态的演化，人类能自然识别这些违反，但现有基准无法自动化这种能力——指标通过暴力计算得到，无可检查或验证的推理过程。

Method: HarnessEval-W采用代理化评估流水线：父代理解释每个评估案例的上下文，将评估问题分解为可衡量的子问题，并生成多个配备定制上下文和诊断工具的专业子代理各自推理。父代理再验证证据并综合成最终判定，形成透明证据树。

Result: 在18个代表性世界模型、330个评估案例上，HarnessEval-W的判断与人类偏好高度吻合，同时为每个生成的rollout提供可验证的细粒度诊断。

Conclusion: 该工作将评估从单一分数升级为可审查的推理链，填补了世界模型评估缺乏自动化推理能力验证的空白。全流程以实时基准形式开源，邀请社区贡献新技能和评估案例以支持世界模型的持续演化。

Abstract: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.

</details>


### [218] [SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16863)
*Yejun Zhang,Zihan Wang,Xu Ji,Yihao Wang,Yuxin Hou,Junyuan Fang,Juho-Matti Kilpeläinen,Arno Solin,Hamed Rezazadegan Tavakoli,Esa Rahtu,Juho Kannala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatGuide通过将单一3DGS重建场景复用为三个互补角色（像素渲染提供几何条件、逐高斯源视图索引生成遮挡感知参考投票图、重建token提供跨注意力特征引导），弥合了前馈3DGS重建与多视图扩散之间的信息割裂，在多个基准上实现无姿态新视角合成的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将前馈3DGS重建与多视图扩散相结合的方法存在信息割裂问题：它们最多只从重建中提取一种信号（像素渲染或学习特征），未能利用逐高斯的可见性信息进行遮挡感知的参考视图选择，导致可渲染几何、可见性线索和学习特征被浪费。

Method: SplatGuide将单一3DGS场景复用于三种互补角色：(1) 渲染图像提供像素对齐的几何条件；(2) 将逐高斯的源视图索引渲染为目标视图投票图，实现遮挡感知的参考视图选择；(3) 重建token通过交叉注意力提供特征级引导。三种信号均来自同一次重建前向传播。

Result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV、Tanks-and-Temples和Mip-NeRF 360基准上取得无姿态新视角合成的SOTA性能。在RealEstate10K上，使用适中数量的输入视图时，超越了使用真实姿态的基线方法。

Conclusion: SplatGuide证明了对3DGS重建信号的充分再利用（尤其是逐高斯可见性信息）能够有效弥合几何重建与生成式扩散之间的信息鸿沟，实现高质量的无需相机姿态的新视角合成，甚至在某些条件下超过依赖真实姿态的方法。

Abstract: Generating photorealistic novel views from unposed images requires both 3D geometric understanding and the ability to synthesize unseen content. A natural strategy combines feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction with multi-view diffusion. Yet prior pipelines extract at most one signal from the reconstruction, either pixel rendering or learned features, while none exploits per-Gaussian visibility for occlusion-aware reference selection. This *information disconnect* leaves renderable geometry, visibility cues, and learned features unused. SplatGuide closes this disconnect by reusing a single 3DGS scene across three complementary roles. Rendered images provide pixel-aligned geometric conditioning. Per-Gaussian source-view indices are rendered into a target-view voting map for occlusion-aware reference selection. Reconstruction tokens supply feature-level guidance via cross-attention. All three signals derive from the same reconstruction forward pass. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV, Tanks-and-Temples, and Mip-NeRF 360, SplatGuide achieves state-of-the-art pose-free novel view synthesis. On RealEstate10K, with a moderate number of input views, it surpasses the ground-truth-pose baseline.

</details>


### [219] [An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16887)
*Dengyang Jiang,Ruoyi Du,Zhennan Chen,Dongyang Liu,Zanyi Wang,Mingzhe Zheng,Xiangpeng Yang,Huanqia Cai,Aiming Hao,Yuming Jiang,Peng Gao,Harry Yang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了像素空间扩散模型的大规模训练问题，发现直接像素空间预训练收敛明显慢于潜空间，进而提出"潜空间预训练+像素空间后训练"的latent-to-pixel策略，并系统探索了迁移过程中的关键设计选择，最终使像素空间模型在匹配或超越潜空间模型性能的同时实现3.18-4.75倍端到端推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管像素空间扩散模型已被广泛研究，但多数工作局限于小规模或类别条件设置，缺乏大规模像素空间模型的实际训练方案，因此一个能媲美甚至超越潜空间模型的像素空间训练配方仍未明确。

Method: 首先通过大规模实证研究揭示像素空间直接预训练收敛速度显著慢于潜空间；进而提出latent-to-pixel策略：在潜空间中高效获取生成先验，再在后训练阶段迁移至像素空间。系统研究了迁移过程中的关键设计维度，包括权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构和噪声调度，最终确定了一套实用的训练配方。

Result: 所提出的配方使像素空间模型在性能上匹配或超越潜空间对应模型，同时实现3.18到4.75倍的端到端推理速度提升。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了像素空间生成研究的有用实证洞察和实践指南，验证了潜空间到像素空间的两阶段训练策略是大规模像素空间扩散模型的一种有效且高效的路径。

Abstract: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [220] [Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16416)
*Sofoklis Kitharidis,Cor J. Veenman,Jan N. van Rijn,Thomas Bäck,Niki van Stein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LACE是首个将通用表格型pipeline AutoML表述为对完整可执行Python程序进行搜索的框架。它通过演化循环维护一个scikit-learn兼容Python类的种群，LLM作为变异算子。在68个OpenML分类任务上，LACE（GPT-5.4-mini）显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线，与最强搜索系统AutoGluon无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AutoML系统只在预先指定的算子、学习器和超参数空间内搜索管线，无法产生该空间之外的结构。作者希望突破这一限制，使AutoML能够搜索完整的可执行pipeline程序，从而让搜索空间本身由代码定义，而非预定义的组件集合。

Method: LACE采用演化算法循环，维护一个scikit-learn兼容Python类的种群，使用大型语言模型（GPT-5.4-mini）作为变异算子。搜索在泄漏控制协议下进行（对生成器隐藏数据集身份），每个候选都是普通Python代码，因此返回的pipeline和搜索过程可直接检查和编辑。组件集可通过编辑提示词而非框架本身来扩展。

Result: 在68个OpenML分类任务上，LACE显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线，与AutoGluon无显著差异（AutoGluon为评估中最强的搜索系统），并完整覆盖基准。更新的表格基础模型在它们支持的任务子集上更准确，但使用固定的预训练预测器而非返回可编辑的任务特定程序。

Conclusion: LACE的核心贡献不在于原始精度，而在于用代码定义的搜索空间：提供完整的基准覆盖、可直接复用和编辑的pipeline，以及通过修改提示词而非框架本身来扩展组件集的能力。

Abstract: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.

</details>


### [221] [Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14556)
*Dongzhe Zheng,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RHMP（黎曼Hodge消息传递）将网格物理场中的拓扑与几何分离：固定由定向关联决定的胞腔上边界算子（d_k），同时学习对称正定余链度量（H_k）用于几何相关传播。通过在Hodge块中施加余链框架等变性，实现了精确的复形恒等式、非负Hodge能量、半正定算子及阿贝尔曲率不变性。在涵盖流体、电磁、规范场和可变网格CFD的七个物理基准上达到最佳整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经代理模型往往在无约束的消息传递中将拓扑与几何角色混为一谈。然而物理场的守恒律本质上是拓扑的（应当精确保持），而几何、材料响应和各向异性耦合应从数据中学习。作者认为需要一种架构原则来明确分离这两种角色。

Method: RHMP将拓扑-几何分离确立为架构原则：固定细胞复形上由定向关联确定的边界算子d_k，学习对称正定余链度量H_k用于几何相关传播。将H_k视为学习度量，推导出余链框架等变性——物理传播应对隐藏余链特征基的正交变换保持不变。实现采用度量加权Hodge块（d_k^T H_{k+1} d_k），从而获得精确的复形恒等式（d_{k+1}d_k=0）、非负Hodge能量、半正定算子以及精确的阿贝尔曲率不变性。

Result: 在七个物理基准任务（涵盖流体、电磁学、规范场和可变网格CFD）上，RHMP取得了最佳整体性能，且在拓扑、学习几何与场结构相互作用的场景中增益最为显著。

Conclusion: 将拓扑精确性与学习几何通过Hodge框架分离，不仅从理论上保证了守恒律等基本物理恒等式，还显著提升了神经替代模型在多种物理基准上的预测性能，验证了该架构原则的有效性。

Abstract: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.

</details>


### [222] [Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14563)
*Rivaan Patil,Simon Dennis,Hao Guo,Kevin Shabahang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FPO（Forward-Pass-Only MLP训练）是一种无需反向传播即可适配大语言模型的新方法，仅通过前向传播在输出层计算单一误差信号并应用于目标层，实现2.7-3.2倍的微调吞吐量提升、约40%的峰值训练内存降低，同时在域外基准上保持与基线种子噪声相当的稳定性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准全网络微调需要构建自动求导图并通过模型主体进行反向传播，计算开销大且内存占用高，且其域外性能不如FPO那样稳定可复现。作者希望找到一种更高效且更稳定的LLM适配方法，其核心假设来源于一个经验观察：在transformer的后期层中，输出层的预测误差与真实梯度的余弦相似度可达0.47-0.59。

Method: FPO基于单一经验观察——transformer后期层的输出预测误差近似真实梯度。方法包括：(1) 引入一个两分钟的逐层诊断，量化每层的近似程度并确定后期层适配的可行性；(2) 在输出层计算单一误差信号，直接应用于每个目标层；(3) 层间不传播任何信号，全程不构建autograd图。相比局部化SFT（仅训练目标层），FPO仍是更快的选择。

Result: 在三个模型家族（OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-8B、Falcon3-7B）上评估，FPO均实现了域内困惑度改善，并将MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag、Winogrande保持在与基线种子噪声相当的范围内。吞吐量为标准微调的2.7-3.2倍，峰值训练内存降低约40%。相比局部化SFT（2.2倍墙钟开销），FPO更为高效。

Conclusion: FPO证明了仅前向传播即可有效适配大语言模型，是一种既高效又在域外性能上高度稳定的训练方案。其关键贡献在于发现了后期层预测误差与真实梯度的高度近似性，并通过无需反向传播和自动求导图的设计简化了训练流程。

Abstract: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.

</details>


### [223] [Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14570)
*Wen Ye,Muyan Weng,Chuizheng Meng,Hao Niu,Yizhou Zhang,Yan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MR-Traj是一个新颖的多分辨率扩散框架，用于大规模合成轨迹生成。它将轨迹显式建模为粗粒度里程碑和细粒度片段的组合，从而在多个时空分辨率下捕捉复杂依赖关系。实验表明，其在全局分布相似性上达到与最先进方法相当的性能，同时在细粒度移动模式建模和下游城市移动任务上持续超越现有方法，并通过多分辨率随机性降低轨迹链接风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于隐私顾虑，大规模公开轨迹数据有限，阻碍了下游移动性分析。现有合成轨迹生成方法主要关注全局分布相似性匹配，而忽略了在实际应用中至关重要的跨时空分辨率的移动模式。

Method: 提出MR-Traj，一种多分辨率扩散框架，将轨迹显式建模为粗粒度里程碑（coarse-grained milestones）与细粒度片段（fine-grained segments）的组合，通过多分辨率层次实现复杂时空依赖的捕捉，并在多分辨率层面引入随机性以增强轨迹多样性。

Result: MR-Traj在全局分布相似性上与最先进方法表现相当，在细粒度移动模式建模和下游城市移动任务上持续超越基线；同时生成的轨迹更多样，在种子引导的数据发布设置下有效降低了轨迹链接风险。

Conclusion: MR-Traj通过多分辨率扩散建模，在保持全局分布保真度的同时显著提升了细粒度移动模式的建模能力与轨迹多样性，兼顾了数据效用与隐私风险缓解，为大规模合成轨迹生成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

</details>


### [224] [Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14594)
*Dhairysheel Durgule*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对Fashion-MNIST上卷积神经网络的PGD攻击进行轨迹级分析，发现平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐模式在不同鲁棒性的对抗训练模型间难以区分，而steps-to-failure分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性等级。轨迹级诊断应作为补充工具而非替代标准鲁棒性度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PGD攻击通常仅通过最终对抗准确率评估鲁棒性，无法捕捉攻击全过程的模型行为。虽然已有研究提出轨迹级诊断（如损失演化、梯度对齐、steps-to-failure），但这些诊断指标是否可靠地指示鲁棒性强度尚不明确，需要系统验证。

Method: 在Fashion-MNIST上训练干净模型和多种对抗训练模型，涵盖不同鲁棒性等级。使用20步PGD攻击，采用随机初始化和多次重启进行鲁棒性测量，并以单初始化记录完整PGD轨迹。对每个模型的3000个干净正确样本记录完整轨迹，分析损失演化、梯度对齐和失败时间（steps-to-failure）三类指标。

Result: 不同模型间存在清晰的鲁棒性层级，但各轨迹指标对鲁棒性识别的贡献不均衡。平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐模式在不同对抗训练模型间量化上相似，即使这些模型具有明显不同的鲁棒准确率。相反，steps-to-failure分布能够更清晰地区分不同鲁棒性等级，直接反映对对抗扰动的功能性抵抗。

Conclusion: 轨迹级诊断描述的是优化几何特性，但不能独立衡量对抗鲁棒性。其可解释性取决于鲁棒性等级、攻击强度和多指标评估的组合。轨迹级分析应作为辅助诊断工具并结合上下文解读，而非替代标准鲁棒性度量。

Abstract: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.

</details>


### [225] [DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14614)
*Zeyu Cao,Xuan Guo,Cheng Zhang,Cheuk Hang Lau,Ilia Shumailov,Yiren Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实际构建并运行一年一个128-GPU的"垃圾场集群"（DumpsterCluster），仅使用二手组件，以22K美元的成本（远低于60万美元的8-GPU B200系统）实现了具有竞争力的LLaMA-70B推理吞吐量。然而，研究发现二手GPU的环境可持续性高度依赖部署条件：在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统的单token碳排放量对8B模型约为当前硬件的4倍，对70B模型超过40倍。只有结合廉价电力和清洁能源，二手GPU的重利用才在总拥有成本和环境两个维度上均具可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心退役大量仍具计算能力的GPU并流入二手市场，但关于这些二手加速器能否有效用于现代LLM推理、以及在何种条件下这种再利用在经济和环境上可行的系统性研究仍然缺乏。作者希望通过实证研究填补这一空白。

Method: 作者从零开始仅使用二手组件物理构建了一个128-GPU的DumpsterCluster，并连续运行一年进行实证测试。基于V100 GPU，通过流水线并行优化实现LLaMA-70B推理，并对不同模型规模（8B和70B）下的吞吐量、能耗、总拥有成本和碳排放进行多维度对比分析。

Result: DumpsterCluster成本为22K美元，远低于8-GPU B200系统的600K美元。V100集群在流水线并行优化下LLaMA-70B吞吐量具有竞争力，验证了生产可行性。但旧GPU的单token能耗显著更高：在电网平均碳强度下，8B模型碳排放约为当前硬件的4倍，70B模型超过40倍。总拥有成本仅在电价低廉地区具有优势。

Conclusion: GPU的"第二生命"并非普遍可持续——硬件再利用必须与低碳能源战略性地结合。在能源经济性和清洁电力兼备的地区，二手GPU为扩展AI算力提供了一条兼顾可负担性、能源安全和环境责任的可实现路径。

Abstract: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

</details>


### [226] [Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14617)
*Surya Saka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文测试了将多种不确定性工具（证据图+信念传播、贝叶斯几率更新、Dempster-Shafer融合、保形预测）融合成统一流水线用于法律案件结果预测的做法，基于1,000个欧洲人权法院真实案件和约4,750次测试，发现融合流水线在预测精度上并不优于直接使用前沿LLM，反而会通过先验失配机制使校准误差翻倍，Dempster-Shafer融合在长链场景下甚至不安全。其真正价值在于操作性层面：通过保形选择预测层实现自动放行与人工升级分流，调优后可达到96.8%自动放行准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律AI领域频繁提出将多种不确定性工具融合成单一流水线以改进案件结果预测的设想，但缺乏系统性的实证检验。作者希望考察这种融合方案是否真正有效，以及它在预测能力和操作价值上的实际表现。

Method: 在1,000个来自LexGLUE和FairLex的欧洲人权法院真实案件中，比较三种证据估计方法（原始LLM、经融合流水线路由的LLM、经同一流水线的词频基线），使用两种前沿LLM（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5）作为逐事实证据估计器，通过AUROC、ECE等指标评估预测性能，并测试保形选择性预测层的操作分流效果。

Result: (1) 在歧视案件上，流水线相对原始LLM和基线均无改进，直接使用前沿LLM是最强判别器；(2) 将LLM与贝叶斯几率+DS融合朴素组合会使校准误差翻倍（ECE从0.16增至0.46），且该先验失配机制在两个模型上均复现；(3) DS融合在长链上不安全，会以低于随机水平的准确率自信地给出错误标签，建议移除；(4) 流水线的真实价值在操作层面：经保形选择预测层分流后，调优引擎以96.8%准确率自动放行，0.5%错误漏出，96.3%被捕获转入人工审查，优于未调优基线（85.9/3.8/72.1）。

Conclusion: 此类不确定性融合流水线在法律领域的贡献在于提供经校准的信任（calibrated trust），而非更锐利的预测能力。直接使用前沿LLM在判别力上已然最强，融合工具的价值体现在操作分流和风险控制层面，而非预测精度层面。

Abstract: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

</details>


### [227] [PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14619)
*Yuan Guo,Hanshu Chen,Zhuojia Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的可解释神经算子框架PIKFNO，通过将来自控制方程的物理信息核函数显式嵌入神经算子架构中，约束主干网络使其与无网格配点法中的核展开对齐，从而在有限训练数据下实现高预测精度、显著提升的可解释性和更强的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性且与物理机理脱节；而经典数值方法（如无网格配点法）虽具有物理一致性但缺乏灵活性。如何将物理知识显式融入神经算子架构以提高可解释性和数据效率是核心动机。

Method: PIKFNO框架包含两种核函数构造策略：(1) 直接从数据中学习核函数，将学习到的核视为非奇异基本解；(2) 通过解析基本解的变换来构建核函数。这些物理信息核函数被用于约束DeepONet类架构中的主干（trunk）网络，使其算子结构对齐meshless collocation方法中的核展开形式。

Result: 数值实验表明，PIKFNO在保持高预测精度的同时，显著提升了模型的可解释性，并在有限训练数据条件下展现出优于传统神经算子的泛化性能。

Conclusion: PIKFNO为构建高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了一条新路径，弥合了深度学习与经典数值方法之间的鸿沟，对科学计算与机器学习交叉领域具有重要参考价值。

Abstract: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

</details>


### [228] [Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14620)
*Jasmina Gajcin,Juan C. Rosero,Ivana Dusparic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了EARL，一个用于强化学习（RL）系统中生成反事实解释的Python库。该库通过探索"假设"（What-if）场景来比较可能的结果，从而阐明智能体行为，并在真实的自适应系统中展示其适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度RL策略依赖神经网络，缺乏透明性，难以理解，导致用户信任度下降和系统验证困难。现有的RL反事实解释实现通常局限于玩具示例和基准测试，缺乏在真实自适应系统中的应用支持。

Method: EARL库通过反事实解释（counterfactual explanations）方法，允许用户探索"假设"场景（What-if scenarios），通过比较可能的输出来澄清智能体行为，并支持在基于RL的自适应系统中生成反事实解释。

Result: 论文在CitiBikes（一个自适应共享单车系统）仿真中展示了EARL的实用性，并提供了其在真实应用中的性能评估。

Conclusion: EARL填补了RL反事实解释在真实自适应系统中的应用空白，为提升RL系统的可解释性和用户信任提供了可行的工具支持。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.

</details>


### [229] [Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14634)
*Isabelle Aguilar,Zayn Andre Zainal,Omid Kavehei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出SynGAP，一种基于自适应梯度预条件（adaptive gradient preconditioning）的任务无关持续学习框架。它通过维护Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均来模拟生物突触元可塑性（metaplasticity），在优化过程中用有界乘法掩码对梯度进行预条件处理，选择性地衰减对关键历史参数的更新，从而在不依赖任务标签且内存开销低的情况下缓解灾难性遗忘。在Split CIFAR-100和CORe50基准上显著优于EWC++、Experience Replay等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物智能通过互补学习系统（CLS）理论和突触元可塑性自然地避免灾难性遗忘，而人工神经网络在非平稳环境中面临稳定性-可塑性困境。现有解决方案要么需要任务标签，要么产生巨大的内存开销，偏离生物现实。作者希望将局部化的突触元可塑性重新构架为优化驱动的过程，提出一种任务无关、内存高效且符合生物机制的持续学习方案。

Method: SynGAP维护一个数据连续流上Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均，从而实时模拟突触元可塑性。在优化步骤中，这些动态元可塑性状态被转化为一个有界乘法掩码，对原始梯度进行预条件处理，选择性地衰减对关键历史参数的重要更新的影响。整个框架是任务无关的（task-free），无需显式的情节性触发机制。

Result: 在Split CIFAR-100基准上，SynGAP相比EWC++将准确率提升了4倍，相比Experience Replay（ER）提升了近10%，对两者的遗忘度量（forgetting measure）均降低了超过10%。在CORe50基准上达到约68%的准确率，相比优化器基线提升了10%。

Conclusion: 通过将连续生物元可塑性数学形式化为稳定的基于梯度的正则化，SynGAP提供了一种高度鲁棒且内存高效的持续学习解决方案，特别适合边缘设备的自适应智能场景。实验证明了其在缓解灾难性遗忘方面的优越性，同时避免了任务标签依赖和大量额外内存开销。

Abstract: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. Rather than relying on explicit episodic triggers, SynGAP simulates real-time metaplasticity by maintaining an exponential moving average of the Fisher Information Matrix over a continuous data stream. During the optimization step, these dynamic metaplastic states are translated into a bounded multiplicative mask that preconditions raw gradients, selectively attenuating updates to critical historical parameters. Empirical evaluations demonstrate SynGAP's superior ability to mitigate catastrophic forgetting compared to established baselines. On the Split CIFAR-100 benchmark, SynGAP delivers a $4\times$ increase in accuracy compared to EWC++ and outperforms Experience Replay (ER) by almost $10\%$, while reducing the forgetting measure by over $10\%$ against both methods. Furthermore, on the CORe50 benchmark, SynGAP achieves about $68\%$, a $10\%$ improvement over optimizer baselines. By mathematically formalizing continuous biological metaplasticity as stable gradient-based regularization, SynGAP offers a highly robust and memory-efficient solution for adaptive intelligence at the edge.

</details>


### [230] [Fractional Optimizers Meet Fractal Activation Functions: An Empirical Study of Multi-Scale Optimization in Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14636)
*Sebastian Raubitzek,Georg Goldenits,Sebastian Schrittwieser,Philip König,Kevin Mallinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一实验框架下研究了分数阶优化器与分形激活函数这两类独立改进神经网络训练技术之间的相互作用，发现在十个分类数据集和多个基准面上，它们存在有用但选择性的配对关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数阶优化器利用分数阶导数和记忆效应扩展一阶优化，而分形激活函数基于自相似Weierstrass和Blancmange型函数引入多尺度非线性表示。这两类技术此前分别被研究，但它们的交互作用尚未被系统探讨。

Method: 在Ackley和Himmelblau基准面上验证分数阶优化器家族（标准形式及Weierstrass型扰动），随后在具有常规和分形激活函数的前馈神经网络上，对十个分类数据集进行比较，涵盖标准方法、正则化风格优化器、显式和自适应记忆分数阶优化器及其他代表性文献方法。

Result: 分数阶优化与分形激活在大多数情况下显示出有用但选择性的配对。正则化风格的分数阶缩放与选定的分形激活在网络训练中表现良好，而Grünwald-Letnikov记忆在扰动表面上最具相关性。自适应记忆在多个场景下优于普通记忆替换。

Conclusion: 受控的分数阶记忆是一个有前景的研究方向，但不应被视为普适替代方案，其效果取决于具体的优化器-激活函数配对。

Abstract: Fractional optimization methods and fractal activation functions are two independent directions for improving neural network training. Fractional optimizers extend first-order optimization through fractional derivatives and memory effects, whereas fractal activations introduce multi-scale nonlinear representations based on self-similar Weierstrass- and Blancmange-type functions. Here, we investigate their interaction within a unified experimental framework. We evaluate fractional optimizer families on Ackley and Himmelblau benchmark surfaces, in standard form and with additive Weierstrass-type perturbations, and then in feed-forward neural networks with conventional and fractal activations on ten classification datasets. The comparison includes standard methods, regularization-style optimizers, explicit and adaptive memory-based fractional optimizers, and other representative literature methods. Overall, fractional optimization and fractal activations show useful but selective pairings. Regularization-style fractional scaling performs well with selected fractal activations in network training, while Grünwald--Letnikov memory is most relevant on perturbed surfaces. Adaptive memory improves plain memory substitution in several cases, supporting controlled fractional memory as a promising direction rather than a universal replacement.

</details>


### [231] [Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14637)
*Suyang Zhuang,Zekun Jiang,Tianhang Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了FlowBD-E1，一个早期循环生成式预测框架，仅利用前9个充放电循环就能预测工业33kW铁铬液流电池整个生命周期（剩余280个循环）的完整充电V/I轨迹，实现了0.731%的联合MAPE和低于1%的SOH估计误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期固定式储能需要能够在显著容量损失累积之前检测退化的电池。铁铬液流电池因使用丰富且低成本活性物质而具吸引力，但受慢铬动力学、析氢、膜交叉和电解液失衡等耦合过程影响，这些过程会逐渐重塑充电V/I轨迹。然而多数电池预测研究聚焦锂离子电池或将老化压缩为标量容量/SOH标签，缺乏对完整轨迹演化的早期预测能力。

Method: FlowBD-E1框架由多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期Transformer和年龄感知FiLM解码器组成。比较了三种部署策略：单步潜在外推（SLE）、递归潜在预测（RLF）和教师强制更新（TFU），仅利用第一9个循环预测整个剩余生命周期的V/I轨迹。

Result: 使用289个循环中的前9个，RLF策略在全生命周期上的联合V/I MAPE为0.731%，SOH估计误差低于1% MAPE。消融和独立序列测试表明，年龄感知生成式架构优于LSTM和TCN基线，并在工业验证下保持亚百分比误差。

Conclusion: 早期循环轨迹生成可以将短暂的调试记录转化为液流电池管理的长期诊断信号，验证了通过少量循环预测完整退化轨迹的可行性。

Abstract: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. The model combines a multi-scale convolutional encoder, a lifecycle Transformer and an age-aware FiLM decoder, and we compare three deployment strategies: single-step latent extrapolation (SLE), recursive latent forecasting (RLF) and teacher-forced updating (TFU). Using the first 9 of 289 cycles, RLF achieved a joint V/I mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.731% over the remaining lifecycle and produced SOH estimates below 1% MAPE. Ablation and independent-sequence tests showed that the age-aware generative architecture outperformed LSTM and TCN baselines and retained sub-percent errors under industrial validation. These results suggest that early-cycle trajectory generation can turn a short commissioning record into a long-horizon diagnostic signal for flow-battery management.

</details>


### [232] [Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14638)
*Leonid Berlyand,Roman Sarapin,Yitzchak Shmalo,Victor Slavin,Sasha Sodin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了自编码器的定点性质，通过收缩性分析其稳定性，并引入了局部和全局的"混沌边缘"（Edge-of-Chaos）概念，分别利用随机矩阵理论的谱技术和高斯过程的Sudakov-Fernique不等式进行分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自编码器作为一类特殊的深度神经网络，其性能可通过定点来刻画，但关于定点存在性、稳定性及吸引盆的问题尚未得到系统研究。同时，Edge-of-Chaos概念虽然已被广泛引入各类神经网络，但尚未针对自编码器进行专门适配和理论分析。

Method: 首先利用自编码器的收缩性质来分析其定点的存在性、稳定性与吸引盆；然后分别定义局部和全局Edge-of-Chaos以控制局部（小）和全局（任意）输入扰动；局部EoC的分析采用随机矩阵理论（RMT）的谱技术，全局EoC则借助高斯过程的Sudakov-Fernique不等式。

Result: 提出了适用于自编码器的局部和全局Edge-of-Chaos概念，并通过随机矩阵理论和高斯过程两种数学工具分别建立了相应的理论分析框架。

Conclusion: 该研究为自编码器在临界初始化状态下的稳定性提供了理论基础，将Edge-of-Chaos概念从均值场平均方法推广到了自编码器的定点稳定性分析中，并建立了与非线性随机矩阵理论的联系。

Abstract: In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos.
  Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a randomly initialized network. Initialization at or near this critical regime offers several theoretical and practical advantages, including stability of the network w.r.t. perturbations of the input. EoC was previously introduced for broad classes of neural networks using mean-field averaging methods. In this paper we modify the notion of EoC for the study of autoencoders. Specifically, we introduce local and global EoC for autoencoders that control local (small) and global (arbitrary) perturbations of the input respectively.
  The study of stability of autoencoders falls within the scope of nonlinear problems in Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Our analysis of local EoC is based on spectral techniques of RMT, whereas global EoC is studied by employing Sudakov-Fernique inequality for Gaussian processes.

</details>


### [233] [Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14639)
*Bhaskar Gurram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究文档抽取系统中"按字段接受/审查"的选择性风险控制问题。在13,859个真实claude-sonnet-5字段上诊断出三个失败模式（文档聚类、分数重拟合泄漏、并列质量病理），并提出"效度阶梯"框架——从拟合/验证分割协议（期望风险控制）、Mondrian学习-检验（逐组PAC证书）到支持箱分类法（逐层严格），在不同严格度层级提供对应的风险保证形式。经验证，更严格的层级虽提供了诚实但近乎空洞的保证，而宽松层级在实践中虽有效但并非证书。研究还进行了冻结配置确认与三标注者人类金标审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档抽取系统需要一种"信任契约"：仅在受控错误率（风险≤α）下接受字段。自然的置信度程序在真实文档上会静默违反这一契约，导致接受的字段可能携带不可控的错误率。作者旨在诊断这一违反的来源并系统性地组织修复方案，使选择性风险控制从经验性技巧升级为有形式的保证。

Method: 方法包含三层"效度阶梯"：(1) 拟合/验证分割协议，恢复期望选择性风险控制的点估计；(2) Mondrian Learn-then-Test（LTT）结合精确二项尾分布，在不同分组（字段-iid、聚类校正、文档-iid）下产生逐组PAC（可能近似正确）证书；(3) 支持箱（provenance taxonomy）分类法，作为预指定框架在每层严格度上进行比较。同时进行冻结配置（selection-untouched）确认和盲法三标注者人类金标审计。

Result: 诊断出三个失败模式：文档聚类（设计效应1.84-2.45）、分数重拟合泄漏（覆盖率0.416而风险0.127，违反α=0.10）、并列质量病理（简并分数崩溃阈值网格，覆盖率从0.030降至0.001）。修复后：fit/val分割协议实现覆盖率0.318/风险0.096（生产变体0.326）；Mondrian LTT产生逐组PAC证书（field-iid 0.171/风险0.068，聚类校正0.140，doc-iid 0.060）。支持箱在各严格度层获胜（p<1e-4, Bonferroni校正），但在haiku/qwen上不复制。人类审计验证实际层级风险1.3%对预算10%（Fleiss' kappa=0.83）。

Conclusion: 结论：宽松层级（分割协议）提供的是"平均点估计"而非证书，实现风险在47.5%的重新分割中超过α；PAC层级提供诚实的保证但当前近乎空洞（文档级仅0.060覆盖率）。支持箱在特定模型/语料上的胜利不可迁移。核心启示：效度与保证形式之间必须明确取舍，生产者应声明并匹配其保证层级；需要更高精度评分模型才能使严格证书层级实际可用。代码以Apache-2.0开源。

Abstract: Per-field accept/review with selective risk at most alpha -- accept a field only if the error rate among accepted fields is controlled -- is the trust contract document-extraction systems need, and the natural procedure silently violates it on real documents. On 13,859 genuine claude-sonnet-5 fields from 800 CORD receipts (49.0% correct) we diagnose three failure modes: document clustering (design effect 1.84-2.45), score-refit leakage (coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127, violating alpha=0.10 in 95% of splits), and a tie-mass pathology (a degenerate score collapses the threshold grid, 0.030 to 0.001). We organize the fixes as a validity ladder, guarantee form stated per tier. A fit/val split protocol restores expected-selective-risk control for a learned fusion: coverage 0.318 at risk 0.096 at nominal alpha=0.10, no tolerance band (production variant 0.326) -- an on-average point whose realized risk exceeds alpha in 47.5% of resplits, not a certificate. Mondrian Learn-then-Test with exact binomial tails yields per-group PAC certificates: field-iid 0.171 at risk 0.068, cluster-corrected 0.140, doc-iid 0.060 -- the only tier matching documents, honestly near-vacuous today. Support-bin, the pre-specified provenance taxonomy, wins every rigor tier on the sonnet CORD capture (p<1e-4, Bonferroni-corrected) -- a win that does not replicate on the same documents under haiku or qwen -- while on higher-accuracy corpora pooled thresholds win: conditioning helps exactly where pooled cannot certify, subsumed by a learned score elsewhere. A frozen-configuration confirmation on selection-untouched claude-haiku-4-5 held at both risk levels, and a blind three-annotator human-gold audit verifies the practical tier's accepted-set risk at 1.3% against its 10% budget (Fleiss' kappa=0.83; labels err one-sidedly pessimistic). Released Apache-2.0 with seed-pinned, regression-gated procedures.

</details>


### [234] [BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14640)
*An Vuong,Chen Zhao,Jin Hu,Shui-Qing Yu,Xintao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个机器学习框架,用于高效构建和预测堆叠双层材料的结构与性质。该框架使用MatterSim-D3的结构优化流程,从单层单元和堆叠构型生成DFT质量的双层结构,并引入BDIP-Net图神经网络,通过交互特异性势表示和自适应消息融合,显式建模层内与层间相互作用,在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 堆叠双层材料具有丰富的堆叠依赖性质,源于强层内键合与弱层间范德华相互作用的耦合。然而,准确的结构生成通常依赖昂贵的DFT优化,而现有机器学习模型在性质预测时往往不能显式区分不同类型的相互作用,导致计算成本高且预测精度受限。

Method: 提出一个两阶段机器学习框架:(1)基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化流程,以显著降低的计算代价从单层积木块和堆叠构型生成DFT质量的双层结构;(2)提出BDIP-Net图神经网络,通过交互特异性的势能表示和自适应消息融合机制,显式建模层内与层间两类相互作用。

Result: 在BiDB(同质双层)、HetDB(异质双层)和SAMBA(扭转双层)三个数据集上的评估表明,MatterSim-D3流程能够紧密复现DFT-PBE-D3优化的结构;BDIP-Net在双层性质预测任务上持续优于现有的图神经网络和基于势能的方法。

Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了双层材料计算发现中结构生成成本高和模型无法区分交互类型两大挑战,为堆叠双层材料的高效计算筛选和性质预测提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

</details>


### [235] [Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14642)
*Prabhjyot Singh,Majid Ghasemi,Mark Crowley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习智能体在伦理行为训练中的核心问题：单一奖励信号下智能体会利用奖励与意图之间的差距，导致伦理违规在少数糟糕回合中集中爆发而均值上看似合规。作者在Craftax基准上比较了四种训练方法（标量惩罚+终止、线性多目标权重扫描、自适应Lagrangian约束、非补偿性ESR效用优化），发现在均值前沿上四种方法难以区分，但按回合粒度评估时差异显著：ESR方法能严格保证每回合约一次违规的预算，而其他方法在恶劣回合中严重超限。作者论证当伦理违规不能跨回合平均抵消时，训练和评估都应针对回合级分布而非均值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习智能体在单一奖励信号下会利用奖励设计与预期行为之间的差距，这在伦理行为训练中尤为严重。一个智能体可以在平均意义上看起来符合伦理，但将违规集中在少数恶劣回合中，而一个回合中对环境中生物造成的伤害无法通过另一回合的良好行为来弥补。现有训练方法缺乏对回合级（而非均值级）伦理保证的比较和评估。

Method: 在Craftax（开放世界生存基准）上比较四种伦理训练方法：(1) 带终止的标量惩罚；(2) 线性多目标权重扫描；(3) 自适应Lagrangian约束；(4) 在ESR（期望标量化回报）准则下按回合优化的非补偿性效用。所有方法在统一的基于检测器的协议下评估，该协议对每回合的每次违规都计数，不进行删截。此外设置观测增强对照实验，以分离训练目标与观测信息的影响。

Result: 在平均回报对平均违规率的前沿上，四种方法难以区分；但按回合粒度评估时差异显著。在匹配的平均回报下：ESR智能体在几乎所有回合中维持其规定的每回合一次违规预算（最差十分位1.04±0.07），Lagrangian方法泄漏超出预算（1.14±0.03），权重扫描的最差回合加倍超限（2.20±0.20）。观测增强对照表明分离来自训练目标而非观测内容，且回合级保证在平均前沿上不产生额外成本。

Conclusion: 当伦理违规不能跨回合平均化抵消时，训练和评估都必须针对回合级分布而非均值。非补偿性、按回合优化的目标（如ESR）能提供更强且可保证的回合级伦理约束，而依赖均值优化的方法虽然在前沿上看似等价，但在恶劣回合中会显著违背伦理预算。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods are indistinguishable; per episode they separate sharply. At matched mean return, the ESR agent holds its stated budget of one violation in effectively every episode (worst-decile 1.04 +/- 0.07 violations), the Lagrangian leaks past the same budget (1.14 +/- 0.03), and the weight sweep's worst episodes double it (2.20 +/- 0.20). An observation-augmentation control attributes the separation to the training objective rather than to what the agent observes, and the per-episode guarantee costs nothing on the mean frontier. When ethical violations do not average away across episodes, we argue both training and evaluation must target the per-episode distribution rather than the mean.

</details>


### [236] [DUET: Dual-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Same-Weight Disagreement for Prohibition Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14644)
*Zihan Li,Feifei Li,Wenhui Que*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DUET，一种针对LLM运行时禁令合规的令牌级选择性on-policy蒸馏方法。通过对"看到禁令的教师"与"看不到禁令的教师"的逐令牌分歧来隔离禁令的因果效应，驱动信号清洗与偏好导向学习两个机制，实现令牌粒度的DPO式优化。在工业基准与SysBench上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景中LLM部署依赖运行时注入的禁令（企业策略、PII红线、工具边界），这些禁令每次请求、每个租户都不同。传统后训练方法结构性不匹配：SFT将违规信号隐藏在合规标签中，DPO的序列级偏好无法匹配令牌级违规。需要一种能捕捉禁令因果效应并支持令牌级学习的对齐方法。

Method: DUET成对使用两个同权重教师：一个看到禁令（阳性），一个看不到（阴性）。二者仅因禁令可见性不同产生的逐令牌分歧可隔离禁令的因果效应，提供干净监督信号。该分歧驱动两个互补机制：(1)信号清洗——丢弃协议令牌（冗余或前缀污染）；(2)偏好导向学习——以令牌粒度将学生推离阴性教师、拉向阳性教师，将DPO式优化直接嵌入OPD，无需离线偏好数据。

Result: 在涵盖显式拒绝、改述鲁棒性与过度拒绝等五个任务族的工业禁令合规基准上，1.5B-8B Qwen系列上DUET实现72.3-85.2%违规合规率，同时保持88-93%正常效用，大幅超越教师模型与其他蒸馏基线。SysBench外部评估确认安全对齐提升且GSM8K与MATH-500仅最小退化。

Conclusion: DUET通过令牌选择性蒸馏将禁令的因果监督信号与模型容量/失配噪声分离，实现了令牌级偏好优化与运行时禁令合规的有效结合，验证了蒸馏范式在动态、按请求变化的合规约束下的可行性。

Abstract: Real-world LLM deployments increasingly rely on runtime-injected prohibitions--enterprise policies, PII redlines, tool boundaries--that vary per request and per tenant. Conventional post-training is structurally ill-suited: SFT hides the violation signal in compliant labels, and DPO's sequence-level preferences mismatch token-localized violations. We propose DUET, a token-selective on-policy distillation method for prohibition compliance. DUET pairs a teacher that sees the prohibition (positive) with an identical-weight teacher that does not (negative). Because the two teachers differ only in prohibition visibility, their per-token disagreement isolates the prohibition's causal effect--yielding a clean supervision signal uncontaminated by model capacity or mismatch. This disagreement drives two complementary mechanisms: signal cleaning, which discards agreement tokens as redundant or prefix-corrupted, and preference-directed learning, which pushes the student away from the negative teacher and toward the positive one at token granularity, embedding DPO-style optimization directly into OPD without offline preference data. We construct an industrial Prohibition-Compliance benchmark spanning five task families covering explicit-refusal, paraphrase robustness, and over-refusal. Across 1.5B-8B Qwen variants, DUET achieves 72.3-85.2% violation compliance while preserving 88-93% normal utility, dramatically outperforming teacher model and other distillation baselines. External evaluation on SysBench confirms improved safety alignment with minimal degradation on GSM8K and MATH-500.

</details>


### [237] [Efficient Neural-Network-Based High-Resolution Radiative Transfer for CO___ Retrieval, and Application to Interferometric Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14645)
*Jordan Lontsi Tedongmo,Yann Ferrec,Laurence Croizé,Pablo Musé,Gabriele Facciolo,Andrés Almansa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种基于前馈多层感知机（MLP）的辐射传输（RT）代理模型，用于在SCARBOn项目的NanoCarb成像干涉仪框架下高效精确地预测CO2弱吸收带的星载顶部大气（TOA）辐亮度。该代理模型结合辐亮度与RT雅可比矩阵的MAE损失约束，并耦合NanoCarb仪器响应，为CO2浓度反演提供了高效且精确的正演模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化研究需要降低CO2和CH4排放估算的不确定性，以更好区分人为与自然排放源，这推动了具有更高重访频率和空间覆盖的星载观测需求。然而，全物理反演算法依赖重复的高分辨率辐射传输模拟，逐线RT模型计算成本极高，成为高频次、大范围CO2浓度反演的主要瓶颈。

Method: 提出一种前馈多层感知机（MLP）代理模型用于替代传统的逐线RT模型。模型采用结合辐亮度与RT雅可比矩阵的联合MAE损失函数进行训练，以同时保持光谱精度和对地球物理参数的敏感性。训练后的MLP代理模型与NanoCarb干涉仪的仪器响应函数耦合，构建完整的快速正演模型。

Result: 将MLP-based RT代理模型与NanoCarb仪器响应耦合后，得到了高效且精确的NanoCarb测量正演模型，在CO2浓度反演中展现出有前景的结果，验证了该代理方法在保证精度的同时大幅降低计算成本的有效性。

Conclusion: MLP代理RT模型是替代逐线RT模拟的可行方案，可在保证光谱精度与物理敏感性的前提下显著提升计算效率，为低轨卫星星座实现高频次、大范围CO2监测提供了关键技术支撑。

Abstract: Studying climate change requires reducing uncertainties in CO2 and CH4 emission estimates to better distinguish anthropogenic from natural sources, which motivates spaceborne measurements with improved revisit frequency and spatial coverage. In this context, the Horizon Europe SCARBOn project assesses a low-cost satellite constellation featuring the NanoCarb imaging interferometer as its core sensor for monitoring CO2 and CH4 emissions in the atmosphere. However, estimating CO2 and CH4 concentrations with high revisit and spatial coverage poses significant challenges: full-physics retrieval algorithms commonly used rely on repeated high-resolution radiative transfer (RT) simulations, which are computationally expensive when using line-by-line RT models. As an alternative, we propose in this study a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) surrogate designed to accurately and efficiently predict top-of-atmosphere radiances in the CO2 weak band, using a combined mean absolute error (MAE) loss on radiances and RT Jacobians to preserve both spectral accuracy and sensitivity to geophysical parameters. Coupling the MLP-based RT surrogate with the NanoCarb instrumental response yields an efficient and precise forward model for NanoCarb measurements, which shows promising results for CO2 concentration retrieval.

</details>


### [238] [iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14646)
*Xiaowei Jiang,Daniel Leong,Beining Cao,Nan Zhou,Yingtao Ren,Yu-Cheng Chang,Thomas Do,Chin-Teng Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出iFuzz-Meta，一个可解释模糊规则学习框架，将模糊规则定义为原始特征空间中的语义与空间原型，结合元学习和知识引导的正则化机制，实现透明推理和跨域泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经计算中，模型不仅需要完成性能任务，还需解释其推理过程。可解释表示学习仍然是一个关键挑战，现有模型在可理解性与性能之间难以取得平衡。

Method: iFuzz-Meta框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 每条模糊规则对应原始特征空间中的一个语义和空间原型，实现透明推理；(2) 元学习范式用于分析可解释规则如何跨任务和领域重组；(3) 知识引导的正则化机制实现自顶向下与自底向上的整合，理论先验作为软归纳偏置，数据驱动学习精炼并扩展这些先验。

Result: 评估表明iFuzz-Meta实现了可解释推理和稳定的跨域泛化，为可解释和知识感知的模糊系统建立了潜在的通路。

Conclusion: iFuzz-Meta证明了在保持人类可理解的推理结构的同时，可以整合元学习和知识引导机制来实现稳定的跨域适应，为可解释模糊系统提供了通用性的发展路径。

Abstract: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends them. This dual process ensures that adaptation proceeds along semantically and physiologically meaningful trajectories, rather than arbitrary parameter shifts. Evaluations demonstrate that iFuzz-Meta achieves interpretable reasoning and stable cross-domain generalization, establishing a potential general pathway toward explainable and knowledge-aware fuzzy systems.

</details>


### [239] [SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14647)
*Chenyang Jiang,Changhan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SMOPD方法，通过在多轮在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中对中间轮生成回复按token熵排序并遮蔽最低熵的20%进行损失裁剪，稳定dirty-history回放带来的训练脆弱性问题，在LiC基准上对Qwen3系列模型提升1.0-2.5个百分点SHARDED准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）在dirty-history回放下表现脆弱：学生一旦产生错误中间回复，后续轮次被其条件化，均匀蒸馏会将损失分配到携带少量纠正信号的token上，导致训练不稳定。现有基于最终答案正确性的标量加权方案不可靠且scale-dependent。

Method: SMOPD是一种仅修改损失的稳定化方法：对每个生成的中间轮回复，按student熵对token位置排序，从裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中移除最低熵的20% token；最终答案和FULL保持损失不变。该方法针对token级不确定性而非粗粒度轨迹结果，不增加参数且零推理开销。同时对比了一个正确性缩放变体，该变体使用最终答案正确性作为共同的分离可靠性代理进行乘法缩放。

Result: 在LiC基准上，SMOPD在Qwen3 1.7B、4B、8B单种子对比中提升SHARDED准确率1.0-2.5个百分点；4B多种子检查显示平均+1.7pp增益（双尾p=0.022）。添加结果标量在1.7B无遮蔽时有害（-4.0pp），与遮蔽组合时仍依赖规模（4B时+1.3pp，1.7B中性，8B时-0.5pp）。

Conclusion: 在评估的dirty-history OPSD设置中，token级不确定性比标量最终答案正确性更可靠地作为稳定化信号。SMOPD有效但机制性因果测试和更广泛的基准验证留待未来工作。

Abstract: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged.
