TL;DR: 本文通过分析残差Jacobian的最小非零奇异值，探讨了grokking泛化转变的机制。研究发现该奇异值在转变期并不坍缩，而是保持非零且在转变期达到最大值，这一证据反对"分岔假说"，支持"平滑收缩"的图景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作将grokking的记忆后阶段视为约束优化问题：网络拟合训练集后，权重衰减沿零损失流形缓慢漂移。然而现有文献未回答一个关键问题：泛化转变是流形正常双曲性的丧失（分岔事件），还是流形保持均匀吸引而泛化通过平滑漂移发生？

Method: 提出一个优化器无关的诊断指标：残差Jacobian的最小非零奇异值σ_min^+(J)。对于平方损失，该值等于流形最慢的正常恢复速率。在两层ReLU网络上使用平方损失训练grokking模加法，监测该奇异值在训练全程的变化。

Result: σ_min^+(J)在转变期并未坍缩；它仅在记忆前接近于零，而在转变期达到最大值。该结论在五个随机种子下均成立，且六个最小奇异值表现一致，不存在子空间局部坍缩。

Conclusion: 初步证据反对分岔假说，支持平滑收缩图景。但作者明确承认，单一设置、渐进转变且使用Adam优化器的实验不能证明分岔的绝对不存在，只是约束了分岔可能隐藏的空间。

Abstract: A recent line of work recasts the post-memorization phase of grokking as constrained optimization: once a network interpolates the training set, weight decay drives a slow drift along the zero-loss manifold toward lower norm. In the language of dynamical systems, this is a fast-slow system in which the interpolation manifold plays the role of a slow manifold. We ask a question that this framing makes natural but the existing literature does not address: is the sharp generalization transition a loss of normal hyperbolicity of that manifold: a fold- or bifurcation-like event in which a normal restoring direction goes flat? Or does the manifold stay uniformly attracting while generalization happens by smooth drift? We propose a simple, optimizer-agnostic diagnostic: the smallest nonzero singular value $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ of the residual Jacobian, which, for the squared loss, equals the slowest normal restoring rate of the manifold. On a two-layer ReLU network trained to grok modular addition under squared loss, $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ does not collapse at the transition; it is near zero only before memorization and attains its largest values during the transition. The result holds across five seeds, and the six smallest singular values behave identically; there is no subspace-local collapse either. This is preliminary evidence against the bifurcation hypothesis and in favor of the smooth-contraction picture. We are explicit that a single-setting, gradual-transition experiment under Adam optimizer does not prove the absence of a bifurcation; it constrains where one could hide.

</details>


### [273] [Disentangling Homophily and Rarity: Explaining Failure in Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14823)
*Preben M. Ness,Fariz Ikhwantri,Dusica Marijan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过系统评估六个GNN在五个不同同质性程度的数据集上的表现，检验了异质性节点难分类的两种主流观点（子群体泛化问题 vs 邻域聚合问题）。研究发现同质性节点即使稀少也更容易分类，挑战了子群体泛化的解释框架；同时发现异质性节点分类所需信息往往可通过重新训练模型分类头或仅最后一层线性层来恢复，丰富了关于GNN如何错误表征异质性节点的现有认知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术界对"异质性节点为何更难分类"存在两种竞争解释：一种将其视为子群体泛化问题（模型在多数群体上表现好而以牺牲少数群体为代价），另一种将其归因于GNN的邻域聚合机制。作者希望通过系统评估来检验这两种观点，澄清异质性节点分类困难的真正根源。

Method: 在五个同质性程度各异的数据集上对六个GNN模型进行详细评估。通过对比同质性节点与异质性节点的分类难度（同时控制了稀有性因素），检验子群体泛化框架的适用性；再通过重训练分类头或仅最后一层线性分类层的实验，考察异质性节点分类所需信息是否在模型中可恢复。

Result: 研究发现：（1）同质性节点即使在数量稀少的情况下也倾向于更容易分类，这与子群体泛化框架的预测相矛盾；（2）异质性节点分类所需的信息常常可以通过重训练模型的分类头甚至仅最后一层线性层来恢复，说明特征信息并未完全丢失。

Conclusion: 异质性节点分类困难既不能简单归因于稀有性/子群体泛化，也不能简单归因于邻域聚合导致的信息不可逆丢失。信息往往存在于模型中，可通过重新训练分类头来恢复，这对未来的方法设计（如改进分类头而非整个GNN架构）有重要启示。

Abstract: Are heterophilic nodes in a graph harder to classify because they are heterophilic or because they are rare? Some existing work frames classification of such nodes as a subgroup generalisation problem, where a model performs well on the majority group at the expense of the rare group. Others explain this as a problem of neighbourhood aggregation in graph neural networks (GNNs). We assess these two viewpoints through a detailed evaluation of six GNNs on five datasets of varying homophily, and find that homophilic nodes tend to be easier to classify, even when they are rare---challenging the subgroup framing. However, our findings also nuance existing beliefs about how GNNs misrepresent heterophilic nodes. We demonstrate that the information needed to classify heterophilic nodes correctly is often recoverable by retraining the classification head of a model, or even just the final linear classification layer.

</details>


### [274] [M-LINKX: Multiview Graph Learning for Brain Cognitive Disease Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14847)
*An Phan,Yufei Jin,Xingquan Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出M-LINKX，一个基于多视图图学习的框架用于EEG痴呆症分类。它将长EEG记录切分为固定长度片段，为每个片段提取通道级节点特征并构建多个功能连接图视图（由连接度量、频带和拓扑过滤器组合定义），采用简单的节点特征与邻接连接表示融合建模，通过全局可训练视图权重融合图视图表示，并平均片段级概率获得受试者级预测。在两个三分类EEG数据集（CAUEEG和AHEAP）上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG信号具有噪声大、非平稳、跨受试者差异大等特点，导致基于EEG的痴呆症（AD、MCI、FTD）分类具有挑战性。现有基于片段的学习方法虽能将长EEG转化为固定长度输入，但在利用通道内信号信息和通道间交互方面存在不足，需要更有效的建模方式。

Method: M-LINKX采用多视图图学习框架：首先将EEG记录切分为固定长度片段；为每段提取通道级节点特征；根据连接度量、频带和拓扑过滤器的组合构建多个功能连接图视图；不依赖图上的消息传递，而是简单地建模节点特征与邻接连接表示；使用全局可训练的视图权重融合各图视图表示；最终通过平均片段级概率获得受试者级预测。

Result: 在两个三分类EEG数据集（CAUEEG包含HC/MCI/Dementia，AHEAP包含HC/AD/FTD）上，M-LINKX在主要实验设置下取得了最优的受试者级分类性能。

Conclusion: 多视图功能连接在结合合适的图学习架构时，能够有效提升EEG痴呆症分类性能。M-LINKX设计简单但有效，证明了FC图的多视角建模对脑疾病分类的价值。代码和数据已开源。

Abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a non-invasive and relatively low-cost procedure that measures brain electricity for the detection of cognitive diseases. EEG-based classification of dementia-related conditions, including Alzheimer's disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), remains challenging because EEG signals are noisy, non-stationary, and vary across subjects. Segment-based learning provides a practical way to model long EEG recordings by converting them into fixed-length inputs. For each segment, discriminative information may be explored by using signals within each channel (i.e. electrode), as well as interactions between EEG channels. In this paper, we propose M-LINKX, a multi-view graph learning framework for EEG-based dementia classification. For each segment, we extract channel-level node features and construct multiple functional-connectivity (FC) graph views, where each view is defined by a specific combination of connectivity metric, frequency band, and topology filter, respectively. Instead of relying on message passing over the constructed graphs, M-LINKX follows a simple design in modeling node features and adjacency-based connectivity representations. The graph-view representations are fused using global trainable view weights, and subject-level prediction is obtained by averaging segment-level probabilities. Experiments on two three-class EEG datasets with different diagnostic groups, CAUEEG (HC/MCI/Dementia) and AHEAP (HC/AD/FTD), show that M-LINKX achieves the best subject-level performance under the main experimental settings. Our study suggests that multi-view functional connectivity can improve EEG-based dementia classification when integrated with an appropriate graph-learning architecture. Code and data are available at https://github.com/anphantt/MLINKX.

</details>


### [275] [Can Neural Networks Learn by Experimenting on Themselves? Self-Interventional Learning from Functional Consequences to Predictive Self-Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14894)
*Michał Tomaszewski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自干预学习（SIL）框架，让神经网络通过扰动自身功能结构、观察后果、学习预测性自模型并指导后续结构操作。实验表明SIL能恢复关键结构、冗余性和可替换性，但在协同性恢复上不可靠；增加干预预算可提升预测精度和相关性；保留干预-后果映射可将预测误差降低81.3%，利用自模型指导行动可将归一化遗憾降低31.7%。但自模型引导的行动未显著优于直接经验记忆策略，且在大规模CIFAR-10/ResNet验证上无鲁棒性优势。SIL支持作为干预驱动的自知识学习框架，但自模型不完整且并非普遍优于简单直接策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习系统通常仅建模外部数据，其内部功能组织由外部观察者分析，缺乏系统对自身结构进行主动干预和学习自模型的能力。

Method: 提出Self-Interventional Learning (SIL)框架：神经系统中先扰动自身功能结构，观察干预后果，学习预测性自模型，泛化到未执行的干预，并用预测结果指导后续结构操作。在构造已知的合成系统和CIFAR-10/ResNet上进行验证。

Result: 在合成系统中，SIL恢复关键结构、冗余性和可替换性，但协同性恢复不可靠。30个种子实验中，干预预算从4增至56时预测误差从0.0335降至0.0148，Spearman相关从0.629升至0.883。保留干预-后果映射使预测误差降低81.3%，自模型指导行动使归一化遗憾降低31.7%。但自模型引导行动未显著优于经验记忆策略，CIFAR-10/ResNet上无鲁棒性优势。

Conclusion: SIL为干预驱动的自知识学习提供了可行框架，能获取关于网络自身功能组织的预测性知识，但自模型不完整且并非在所有场景下都优于更简单的直接策略。

Abstract: Machine-learning systems usually model external data, while their internal functional organization is analyzed by external observers. This work introduces Self-Interventional Learning (SIL), in which a neural system perturbs its own functional structure, observes consequences, learns a predictive self-model, generalizes to unexecuted interventions, and uses predictions to guide later structural action. In a construction-known synthetic system, SIL recovered critical structure, redundancy, and replaceability, while synergy was not reliably recovered. Across 30 fresh confirmatory seeds, increasing the pairwise intervention budget from 4 to 56 reduced held-out prediction error from 0.0335 to 0.0148 and increased Spearman correlation from 0.629 to 0.883. In a matched ablation, preserving the correct intervention--consequence mapping reduced prospective prediction error by 81.3%, while using the same learned self-model for action reduced normalized regret by 31.7% relative to ignoring it. However, model-guided action did not significantly outperform a direct empirical-memory policy, and powered CIFAR-10/ResNet validation showed no robustness advantage over equal-budget direct repair search. These results support SIL as an intervention-driven framework for learning predictive knowledge about a network's own functional organization, while showing that the self-model remains incomplete and is not universally superior to simpler direct strategies.

</details>


### [276] [Degeneracy Counting Quantum Algorithm using Decoherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14941)
*Malay Marut Das,Mark A. Novotny,Yaroslav Koshka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于正则热纯量子（CTPQ）态的简并度计数算法CTPQsd#，通过只测量小型探针S即可计算经典优化问题的全局最优解个数，无需找到各个最小值。该方法利用S与问题P在CTPQ态下的退相干度量与P的简并度之间的微扰关系，并在对角随机能量哈密顿量编码的问题上进行了数值验证，支持最多20个问题量子比特的经典模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算经典优化问题的全局最优解数量（即计数问题）是#P-难任务，传统方法需要遍历指数大的解空间或进行全希尔伯特空间层析成像，计算代价极其高昂。开发一种只需测量小型探针即可高效计数全局最优解个数的算法具有重要意义。

Method: CTPQsd#算法将小型探针S与经典优化问题P耦合在一起制备成CTPQ状态，利用S的退相干度量与P的全局最优解简并度之间的微扰关系来计数全局最小值。算法仅需对少数量子比特（仅4个量子比特）组成的探针进行层析成像测量，无需在整个问题希尔伯特空间上进行测量。数值验证采用对角随机能量哈密顿量（最大化无结构测试床）编码的经典二元优化问题，对最多20个问题量子比特进行经典模拟，系统分析了CTPQ温度、哈密顿量能量范围、问题规模和简并度变化对算法灵敏度的影响。

Result: 建立了确定精确简并度的温度阈值，并识别出第二个较低阈值，在该温度窗口内可以在用户定义的能量容差条件下计数近简并的极小值。数值实验表明算法能有效计数全局最优解，并且对CTPQ态温度、哈密顿量能量范围、问题大小及简并度等参数具有可控的灵敏度。

Conclusion: CTPQsd#算法成功将指数大的问题希尔伯特空间上的层析成像替换为仅4个量子比特的小型探针上的层析成像，显著降低了计数全局最优解的计算开销。该工作首次对退相干度量与简并度之间的微扰关系进行了数值验证，为大规模经典优化问题的简并度计数提供了新的量子途径。

Abstract: Counting the global optima of a classical optimization problem is a #P-hard task. We develop the canonical thermal pure quantum (CTPQ) state-based degeneracy counting (CTPQsd#) algorithm that determines the number of global optima of a classical optimization problem P by measuring only a small probe S, without finding individual minima. The method exploits a perturbative relation between the decoherence measure of S and the degeneracy of P when S and P are together in a CTPQ state. We provide the first numerical demonstration that this relation can be used to count the global minima, applying it to problems encoded by diagonal random-energy Hamiltonians as a maximally unstructured testbed for classical binary optimization problems. Classical simulations of up to 20 problem qubits quantify the algorithm's sensitivity to variations in the temperature of the CTPQ state, the Hamiltonian energy range, the problem size, and degeneracy. We establish the temperature threshold for determining the exact degeneracy and identify a second, lower threshold that provides a temperature window to count near-degenerate minima within a user-defined energy tolerance. By confining measurement to S, the protocol replaces tomography over the exponentially large problem Hilbert space with tomography over a small probe represented by only four qubits.

</details>


### [277] [PathFinder: Joint Decompositions of Linked Multimodal Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14951)
*Ying-Qiu Zheng,Alex Fung,Stephen M Smith,Rogier B Mars,Saad Jbabdi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PathFinder是一种新的联合低秩矩阵分解方法，允许对不完全共享维度的多模态数据集进行联合分析，只需通过成对或子组共享维度形成连接路径，即可实现全局联合分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的联合低秩分解方法要求所有多模态数据共享一个或多个维度，这限制了其应用范围。许多现实场景中，不同模态（如不同物种、不同尺度）的数据并不完全共享维度，但彼此之间可能通过成对或部分共享维度存在间接联系。

Method: PathFinder的核心思想是：只要数据矩阵的成对或子组之间存在共享维度，且通过一条或多条路径连接所有数据矩阵，就可以寻找全局联合分解。它作为一个统一的框架，涵盖了多种矩阵分解方法作为特例。

Result: PathFinder能够发现跨不同数据集的共同模式，并对缺失数据或模态进行预测，同时作为通用框架涵盖了许多现有矩阵分解方法。

Conclusion: PathFinder为不完全共享维度数据的联合分析提供了一种通用解决方案，扩展了联合低秩分解的适用范围，能够处理跨模态、跨物种、跨尺度的数据联合分析问题。

Abstract: Low-rank matrix decompositions can uncover patterns and structure in data and have a number of different applications across many disciplines. Extensions to "joint" low-rank decompositions have been proposed to link datasets from different modalities. While these methods enable the discovery of common patterns across modalities, they require that all the multimodal data share one or more dimensions. We propose a new analysis method, PathFinder, that enables co-analysis of datasets that do not necessarily all share a dimension. The key insight is that as long as pairs or subgroups of matrices do share some dimension, and that there are one or more paths that link across the data matrices, a global joint decomposition can be sought out. This enables the joint estimation of common patterns across different modalities, species, or scales, where a one-to-one mapping across all data along some dimension is not necessarily available. We show that PathFinder is a general umbrella under which many matrix decomposition methods fall as special cases. It can be used to discover common patterns across disparate datasets and to make predictions for missing data or modalities.

</details>


### [278] [LLM-based Framework for Generating and Verifying Parallel DEVS Statecharts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14956)
*Vamsi Krishna Vasa,Hessam S. Sarjoughian,Edward J. Yellig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个agentic PDEVS-LLM框架，利用大语言模型协助人类建模者生成和验证原子并行离散事件系统规范（PDEVS）状态图，通过受控校正机制和命题逻辑蕴含验证来确保所生成事实的逻辑一致性，并引入基本正确性度量来量化状态图模型的完整性和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发模型需要扎实的建模与仿真知识以及领域知识，每个模型都应准确表示系统动态且可验证。LLM生成的可信事实中的不一致性会导致PDEVS状态图存在逻辑结构和行为上的不准确，因此需要一种机制来辅助建模者生成和验证行为模型。

Method: 框架包含以下核心组件：(1) 使用agentic LLM从系统描述提示中生成/重新生成可信事实；(2) 受控校正机制，通过agentic LLM提取关键行为条件，并利用命题逻辑蕴含对可信事实进行有限次数的逻辑一致性验证；(3) 基于验证结果生成修改提示以减少错误；(4) 手动将状态图转换为时间自动机（Timed Automata）以验证死锁和可达性属性；(5) 迭代增量式地重新生成可信事实和PDEVS状态图；(6) 引入基本正确性度量来量化状态图模型的完整性和准确性。

Result: 开发了一系列不同复杂度级别的示例系统来展示LLM的能力和局限性，评估结果表明所提出的验证机制在生成状态图的逻辑一致性方面有显著改进。

Conclusion: 该agentic PDEVS-LLM框架能够利用LLM辅助生成和验证PDEVS状态图，通过受控校正机制和逻辑验证显著提升生成状态图的逻辑一致性，同时保留人类建模者在迭代循环中的关键决策角色。

Abstract: The development of models demands sound modeling and simulation knowledge as well as domain knowledge. Every model should accurately represent a system's dynamics and be verifiable. Toward this objective, this research introduces an agentic PDEVS-LLM framework to assist human modelers in generating and verifying PDEVS statecharts for behavior modeling of atomic Parallel Discrete Event System Specification (PDEVS) models. The framework supports (re)generating plausible facts from a system description prompt using the agentic LLM used for generating plausible facts. Inconsistencies in plausible facts lead to incorrect PDEVS statecharts having logical structure and behavioral inaccuracies. A controlled-correction mechanism is developed to verify the logical consistency of the plausible facts. The agentic LLM is used to generate key behavioral conditions from the system description prompt. The plausible facts are then verified against the behavioral conditions using propositional logic entailment for a finite number of times. The verification results enable the generation of modification prompts that can reduce errors in generated plausible facts, resulting in more accurate PDEVS statecharts. To verify a statechart's logical correctness, its Timed Automata counterpart is manually created and verified for deadlock and reachability properties. The human modeler may regenerate plausible facts and PDEVS statecharts iteratively and incrementally. A basic correctness metric is introduced to quantify the completeness and accuracy of the expected behavioral traits of the PDEVS statechart models. A collection of example systems with varying levels of complexity is developed to demonstrate the capabilities and limitations of LLMs. The evaluation of the proposed verification mechanism shows a substantial improvement in the logical consistency of generated statecharts.

</details>


### [279] [Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14963)
*Joanikij Chulev,Hendrik Baier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CF-ZOO方法，通过命令空间反事实解释来解析Pareto条件网络（PCN）中从回报命令到动作的局部映射。在给定状态、原始命令和备选动作的情况下，该方法在黑盒环境中搜索最小改变的期望回报命令，使同一训练策略选择该备选动作，从而为用户提供直观可操作的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pareto条件网络通过将单一策略作用于期望回报命令来学习多种多目标强化学习行为，但从命令和状态到动作的局部映射是不透明的。为了增强这类模型的可解释性，需要一种能够解释"为什么在当前命令下选择当前动作"以及"命令如何改变才能导致不同动作"的方法。

Method: 作者提出三类贡献：(1) 将PCN解释形式化为回报命令干预，使用仅回报（return-only）的PCN变体，避免水平条件（horizon-conditioning）带来的额外模糊性；(2) 将对抗机器学习方法适配到强化学习解释场景；(3) 引入边界种子（boundary-seeded）定向搜索方法，改进纯局部优化在命令-动作landscape中的表现，最终形成CF-ZOO方法。

Result: 所得的解释具有可操作性，并能以用户自身的偏好直观表达，例如："如果你的权衡稍微偏向X，智能体就会选择Y。"这表明该方法能够生成语义清晰、易于理解的反事实解释。

Conclusion: CF-ZOO通过命令空间中的最小干预搜索，成功为Pareto条件网络提供了可操作且符合用户直觉的反事实解释，弥合了多目标强化学习模型内部决策机制与人类可理解性之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Pareto Conditioned Networks learn multiple multi-objective reinforcement learning behaviours by conditioning a single policy on a desired return command. However, the local mapping from command and state to action remains opaque. We propose command-space counterfactual explanations for PCNs: given a fixed state, original command, and foil action, we search, in a black-box setting, for a minimally changed desired-return command under which the same trained policy would choose the foil. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate PCN explanations as return-command interventions, using a return-only PCN variant that avoids the added ambiguity of horizon-conditioning. Second, we adapt adversarial machine learning methods to reinforcement-learning explanations. Third, we introduce a boundary-seeded directional search that improves over purely local optimization in the command-action landscape, resulting in our proposed approach CF-ZOO. The resulting explanations are actionable and intuitively expressed in the user's own preferences: "If your trade-off had shifted slightly towards X, the agent would have chosen Y."

</details>


### [280] [A Physiology-Informed Digital Twin Framework for Simulating Liver Health Progression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14969)
*Sumaiya Afroz Mila,Sandip Ray*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HEPATWIN，一个基于生理学的人肝脏数字孪生模型，用于纵向模拟肝功能及早期疾病进展。该模型整合碳水化合物、脂质、蛋白质代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁生成和解毒等关键肝过程，通过阶段转换驱动的校准机制与临床疾病进展模式对齐，并在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上验证了其产生临床可接受的纵向生物标志物估算及多年度预测能力，且模拟数据足以支持下游NASH检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统纯数据驱动方法缺乏对肝脏生理机制的因果表征，难以进行个性化的长期疾病进展预测。研究者希望构建一个整合生理机制的数字孪生模型，用于非侵入性、个性化的肝脏健康监测和疾病早期诊断。

Method: HEPATWIN采用统一系统级框架，整合碳水化合物、脂质、蛋白质代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁生成和解毒等肝生理过程的机制性表征；输入患者特异性数据（饮食、活动、基线生物标志物）；引入阶段转换驱动的校准机制，将模拟输出与人群层面的生物标志物分布（覆盖NAFLD、纤维化和肝硬化阶段）对齐，从而生成临床可观察的生物标志物轨迹。

Result: 在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上的验证表明：HEPATWIN产生的纵向生物标志物估计处于临床可接受范围，能够在多年时间尺度上预测轨迹；模拟生物标志物保留足够的临床信号，支持下游NASH检测，其性能与使用真实实验室数据的模型相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 生理学信息驱动的数字孪生模型在个性化、非侵入性器官健康诊断与预测方面具有重要潜力，尤其在肝脏健康监测领域表现突出，为从机制层面理解并预测疾病进展提供了新的范式。

Abstract: We present a physiology-informed digital twin of the human liver designed for longitudinal simulation of liver function and early-stage disease progression. The model, referred to as HEPATWIN, integrates key hepatic processes, including carbohydrate, lipid, and protein metabolism, bilirubin conjugation, bile production, and detoxification, within a unified systems-level framework to generate clinically observable biomarker trajectories. Unlike purely data-driven approaches, HEPATWIN incorporates mechanistic representations of liver physiology and patient-specific inputs such as diet, activity, and baseline biomarkers to simulate disease evolution over time. To ensure consistency with clinical progression patterns, we introduce a stage-transition-driven calibration mechanism that aligns simulated outputs with population-level biomarker distributions across disease stages, including NAFLD, fibrosis, and cirrhosis. Validation using the NIDDK NAFLD dataset demonstrates that HEPATWIN produces longitudinal biomarker estimates within clinically acceptable ranges and can forecast trajectories over multi-year horizons. Furthermore, simulated biomarkers retain sufficient clinical signal to support downstream NASH detection with competitive performance relative to models using ground-truth laboratory data. These results highlight the potential of physiology-informed digital twins for personalized, non-invasive diagnosis and prediction of organ health in general and liver health monitoring in particular.

</details>


### [281] [Do Geometry-Aware Positional Encodings Help Transformers in Spatial Imperfect-Information Games?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14982)
*Wenji Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了几何感知位置编码（HexRoPE）在空间不完美信息博弈（六边形海军追击游戏）中的作用。通过四层基准测试发现，HexRoPE能显著改善隐藏目标跟踪的信念估计（后验交叉熵降低0.278-0.329）和数据高效的策略模仿（1k游戏下动作准确率提升4.63个百分点），但并未提升闭环对战的总体胜率（与无编码相比为-1.56个百分点）。这表明几何归纳偏置虽然能提升表征质量，但表征优势并不会自动转化为更强的闭环博弈表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer应用于空间不完美信息博弈时，需要同时表示地图几何结构并随时间追踪隐藏实体。现有位置编码大多面向文本或完美信息场景，缺乏针对六边形网格空间博弈的几何感知归纳偏置，因此作者希望探究几何感知位置编码能否提升这些核心能力。

Method: 作者不声称提出新位置编码，而是构建了一个四层基准：1) 受控几何与拓扑探测；2) 精确贝叶斯隐藏目标追踪任务；3) 分别在1k和10k场游戏上进行离线策略模仿；4) 对三个遗留对手进行7,200场固定种子游戏评估。在匹配的Transformer骨干网络上比较HexRoPE、无位置编码、矩形相对偏置和图表偏置。

Result: HexRoPE在D6变换测试轨道上将精确贝叶斯后验交叉熵较无编码降低0.278（更大地图上为0.329），分层bootstrap置信区间排除零，Holm校正p值均低于0.001。在1k场游戏时，HexRoPE较无编码提升动作准确率4.63个百分点，较矩形相对偏置提升2.05个百分点；在10k场时增益缩小至1.55和0.41个百分点。但六边形RPE未提升总体对战胜率，较无编码的配对效应为-1.56个百分点（95% CI [-4.50, 1.17]）。矩形相对偏置在D6信念一致性上最强但在半径3外推至半径4时急剧失败。

Conclusion: 几何归纳偏置能够显著改善信念估计和数据效率型的策略模仿，但这些表征层面的提升并不能自动转化为更强的闭环博弈表现。这揭示了表征能力与闭环节奏下决策质量之间存在脱节，对空间不完美信息博弈中的位置编码设计具有重要启示。

Abstract: Transformers applied to spatial imperfect-information games must represent map geometry while tracking hidden entities through time. We ask whether geometry-aware positional encodings improve these capabilities, without claiming a new positional encoding. We construct a four-level benchmark on a hexagonal naval pursuit game: controlled geometry and topology probes, an exact-Bayes hidden-target tracking task, offline policy imitation at 1k and 10k games, and 7,200 fixed-seed games against three legacy opponents. Across matched Transformer backbones, HexRoPE reduces exact-belief posterior cross-entropy relative to no positional encoding by 0.278 on D6-transformed test orbits and 0.329 on a larger map; both hierarchical-bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero, and both Holm-adjusted p-values are below 0.001. At 1k games, HexRoPE improves policy action accuracy by 4.63 percentage points over no encoding and 2.05 points over rectangular relative bias; the gains shrink to 1.55 and 0.41 points at 10k games. However, HexRoPE does not improve aggregate gameplay win rate: its paired effect over no encoding is -1.56 percentage points (95% CI [-4.50, 1.17]). Rectangular relative bias is strongest on D6 belief consistency but fails sharply when extrapolating from radius 3 to radius 4, while graph bias provides only a small blocked-edge gain. The results show that geometric inductive bias improves belief estimation and data-efficient imitation, but those representation gains do not automatically produce stronger closed-loop play.

</details>


### [282] [Lipschitz Bandits with Arbitrary Feedback Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15036)
*Yuhao Liu,Yu Chen,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带有任意反馈延迟的Lipschitz赌博机问题，针对随机与对抗性奖励设置分别提出基于消除(elimination)和EXP3的算法，实现了$\tilde{O}(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D})$的遗憾界，与无延迟情形匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Lipschitz赌博机假设奖励即时反馈，但在许多实际场景（如在线推荐、网络优化）中反馈存在延迟。已有工作未充分考虑任意反馈延迟下Lipschitz带状赌博机的遗憾保证，需要理论刻画延迟对学习性能的影响。

Method: 针对随机奖励设置提出基于消除(elimination)的算法；针对对抗性奖励设置提出基于EXP3的算法。两种算法均将反馈延迟纳入设计，并利用zooming dimension $d_z$刻画动作空间的结构复杂度。在随机设置中$d_z$与Lipschitz函数类相关，在对抗设置中$d_z$定义略有不同。

Result: 两种设置下的算法均达到$\tilde{O}(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D})$的遗憾界，其中$T$为时间范围，$D$为总延迟。该界与已有的无延迟Lipschitz赌博机遗憾保证相匹配，并精确刻画了反馈延迟带来的额外$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$影响。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统研究了任意反馈延迟下的Lipschitz赌博机问题，表明延迟仅引入$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$的额外遗憾，不改变原有延迟无关框架下的主导遗憾阶数，为带延迟的连续动作空间在线学习提供了理论保障。

Abstract: The Lipschitz bandit problem extends the traditional multi-armed bandit framework to continuous action spaces by assuming that the reward functions satisfy a Lipschitz condition. This work investigates Lipschitz bandits under arbitrary feedback delays, where reward signals are not received immediately upon taking an action but after an arbitrarily chosen delay. We consider both stochastic and adversarial reward settings, proposing an elimination-based algorithm and an EXP3-based algorithm, respectively. For both settings, our algorithms achieve a regret bound of $\tilde{O}\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D}\right)$ over a time horizon $T$ with total delay $D$, where the main difference between settings lies in the definition of the zooming dimension $d_z$. Our bounds match existing delay-free regret guarantees for Lipschitz bandits and characterize the additional $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$ impact introduced by feedback delays.

</details>


### [283] [Certifying Compressed Language Models: An Audit and a Statistical Toolkit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15046)
*Amogh Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出用"净准确率差值"来证明压缩模型与原模型等价是最无效的证据，因为在等价声称所在的场景中，正负方向逐项变化的抵消最为严重。作者从公共逐项评测数据中挖掘了1,707个模型-任务配对（参数量1.3B-405B），发现"churn"（逐项翻转率）约为净准确率差值的5倍，即使宏观得分与基线完全一致的单元，在单项上仍有分歧。对17个等价声称（来自方法论文、模型卡、厂商文档三类注册框架）进行预注册审计，16个可用，其中没有一个宣称前瞻性的数值等价边际，也没有一个发布任务匹配的逐项输出。作者提供了配对等价检验这一缺失工具，并给出认证表，实验表明校准样本的随机变化足以在5/8的确认单元中逆转GPTQ与AWQ的方法排序。最后提出五条报告标准：声明边际、做配对检验、报告churn与净差、引用满足的样本量、发布逐项输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前压缩模型等价性的证据标准严重不足：研究者通常仅以"精度下降零点几个百分点"来宣称模型等价，但净差值这一统计量在"两模型几乎相同"这一等价声称的核心场景中恰恰是最不具信息量的，因为正负方向的逐项变化被大规模相互抵消。这种"cancellation"现象使得净差值在等价声称中最容易被操纵或掩盖实质性分歧。作者因此致力于揭示该问题的严重程度，并提供一个严格的统计工具与报告标准框架。

Method: 作者从公开逐项评测结果（per-item evaluation dumps）中挖掘1,707个模型-任务配对单元格（涵盖1.3B到405B参数规模），计算每个单元格的净准确率差值与逐项churn（item-level flip rate）之比。随后进行了预注册审计：从方法论文、模型卡和厂商文档三类注册框架中选取17个等价声称（16个符合审计条件），检查其是否声明了前瞻性数值等价边际、是否发布了任务匹配的逐项输出。最后设计了配对等价检验（paired equivalence testing）方法，并给出"认证表"（certification tables）用于计算评测所需的样本量（基于压缩下观察到的分歧率而非独立二项方差）。在受控实验中，使用五粒种子对GPTQ与AWQ在字节级一致的校准样本上做配对对比。

Result: churn大小约为净准确率差值的5倍；即使与基线得分完全相同的单元格，在单项上仍存在分歧。17个等价声称中16个符合审计条件，其中没有任何一个声明前瞻性数值等价边际，也没有任何发布任务匹配的逐项输出；仅3个发布了其他任务的输出，5个因信息过少无法进行数值核查（读者在任何样本量下都无法验证）。在冻结的八单元格决策规则下，H3假设得到支持：5/8的确认单元格中，改变校准样本抽取方式足以逆转可见的方法排序（即校准种子效应强于方法间差异）。

Conclusion: 现有的等价性声称在证据充分性上系统性不足，但作者强调审计的是"证据充分性"而非"真实性"——没有声称被判定为虚假。作者提出了可操作的修正方案：五条报告标准（声明边际、配对检验、churn与净差并列报告、声明所满足的样本量、发布逐项输出），并指出该方法适用于任何"相似到值得比较"的两个模型之间的比较。所有逐项输出、协议和代码均已开源发布。

Abstract: A fraction of a point of benchmark accuracy is the usual evidence that a compressed model is equivalent to its original. That quantity is least informative when two models are most alike: a net delta is what survives cancellation between opposing per-item changes, and cancellation is most complete in the regime equivalence claims occupy. Across an atlas of 1,707 paired model-by-task cells mined from public per-item evaluation dumps (1.3B-405B), churn runs roughly five times the net accuracy delta, and cells scoring identically to their baseline still disagree on individual items. In a preregistered audit of 17 equivalence claims from three registered frames (method papers, model cards, vendor documentation), 16 are eligible. None states a prospective numerical equivalence margin, and none releases task-matched per-item outputs, though 3 release outputs for other tasks only; 5 report too little to assess numerically, so a reader cannot check them at any sample size. We audit evidential sufficiency, not truth: no claim is called false. We supply the missing instrument: paired equivalence testing at a declared margin, with certification tables giving the items an evaluation needs, computed from disagreement observed under compression, not from independent-binomial variance. A controlled experiment pairs GPTQ and AWQ on byte-identical calibration samples across five seeds. Under the frozen eight-cell decision rule H3 is supported: changing the calibration draw was sufficient to reverse the observed method ordering in 5 of 8 confirmatory cells. The reporting standard we propose is five lines: declare a margin, run the paired test, report churn beside net delta, cite the sample size you met, release per-item outputs. It applies to any comparison between two models alike enough to be worth comparing. All per-item outputs, protocols and code are released.

</details>


### [284] [Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15050)
*Yiyang Lu,Hareshkumar Jadav,Mohammad Pedramfar,Ranveer Singh,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线凸优化中的对偶（成对比较）反馈设置，提出了一种将成对比较反馈转化为近似梯度的简化归约方法，使得标准一阶方法可以直接使用。在该归约下遗憾保证得以传递，首次为该设置提供了静态、自适应和动态遗憾的O(T^{3/4})结果；在额外结构假设下，对光滑目标函数和强凸函数分别获得O(T^{2/3})和O(√(T log T))的改进率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对比较（dueling）反馈在离散或随机设置中已被充分研究，但对抗性凸设置此前尚未被探索。该文旨在填补这一空白，为在线凸优化与成对比较反馈的结合提供理论保证。

Method: 提出一种简单归约方法，将成对（二元）比较反馈转换为近似梯度，从而允许直接使用标准的（primal/hyper? 一阶）优化方法。通过该归约，将已有的遗憾保证迁移到新的设置中。

Result: 该归约实现了遗憾保证的传递，首次为该设置提供了O(T^{3/4})的静态、自适应和动态遗憾结果。在额外结构下，对光滑目标获得O(T^{2/3})的改进率，对强凸函数获得O(√(T log T))的速率。

Conclusion: 通过一个简洁的梯度近似归约，成功将对抗性凸优化中基于梯度的经典方法扩展到成对比较反馈设置，并给出了从次线性到近乎最优的遗憾界，为该方向的研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: We study online convex optimization with dueling (pairwise comparison) feedback, where the learner observes only a binary preference between two queried points. While dueling feedback is well understood in discrete or stochastic settings, the adversarial convex setting has remained unexplored. We propose a simple reduction that converts dueling feedback into approximate gradients, enabling the use of standard first-order methods. We show that regret guarantees transfer under this reduction, yielding the first results for this setting, including $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ static, adaptive, and dynamic regret. Under additional structure, we obtain improved rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ for smooth objectives and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$ for strongly convex functions.

</details>


### [285] [A Unified Mamba--MoE Surrogate for Closed-Loop Simulation and Measurement-Window Forecasting of Inverter Transients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15051)
*Haoguang Wang,Huy Hoang Le,Akhila Kandivalasa,Christian Moya,Marcos Netto,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Mamba架构与混合专家（MoE）路由的代理模型，用于表征逆变器资源（IBR）的瞬态动态。该统一模型同时支持闭环仿真与量测窗口预测两项任务，通过任务条件与专家路由共享单一骨干网络，相比使用两个独立专家模型减少了13%的参数，同时预测区间在两任务上达到94-96%的经验边际覆盖率，并在控制器硬件在环仿真中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆变器资源（IBR）的瞬态动态建模对电网稳定运行至关重要，但传统方法需为不同预测任务分别训练专用模型，参数冗余且泛化能力有限。作者希望构建一个统一的代理模型，既能执行闭环仿真又能进行量测窗口预测，同时通过MoE路由提升对远离平衡点瞬态动态的拟合精度。

Method: 采用Mamba架构构建代理模型，引入混合专家（MoE）路由机制，由路由器网络为各专家子网络分配数据相关的权重。模型通过任务条件（task conditioning）和专家路由在单一Mamba骨干上同时完成两项任务，并采用任务匹配的损失目标分别适配各自的预测形式，最后附加自适应共形层（adaptive conformal layer）为两项任务都提供预测区间。

Result: 针对所考虑的电网跟随型逆变器，统一代理模型与Mamba专家对（specialist pair）性能相当（处于同样的低误差区间），但参数减少13%；预测区间在两项任务上实现94-96%的经验平均边际覆盖率。在瞬态动态（远离平衡点）场景下，带MoE路由的代理模型相比无专家路由的共享Mamba骨干在所有输出上均获得更低误差。控制器硬件在环仿真验证表明，仅用有限实测数据适配共享输出头即可降低留出集预测误差。

Conclusion: Mamba-MoE统一代理模型能够在降低参数量的同时保持与独立专家模型相当的精度，并通过MoE路由显著提升瞬态动态的建模准确性；自适应共形层提供了可靠的预测区间，且该方法在实际控制器硬件在环环境中的有效性得到了验证，为逆变器瞬态建模提供了一种高效统一的解决方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes a Mamba surrogate model with mixture-of-experts (MoE) routing to represent the transient dynamics of inverter-based resources. A Mamba surrogate model is a predictive machine learning model built on the Mamba architecture. MoE routing uses a router network to assign data-dependent weights to specialized subnetworks (experts). The resulting Mamba--MoE surrogate can perform two tasks: (i) closed-loop simulation and (ii) measurement-window forecasting of inverter transients. A single Mamba backbone with task conditioning and expert routing serves both tasks, replacing two separate specialists. Task-matched objectives fit each prediction form, and an adaptive conformal layer provides prediction intervals for both tasks. For the considered grid-following inverter, the unified surrogate model remains in the same low-error regime as a Mamba specialist pair while using 13% fewer parameters. The prediction intervals achieve 94--96% empirical mean marginal coverage across the two tasks. For transient dynamics---that is, beyond the vicinity of an equilibrium point---our surrogate model with MoE routing yields lower errors across all outputs in both tasks compared to a shared Mamba backbone without expert routing. A controller hardware-in-the-loop simulation validates our results and shows that adapting only the shared output head with limited measured data reduces held-out forecasting error.

</details>


### [286] [GATTA: Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15084)
*Zsombor Bánfi,András Gézsi,András Formanek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GATTA框架，将测试时增强（TTA）应用于图数据的主动学习中，通过聚合多个增强视图的预测来生成更可靠的Uncertainty估计，并引入基于一致性过滤的机制去除不可靠的增强视图。实验表明，简单的Uncertainty方法（如Entropy和Least Confidence）结合TTA后性能可与更复杂的方法媲美，并提出实用的部署指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时增强（TTA）在计算机视觉领域已被证明能有效提升模型鲁棒性和Uncertainty估计质量，但将其应用于图结构数据的场景几乎未被探索。同时，主动学习中复杂的获取函数虽然有效但计算开销大，作者希望探索一条更高效、低复杂度的路径来提升主动学习性能。

Method: GATTA框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 通过多个增强视图的预测聚合来生成更可靠的Uncertainty估计；(2) 针对图增大增强难以保持标签不变性的挑战，提出基于一致性的过滤机制，丢弃产生不可靠预测的增强视图。框架在不同GNN架构和多种获取策略（如Entropy、Least Confidence等）下进行系统评估。

Result: 实验结果显示：简单的Uncertainty-based方法（Entropy和Least Confidence）从TTA中获益最大，性能可与更复杂、计算开销更高的方法相竞争；GATTA在不同架构间具有良好泛化性，优于MC Dropout等模型集成方法；在集成规模和图的规模上都表现出良好的可扩展性。此外，对增强类型、强度和过滤策略的广泛分析为实际部署提供了实用指南。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，将TTA与简单方法结合是获得强主动学习性能的更高效途径，比设计复杂获取函数更具性价比，能在更低计算开销和实现复杂度下达到有竞争力的效果，为图数据上的主动学习提供了新的实用方向。

Abstract: Test-time augmentation (TTA) has proven effective for improving model robustness and uncertainty estimation in computer vision, yet its application to graph-structured data remains largely unexplored. We introduce GATTA (Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation), a framework for enhancing active learning by aggregating predictions across multiple augmented views to produce more reliable uncertainty estimates. To address the challenge of label-preserving graph augmentations, GATTA incorporates a consistency-based filtering mechanism that discards augmented views yielding unreliable predictions. We systematically evaluate GATTA across multiple graph datasets, GNN architectures, and acquisition strategies. Our results show that simple uncertainty-based methods, such as Entropy and Least Confidence, benefit most from TTA, achieving performance competitive with more sophisticated and computationally expensive approaches. GATTA generalizes across architectures, outperforms model-side ensemble methods such as MC Dropout. We further show that GATTA scales efficiently with both ensemble size and graph size. Extensive analysis of augmentation types, strengths, and filtering strategies provides practical guidelines for effective deployment. Our findings demonstrate that augmenting simple methods with TTA offers a more efficient path to strong active learning performance than engineering complex acquisition functions, enabling practitioners to achieve competitive results with lower computational overhead and reduced implementation complexity.

</details>


### [287] [EMASAM: a Computationally Efficient Sharpness-Aware Minimization via EMA-Guided Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15105)
*Tanapat Ratchatorn,Masayuki Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EMASAM，一种计算高效的Sharpness-Aware Minimization（SAM）变体。EMASAM用主模型与EMA影子模型之间的差异来定义扰动方向，替代SAM中需要额外梯度计算的扰动步骤，从而消除额外的反向传播，同时保持SAM风格的泛化能力并缓解梯度不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM虽能通过锐度感知最小化提升泛化性能，但其核心算法在扰动步骤需要额外的梯度计算，导致两倍的计算成本。此外，SAM依赖嘈杂的mini-batch梯度进行扰动，可能引入梯度相关的不稳定性。因此，需要一种既能保持SAM泛化优势又降低计算开销的方法。

Method: EMASAM利用指数移动平均（EMA）维护一个影子模型，在扰动步骤中不计算损失梯度，而是基于主模型与EMA影子模型之间的差异来定义扰动方向。该扰动方向从稳定的平均位置朝向不太稳定的区域移动，作为SAM最坏情况扰动的更柔和且更廉价的替代。由于扰动不依赖mini-batch梯度，因此缓解了梯度诱导的不稳定性。

Result: 多项实验验证了EMASAM的效率和鲁棒性，确认其在消除额外反向传播需求的同时，能够保持SAM风格训练的泛化能力。

Conclusion: EMASAM通过用EMA模型差异替代梯度扰动，成功将SAM的计算成本从两倍降至单次，同时保留了泛化性能并增强了训练稳定性，是一种高效且稳健的SAM替代方案。

Abstract: Recent progress in optimization research has highlighted the sharpness of the loss landscape as a key factor in narrowing the generalization gap. Motivated by this insight, Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) was proposed as a training strategy that enhances generalization. Despite the promising performance, SAM suffers from its twice computational cost due to its core algorithm requiring an extra gradient computation during the perturbation step. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Exponential Moving Average Sharpness-Aware Minimization (EMASAM), a computationally efficient variant of SAM. EMASAM does not require the loss gradient in the perturbation step. Instead, EMASAM defines the perturbation direction based on the discrepancy between the main model and the EMA shadow model. This perturbation travels away from the stable average position toward the less stable area, acting as a softer yet cheaper alternative to SAM's worst-case scenario perturbation. Moreover, since EMASAM's perturbation does not rely on noisy mini-batch gradients, it mitigates the gradient-induced instability inherent in SAM. Hence, EMASAM eliminates the need for an extra backpropagation while also preserving the generalization ability of the SAM-style training. Several experiments have been performed and confirm the efficiency and robustness of our method.

</details>


### [288] [Global Federated Learning Strategies for Building Efficient Personalized Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15107)
*Seongyoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本论文研究了联邦学习中数据异构性导致的全局与个性化性能同时下降问题，提出了三种方法论：特征向量坍缩缓解、全局知识保持的局部对齐、以及全局初始化数量的重新审视，为高效个性化模型构建提供了实用训练策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中用户数据分布的异构性常常导致全局模型和个性化模型的性能同时退化，需要厘清哪些训练策略在全局训练阶段有效，以及如何在局部适应阶段在保持全局知识的同时确保用户特定性能。现有方法未能同时解决表示层面（特征向量）与知识层面（全局知识遗忘）的根本瓶颈。

Method: 论文提出三项核心方法：(1) 指出数据异构性下特征向量坍缩比分类器权重是更根本的瓶颈，通过直接缓解局部与全局模型表征幅度的差异来解决问题；(2) 分析强化局部对齐的训练方法会诱发全局知识遗忘（如局部未观察到的类别），提出结合全局模型特征向量的特征蒸馏方法，同时实现局部对齐与全局知识保持；(3) 在偏好异构的联邦个性化奖励模型学习中，实证检验"更多全局模型带来更好初始化"的传统假设，证明在允许充分局部微调时，单一全局初始化反而能提供更强的个性化性能。

Result: 研究表明：特征向量坍缩是异构联邦学习中更关键的瓶颈；特征蒸馏能有效平衡局部对齐与全局知识保持；且在奖励模型学习中推翻了"全局模型越多越好"的固有认知，单一全局初始化在充分局部微调条件下可获得更强的个性化表现。

Conclusion: 该研究重新定义了数据与偏好异构性下全局初始化的角色，提供了能同时满足全局知识保持与个性化的实用训练策略，为联邦个性化学习提供了系统性的方法论框架。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a practical framework that can train models on distributed user data while guaranteeing data privacy; however, due to heterogeneity in which each user has a different data distribution, problems frequently arise where both global and personalization performance deteriorate simultaneously. This dissertation presents methodologies for building efficient personalized models by identifying which strategies are effective in the global training stage and by showing how to preserve global knowledge while securing user-specific performance during local adaptation. First, we show that as data heterogeneity increases, the collapse of feature vectors is a more fundamental bottleneck than classifier weights, and propose a method that directly mitigates the discrepancy in representation magnitude between local and global models. Second, we analyze that a training approach that strengthens local alignment can induce forgetting of global knowledge (e.g., categories not observed locally), and propose a method that achieves both local alignment and global knowledge preservation by combining feature distillation based on the global model's feature vectors. Third, in federated personalized reward model learning with preference heterogeneity, we empirically verify the conventional belief that "increasing the number of global models yields better initialization," and we show that when sufficient local fine-tuning is allowed, a single global initialization can instead provide stronger personalization performance. This study redefines the role of global initialization under data and preference heterogeneity and provides practical training strategies that simultaneously satisfy global knowledge preservation and personalization.

</details>


### [289] [Probability-Preserving Transformer for the Time-Dependent Schrödinger Equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15112)
*Mushtaq Ali,Muzamil Tariq,Niaz Ali Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将时间相关薛定谔方程(TDSE)的概率守恒作为硬约束的Transformer架构，通过内在保证时间演化的幺正性，无需重复训练即可严格保证概率守恒，并在物理精确性和计算效率上均优于传统软约束方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数值方法求解TDSE计算成本高昂；Transformer模型虽可作为替代方案，但标准实现依赖软约束，无法严格保证概率守恒这一关键物理性质。

Method: 设计一种将TDSE概率守恒作为硬约束的Transformer架构，在架构层面内在确保时间演化过程的幺正性，使概率守恒在每次推理中天然满足，无需重复训练或外部约束校正。

Result: 实验结果表明，硬约束方法不仅在物理上保持精确（概率严格守恒），而且在计算效率上优于传统的软约束方法。

Conclusion: 硬约束Transformer架构是求解TDSE的可行且优越的方案，兼顾物理严格性与计算效率，为量子动力学模拟提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation (TDSE) via traditional numerical methods is computationally intensive. Transformer models offer a compelling alternative, but standard implementations rely on soft constraints that cannot rigorously guarantee probability conservation. Here, we introduce a Transformer architecture that enforces TDSE probability conservation as a hard constraint. The design intrinsically ensures unitarity across temporal evolution without requiring repeated retraining. Our empirical findings show that this hard-constraint approach is not only physically exact but also computationally superior to conventional soft-constraint methods.

</details>


### [290] [Decision-Driven Regularization: A Blended Model for Learning and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15124)
*Gar Goei Loke,Qinshen Tang,Yangge Xiao,Xun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为"决策驱动正则化"的双目标优化框架，在上下文优化中平衡预测准确性与成本最小化，并通过引入新的超参数构建成本函数的替代形式，从而减少过拟合并提升决策有效性。该框架在理论上与其他主流方法（鲁棒优化、遗憾最小化、SPO+等）密切相关，并在合成实验中对OLS、随机森林、XGBoost、SPO+等基准模型表现出数值优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在上下文优化中，现有的集成学习与优化方法缺乏对预测准确性的控制，容易导致过拟合以及决策效果下降，甚至不如简单的分离式学习与优化模型。作者希望解决这一问题，提出一种兼顾预测准确性与决策成本最小化的方法。

Method: 提出一个双目标优化问题，同时平衡预测准确性和成本最小化，称为"决策驱动正则化"。通过引入一个与成本函数相关的新的超参数来构造替代成本函数，解决成本函数定义的歧义问题。同时从鲁棒优化和遗憾最小化两个视角论证该模型与其他主流模型的联系，并证明其能够推广SPO+等模型。

Result: 在合成实验研究中，该模型在决策有效性上优于OLS、随机森林、XGBoost、SPO+、扰动梯度（Perturbation Gradient）以及Learning and Rank等多个基准方法。

Conclusion: 本文提出的"决策驱动正则化"框架通过在集成学习与优化过程中显式控制预测准确性，有效缓解了过拟合问题，改进了决策效果，并在理论上统一和推广了多种现有方法，提供了一种更稳健且更实用的上下文优化方案。

Abstract: In contextual optimization, the decision-maker seeks optimal decisions to minimize a cost function, that varies based on observed features. This context is common in many business applications ranging from on-demand delivery and retail operations to portfolio optimization and inventory management. In this paper, we study the learning and optimization approach, which first learns how outcomes result from the features, and then selects optimal decisions based on these outcomes. We focus on the integrated learning and optimization literature, and identify that a lack of control for prediction accuracy can lead to overfitting and a loss of decision effectiveness against simple separate learning and optimization models. Instead, we propose a bi-objective formulation that balances prediction accuracy and cost minimization, termed decision-driven regularization. It also addresses ambiguity in the definition of the cost function via a surrogate that depends on a new hyperparameter. We additionally show that alternative perspectives for formulating the problem, namely robust optimization and regret minimization, lead to models that are closely related to our proposed model. As a consequence, our framework generalizes models such as SPO+. Our model is shown to be numerically superior to other benchmarks, such as OLS, Random Forest, XGBoost, SPO+, Perturbation Gradient, and Learning and Rank, in our synthetic studies.

</details>


### [291] [PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15146)
*Alexander L. Strehl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Tesauro的TD-Gammon算法，在无评估时搜索的背景下用于双陆棋（backgammon）货币对局。通过纯自我对弈强化学习，从零学习棋子走法和骰子加倍操作，仅需极少的硬编码逻辑且不使用专家特征，模型达到了接近最先进的棋力水平，且评估速度更快、实力显著强于使用1-ply搜索的开源引擎GNU Backgammon和Open Sage。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在验证纯自我对弈强化学习在现代计算资源下是否足以训练出接近最先进水平的双陆棋AI，而不依赖评估时搜索、专家特征或大量手工编码逻辑，重新检验TD-Gammon范式的潜力。

Method: 采用自我对弈强化学习（RL），从零开始同时学习checker play（棋子走法）和cube action（加倍骰子决策），仅使用极少的硬编码逻辑，不使用任何专家特征，并在无评估时搜索（search-free）的设置下训练模型。

Result: 纯自我对弈RL训练出的模型在双陆棋货币对局中达到了接近最先进的强度。在无搜索条件下，该模型评估速度更快，且显著强于GNU Backgammon和Open Sage在1-ply搜索下的表现。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，即使在没有评估时搜索的情况下，纯自我对弈强化学习仍足以训练出接近最先进水平的双陆棋模型，挑战了此前认为必须依赖搜索或专家特征才能达到顶尖棋力的观点，并验证了TD-Gammon方法在现代条件下的有效性。

Abstract: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source engines GNU Backgammon and Open Sage running a one-move (1-ply) look-ahead search.

</details>


### [292] [FinFraudBench: A Heterogeneous Graph Benchmark for Financial Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15177)
*Yixuan Chen,Hongyu Zhan,Jie Sheng,Weiyu Han,Shuai Chen,Tianyi Zhang,Xiao Tan,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FinFraudBench，一个面向金融欺诈检测的异构图基准，包含两个大规模异构金融图数据集（CreditCard-Fraud和BankTrans-Fraud），节点数最高达899万、有向边达8923万条，保留了六种金融实体类型、十四种有向边类型和自然欺诈率，并建立了涵盖排序和不平衡敏感分类指标的标准化评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图欺诈检测方法虽进展迅速，但公共基准与实际金融系统严重脱节：一方面常将金融生态简化为同构或单节点类型多关系图，丢失了金融数据的多实体、多关系本质；另一方面缺乏在极端类别不平衡和有限标签可用性等真实部署条件下的大规模异构金融图数据集，难以评估现有方法的实际效果。

Method: 作者构建了FinFraudBench异构图表征基准，包括两个数据集：CreditCard-Fraud和BankTrans-Fraud，规模达到899万节点和8923万条有向类型边。每个数据集保留六种金融实体类型、十四种有向边类型，并采用反映部署约束的自然欺诈率。同时建立了涵盖排序指标和不平衡敏感分类指标的标准化评估协议，并评估了代表性基线方法。

Result: 通过大规模实验，获得了对当前图欺诈检测方法局限性的实证洞察，揭示了现有方法在真实金融部署条件下的能力边界，并提出了未来研究的有前景方向。

Conclusion: FinFraudBench填补了金融欺诈检测图基准与真实金融系统之间的差距，为图神经网络等欺诈检测方法提供了更贴近实际部署的评测平台，并推动了该领域标准化评估体系的建立。

Abstract: The increasing complexity of digital financial systems has reshaped financial fraud detection from isolated transaction classification into relational risk reasoning over interconnected financial entities. This shift has motivated graph-based fraud detection, where models identify fraudulent nodes by exploiting dependencies among customers, cards, merchants, categories, and locations. However, despite rapid progress in graph-based methods, existing public benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world financial systems in two important aspects. First, they often simplify financial ecosystems into homogeneous or single-node-type multi-relational graphs, failing to preserve the multi-entity and multi-relational nature of financial data. Second, they rarely provide large-scale heterogeneous financial graph datasets with realistic operating conditions such as extreme class imbalance and limited label availability, making it difficult to assess the practical effectiveness of current methods. To address these gaps, we present FinFraudBench, a heterogeneous graph benchmark for financial fraud detection. FinFraudBench contains two heterogeneous graph datasets (CreditCard-Fraud and BankTrans-Fraud) with up to 8.99M nodes and 89.23M directed typed edges. Each dataset preserves six financial entity types, fourteen directed edge types, and natural fraud rates that mirror deployment constraints. With these datasets, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol covering both ranking and imbalance-sensitive classification metrics, and evaluate representative baselines. Extensive experiments yield empirical insights into current methods' limitations and suggest promising avenues for future research. FinFraudBench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinFraudBench-B002.

</details>


### [293] [MiNO: Cotangent-bundle propagator learning for PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15187)
*Gnankan Landry Regis N'guessan,Bum Jun Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出微局域神经算子（MiNO），学习偏微分方程解的传播子（相空间中的相位和振幅），而非直接拟合解场或解算子。通过程函方程学习相位、输运方程学习振幅，再用振荡积分恢复解。MiNO在间断输运基准上达到有限重建窗口的精度极限（以闭式预测），在光滑输运上均方误差为3.84×10⁻³，显著优于物理信息神经网络和傅里叶神经算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统科学机器学习要么学习解场（如PINN）要么学习解映射（如神经算子），但这两者都面临规律性缺口：被输运的间断在空间和时间上都不光滑，而生成该演化的规则（传播子）本身可能是一个多项式的相位函数并携带单位振幅，即生成演化的对象可以远比其生成的场更光滑。因此学习传播子而非场本身有望规避非光滑性的困难。

Method: MiNO（微局域神经算子）学习传播子，该传播子由相空间中的相位和振幅组成。相位通过程函方程学习，振幅通过输运方程学习，最终通过振荡积分重建解场。尖锐前沿（fronts）和焦散线（caustics）被视为传播几何属性而非逐点拟合的场。小残差不仅保证重建场精度，还确保学到的正则关系（携带奇性的几何结构）接近精确几何，并能将可训练误差与频率截断尾部分离。

Result: 在不连续输运的匹配预算对比实验中，MiNO在10,000步内收敛到其有限重建窗口的精度极限（该极限可闭式预测），而带神经正切核损失平衡的PINN停留在初始误差附近。在光滑输运中，MiNO均方误差为3.84×10⁻³，而监督傅里叶神经算子为3.12×10⁻²。单分支MiNO是所比较中最小的模型，一个训练好的生成器可为五个未见初始条件服务而无需重训练。

Conclusion: 学习传播子（相位与振幅）而非解场本身，是一种有效的科学机器学习范式。MiNO在间断和光滑输运场景均显著优于传统方法，且模型更小、泛化能力更强（可泛化到未见初始条件）。残差具有更深层的几何意义：小的残差意味着学到的正则关系接近精确几何，并能区分可训练误差与频率截断误差。

Abstract: Scientific machine learning for partial differential equations commonly targets solution fields, as in physics-informed neural networks, or solution maps, as in neural operators. We study a third target: the propagator itself, a phase and amplitude in phase space. The motivation is a gap in regularity. A transported discontinuity is nonsmooth in space and time, yet the rule that moves it can be a polynomial phase carrying unit amplitude, so the object that generates an evolution can be far smoother than the field it generates. The microlocal neural operator (MiNO) learns that object, using the eikonal equation for the phase and the transport equation for the amplitude, and recovers the solution by an oscillatory integral. Sharp fronts and caustics then belong to propagation geometry rather than to a field fitted pointwise. Small residuals certify more than the reconstructed field. They place the learned canonical relation, the geometry that carries singularities, close to the exact one, and they separate trainable error from the frequency-truncation tail. On a matched-budget discontinuous-advection benchmark, MiNO stops improving within 10,000 steps at the accuracy limit of its finite reconstruction window, a limit predicted in closed form, whereas a physics-informed neural network with neural-tangent-kernel loss balancing stays near its initial error. On smooth advection, the mean error is $3.84\times10^{-3}$ for MiNO and $3.12\times10^{-2}$ for a supervised Fourier neural operator. Single-branch MiNO is the smallest model compared, and one trained generator serves five unseen initial conditions without retraining.

</details>


### [294] [Structuring Semantic Embeddings for Principle Evaluation: A Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15224)
*Che Shen,Junwei Su,Lingpeng Kong,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出原型引导对比学习（PGCL）模块，在冻结文本嵌入之上进行原型引导的几何正则化，用于可靠的post-hoc评估任务（毒性检测、细粒度情绪分类和序数评论评分），在不更新基础编码器的情况下生成紧凑的任务适应表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用文本嵌入被广泛部署用于post-hoc评估代理任务，但广泛语义相似性会使语义相似但任务不同的样本在表示空间中重叠，导致评估不可靠。因此需要在冻结嵌入基础上获得任务适应表示。

Method: PGCL由多个流组成：语义流、原型-锚注意力流、监督对比学习、基于偏移的原型边界正则化和流正则化。该模块构建在冻结文本嵌入之上，不更新基础编码器，通过原型引导的几何正则化生成紧凑的任务适应表示。理论分析作为原型映射空间中显式假设下的充分条件说明，而非无条件的训练或最终嵌入分离保证。

Result: PGCL在三个数据集上均优于原始冻结嵌入，在AmazonReviews上相比直接基线取得了最清晰的边际优势，在GoEmotions和ToxicComment上与强直接冻结度量学习基线保持竞争力。还通过监督残差适配器、编码器LoRA、全微调、目标消融、敏感性和完整记录的少样本LLM协议诊断定义了主张边界。

Conclusion: PGCL作为冻结嵌入之上的原型引导几何正则化模块，在不更新基础编码器的情况下有效提升post-hoc评估任务的表示质量，并通过充分条件的理论分析为原型边界行为提供了更严谨的说明。

Abstract: Reliable post-hoc evaluation asks whether already generated text satisfies a target criterion after generation. In this paper we study a focused frozen-embedding setting using principle-evaluation proxy tasks: toxicity detection, fine-grained emotion categorization, and ordinal review rating. General-purpose text embeddings are widely deployed for such tasks, but broad semantic similarity can place semantically similar yet task-distinct examples in overlapping regions of the representation space. We introduce Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning (PGCL), a prototype-guided geometric regularization module built on top of frozen text embeddings. The module combines a semantic stream, a prototype-anchor attention stream, supervised contrastive learning, offset-based prototype-margin regularization, and stream regularization to produce a compact task-adapted representation without updating the base encoder. Controlled experiments show that PGCL improves over raw frozen embeddings on all three datasets and gives the clearest direct-baseline margin on AmazonReviews, while remaining competitive with strong direct frozen metric-learning baselines on GoEmotions and ToxicComment. We also add supervised residual-adapter, encoder-LoRA, full fine-tuning, objective ablation, sensitivity, and fully logged few-shot LLM protocol diagnostics to define the boundary of the claim. The theoretical analysis is revised as a sufficient-condition account for prototype-margin behavior under explicit assumptions in the prototype-mapping space, rather than as an unconditional training or final-embedding separation guarantee.

</details>


### [295] [Learning reshapes power-law anisotropy in internal representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15239)
*Asahi Nakamuta,Jun-nosuke Teramae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过精确求解宽两层线性神经网络在teacher-student框架下的学习动力学，揭示了内部表征中幂律各向异性的形成机制。研究发现，在特征学习机制下，内部表征谱的局部幂律指数随训练呈非单调演化，跨模态和训练时间最多可呈现四种不同的渐近状态；而在惰性机制下指数基本保持不变。数值实验表明类似动力学在更真实的非线性网络中也存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 幂律各向异性是生物和人工神经系统中广泛观察到的关键几何性质，支撑了许多理论分析，但其从输入结构和任务驱动学习中涌现的机制此前尚不清楚，因此需要理论表征这一形成过程。

Method: 在teacher-student框架下对具有幂律输入和教师结构的宽两层线性神经网络的学习动力学进行精确求解，分别分析特征学习机制和惰性机制下的内部表征谱指数演化，并通过数值实验验证非线性网络的推广性。

Result: 在特征学习机制下，内部表征谱的局部幂律指数在训练过程中呈非单调演化，跨模态和训练时间最多可出现四种不同的渐近状态；在惰性机制下指数基本保持不变。数值实验证实类似指数动力学在更真实的非线性网络中也存在。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了一个普遍机制：输入统计与任务结构的动态相互作用产生幂律内部表征，为理解神经系统中广泛存在的幂律各向异性提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Power-law anisotropy in internal representations has been observed across a wide range of biological and artificial neural systems, from state-of-the-art language models to the mouse cerebral cortex. This anisotropy is a key geometric property of high-dimensional information processing and underlies a variety of theoretical analyses. However, the mechanism by which it emerges from input structure and task-driven learning has remained unclear. Here, we characterize this formation process by exactly solving the learning dynamics of a wide two-layer linear neural network in a teacher--student setting with power-law input and teacher structures. We show that, in the feature-learning regime, the local power-law exponent of the internal-representation spectrum evolves nonmonotonically over the course of training and exhibits up to four distinct asymptotic regimes across modes and training times. By contrast, in the lazy regime, the exponent remains essentially unchanged. We further demonstrate numerically that similar exponent dynamics arise in more realistic nonlinear networks. Together, these results suggest a general mechanism by which the dynamic interaction between input statistics and task structure gives rise to power-law internal representations.

</details>


### [296] [Earth Observation Foundation Models for Terrestrial Ecohydrology: From Representation Learning to Process Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15282)
*Yi Yu,Jian Peng,Yucheng Lin,Trevor F. Keenan,Thomas F. A. Bishop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对地球观测基础模型（EOFMs）在生态水文学中的应用进行了系统综述，构建了一个"观测-推断"层级框架和元分析，发现EOFMs与生态水文需求之间存在错配：预训练数据以反射光学和主动微波为主，热红外覆盖稀疏且无被动微波发射源；应用证据随推断深度递减，通量独立验证、耦合动态、事件轨迹、校准不确定性和决策效益的证据仍显匮乏；基准审计显示物理一致性和不确定性评估薄弱。作者据此提出一个过程感知框架，使EOFMs的设计与评估与目标变量、观测路径和过程时间尺度对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生态水文学领域缺乏针对EOFMs的系统性综述，尚未评估EOFMs在生态水文场景中的相关性、应用证据和评估需求，尤其是在参考数据不确定、尺度错配和时间依赖性等挑战下的表现。作者旨在填补这一空白，识别EOFMs与生态水文实际需求之间的错配，并为可信赖的监测与解释提供指导。

Method: 本文采用多层次的综合分析方法：（1）构建"观测到推断"的层级框架，评估目标特异性感知路径、时空支持和可追溯不确定性；（2）进行元分析，梳理EOFMs预训练数据源的模态分布；（3）对生态水文应用证据进行综合评估；（4）对基准测试进行审计，比较通用EOFMs套件与生态水文专项评估的覆盖差异。

Result: 研究发现：（1）EOFMs对生态水文学的相关性取决于目标特异性感知路径、时空支持和不确定性可追溯性；（2）预训练以反射光学和主动微波数据为主，热红外覆盖不足，且完全没有被动微波辐射源；（3）应用上最强支持体现在空间上下文、标签高效适应和混合工作流，但独立通量验证、耦合动态、事件轨迹、校准不确定性和决策效益验证稀疏；（4）通用EOFMs套件在公平适应和可复现性方面覆盖较好，生态水文评估在过程目标、直接参考证据和分布偏移方面覆盖较好，但物理一致性和不确定性评估均薄弱。

Conclusion: EOFMs与生态水文需求之间存在系统性错配，需要采用过程感知框架来对齐EOFMs的设计与评估，使模型适配目标变量、观测路径和过程时间尺度，从而支持水-能量-碳耦合动态的可信监测与解释。

Abstract: Earth observation foundation models (EOFMs) are emerging as reusable representation frameworks for data-driven retrieval, prediction and process modelling within ecohydrology, which integrate EO, meteorological forcing and process models to characterise coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics in vegetation and soil across scales. However, there is yet to be an ecohydrology-specific synthesis assessing the EOFM relevance, application evidence or evaluation requirements under uncertain reference data, scale mismatch and temporal dependence. Here, we develop a framework for determining when EOFMs support interpretable inference and identify a mismatch between EOFMs and ecohydrological requirements. Firstly, an observation-to-inference hierarchy shows that relevance depends on target-specific sensing pathways, spatial-temporal support and traceable uncertainty. Secondly, a meta-analysis shows that pretraining is dominated by reflected optical and active-microwave data, with sparse thermal coverage and no passive-microwave-emission sources. Thirdly, our synthesis of ecohydrological applications finds strongest support for spatial context, label-efficient adaptation and hybrid workflows. Evidence declines with inference depth; independent validation of fluxes, coupled dynamics, event trajectories, calibrated uncertainty and decision benefits remains sparse. Fourthly, our benchmark audit finds stronger coverage of fair adaptation and reproducibility in general EOFM suites, and of process targets, direct reference evidence and distribution shifts in ecohydrological evaluations; physical consistency and uncertainty remain weakly assessed. These findings motivate a process-aware framework aligning EOFM design and evaluation with the target variable, observation pathway and process timescale, supporting trustworthy monitoring and interpretation of coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics.

</details>


### [297] [No Task Fails Every Time: Why One-Shot Audits Are Structurally Blind to Agent Damage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15286)
*Shiven Khurdi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AgentRelBench，一个与具体环境无关的可靠性评测工具，通过重复运行的数据库状态差异计算真实、按严重程度定价的损害（测量路径中不经过任何 LLM），并在 EnterpriseOps-Gym 上验证。在 2128 次评测运行、九个模型（六大族，含预注册的保留集与前沿模型探索性实验）中发现：不可逆动作的损害在所有被测家族中普遍存在且在同配置堆栈上具有随机性；没有任何任务在所有运行中都受损；造成损害的任务数量随模型能力下降；一个模型族在声明已拒绝的同时实施了受限的不可逆变更。所有确证性发现均预注册并设有逐条降级标准，其中一条降级了作者最初偏爱的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Agent 可靠性评测方法（如日志分析、评判模型等）往往依赖 LLM 参与测量路径，可能引入偏差，且难以获取真实、可量化的损害程度。需要一个不依赖 LLM、基于客观状态差异来测量 agent 可靠性的工具，以获得可信的 ground-truth 指标。

Method: 设计环境无关的评测仪器 AgentRelBench，通过对比同一任务重复运行前后的数据库状态差异，计算经过严重程度定价的损害值，测量路径中排除任何 LLM 参与。在 EnterpriseOps-Gym 场景中对九个模型（六大族：四个开发集、三个预注册保留集、两个前沿模型的探索性实验）进行了 2,128 次评估运行，并对确证性发现进行预注册、设定逐条降级标准。

Result: (1) 不可逆动作造成的损害在所有被测模型家族中普遍存在，且在同栈同配置下具有随机性；(2) 42 个保留集损害事件中无任何 "always-fail" 单元，单次干净运行漏检损害对 80%（开发池）与 57.5%（保留池，但低于预注册统计功效下限，报告为功效不足）；(3) 造成损害的任务数随模型能力下降（8B 模型 7/20，最强模型 1/20），但为观察性梯度而非因果结论；该最强模型在探索性前沿实验中仍以 p̂=0.16 概率受损，单次审计 84% 漏检；(4) 有一模型族在声明拒绝的同时实施了受限的不可逆变更，转录与评判者评分记为安全拒绝，仅状态差异识别为损害。

Conclusion: LLM Agent 对不可逆操作的可靠性损害是普遍、随机且难以被单次审计捕获的；基于 LLM 的评分（转录与评判者）会漏判实际状态损害，状态差异测量是必要补充。同时强调预注册与降级机制对科学诚实性的价值——其中一条降级了作者自己最初偏爱的结论。

Abstract: We introduce AgentRelBench, an environment-agnostic reliability instrument that computes ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path, demonstrated on EnterpriseOps-Gym. Across 2,128 evaluation runs spanning nine models in six families (four development, three pre-registered held-out, plus a frontier pass on two frontier-tier models that the pre-registration designates exploratory), we find: (1) damage on irreversible actions is universal across the families we measured and stochastic within them on pinned, single-provider stacks. (2) No task damaged on every run: zero always-fail cells across 42 confirmatory held-out damage events. A single clean run misses a damage-producing (model, task) pair 0.80 of the time on the development pool (13 pairs); the held-out pool is descriptively consistent (0.575 over 5 pairs, pair-weighted) but sits below our pre-registered power floor and is reported as underpowered, not as confirmation. (3) Damage-producing task count falls with model capability, from 7 of 20 tasks for an 8B model to 1 of 20 for the most capable; capability is confounded with family and training, so this is an observed gradient, not a causal claim. The residual damage does not change in character: in the exploratory frontier pass, the most capable model's one damaging task damages at $\hat{p} = 0.16$ per run, inside the same demonstrably-stochastic band, and a single audit misses it 84% of the time. (4) One model family committed the gated irreversible change while declaring it had refused: transcript- and judge-based grading scores those runs as safe refusals, only state diffs as damage. All confirmatory findings were pre-registered with per-claim demote criteria; one demoted our own initially favored finding, which we report.

</details>


### [298] [MAPLE: MoE Adaptive Plug-and-play Layer-wise Expert allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15299)
*Lie Li,Wen Li,Junxiao Shen,Gusheng Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MAPLE框架，在不修改权重或重新训练的前提下，将预训练MoE大语言模型中各层的路由专家预算进行异构重新分配，替代传统统一分配策略。通过闭式敏感性引导分配和敏感性约束的遗传搜索，在不同规模的四个MoE模型上超越了统一基线和剪枝基线，在75%专家预算下甚至超越100%专家统一基线，并在SGLang部署中降低32.2%端到端延迟、提升47.4%吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏激活的Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）Transformer在所有层使用相同数量的路由专家，但各层存在显著的冗余异质性（layer-wise redundancy heterogeneity）。这种统一分配策略系统性次优，忽视了不同层对专家数量的不同敏感度，浪费了计算和存储资源。

Method: MAPLE框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 闭式敏感性引导分配：探测每层对专家数量变化的响应，用三种度量量化敏感性，推导出解析最优的专家预算分配方案，将容量导向敏感层，在冗余层吸收削减；(2) 敏感性约束的遗传搜索：以层敏感性作为先验引导搜索空间，加速收敛并提高分配质量。整体为即插即用框架，无需改权重或重新训练。

Result: 在四个不同规模和架构的MoE模型上，以75%路由专家预算进行评测，MAPLE优于统一基线和基于剪枝的基线。在DeepSeek-MoE-16B上，仅用75%专家即在ARC-E、ARC-C和BoolQ上超越原始100%专家统一基线（准确率分别从65.09提升到71.40、48.49提升到51.50、80.03提升到82.38）。部署到SGLang后，单GPU端到端服务延迟降低32.2%，吞吐量提升47.4%。

Conclusion: 精心设计的异构专家分配比简单激活更多专家更有效，证明了异构分配是提升MoE效率的一个原则性且实用的新方向，为MoE推理效率优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Sparsely-activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers universally fix the same number of routed experts across all layers, a convention that ignores the well-documented heterogeneity in layer-wise redundancy. We demonstrate that this uniformity is systematically suboptimal and propose MAPLE, a plug-and-play framework that reallocates the routed-expert budget heterogeneously across layers of any pretrained MoE LLM, without modifying weights or requiring retraining. Our core contribution is a closed-form sensitivity-guided allocation: we probe each layer's response to variation in expert count, quantify sensitivity using three measures, and derive an analytically optimal budget assignment that directs capacity towards sensitive layers and absorbs reductions in redundant layers. This closed-form solution is further refined by a sensitivity-constrained genetic search that uses layer-wise sensitivity as a prior to guide exploration, yielding faster convergence and superior allocation quality. On four MoE models spanning different scales and architectures, MAPLE outperforms uniform and pruning-based baselines under a 75% routed-expert budget. Notably, on DeepSeek-MoE-16B, MAPLE uses only 75% of the experts yet surpasses the original 100% expert-uniform baseline on ARC-E, ARC-C, and BoolQ, improving accuracy from 65.09 to 71.40, 48.49 to 51.50, and 80.03 to 82.38, respectively. These accuracy gains translate into measured deployment efficiency: implementing MAPLE in SGLang reduces single-GPU end-to-end serving latency by 32.2% and improves throughput by 47.4%. These results show that well-designed heterogeneous allocation can be more effective than simply activating more experts, establishing it as a principled and practical axis for improving MoE efficiency.

</details>


### [299] [Shape Operator PCA: Curvature-Aware Projections for Geometric Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15313)
*Alexandre L. M. Levada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SHOPCA，一种基于形状算子的主成分分析方法，通过将局部微分几何信息（平均形状算子）整合进经典PCA的协方差矩阵中，实现无监督度量学习与降维，并在超过50个基准数据集上优于PCA，在小样本场景下超越UMAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典PCA仅关注数据的全局方差，忽略了数据流形的局部几何结构（曲率信息），导致在聚类等下游任务中性能受限；而现有流形学习方法（如ISOMAP、UMAP）在小样本场景下易退化且参数敏感。因此需要一种既能保留PCA计算效率与简洁性，又能融入几何曲率信息的无监督降维方法。

Method: SHOPCA利用数据流形上估计的局部形状算子（取绝对值后求平均）来正则化全局协方差矩阵。引入迹归一化的混合系数α控制正则化强度：α=0时为标准PCA，α→∞时退化为纯曲率驱动的嵌入。α的选择采用完全无监督的谱特征间隙（eigengap）准则，最大化前d个特征值与剩余特征值之间的相对分离度，无需类别标签。

Result: 在超过50个真实世界基准数据集上，以ARI、NMI、FM和V-measure为评价指标，SHOPCA相比PCA在广泛数据集上持续提升聚类质量；在小样本场景下超越UMAP，因为迭代式邻域流形估计在小样本中容易退化。同时SHOPCA计算效率高、参数少。

Conclusion: SHOPCA是一种计算可行、参数高效且完全无监督的几何感知降维方法，在保持PCA简易性的同时引入流形曲率信息，适用于需要无监督几何感知降维的领域，特别是在小样本数据场景下表现突出。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose SHOPCA (Shape Operator-based Principal Component Analysis), a novel method for unsupervised metric learning and dimensionality reduction that incorporates differential geometric information into the covariance structure of classical PCA. SHOPCA regularizes the global covariance matrix using the mean shape operator, defined as the average of the absolute local shape operators estimated from the data manifold, steering principal components toward directions of both maximum variance and informative curvature. A single trace-normalized mixing coefficient $α$ controls the regularization, recovering standard PCA at $α= 0$ and a curvature-driven embedding as $α\to \infty$. We further introduce a fully unsupervised criterion for selecting $α$ based on the spectral eigengap of the regularized covariance matrix, maximizing the relative separation between the top-$d$ and remaining eigenvalues without using class labels. We evaluate SHOPCA on more than 50 real-world benchmark datasets, comparing it with PCA, ISOMAP, and UMAP using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), Fowlkes-Mallows index (FM), and V-measure. Results show that SHOPCA consistently improves clustering quality over PCA across a broad range of datasets and surpasses UMAP on small-sample settings, where iterative neighborhood-based manifold estimation can degrade. SHOPCA is computationally tractable, parameter-efficient, and applicable to domains requiring fully unsupervised, geometry-aware dimensionality reduction.

</details>


### [300] [Spectral Rank Certification for Foundation Model Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15351)
*Mohammed Ahnouch,Lotfi Elaachak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对公开基础模型适配器（LoRA）提出了一套有限样本框架，用于推断校准的有效秩结构。理论核心是固定维高斯秩一参考实验的精确卡方散度，以及可计算的有限样本Le Cam界、截断余项界和矩形BBP极限。通过实证审计26个公开适配器、684个模块、6个架构家族和31,770个谱数据行，发现校准有效秩通常远小于名义秩，且与95%能量保留标准存在系统性差异。能源保留与统计显著性回答的是不同的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 名义LoRA秩是一个设计参数，而校准谱证据是一个独立的推断量。现有实践中常用名义秩或能量保留（如95%能量）来设定LoRA秩，但这些方法缺乏严格的统计推断基础。作者希望建立一套有限样本统计框架，从谱证据中推断真实的有效秩，以便更合理地设置和校准PEFT适配器的秩。

Method: (1) 推导固定维高斯秩一参考实验的精确卡方散度，未知信号方向在旋转不变的参考先验下积分，得到可计算的有限样本Le Cam界和数值截断余项界；(2) 推导矩形BBP极限；(3) 利用紧流形Laplace展开表明有限样本似然证据依赖谱间隙$s_1^{|m-n|}\prod_{i\ge2}(s_1^2-s_i^2)$，支持聚类奇异值的联合校准；(4) 提出经验空值工作流：因子重构、Monte Carlo p值、阶段式和分块检验、模块级和语料级BH报告；(5) 对26个公开适配器（684模块、6架构家族、31,770谱行）进行系统审计。

Result: 校准有效秩通常远小于名义秩，且与95%能量保留标准存在系统性、显著的差异。在RoBERTa-RTE切片（n=24）上展示了从校准秩到任务评估的完整测量路径，但不将该切片视为效用研究。

Conclusion: 校准有效秩通常远低于名义秩是主要实证发现；能量保留（衡量信号能量占比）与统计显著性（衡量与空值的偏离程度）回答不同的问题，应分别分析和解读。

Abstract: Nominal LoRA rank is a design parameter; calibrated spectral evidence is a separate inferential quantity. This article develops a finite-sample framework for inferring effective rank structure in public foundation-model adapters. The theoretical core is an exact chi-square divergence for the fixed-dimensional Gaussian rank-one reference experiment, with an unknown signal direction integrated under a rotation-invariant reference prior. The resulting series yields a computable finite-sample Le Cam bound at concrete layer sizes, an explicit remainder bound for numerical truncation, and the rectangular Baik-Ben Arous-Peche (BBP) limit. A compact-manifold Laplace expansion shows that finite-sample likelihood evidence also depends on leading spectral gaps through the factor $s_1^{|m-n|}\prod_{i\ge2}(s_1^2-s_i^2)$, motivating joint calibration of clustered singular values. Building on these results, we introduce an empirical-null workflow for PEFT LoRA adapters: factor reconstruction, Monte Carlo $p$-values, stagewise and block testing, and module-wise and corpus-level BH reporting. In an audit of 26 public adapters, 684 modules, six architecture families, and 31,770 public-checkpoint spectra rows, calibrated effective rank is typically much smaller than nominal rank and differs systematically from 95\% energy retention. A measured RoBERTa-RTE slice on $n=24$ examples illustrates the measurement path from calibrated ranks to task evaluation, without treating the slice as a utility study. The main empirical finding is that calibrated effective rank is usually far below nominal rank, and that energy retention and statistical surprise answer different questions.

</details>


### [301] [SAPE: Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency in Large Language Model Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15360)
*Mohammad Aref Jafari-Raddani,Morteza Mohajjel Kafshdooz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAPE是一种基于三明治式硬权重共享拓扑的PEFT框架，通过将中间Transformer层路由到平衡的共享组适配器，同时严格隔离输入嵌入和最终投影层的边界变换，在不增加动态参数共享方法计算开销的前提下大幅降低内存消耗。在低参数预算下达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT虽然通过减少可训练参数降低了LLM适配的硬件成本，但进一步改进的尝试中，均匀跨层参数共享会延迟收敛，动态掩码策略则增加计算开销。作者指出，利用Transformer架构固有的层次结构来设计共享模式的可能性在PEFT中尚未被探索，这是本文要填补的空白。

Method: SAPE采用三明治式硬权重共享拓扑：将中间Transformer层通过平衡的共享组适配器进行路由，同时严格隔离输入嵌入层和最终投影层的边界变换，以避免梯度干扰。这种硬共享设计显著减少内存消耗，且不引入动态参数共享方法带来的额外计算开销。作者还通过全面的拓扑消融实验分析了参数共享的影响。

Result: 在编码器-only和因果解码器架构上的广泛评估表明SAPE在低参数预算下达到SOTA性能。在NLU任务上，SAPE在RoBERTa-large上优于proPETL，仅使用其10%的参数预算。在NLG和世界知识推理任务中，使用LLaMA-3.2 (3B)并在严格~0.6M参数约束下，SAPE比AdaLoRA在GSM8K上绝对提升+4.85%，在CommonsenseQA上绝对提升+3.11%。

Conclusion: 通过全面的拓扑消融实验，作者形式化了一个内在的能力权衡：硬参数共享虽能强有力地正则化语义泛化，但会略微平滑刚性多步算术推理所需的锐利层间变换。

Abstract: While Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has substantially reduced the hardware cost of adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) by decreasing the number of trainable parameters, recent studies have sought to further improve PEFT through parameter sharing. However, these approaches either employ uniform parameter sharing across layers, which can delay convergence, or rely on dynamic masking strategies, which add computational overhead. The potential of sharing patterns inspired by the inherent hierarchical structure of Transformer architectures remains unexplored in PEFT. To address this gap, we introduce SAPE (Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency), a PEFT framework based on a sandwich-style hard weight-sharing topology. SAPE routes intermediate Transformer layers through balanced shared group adapters while strictly isolating the input embedding and final projection boundary transformations to prevent gradient interference. This design significantly reduces memory consumption while eliminating the computational overhead associated with dynamic parameter-sharing methods. Extensive evaluations across encoder-only and causal decoder architectures demonstrate that SAPE achieves state-of-the-art performance in low-parameter regimes. On natural language understanding, SAPE outperforms proPETL on RoBERTa-large while utilizing only 10% of the baseline's parameter budget. On natural language generation and world knowledge reasoning with LLaMA-3.2 (3B) under a strict ~0.6M parameter constraint, SAPE outperforms AdaLoRA, yielding absolute improvements of +4.85% on GSM8K and +3.11% on CommonsenseQA. Furthermore, through comprehensive topological ablations, we formalize an inherent capacity trade-off: while hard parameter sharing strongly regularizes semantic generalization, it slightly smooths the sharp layer-wise transformations required for rigid multi-step arithmetic reasoning.

</details>


### [302] [Does 1/2-Tsallis-INF Also Work Well for Best-Arm Identification?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15365)
*Jingxin Zhan,Yuze Han,Zhihua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了1/2-Tsallis-INF这一经典的regret最小化FTRL算法，在随机bandit环境下无需额外探索是否能可靠地识别最优臂。通过构造Lyapunov函数分析最优臂与最佳竞争臂之间累积损失估计的gap过程，证明了错误概率Err_t以多项式速率衰减，并给出了紧的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1/2-Tsallis-INF在regret最小化中具有"两全其美"性质（随机环境对数伪regret，对抗环境minimax最优），但能否在同一算法框架下（不增加额外探索）同时实现best-arm identification（BAI）是一个自然且重要的问题。关键在于：在对数regret尺度下，次优臂采样概率约为1/t，重要性加权导致累积估计器在线性尺度上与均值差同量级波动，这使得精确分析变得困难。

Method: 以一个diffusion toy model为启发，为最优臂与最佳竞争臂之间累积损失估计的gap过程构造Lyapunov函数。分析中考虑了学习率η_t=α/√t的设置，通过Lyapunov函数的漂移分析推导错误概率的多项式上界。同时建立了匹配的下界来证明指数的紧致性。

Result: 对学习率η_t=α/√t，错误概率Err_t以t^{-2+α²μ_{i*}/4+ρ}的速率衰减（对任意ρ>0），其中μ_{i*}是最优臂的均值损失。同时证明了Ω(t^{-2-ε})的下界（对任意ε>0），表明指数2本质上是最优的。

Conclusion: 1/2-Tsallis-INF在不额外增加探索的情况下，能以多项式速率可靠地识别最优臂，错误概率的指数2本质上是紧的。这为"regret最小化算法天然具备BAI能力"提供了理论保证，表明该算法在无需预先知道环境类型的条件下同时兼顾了regret最优与可靠的臂识别。

Abstract: Regret minimization (RM) and best-arm identification (BAI) are two fundamental objectives in multi-armed bandits. Among regret-minimizing algorithms, $1/2$-Tsallis-INF is a canonical best-of-both-worlds FTRL algorithm: it achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic bandits while retaining minimax-optimal regret in adversarial bandits, without knowing the environment in advance. This raises a natural question: can the same algorithm, without additional exploration, also identify the best arm reliably? We study this question in stochastic bandits by analyzing the failure probability $\operatorname{Err}_t$, defined as the probability that the empirical best arm determined by the cumulative importance-weighted loss estimates of 1/2-Tsallis-INF differs from the true optimal arm. The main difficulty is that, at the logarithmic-regret scale, suboptimal arms are sampled with probability heuristically of order $1/t$. Consequently, importance weighting causes the cumulative estimator to fluctuate on the same linear scale as its mean separation. To overcome this obstacle, guided by a diffusion toy model, we construct a Lyapunov function for the gap process between the estimated cumulative loss of the optimal arm and that of the best competing arm. This leads to polynomial upper bounds on $\operatorname{Err}_t$: for learning rate $η_t=α/\sqrt t$, $\operatorname{Err}_t$ decays at rate $t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}$ for any $ρ>0$, where $μ_{i_*}$ denotes the mean loss of the true optimal arm. We also establish a lower bound $Ω(t^{-2-\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$, showing that the exponent $2$ is essentially tight.

</details>


### [303] [Beyond Field Accuracy: Two-Axis Diagnosis of Inverse-PINN Parameter Error](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15373)
*Yifan Zhang,Qian Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双轴后训练诊断方法，用于分离逆物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在参数重建中有限样本分辨率与符号参数偏好两个维度，并通过合成实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆PINNs在重建场时可能返回正确的场数据却给出错误的物理参数，现有方法无法区分这种失败源于观测/估计协议的有限样本分辨率问题，还是最终学习到的场与残差度量所编码的符号参数偏好问题。

Method: 提出双轴后训练诊断：第一轴使用匹配的正向估计器对噪声观测反复拟合，分离有限样本分辨率；第二轴冻结场与残差视图，计算局部分数向邻近残差剖面最小值的位移，并通过端点一致性测试联合训练是否在该最终视图下达成此偏好。该诊断被设计为互补的诊断坐标，而非可加误差成分或可部署的无预言机估计器。

Result: 在三个合成一维标量参数PDE上，匹配正向估计的MARE范围为2.34%至17.46%。位移量在锁定种子、架构和新噪声重训练下跟踪冻结剖面最小值（r=0.945至0.982），并在240次新噪声RBA运行中跟踪交付的有符号对数误差（r=0.994；237/240方向正确）。双参数Darcy检验验证了完整矩阵计算。

Conclusion: 两个轴是互补的诊断坐标而非可加误差成分，它们共同将后续工作导引至观测、残差证据或端点交付这三个方向，为逆PINNs参数的诊断与改进提供了系统路径。

Abstract: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can reconstruct a field accurately while returning an incorrect physical parameter. We introduce a two-axis post-training diagnosis that separates finite-sample resolution under a specified observation-and-estimation protocol from the signed parameter preference encoded by the final learned field and residual metric. The first axis repeatedly fits noisy observations with a matched forward estimator. At known synthetic truth, the second freezes the field and residual view and computes a local score displacement toward a nearby residual-profile minimum. Endpoint consistency then tests whether joint training delivers that preference under the same final view. Across three synthetic one-dimensional, scalar-parameter PDEs, matched-forward mean absolute relative error ranges from 2.34 percent to 17.46 percent. The displacement tracks frozen-profile minima across locked seeds, architectures, and fresh-noise retraining (r from .945 to .982), and it tracks delivered signed log-error in 240 fresh-noise RBA runs (r = .994; 237/240 correct directions). A coupled two-parameter Darcy check validates the full matrix calculation. The axes are complementary diagnostic coordinates, not additive error components or a deployable oracle-free estimator. Together, they route follow-up work toward observations, residual evidence, or endpoint delivery.

</details>


### [304] [Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15383)
*Amjad Saab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ExactMoE 是一种面向稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型的推理设计，仅对路由专家应用对称4-bit权重量化，并以MARLIN格式存储在主机固定内存中，通过GPU驻留的槽缓存和融合分组MoE内核执行所选专家。在OLMoE-1B-7B上，16槽配置将峰值GPU显存从14.168降至1.836 GiB（降87.04%），保留81.85%的BF16解码吞吐；64槽全驻留配置达到31.923 tokens/s（BF16为21.662），保留99.23%的零样本准确率。该工作揭示了完整专家MoE推理的显存-吞吐量权衡边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE语言模型虽然通过仅激活部分专家来减少计算量，但部署时仍需存储和移动全部专家权重，导致显存和访存开销巨大。现有方法通常通过专家剪枝、替换或CPU卸载来缓解，但这些方案会损害专家可用性并改变路由行为。作者希望在不牺牲任何专家可用性的前提下，实现MoE推理的显存压缩与吞吐优化。

Method: ExactMoE采用以下关键技术：1) 仅对路由专家应用对称组128四比特权重量化，路由器、注意力、嵌入、归一化和语言模型头保持BF16精度；2) 量化后的专家以内核原生的MARLIN格式存储在固定主机内存中；3) 通过可配置的GPU驻留槽缓存按需加载选中的专家；4) 使用融合的Grouped MoE内核并行执行所有被选中的专家。该方法不剪枝、不替换任何专家，完全保留top-k路由过程。

Result: 在单块NVIDIA L4上对OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct评估：16槽配置将峰值保留显存从14.168降至1.836 GiB（-87.04%），保留81.85%的BF16解码吞吐；64槽全驻留配置达到31.923 tokens/s（BF16为21.662），显存占用4.061 GiB；在12,450道零样本多项选择题上获得70.3534%归一化准确率（BF16为70.8996%），保留99.23%基线准确率；融合分组执行比顺序W4参考快1.97倍。

Conclusion: ExactMoE展示了在保持完整专家可用性的前提下，通过量化、显存层次管理和融合内核优化，可以实现显存占用的大幅降低与吞吐提升，同时保持极高的精度保留率。研究揭示了"完整专家MoE推理"中显存-吞吐量之间的实用权衡边界，为MoE模型在受限硬件上的高效部署提供了新思路。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kernels. The router, attention, embeddings, normalization layers, and language-model head remain in BF16.
