"Exact" refers to complete expert availability and an unchanged top-k routing procedure: no expert is pruned, substituted, or forced to execute on the CPU. It does not imply numerical identity with the BF16 model. On OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct, evaluated on a single NVIDIA L4, a 16-slot configuration reduces peak reserved GPU memory from 14.168 to 1.836 GiB (87.04%) while retaining 81.85% of BF16 decode throughput. A fully resident 64-slot configuration reaches 31.923 tokens/s versus 21.662 tokens/s for BF16 while reserving 4.061 GiB. Across 12,450 zero-shot multiple-choice questions, ExactMoE obtains 70.3534% normalized accuracy versus 70.8996% for BF16, retaining 99.23% of the baseline accuracy. In a matched 16-token ablation, fused grouped execution is 1.97x as fast as a sequential W4 reference. These results identify a practical memory-transfer-throughput frontier for complete-expert MoE inference.

</details>


### [305] [Look Before You Lift: Visual and Quantitative Diagnostics for Topological Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15388)
*Mathilde Papillon,Guillermo Bernárdez,Álvaro Ballón Barreiro,Marco Montagna,Rémi Devaux,Antoine Jardin,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TopoExplorer，一种基于严格增广Hasse图的拓扑深度学习数据集可视化技术，使从业者能够首次直观地查看提升后的高阶离散域（如单纯复形、胞腔复形、超图）中的关联与邻接结构，并读取描述结构及特征景观的关键图指标。实验表明这些指标与下游模型性能相关，将TDL工作流从'提升-训练'重新定义为'提升-查看-设计-训练'。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑深度学习中的提升步骤被当作黑盒处理，从业者选择某种提升后直接调整架构，无法判断生成的高阶连接对下游任务是否有意义，缺乏诊断层来评估提升质量。

Method: 提出TopoExplorer可视化工具，利用严格增广Hasse图形式呈现拓扑数据集，使从业者能够可视化基于关联和邻接的邻域结构，并读取描述数据集结构与特征景观的关键图指标；通过跨多个数据集和提升方式的实验验证指标与模型性能的相关性。

Result: 实验表明多个图指标与下游模型性能存在相关性，表明这些指标可用于指导拓扑深度学习预处理设计。

Conclusion: 将TDL工作流从提升-训练重构为提升-查看-设计-训练，实现更规范、可解释且高效的模型开发流程。

Abstract: Topological deep learning (TDL) methods rely on lifting raw data into higher-order discrete domains such as simplicial complexes, cell complexes, and hypergraphs. In practice, this lifting step is often treated as a black box: practitioners select a lifting and then tune architectures, with limited visibility into whether the induced higher-order connectivity is meaningful for the downstream task. To address this missing diagnostic layer, we propose a visualization technique called TopoExplorer that leverages the strictly augmented Hasse graph form of topological datasets for exploratory data analysis. For the first time, practitioners can easily visualize the incidence- and adjacency-based neighborhoods that define the lifted dataset, as well as read off key graph metrics that describe its structural and feature landscape. Via an extensive set of experiments across many datasets and liftings, we show that several of these metrics correlate with downstream model performance, suggesting they can help inform TDL preprocessing design. Our perspective reframes the TDL workflow from lift-train to lift-look-design-train, enabling more principled, interpretable, and efficient model development. TopoExplorer is hosted at https://topoexplorer.pagekite.me, and its source code is available at github.com/geometric-intelligence/topoexplorer.

</details>


### [306] [Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15402)
*Steve Hanneke,Hongao Wang,Mingyue Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从统计学习视角系统地研究推理时对齐问题，将其形式化为弱到强的学习问题，引入对齐维数（alignment dimension）作为奖励类的一个新组合维度，并证明它完全刻画了对齐可学习性——奖励类可对齐学习当且仅当其对齐维数有限。学习方法的核心是通过调用普通的一包含图（one-inclusion graph）算法，对所有互不为子集的标签集对运行锦标赛过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型对齐虽然在监督微调和推理时计算方面取得了显著进展，但从统计学习角度对其理解仍然不足。现有的推理时对齐理论假设可以访问良好的奖励估计，而实际问题中一切都需要从数据中学习。因此需要建立一个从零学习的、基于PAC原则的对齐学习理论框架，以提供对对齐问题的完整理论理解。

Method: 论文将对齐问题形式化为弱到强学习问题：假设参考策略（弱学习器）相当好，目标是产生一个强学习器，使其在测试时能以任意高概率预测好响应。问题完全从数据学习（而非依赖奖励估计），允许每个提示对应多个好响应。作者定义了奖励类的对齐维数这一新型组合维度，并采用PAC学习原理定义对齐可学习性。核心学习过程通过调用普通的一包含图算法，在满足"互不为子集"条件的标签集对上运行锦标赛机制。

Result: 证明了对齐维数完全刻画了对齐可学习性：奖励类的对齐维数有限当且仅当该奖励类是可对齐学习的。这建立了一个精确的充分必要条件，类似于经典PAC学习中VC维的角色。

Conclusion: 该工作首次为推理时对齐提供了从零学习的统计学完备刻画，为建立完整的对齐理论理解奠定了基础，对后续对齐算法的设计与分析具有指导意义。

Abstract: Generative model alignment has received broad interest, and significant progress has been made in supervised fine-tuning and inference-time computation. Yet, alignment has remained poorly understood from a statistical learning perspective. We formulate inference-time alignment as a weak-to-strong learning problem, where a reference policy (weak learner) is assumed to be fairly good and the goal is to produce a strong learner that predicts a good response at test time with arbitrarily high probability. Our problem is formulated as learning from scratch --- everything is learned from data rather than assuming access to a good reward estimate, and thus differs from the existing inference-time alignment theory. Our model shares similarity to the recent work of arXiv:2510.15464, where for each prompt, there could be multiple good responses. Our definition of the alignment learnability follows the PAC learning principle. We introduce a novel combinatorial dimension of the reward class which we call the alignment dimension, and show that it completely characterizes the alignment learnability --- a reward class is alignment learnable if and only if its alignment dimension is finite. The core of our learning procedure works by invoking the ordinary one-inclusion graph algorithm to run a tournament over all pairs of label sets satisfying that neither is a subset of the other. We believe our results might shed light on establishing a complete theoretical understanding towards alignment.

</details>


### [307] [FAST-DeepONet: Factor-Augmented Branch Representations for High-Dimensional PDE Inputs in the Small-Sample Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15408)
*Jiyong Kwon,Bongseok Kim,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FAST-DeepONet提出一种结合固定谱路径与正交残差正则化投影的分支网络表示，解决了DeepONet在强相关传感器数量大但算子样本少时的统计不稳定性，使传感器网格可以精细化而不产生统计惩罚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当偏微分方程输入在数千个强相关传感器上观测且仅有少量算子样本时，深度算子网络会变得统计不稳定（普通DeepONet在Navier-Stokes流上误差从0.0394退化到0.1556）。需要一种方法允许网格细化而不付出统计代价。

Method: FAST-DeepONet的分支表示由两部分组成：一个固定的谱路径（固定谱基）加上对正交残差进行正则化投影。方向性惩罚作用于每一行归一化后的有效残差映射上。该架构面向坐标查询，仅基于解值进行训练。

Result: 在Navier-Stokes流上，普通DeepONet在分支从129增长到8193个坐标时误差从0.0394退化到0.1556，而FAST-DeepONet保持在0.04附近。在Navier-Stokes、Darcy流和符号终端波场预测的独立测试集上，平均相对L2误差降低4.7%~37.0%，且可训练参数减少3~7倍。

Conclusion: 分离消融实验表明：固定谱路径单独负责Navier-Stokes和Darcy流上的改进，而终端波预测需要残差路径及其方向性惩罚。FAST-DeepONet有效解耦了网格分辨率与统计稳定性，提升了泛化性能同时大幅减少参数。

Abstract: Deep operator networks can become statistically unstable when partial differential equation inputs are observed at thousands of strongly correlated sensors but only a small number of operator samples is available. We introduce FAST-DeepONet, a branch representation combining a fixed spectral path with a regularized projection of the orthogonal residual, in which the directional penalty acts on the effective residual map after each of its rows is normalized. On Navier--Stokes flow a plain DeepONet degrades from $0.0394$ to $0.1556$ mean relative $L_2$ error as the branch grows from $129$ to $8193$ coordinates, while FAST-DeepONet stays near $0.04$, so the sensor grid can be refined without a statistical penalty. Across independent test sets for Navier--Stokes flow, Darcy flow, and signed terminal wavefield prediction it lowers mean relative $L_2$ error by $4.7\%$ to $37.0\%$ with three to seven times fewer trainable parameters. A spectral-only branch sharing the same basis separates the two paths: the fixed spectral path carries the improvement on Navier--Stokes and Darcy, while terminal wave prediction requires the residual path together with its directional penalty. FAST-DeepONet targets coordinate-query architectures and trains on solution values alone.

</details>


### [308] [Invariant Pretraining for Robust Code Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15412)
*Yifeng He,Yundi Xu,Christopher Castro Gaw Gonzalo,Zili Wang,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为不变预训练（InvPT）的仅代码微调方法，通过语义保持变换配合多正样本监督对比学习，显著缩小了编码器在同类程序（语义等价但语法不同）上的表征鲁棒性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于编码器的代码表示模型在判别任务（如克隆检测、代码分类）中因体积小、推理成本低而广泛部署，但其鲁棒性脆弱——在语义等价的程序变体下表示质量大幅退化。现有研究缺乏对这一问题系统性的量化评估，也缺乏能够弥补该差距的有效方法。

Method: 首先对四个编码器基线、两个下游任务和四个数据集进行鲁棒性差距的经验研究。随后提出InvPT：对语料施加语义保持变换，结合掩码语言建模与多正样本监督对比学习。将同一源函数的所有增强视为正样本，混合自对比对（相同代码、不同掩码）与不变对比对（变换后代码）以提供不同难度的正样本。该方法仅需代码数据，不依赖自然语言配对数据。

Result: 在变换后的测试集上，InvPT在克隆检测上最多提升11个百分点、代码分类上最多提升19个百分点，同时保持或提升标准准确率。消融实验表明多正样本不变对比学习是收益的主要来源。

Conclusion: 本文目标并非提出全新目标函数，而是对编码器鲁棒性在何处失效以及简单仅代码方案能在多大程度上恢复它进行精细测量。InvPT证明仅需极简的代码级连续预训练配方即可大幅弥合鲁棒性差距，且无需自然语言配对数据。

Abstract: Encoder-based code representation models remain widely deployed for discriminative tasks such as clone detection and code classification, where their small size and low inference cost are decisive. Their robustness, however, is fragile: under invariant programs, semantically equivalent code written in different syntactic forms, learned representations degrade substantially even though program behavior is unchanged. We present an empirical study of this robustness gap across four encoder baselines, two downstream tasks, and four datasets, together with a minimal code-only continued pretraining recipe that closes much of it. Our method, invariant pretraining (InvPT), applies semantic-preserving transformations to the corpus and combines masked language modeling with multi-positive supervised contrastive learning that treats all augmentations of the same source function as positives, mixing self-contrast pairs (same code, different masks) with invariant-contrast pairs (transformed code) for positives of varying difficulty. Unlike prior contrastive code encoders, InvPT does not require paired natural-language data. Across our evaluation, InvPT improves robustness on transformed test sets by up to 11 percentage points on clone detection and 19 on code classification while matching or improving standard accuracy, and our ablations isolate multi-positive invariant contrast as the main source of the gains. Our aim is not a new objective but a careful measurement of where encoder robustness breaks and how far a simple, code-only recipe can recover it.

</details>


### [309] [SAGA: Structure-Attended Generative Action Embedding Model that encodes Multi-Surface User Action Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15429)
*Tsz Fung Pang,Po Jen Chen,Nimish Ronghe,Farhad Farahani,Bo Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAGA是一种生成式动作嵌入模型，通过跨字段分词方案将多表面用户交互序列（涵盖结账、P2P交易、应用内参与、邮件和账户操作）编码为统一用户表示，用于下游推荐任务，并在离线消融研究和下游点击/转化提升中展现出优于替代架构的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有顺序推荐嵌入模型通常在单一同质动作空间中操作，无法捕捉跨越不同行为领域的跨表面行为信号。金融服务的生态系统中用户行为分布多个表面（结账、P2P、应用内互动、邮件、账户操作），需要一个统一的用户表示模型来融合这些异质信号。

Method: SAGA采用生成式动作嵌入方法，核心是逐字段（per-field）分词方案：将每个动作事件分解为多个字段级token（如产品、交互、表面），支持字段级注意力机制和逐字段训练目标，突破了单token方法无法支持的多粒度聚合能力。

Result: 通过针对损失函数形式、分词粒度和训练数据范围的离线消融研究，隔离了各设计选择的贡献。集成SAGA用户嵌入的下游模型在多个下游触点中取得了最强的综合点击和转化提升，优于所有消融变体和替代架构。

Conclusion: SAGA通过跨动作空间的字段级tokenization统一编码多表面用户行为，其设计选择（损失形式、分词粒度、训练数据范围）对最终效果各有贡献，且在实际下游推荐任务中相较替代方案具有更优的表现。

Abstract: Prior embedding models for sequential recommendation typically operate within a homogeneous action space, limiting their ability to capture cross-surface behavioral signals spanning distinct behavioral domains. We present SAGA, a generative action embedding model that encodes multi-surface user interaction sequences across a Financial Service organization's ecosystems, from checkout, peer-to-peer (P2P) transactions, in-app engagement, email to account actions, into a unified user representation for downstream recommendation tasks. Central to SAGA is a per-field tokenization schema that decomposes each action event into multiple field-level tokens (e.g. product, interaction, surface), enabling field-level attention and per-field training objectives that fused single-token approaches cannot support. Through an offline ablation study on loss formulation, tokenization granularity and training data scope, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. A downstream model integrated with SAGA-generated user embeddings delivers the strongest overall click and conversion lift across diverse downstream touchpoints, compared to all ablated and alternative architectures.

</details>


### [310] [Detecting Money Laundering in Rwandan Mobile Money: A Machine Learning Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15447)
*Emmanuel Nahimana,Yaé Ulrich Gaba*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对卢旺达移动货币生态中的反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CFT）监管场景，提出并评估了一个交易监控框架。基于包含950万笔交易、17种洗钱类型的SAML-D合成数据集，构建账户级行为特征，并基准测试了监督分类器、无监督异常检测器、自编码器及融合元学习器。在极端类别不平衡（~0.1%）、标签稀缺延迟、调查人员能力受限的现实约束下，LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469，融合堆叠器达到PR-AUC=0.0477，二者均实现约90-91%精度和约0.5/万笔的告警率。论文贡献在于面向非洲移动货币监管者治理约束的运营级流水线与评估协议，而非新算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动货币扩大了撒哈拉以南非洲的金融覆盖面，同时也扩大了高量低值交易生态中洗钱与恐怖融资（ML/TF）的风险面。卢旺达拥有数百万活跃移动货币用户、电信主导的钱包及监管交易流规模超出静态规则监控能力的金融情报中心（FIC）。以卢旺达为典型案例，研究者旨在应对监管机构面临的极端类别不平衡（~0.1%）、标签稀缺且延迟、调查人员能力有限的三大现实约束，构建可行的交易监控框架。

Method: 使用SAML-D合成数据集（9,504,852笔交易、17种洗钱类型），工程化账户中心行为特征（滚动速度、净流向方向性、交易对手多样性、突发性）。基准测试包括监督分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、LightGBM）、无监督异常检测器（孤立森林、局部离群因子）、密集自编码器及晚期融合元学习器。评估指标采用运营导向的PR-AUC、~90%精度校准点召回率、top-K%召回率及每万笔告警数，按时间顺序划分持有测试集。

Result: 在时间持有测试集上，LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469，以~0.89精度捕获64个洗钱案例，告警率为0.51/万笔；融合堆叠器达到PR-AUC=0.0477，~0.91精度、0.46/万笔告警率，恢复59个真实正例。研究将分数区间映射到卢旺达相关分析师工作流及STR/SAR升级路径，并规划了从合成原型到与卢旺达国家银行和FIC真实数据验证的分阶段路径。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献是运营层面的：提供了一个治理感知的流水线和评估协议，针对非洲移动货币监管者的约束条件进行校准。其核心价值不在于提出新算法，而在于展示如何在极端类别不平衡、标签稀缺和人力有限的真实约束下，构建可操作、可部署的AML/CFT交易监控框架，并为从合成数据到真实数据的验证过渡提供可行路径。

Abstract: Mobile money has widened financial access across Sub-Saharan Africa and enlarged the surface for money-laundering and terrorism-financing (ML/TF) activity in ecosystems dominated by high-volume, low-value transactions. Rwanda is a case in point: several million active mobile-money users, telecom-led wallets on the MTN and Airtel networks, and a Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) supervising transaction streams whose scale exceeds static rule-based monitoring. This paper develops and evaluates a transaction-monitoring framework aligned to the Rwandan AML/CFT regime under (i) extreme class imbalance (~0.1% prevalence), (ii) scarce and delayed labels, and (iii) bounded investigator capacity. Using SAML-D, a synthetic dataset of 9,504,852 transactions with 17 laundering typologies, we engineer account-centric behavioural features (rolling velocity, net-flow directionality, counterparty diversity, burstiness) and benchmark supervised classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM), unsupervised anomaly detectors (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor), a dense autoencoder, and a late-fusion meta-learner. Evaluation is operational: PR-AUC, recall at a calibrated ~90%-precision point, recall at top-K%, and alerts per 10,000. On the chronologically held-out test period, LightGBM attains PR-AUC = 0.0469, capturing 64 laundering cases at precision ~0.89 with 0.51 alerts per 10,000; the fusion stacker reaches PR-AUC = 0.0477 at precision ~0.91 and 0.46 alerts per 10,000, recovering 59 true positives. We map score bands to Rwanda-relevant analyst workflows and STR/SAR escalation, and outline a staged path from synthetic prototyping to real-data validation with the National Bank of Rwanda and FIC. The contribution is operational: a governance-aware pipeline and evaluation protocol calibrated to the constraints of an African mobile-money regulator, not a new algorithm.

</details>


### [311] [Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15459)
*Aditya Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于注意力机制的综合性综述，涵盖其从序列到序列任务到计算机视觉的演进，以及效率、可解释性方面的创新。通过EEI（效率-表达力-可解释性）评分框架对21种方法进行对比，并利用蒙特卡洛分析表明结果仅支持粗粒度的层级比较而非细粒度排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力机制在过去十年驱动了机器学习领域的发展，从神经机器翻译到通用推理语言模型。然而，注意力研究的四个核心方向（序列任务公式化、计算机视觉适配、二次复杂度瓶颈的效率创新、可解释性进展）缺乏系统的整合性综述，且缺乏统一的评价框架来横向比较不同方法。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供一个结构化的、涵盖2015-2026年的全面调研。

Method: 作者定义了效率、表达力和可解释性三个评价标准，对21种注意力方法进行了EEI评分。评分由单一评分者给出并假设±1分的扰动范围，随后采用确定性蒙特卡洛分析（20万次采样）检验排名的稳定性，并使用排名匹配的零模型进行对照验证。此外，论文提供了结构化叙事综述、跨研究基准综合、五问题研究空白分析和2015-2026年演进时间线。

Result: 蒙特卡洛分析显示，在该扰动模型下，超过一个位次的排名变化在67-70%的样本中发生，排名匹配的零模型重现了类似的稳定性特征，表明细粒度排名不可靠。研究覆盖了Bahdanau-Luong对齐到Transformer再到视觉架构的演进，以及固定/学习稀疏注意力、线性注意力、IO感知精确算法（FlashAttention）和状态空间模型（Mamba）等方法，并探讨了归纳头、叠加和注意力-SSM对偶性。

Conclusion: 作者将注意力研究框定为效率-表达力-可解释性前沿的扩张过程，并指出未来研究方向包括：统一效率基准的建立、混合架构的学习路由、长度泛化问题以及可扩展的机制可解释性。该综述的核心贡献在于提供了一个诚实评估方法排序稳健性的框架，而不是简单的性能排行榜。

Abstract: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring framework. Scores come from a single rater with an assumed +/-1-point perturbation range. A deterministic Monte Carlo analysis with 200,000 samples shows that, under this perturbation model, rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples on average. A rank-matched null model reproduces a similar stability profile, so the results support coarse tier-level comparisons rather than fine-grained rankings. The survey traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through the Transformer and into vision architectures. It reviews fixed and learned sparse attention, linear attention, IO-aware exact algorithms including FlashAttention, and state-space alternatives including Mamba. It also covers induction heads, superposition, and the attention-SSM duality. We further provide a structured narrative review, a benchmark synthesis with cross-study caveats, a five-problem research gap analysis, and a 2015-2026 evolution timeline. We conclude by framing attention research as an expansion of the efficiency-expressiveness-interpretability frontier and identifying future directions including unified efficiency benchmarks, learned routing for hybrid architectures, length generalization, and scalable mechanistic interpretability.

</details>


### [312] [High-Dimensional Nonparametric Change-Point Detection via Low-Rank Degree-Three Density Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15466)
*Guoqing Zhang,Zhaixin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种非参数变点检测方法，利用三阶Legendre特征张量对密度投影进行等距编码，无需直接密度估计即可捕获均值、协方差不可见的分布变化（偏度、非对称交互等三阶结构）。算法采用播种最短区间与局部去中心化步骤，并通过归纳法证明精确恢复，在小跳变情形下达到与Le Cam下界匹配的O(κ⁻²)定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的变点检测方法通常依赖均值或协方差的变化，但许多分布变化在均值和协方差上不可见，仅体现在偏度、非对称交互等高阶（三阶）结构中。作者希望开发一种非参数方法，能够检测这类隐藏在三阶结构中的分布变化，同时避免直接估计密度（在高维下不可行）。

Method: 1) 构建对称三阶Legendre特征张量H₃(X)∈Sym³(R^{d+1})，使得A(f)=E_fH₃(X)对三阶密度投影构成精确等距编码；2) 利用固定张量收缩作为三阶多项式混沌，具有ψ_{2/3}尾部；3) 对坐标正交特例将界改进至√log d，支持数百维的前缀和实现；4) 推导总体帐篷形和定位边际，引入播种最短区间算法与填充局部去中心化步骤；5) 通过归纳法证明精确恢复（空递归段保持非活动、未检测变化保有平衡隔离区间）；6) 双向交叉拟合标量精化在小跳变区达到O(κ⁻²)定位。

Result: 在小跳变情形下达到O_P(κ⁻²)的定位精度，与纯三次族（二阶投影跳变为零）上的Le Cam下界匹配。在d∈{20,50,100,200}及d=100三变点序列的实验中，证明了其在高维情形下的可行性，且无需具体化(d+1)³大小的张量。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法能够在高维环境下有效检测仅体现在三阶结构中的分布变化，兼具理论最优性和计算可行性，为分布变点检测提供了一个不依赖均值协方差、也不依赖直接密度估计的新框架。

Abstract: Distributional changes can be invisible to means and covariances yet appear in skewness, asymmetric interactions, or other third-order structure. We develop a nonparametric change-point method that retains every degree-at-most-three coefficient of a density while avoiding direct density estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, we construct a symmetric order-three Legendre feature tensor $H_3(X)\in\Sym^3(\R^{d+1})$ such that $A(f)=\E_fH_3(X)$ is an exact isometric encoding of the degree-three density projection: $\|A(f)-A(g)\|_{\F}=\|P_3(f-g)\|_{L^2}$. Instead, fixed tensor contractions are degree-three polynomial chaoses with $ψ_{2/3}$ tails. The two terms have the characteristic order-three tensor scaling and match the powers in sharp concentration results for simple random tensors. For a coordinate-orthogonal specialization, the bound improves to $\sqrt{\log d}$ and enables a prefix-sum implementation in hundreds of dimensions. We derive the exact population tent shape and localization margin, introduce a seeded shortest-interval algorithm with a padded local recentering step, and prove exact recovery by induction: null recursive segments remain inactive, every undetected change retains a balanced isolating interval, and the shortest active seed contains exactly one change before recentering. A two-way cross-fitted scalar refinement attains $O_{\Pp}(κ^{-2})$ localization in the small-jump regime, matching a Le Cam lower bound on a pure cubic family whose degree-two projection jump is exactly zero. Reproducible experiments at $d\in\{20,50,100,200\}$ and a three-change $d=100$ sequence demonstrate the intended high-dimensional regime without materializing a $(d+1)^3$ tensor.

</details>


### [313] [Population Structure Analysis of an Inbred Population using Quantitative Shape Phenotyping from Stereo Retinal Photographs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15471)
*Li Tang,Michael D Abramoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过对诺福克岛781人（其中318人为邦蒂号叛乱者后裔）的视网膜立体照片进行三维视神经头（ONH）形状重建，利用深度神经网络进行无监督特征学习，提取层次化特征并基于判别力选择特征，通过分层交叉验证评估种群分类准确率。随后对个体进行层次聚类分析，研究近交群体的表型群体结构，为青光眼等视神经相关眼病的遗传风险因素研究提供基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索利用视网膜表型（而非基因型）进行群体结构分析的可能性，利用诺福克岛特有的近交人群（含邦蒂号叛乱者后裔的遗传隔离群体），为青光眼等视神经相关疾病的遗传连锁分析提供新途径。

Method: 1) 从立体视网膜眼底照片通过多尺度立体匹配算法重建三维ONH形态；2) 使用深度神经网络通过自学习方法将ONH形态分解为层次化特征集；3) 根据区分两个亚群的判别力选择不同层级特征；4) 采用分层交叉验证评估预测准确率；5) 基于选定特征将个体划分为k=2至7个层次聚类，确定聚类成员比例。

Result: 所选特征集在识别两个种群（邦蒂号后裔与非后裔）方面具备有效判别力，分层交叉验证给出了预测准确率；对个体进行k=2至7的层次聚类分析，确定了各聚类级别的成员分配比例。

Conclusion: 基于表型的图像分析（三维ONH形态）能够有效揭示近交群体的种群结构，支持后续的遗传力与连锁分析，有望发现来自英格兰和波利尼西亚祖先的创始人效应，从而识别青光眼及其他视神经相关眼病的新遗传风险因素。

Abstract: The population structure of an inbred population of 781 people on Norfolk Island in the Pacific, 318 of which are descendants of the original Mutineers of the Bounty, is analyzed phenotypically using shape from stereo retinal fundus photographs. Three-dimensional optic nerve head (ONH) shape is reconstructed from stereo pairs by a multi-scale stereo matching algorithm. Using deep neural network, the shape of ONH, which is under genetic control, is decomposed into a set of hierarchical features through self-taught learning. Features captured at different levels are selected according to their discriminant power in identifying the two populations. The prediction accuracy is evaluated with stratified cross validation. Given the selected feature set, individuals are grouped into k hierarchical clusters and cluster membership fractions are determined for k=2,3,4,5,6,7. Population structure analysis on the basis of phenotypes through image analysis allows heritability and linkage analysis, including founder effects from English and Polynesian ancestors, potentially leading to new genetic risk factors for glaucoma and other ONH-related eye diseases.

</details>


### [314] [Optimal Lower Bounds for Networked Information Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15472)
*Ambar Pal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了Kearns等人(2026)提出的网络信息聚合问题中MSE误差上下界的开放问题，构造了最坏情形实例族，证明其MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)，并通过利用学习器预测结构的对称性，将分析推广到满足正则性条件的凸损失函数（包括强凸和与标签正相关的理想预测器），同时证明了逻辑损失等方法满足这些条件，从而也弥合了Bateni等人(2026)中的上下界差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kearns等人(2026)研究有向无环图上的网络信息聚合问题，证明了沿长度为D的路径，MSE误差上界为O(1/√D)，但只获得了Ω(1/D)的下界，正确阶数（最优下界）未知。本文旨在解决这一核心开放问题，确定MSE误差的真实下界，并进一步将结果推广到更广泛的凸损失函数类别。

Method: 构造一族最坏情形问题实例，利用学习器预测结构的对称不变量性质，证明其MSE误差下界为Ω(1/√D)。分析基于高斯实例，考虑满足正则性条件的凸损失函数（包含原点附近的强凸性，以及最小化总体损失的理想预测器与标签正相关）。通过验证多种常见损失的合规性，将下界推广到一般凸损失。

Result: 获得了一族最坏情形实例，其MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)，与已知的O(1/√D)上界匹配，从而解决MSE阶数的开放问题。进一步，证明在满足正则条件的凸损失（包括逻辑损失等）下，高斯最坏实例族的ℓ误差下界同样为Ω(1/√D)，并弥合了Bateni等人(2026)在逻辑损失下的上下界差距。

Conclusion: 网络信息聚合中MSE误差的真实最坏阶数为Θ(1/√D)。通过利用预测器结构的对称性，该结果可推广到一类广泛的凸损失函数，为理解有向无环图结构下的信息聚合最优误差提供了完整刻画。

Abstract: The problem of networked information aggregation, studied in Kearns et al. (2026), involves a group of learners situated on the vertices of a directed acyclic graph $G$, each learning a linear predictor $\widehat Y$ for a fixed random variable $Y$ given access to a local feature, as well as the predictors learnt by its parents. Learning proceeds iteratively, with learners ordered according to a topological sort of $G$. The main quantity of interest is the error incurred by the current learner, constrained to this flow of information, with respect to the best linear predictor using all the features seen so far. When the studied error is the MSE, i.e., $\mathbb{E} (\widehat Y - Y)^2$, Kearns et al. (2026) show that the error is at most $O(1/\sqrt{D})$ along a path of length $D$. They also obtain a hard instance where the MSE is lower bounded by $Ω(1/D)$, leaving the correct order open. In this work, we resolve this central open problem, and obtain a family of worst case problem instances with a MSE lower bound of $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$.
  By exploiting invariances in the structure of the learnt predictors, our analysis generalizes to all convex loss functions $\ell(\widehat Y, Y)$ satisfying regularity conditions which include strong convexity in a ball around the origin, and that the ideal predictor minimizing the population loss is positively correlated with the label. We show that networked information aggregation on a gaussian instance in our worst case family incurs an $\ell$-error lower bounded by $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$ with respect to this ideal predictor. We demonstrate that a variety of common losses satisfy these regularity conditions. In particular, the logistic loss satisfies them, and hence our analysis also closes the gap between the upper and lower bounds in Bateni et al. (2026).

</details>


### [315] [Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15483)
*Fanqi Wang,Weisheng Tang,Hairong Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将"短视距可预测性"作为衡量训练轨迹时间冗余度的指标，通过三类互补探针（位移方向、子空间残差、预测器）在CIFAR与Pythia预训练上发现：辅助参数（归一化参数和偏置）具有更简单的短视距动力学，而主体权重（矩阵类特征变换参数）的可预测行为集中在局部、时变的"口袋"区域，从而将可预测性定位为一种参数解析的训练动力学追溯诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络的训练是长更新轨迹，但轨迹的时间组织方式远不如网络架构、损失函数和优化器那样被系统地表征。作者希望回答：训练轨迹中的时间冗余在哪里、何时出现、在何种训练条件下近期的更新能携带关于近未来参数运动的信息。

Method: 结合三类互补探针框架：(1) 位移方向探针（displacement-direction）、(2) 子空间残差探针（subspace-residual）、(3) 预测器探针（predictor-based）；配合对惯例敏感（convention-aware）、零假设校准（null-calibrated）的组级读出方法；应用于CIFAR上的多遍视觉训练以及公开的Pythia预训练检查点。

Result: 在两个训练体制下，向量型张量（归一化参数、偏置等辅助参数）的短视距动力学比矩阵型特征变换权重（主体参数）更简单；主体参数的可预测行为集中在局部且随时间变化的口袋区域。三类探针内部及彼此间一致性、以及独立轨迹诊断的结果表明捕获的是内在轨迹结构，而探针差异则反映互补形式的时间组织。CIFAR对照实验显示架构与训练配方会系统性调节该结构。Pythia-70M案例研究揭示了角色、深度和尺度依赖的事件序列，包括主体ESA跌至随机符号一致水平之下，以及可预测qkv口袋在各层出现与再分布。

Conclusion: 短视距可预测性可作为一类追溯性的、参数分辨级的训练动力学诊断工具，能够揭示训练轨迹中此前未被系统表征的时间组织特征，并区分不同参数类型的动力学差异。

Abstract: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, with convention-aware, null-calibrated group-level readouts, and apply them to multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. Across both regimes, vector-like tensors such as normalization parameters and biases (auxiliary parameters) exhibit simpler short-horizon dynamics than matrix-like feature-transforming weights (bulk parameters), whose predictable behavior concentrates in localized, time-varying pockets. Agreement within and across probe families, and with independent trajectory diagnostics, indicates that these measurements capture intrinsic trajectory structure, while probe differences distinguish complementary forms of temporal organization. Controlled CIFAR comparisons further show that architecture and training recipe systematically modulate the measured structure. A Pythia-70M case study further exposes a sequence of role-, depth-, and scale-dependent events, including bulk ESA falling below the random sign-agreement level and the emergence and redistribution of predictable qkv pockets across layers. These results position short-horizon predictability as a retrospective, parameter-resolved diagnostic of training dynamics.

</details>


### [316] [QSMP: finding representative time series subsequences through Quick Shift+Matrix Profile](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15492)
*Carlos H. Mendoza-Cardenas,Rogers F. Silva,Austin J. Brockmeier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QSMP是一种通过密度引导的时序子序列聚类来发现长时间序列中代表性波形的方法，它创新性地将Quick Shift模式搜索算法与Matrix Profile相似性搜索数据结构相结合，在空间复杂度上优于现有最先进方法，并通过合成与真实数据实验验证了其在长时间序列摘要和可视化中的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长时间序列中发现代表性波形具有重要的科学和实践价值，因为它能够实现大规模时间序列数据集的摘要与可视化，并支持分类和预测等下游任务。然而现有方法在计算复杂度或空间复杂度方面存在不足，需要一种更高效的方法来识别代表性波形。

Method: QSMP通过在Quick Shift（一种模式搜索/聚类算法）与Matrix Profile（一种时间序列相似性搜索数据结构）之间建立新颖的联系，将Quick Shift适配到长时间序列的子序列聚类任务中，从而实现密度引导的聚类，在空间复杂度上优于现有最先进方法。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，QSMP能够有效找到代表性波形，是总结和可视化长时间序列的有价值工具。

Conclusion: QSMP为长时间序列中的代表性波形挖掘提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案，其空间复杂度优势使其适用于大规模时间序列数据集的摘要、可视化和下游分析任务。

Abstract: Finding representative waveforms in long time series has scientific and practical value in many domains, as it enables summarization and visualization of large time series datasets, and downstream tasks like classification and forecasting. We present here QSMP, a method to find representative waveforms in long time series through a density-guided clustering of time series subsequences. Our method makes a novel connection between Quick Shift, a mode-seeking algorithm, and the Matrix Profile, a time series similarity-search data structure, to adapt Quick Shift to the clustering of subsequences in long time series, with a space complexity that is superior to the state-of-the-art method. Our experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that QSMP can be a valuable tool to summarize and visualize long time series by finding representative waveforms.

</details>


### [317] [PERO: Efficient Robust Post-Training Foundation Models for Encrypted Traffic Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15504)
*Wumei Du,Jiarong Wen,Kaiyu Zhang,Zi Yang,Yiqin Lv,Longfei Zhang,Dong Liang,Zheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PERO（Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization），一种高效的鲁棒后训练框架，用于加密流量基础模型。PERO通过轻量级代理模型估计样本风险，仅挑选高风险样本子集更新基础模型，将风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化解耦，在显著降低计算和内存成本的同时，实现了与优秀鲁棒后训练方法相当或更优的鲁棒性和平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加密流量分类对网络安全至关重要，真实部署中对恶意流量误分类等低概率但高损失的错误极为敏感。加密流量基础模型虽整体性能优异，但标准目标函数（如经验风险最小化）容易忽视高风险尾部事件，而常规性能指标难以反映风险敏感场景下的鲁棒性不足。此外，直接应用条件风险价值（CVaR）等鲁棒优化目标到后训练阶段，对大型模型而言计算量巨大，因为识别高损失样本需要耗费大量计算资源。

Method: PERO框架的核心思路是通过轻量级代理模型估计样本级风险，选出高风险样本子集用于更新基础模型，从而将风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化过程解耦。具体而言，该方法避免了直接在大型模型上执行全量风险识别（这在计算上是不可行的），而是利用代理模型低成本地近似样本风险分布，指导后续的鲁棒后训练。

Result: 在典型加密流量数据集上的大量实验表明，PERO在鲁棒性和平均性能上与现有的优秀鲁棒后训练方法相比具有竞争力或更优的表现，同时在计算和内存成本上实现了显著降低。

Conclusion: PERO为加密流量基础模型提供了高效可行的鲁棒后训练方案，解决了鲁棒优化在大模型上计算不可行的问题，兼顾了鲁棒性与效率，适用于风险敏感的网络安全场景。

Abstract: Encrypted traffic classification is vital for network security, yet real-world deployments are inherently sensitive to rare but high-loss errors such as misclassification of malicious traffic. The encrypted traffic foundation model, as a promising general-purpose technique, can achieve impressive overall performance. However, employing standard objectives such as empirical risk minimization often overlooks high-risk tail events, and commonly used performance metrics hardly reflect robustness limitations in risk-sensitive scenarios. Directly applying robust optimization objectives, such as conditional value-at-risk, to post-training is computationally prohibitive for large models, as identifying high-loss samples exhausts substantial computation. To this end, we propose Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization (PERO), an efficient robust post-training framework for encrypted traffic foundation models. PERO employs a lightweight proxy to estimate sample-wise risk and selects a subset of high-risk samples to update the foundation model, decoupling risk estimation from expensive large-model optimization. Extensive experiments on typical encrypted traffic datasets show that PERO achieves competitive or superior robustness and average performance compared to outstanding robust post-training methods, while significantly reducing computational and memory costs.

</details>


### [318] [UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15516)
*Pengyu Wang,Baochen Xiong,Xiaoshan Yang,Yifan Xu,Zhang Qimeng,Haifeng Chen,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出UniFed-VLM，一个统一联邦指令微调框架，旨在解决VLMs在联邦学习中面临的任务、模态和模型架构三重异质性问题。框架包含Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA)和Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD)两个核心组件，在多个基准数据集上优于现有FL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM微调依赖集中式数据，在医疗等领域引发隐私担忧；联邦学习虽能解决隐私问题，但直接应用于VLM指令微调面临参数规模大、客户端在任务、模态和模型架构上高度异质性等挑战。现有方法仅处理简化场景，无法应对多维异质性的真实场景。

Method: 提出UniFed-VLM框架，包含两个核心组件：1) Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA)，通过子空间对齐的参数高效适配器聚合，结合动态权重和补偿机制来缓解异质性引起的冲突；2) Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD)，通过Mutual Distillation Adapter (MDA)和基于混合专家(mixture-of-experts)的蒸馏策略实现跨异构模型的有效知识迁移。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，UniFed-VLM相比现有FL方法在多样化任务上取得了更强的平均性能。

Conclusion: UniFed-VLM有效解决了VLM联邦指令微调中任务、模态和模型架构的多维异质性挑战，为隐私保护下的多模态模型协作训练提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients exhibit significant heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  Existing methods mainly focus on simplified settings and are unable to handle such multi-dimensional heterogeneous scenarios. In this work, we study federated instruction tuning under joint heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  We propose UniFed-VLM, a unified federated instruction tuning framework for VLMs that addresses multiple types of heterogeneity. It consists of two key components: 1) Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA), which performs subspace-aligned aggregation of parameter-efficient adapters with dynamic weighting and compensation to mitigate heterogeneity-induced conflicts; 2) Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD), which enables effective knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models via a Mutual Distillation Adapter (MDA) and a mixture-of-experts-based distillation strategy. We conduct experiments on multiple benchmark datasets, and the results show that UniFed-VLM achieves stronger average performance across diverse tasks compared with existing FL methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/wangpengyu2004/UniFed-VLM.

</details>


### [319] [Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15520)
*Melika Baghi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RouteCert方法，用于多模态系统中自适应输入获取（adaptive acquisition）场景下的条件校准。当推理策略决定最终观测哪些输入时，传统条件校准的"分组映射独立于校准样本"假设被违反。论文刻画了模式条件保证仍然有效的条件，给出两种有限样本构造方法（阈值无关的路由+终端模式校准，以及完整策略-模式对的联合认证），并通过反例证明校准独立分组映射的保证不能直接迁移到策略依赖分组场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态系统可能只持有部分输入开始推理，并以一定成本获取其余输入。在自适应获取中，策略决定最终观测哪些输入，因此需要针对最终输入模式给出条件性保证。然而条件校准通常假设分组映射独立于校准样本，而策略引起的分组不满足这一假设，导致传统认证方法失效。

Method: 1) 刻画模式条件保证在策略诱导分组下仍然有效的条件；2) 提出阈值无关的路由方法，在终端模式上应用校准；3) 提出完整策略-策略模式对的联合认证方法，允许校准数据选择部署策略；4) 通过反例说明校准独立分组映射的保证在策略依赖分组下不一定成立。

Result: 在临床心电图任务中，采用分阶段、成本排序的导联协议，认证策略在48.8%的预设序数成本下，以7.4%的心电图专家诊断不一致率回答71.2%的留出患者，三个获取阶段均带各自证书。在掩蔽多模态基准上，按各终端模式逐点认证，将最坏模式选择性风险（相对全信息参考决策而非真实标签）保持在0.034，而池化设计达到0.145（上限0.10），已回答比例相当（0.350 vs 0.342）；预算匹配的同步比较下已回答比例降至0.305。

Conclusion: RouteCert方法为标准多模态学习器提供一种实用的同时认证方式，使两个关键属性（保证如何应用于一个策略，以及哪些策略被给定保证）可以通过覆盖标准学习器输出的认证框架来同时处理，从而克服策略诱导分组下标准条件校准失效的问题。

Abstract: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing with calibration applied at the terminal pattern, and simultaneous certification of complete policy-pattern pairs, which lets calibration data select the deployed policy. A counterexample shows that a guarantee proved for a calibration-independent grouping map need not transfer once the policy makes the terminal group calibration-dependent. We call the resulting method RouteCert. On a clinical electrocardiogram task with a staged, cost-ordered lead protocol, the certified policy answers 71.2% of held-out patients at an observed 7.4% disagreement with the cardiologist's diagnosis at 48.8% of the prespecified ordinal cost of acquiring every stage, and all three acquisition stages carry their own certificate. On masked multimodal benchmarks, certifying pointwise at each terminal pattern holds observed worst-pattern selective risk, measured against the full-information reference decision rather than the true label, at 0.034 where a pooled design reaches 0.145 against a 0.10 cap, at a comparable answered fraction (0.350 vs 0.342); under the budget-matched simultaneous comparison the answered fraction falls to 0.305.

</details>


### [320] [Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15548)
*Cedar Site Bai,Amber Yijia Zheng,Raymond A. Yeh,Brian Bullins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出光谱显著性遗忘（SSU），该方法从光谱视角借鉴Muon优化器的思想，通过阈值截断弱奇异分量，仅沿具有高置信度遗忘信号的方向进行参数更新，从而实现高效的机器遗忘。实验覆盖图像分类器、扩散模型和大型语言模型，验证了SSU的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘（MU）旨在移除特定训练数据的影响同时保持模型效用，通常通过梯度更新抵消已学行为。受Muon优化器（其通过谱幅度归一化鼓励探索稀有方向）启发，作者采用光谱视角来处理遗忘问题，希望更精准地区分需要遗忘的方向与需要保留的方向。

Method: 提出SSU方法：1）对模型参数的奇异值分解进行谱分析；2）阈值截断弱奇异分量，仅保留受置信遗忘信号支持的方向；3）仅在这些选定的方向上执行参数更新。同时从遗忘-保留权衡的角度提供了该阈值策略的理论依据。

Result: 在图像分类器、扩散模型和大型语言模型等多样化的实验场景中，SSU均展现出优于现有方法的遗忘性能。

Conclusion: 光谱视角为机器遗忘提供了新的启发，通过针对性地更新弱奇异方向，SSU能够在遗忘特定数据的同时有效保留模型其余能力，并在多种模型类型上表现出通用性。

Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. As the name suggests, MU can be viewed as the inverse of learning, using gradient-based updates to reduce the influence of a forget-set by counteracting the previously learned behavior. Recently, Muon, a gradient descent variant, has been introduced. Muon applies spectral magnitude normalization to encourage exploration of rare directions and demonstrates promising performance. Inspired by Muon, we adopt the spectral view for unlearning and propose Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU). SSU thresholds weak singular components and updates only those directions supported by a confident unlearning signal. We further provide theoretical justification for this thresholding approach from the perspective of the forgetting-retention trade-off. Experiments across image classifiers, diffusion models, and LLMs demonstrate SSU's effectiveness.

</details>


### [321] [Amortised Post-Hoc Explanation with Exact Preservation for Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15559)
*Iyad Assaad Nekka,Hamida Seba,Walid Khaled Hidouci,Karima Amrouche*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Anomaly detection in dynamic graphs underpins financial fraud analysis, intrusion detection, and platform integrity, where automated decisions require human-interpretable justifications. StrGNN, the strongest performer in recent benchmarks, produces no explanation: when an edge is flagged, the analyst receives only a score. Explanation metrics are undefined for StrGNN because no attribution vector exists. This paper closes that gap. We present X-StrGNN, a post-hoc explanation layer that wraps a trained, frozen StrGNN and emits, for every flagged edge, dual attributions: a structural attribution identifying which contextual interactions in the enclosing subgraph drove the decision, and a temporal attribution identifying which historical snapshot carried the signal. Both attributions are multiplicative masks identically one in the unexplained pass, so the layer is an exact pass-through: detection is preserved to machine precision, verified rather than asserted (Delta AUC = 0.0000, Delta AP = 0.0000, Delta P@100 = 0.0000). Attribution costs 0.66 ms per edge, making explanation of an entire alarm list feasible. We conduct the first controlled design study of attribution strategies for this architecture, comparing gradient attribution, per-instance mask optimisation, and amortised parameterisation under one protocol, one budget, and three seeds. X-StrGNN attains the highest stability (0.913) at 268x lower cost than per-instance optimisation, and its temporal attribution (1.601 against a measured random floor of 0.973) is separably better than its ablated control, while per-instance optimisation - the most expensive strategy - falls below that floor. Code, protocol, and per-seed measurements are released.

</details>


### [322] [SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15567)
*Gunjun Lee,Sehwan Son,Younjoo Lee,Byungjun Kim,Jung Ho Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCHUROPT和SCHURQUANT两种无反向传播的后训练量化方法，通过Schur补精确消除后缀的连续最优响应，并结合行式缩放/零点重拟与整数码坐标下降，在2位量化下显著提升零样本准确率，其中SCHURQUANT在8个模型中平均超越最强基线9.65个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无反向传播的PTQ优化器存在两个局限：组决策忽略了剩余连续后缀可吸收的校正；离散细化通常固定仿射量化网格，导致2-3位低比特下精度急剧下降。需要一种能同时解决这两个问题的高效量化优化方法。

Method: SCHUROPT首先通过解析消去后缀的最优连续响应，利用Schur补曲率构建精确的组级二次目标，然后交替执行闭式行式缩放/零点重拟合与整数码的坐标下降。SCHURQUANT在此基础上进一步组合量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则化、残差加和目标以及教师决策token加权等多种策略。

Result: 在固定GPTQ目标下，SCHUROPT在2位Qwen3-4B上的平均零样本准确率提升11.88个百分点。SCHURQUANT在8个Llama和Qwen模型中取得所评估的无反向传播PTQ基线中最高的平均零样本准确率，在2位下超越最强基线9.65个百分点。

Conclusion: 低比特下更紧致的重建目标能显著提升端模型指标，但在高精度下重建质量的提升并不总能带来一致的端模型改善。SCHURQUANT通过综合多种训练策略在低比特场景实现了最优的无反向传播量化性能。

Abstract: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an exact groupwise quadratic with Schur-complement curvature. It then alternates closed-form row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with coordinate descent over integer codes. With the GPTQ objective fixed, SCHUROPT improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp). At higher precision, however, tighter reconstruction does not consistently improve end-model metrics. SCHURQUANT therefore combines SCHUROPT with quantized-prefix teacher reconstruction, reference-weight regularization, residual-add targets, and teacher-decision token weighting. Across eight Llama and Qwen models, SCHURQUANT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the evaluated backpropagation free PTQ baselines, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.65 pp at 2 bits.

</details>


### [323] [GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15584)
*Jinhyun Jeon,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraniKV 是一个面向生产级 KV-cache 层的系统，针对多智能体工作负载中共享前缀与逐请求后缀的不同存储需求，采用非对称分页粒度（前缀用连续 HOT 池，后缀用 token 级 COLD 池），并结合按步调度器在双后端间选择。在共享 token 为 16K 时达到 2.16×/1.98×/1.57× 的吞吐提升，在异构多智能体场景下（不同提示长度）保持 1.95× 增益，而批全局级联在此场景下降到持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级分页服务引擎对 KV cache 使用统一的分页粒度，但多智能体工作负载的两类区域（长共享前缀与逐请求后缀）对存储有什么相反的需求——前缀要求连续性，后缀要求细粒度分配——这是现有系统无法同时满足的。

Method: GraniKV 采用双池存储结构：共享前缀存放在连续分配的 HOT 池中，逐请求后缀存放在 token 级分配的 COLD 池中；同时配备按步（per-step）调度器，在每个计算、内存或通信受限的运行阶段选择合适的后端。此外，通过级联注意力（cascade attention）集成与批量化 GEMM 前缀后端实现加速。

Result: 在 L_p=16K 共享 token 下，GraniKV 在 Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2 和 Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 上分别达到 2.16×、1.98× 和 1.57× 的吞吐提升。增益分解显示：饱和时级联注意力贡献大部分；非对称存储层贡献 1.05–1.15× 端到端且是 batched-GEMM 前缀后端可行的前提。在异构多智能体服务（不同长度提示）下，归因反转：GraniKV 保持 1.95×，而批全局级联降至持平，存储层独自承载此场景下的全部增益。

Conclusion: GraniKV 是首个对生产级分页服务引擎的 KV cache 应用非对称分页粒度的系统，其存储层设计在异构多智能体场景（论文的动机场景）中贡献核心性能增益，而级联注意力仅在饱和场景起主导作用。

Abstract: Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation.
  We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend among dual backends for each regime (compute-, memory-, or communication-bound). To the best of our knowledge, GraniKV is the first system to apply asymmetric paging granularity to the KV cache of a production paged-serving engine.
  At $L_p{=}16$\,K shared tokens GraniKV reaches $\mathbf{2.16\times}$, $\mathbf{1.98\times}$, and $\mathbf{1.57\times}$ output-token throughput over the production baseline on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, and Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4. The gain decomposes: cascade attention integration contributes the majority at saturation; the asymmetric storage layer adds $1.05$--$1.15\times$ end-to-end while being what makes the batched-GEMM prefix backend possible at all. Under heterogeneous multi-agent serving with \emph{distinct} prompts of different lengths, the attribution inverts: GraniKV sustains $\mathbf{1.95\times}$ while batch-global cascade collapses to parity --- the storage layer alone carries the win in the regime that motivates the paper.

</details>


### [324] [Quantum Models with Multi-Stage Training for Compositional Concept Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15601)
*Mina Abbaszadeh,Matilda Karabina Moore,Mehrnoosh Sadrzadeh,Martha Lewis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种使用张量和变分量子电路实现组合式概念泛化（CoCoGen）的多模态学习方法。通过分离名词与关系的组合式意义模型，结合多阶段训练（先学习对象表示，再冻结对象参数并训练关系组件），在CLEVR数据集上实现了显著的分布外关系泛化改进，同时使用的可训练参数比经典基线少几个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合式概念泛化（系统性地在新情境中重新组合已学原语）是多模态学习的关键挑战。作者旨在通过量子机器学习框架解决这一问题，利用量子电路的结构性来显式强制组合因子化。

Method: 提出组合式意义模型，将名词与关系分离：文本采用向量的名词表示和张量的关系表示（使用多种变量子电路ansatz）；图像采用CLIP嵌入的量子编码，对比幅度编码（保留原始嵌入几何）与角度编码（引入非线性特征变换）。采用多阶段训练：先在单对象图文对上学习对象表示，再在关系阶段冻结对象参数，仅优化关系组件。

Result: 多阶段训练结合结构化编码显著改善了分布外关系泛化性能；性能增益源于表示与编码的交互作用，非线性量子编码增强了组合结构的可分性；所用可训练参数比经典基线少数个数量级。

Conclusion: 结构化量子表示与分阶段学习为多模态量子机器学习中的组合泛化提供了有效框架，演示了量子电路的结构特性可以自然地对齐组合语义分解。

Abstract: Compositional Concept Generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to systematically recombine learned primitives in novel contexts, is a key challenge for multimodal learning. In this work, we provide a solution using a compositional model of meaning that separates nouns from relations and uses tensors and variational quantum circuits to train them on data. This model enables us to employ a multi stage training paradigm, one that first learns object representations from single-object image-caption pairs, then subsequently transfers these to the relational stage where object parameters are frozen and optimisation is only applied to relational components. This design explicitly enforces compositional factorisation at the circuit, ensuring that relations are learned as transformations over stable primitives. The training paradigm is tested on the CLEVR dataset developed specificially for CoCoGen. For text, we work with vector representations of nouns and higher order tensor representations of relations using a set of different ansatz. For images, we work with quantum encodings of image embeddings dervied from Open AI's Vision Language tool CLIP and contrast amplitude encoding, which preserves the original embedding geometry, with angle encoding, which introduces nonlinear feature transformations. Our results show that multi-staged training combined with structured encodings significantly improves out of distribution relational generalisation, while using orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters than classical baselines. We find that performance gains arise from the interaction between representation and encoding, with nonlinear quantum encodings enhancing the separability of compositional structure. These findings demonstrate that structured quantum representations and staged learning provide an effective framework for compositional generalisation in multimodal quantum machine learning.

</details>


### [325] [FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15602)
*Qingyao Yang,Runming Yang,He Xiao,Wendong Xu,Junyu Chen,Haobo Liu,Chenchen Ding,Ruihan Hu,Yik-Chung Wu,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FluxBin是一种算法-内核协同设计的超低比特量化方案，通过去耦合行列二元分解和基于查找表的CUDA内核，在保持精度的同时实现了比二值量化方法高达5.92倍加速和10.19倍节能，支持在单块A100上部署70B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有二值量化研究虽理论上可带来极致压缩和加速，但往往忽略了专用硬件内核的必要性，导致仍依赖昂贵的浮点运算或运行时反量化开销，无法充分发挥加速潜力。

Method: 算法层面：提出Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition增强表征能力，配合Hessian引导的显著性感知混合基保留关键信息；内核层面：实现基于查找表构建和Scale Fusion的方法以减少浮点运算，并通过Virtual Columnar Mapping将不规则、稀疏、显著的矩阵转化为稠密执行。

Result: 在多种模型架构上实现高达5.92倍加速和10.19倍节能，精度与重微调方法相当，支持在单块A100 GPU上部署70B规模模型，内存减少4倍。

Conclusion: FluxBin通过算法与内核的协同设计，有效弥合了二值量化理论优势与实际加速之间的差距，证明了超低比特量化在实际硬件上释放极致性能的可行性。

Abstract: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. At the kernel level, we implement a Lookup Table Building Approach with Scale Fusion to reduce floating-point arithmetic, featuring a Virtual Columnar Mapping that transforms irregular, sparse, and salient matrices into dense execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate FluxBin achieves up to $5.92\times$ speedup and $10.19\times$ energy savings across diverse model architectures, delivering comparable accuracy to heavily fine-tuned methods. This effectively enables the deployment of 70B-scale models on one single A100 GPU with a $4\times$ memory reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin.

</details>


### [326] [Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15617)
*Md Rezwanul Islam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对电力系统网络攻击检测中的机器学习模型（包括量子机器学习模型）进行了系统性基准测试，核心发现是：基准测试的结论在很大程度上由评估者的选择决定，而非模型本身。文章识别出八个关键选择点（六个在评估协议中，两个在基准调参中），每个都能反转或移动结论，并发布了一个带种子的基准以支持可复现研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力系统网络攻击检测的机器学习模型本身也是攻击面，量子机器学习被提出作为解决方案。然而，现有基准测试的可靠性存疑——评估协议中的细微选择可能导致截然不同的结论。作者希望揭示这些隐藏的方法学陷阱，建立更可信的评测框架。

Method: 作者在公开的电力系统攻击数据集（Mississippi State/ORNL）上，对保真度核SVM和变分分类器等量子模型与六个调优后的经典模型进行了对比评估。攻击场景涵盖白盒、迁移、基于决策的黑盒和中毒攻击。作者系统性地操控评估协议的八个关键选择点，观察结论如何随之改变，并使用正对照实验来区分标签信号与管道效应。

Result: 研究发现：行级数据划分达到0.905宏F1，而按源文件整体留存仅为0.594；在匹配维度的受限设置下，量子模型接近随机水平，经典模型仅高出0.024。保真度核在直接攻击下鲁棒性从0.886骤降至0.064；错误拟合的代理模型制造出10倍的不对称性；未播种的黑盒攻击在重启间有75%的波动。正对照实验证明准确率为零的结果源于标签而非流程。

Conclusion: 基准测试的结论由评估者的选择决定而非模型本身。作者为每个选择提供了检测对照，并发布了种子化基准以确保研究的可复现性和可比性。

Abstract: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. Eight choices -- six in the evaluation protocol, two in the tuning the benchmark itself runs -- each reversed or moved a conclusion at fixed models. The largest is the split: the row-level protocol scores 0.905 macro-F1 where holding whole source files out leaves 0.594, and in the capped matched-dimensionality regime the quantum arm sits within noise of chance with the classical arm 0.024 above it. A fidelity kernel looks most robust until attacked directly (retention 0.886 to 0.064); a mis-fitted surrogate manufactures a 10x asymmetry; an unseeded black-box attack moves 75% between restarts. A positive control explains the accuracy null: the labels, not the pipeline. We give the control that catches each choice and release the seeded benchmark.

</details>


### [327] [In Defense of OCTA: The Reconstruction-Utility Gap in OCT-to-OCTA Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15626)
*Michael Chertok,Alon Tiosano,Orly Gal-Or,Lior Kramarski,Einav Baharav Shlezinger,Irit Bahar,Lior Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了当前OCT-to-OCTA合成研究中以图像重建指标（PSNR/SSIM）作为评估标准的做法，提出应以下游任务保真度（downstream-task fidelity）作为评价标准。研究发现，虽然合成OCTA图像在像素级指标上表现优秀，但其精细毛细血管结构是伪造的而非真实的，导致下游糖尿病视网膜病变缺血分级任务性能大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OCT-to-OCTA合成研究仅以重建相似度（PSNR>31dB, SSIM>0.9）作为评估标准，但这些指标无法反映合成图像是否支持OCTA原本要提供的临床测量功能。作者质疑：合成图像看起来相似，但能否支撑OCTA的临床用途（毛细血管灌注、中心凹无血管区生物标志物、DR缺血分级）？

Method: 作者将冻结的真实OCTA分割器作为"探针"（probe），应用于两种合成器（XOCT、TransPro）的输出图像，评估下游分割性能。通过对比大血管与精细毛细血管网络的Dice系数差异、使用匹配模糊（matched-blur）对照区分细节是伪造还是模糊、以及在私有Spectralis数据集上重新训练评估新生血管病变的再现能力。

Result: 下游Dice随结构精细度下降：大血管保留较好（0.862→0.831），而精细毛细血管网络严重退化（0.798→0.635），损失约为大血管的5倍（配对Wilcoxon检验p<1e-3），TransPro在两个合成器中表现更差。匹配模糊对照表明这些精细细节是伪造而非模糊造成的。在私有Spectralis数据集上，两种合成器均无法再现新生血管病变。

Conclusion: 重建保真度不等于临床实用性。OCT-to-OCTA合成评估应从图像相似度转向下游任务保真度（downstream-task fidelity），即以合成图像能否支持其临床目标测量作为核心评估标准。

Abstract: Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) images retinal blood flow, giving capillary-perfusion and foveal-avascular-zone biomarkers that grade diabetic-retinopathy ischemia. Because OCTA hardware is less common than structural OCT, recent work synthesizes it from OCT, reporting strong reconstruction (3D PSNR > 31 dB, SSIM > 0.9). We ask not whether the synthetic image looks similar, but whether it supports the measurements OCTA is acquired for. A frozen real-OCTA segmenter, applied as a probe to two synthesizers (XOCT, TransPro), shows downstream Dice falling with structural fineness: large vessels survive (0.862 -> 0.831) while the fine capillary network collapses (0.798 -> 0.635, five times the large-vessel loss; paired Wilcoxon p < 1e-3), TransPro worse throughout. A matched-blur control shows this detail is fabricated, not blurred. Retrained on a private Spectralis dataset, neither synthesizer reproduces the neovascular lesion (qualitative, n=3). Reconstruction fidelity is not clinical utility; we establish downstream-task fidelity as the evaluation OCT-to-OCTA synthesis needs.

</details>


### [328] [Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15632)
*Yehonatan Avidan,Daniel D. Lee,Haim Sompolinsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现深度学习模型在视觉、音频和语言处理中的分类任务展现出普适的表征几何结构：类内变异性并非随机，其分类器相关成分与真类和竞争类的质心坐标存在强结构化相关。基于此提出了一个解析的平均场理论，仅需少数质心坐标即可准确预测不同架构和模态的分类准确率，且发现相关几何量随模型规模提升而系统性改善，该理论具有稀疏性，与稀疏特征提取方法（如稀疏自编码器）相关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经表征是现代AI模型内部机制研究的核心工具，但其高维复杂结构难以解释。现有方法缺乏对分类任务中表征几何结构的普适性理解，亟需一个能跨架构、跨模态统一解释分类行为的简约理论。

Method: 作者首先实证发现分类任务中类内变异性的分类器相关成分与真类和竞争类质心坐标具有强结构化相关。基于此构建解析的平均场理论，主要利用沿真类和竞争类质心坐标的变异性，并引入全局类半径重正化来处理真实表征的非高斯统计特性。理论只需少量质心坐标（真类及最强竞争类）即可预测分类准确率。

Result: 该理论跨视觉、音频和语音等多种架构与模态准确预测了分类准确率。相关几何量随模型规模提升而系统性改进，与观察到的性能增益一致。理论的稀疏性表明分类主要由少数质心对齐的结构主导，将框架与稀疏自动编码器等稀疏特征提取方法联系起来。

Conclusion: 深度网络中的分类由一个稀疏的、质心对齐的结构所支配，该结构嵌入于完整的高维表征空间中。这一发现提供了一种简约且可预测的神经表征理论，为理解现代AI模型的内部机制提供了新的视角，并暗示分类机制本质上依赖于稀疏的质心坐标信息。

Abstract: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own centroid and with the centroids of its competing classes. Building on this observation, we derive an analytical mean-field theory governed mainly by the variability along true-class and rival-class centroid coordinates, together with a global renormalization of the class radius that compensates for the non-Gaussian statistics of real representations. The theory accurately predicts classification accuracy across architectures and modalities. The relevant geometric quantities improve systematically with model scale, mirroring the observed gains in accuracy. A striking feature of the theory is its sparsity: accurate prediction requires only a small set of centroid coordinates associated with the true class and its strongest rivals - connecting our framework to sparse-feature extraction approaches such as sparse autoencoders. Together, these results provide a parsimonious predictive theory of neural representations and suggest that classification in deep networks is governed by a sparse, centroid-aligned structure embedded within the full high-dimensional representation space.

</details>


### [329] [Generalised Transportability via Causal Abstractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15645)
*Yorgos Felekis,Paris Giampouras,Fabio Massimo Zennaro,Theodoros Damoulas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于因果抽象理论的模型级可迁移性(transportability)框架，取代传统逐查询(query-by-query)的可迁移性判据。源与目标共享变量、图与干预，仅机制不同，将可迁移性视为同层抽象的特例。核心贡献在于近似情形：当不存在精确对齐映射时，最优近似映射仍能提供经过认证的查询区间，将抽象误差转化为近似可迁移性的定量概念，并通过分布鲁棒优化处理不可迁移查询及目标数据缺失两种困难场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统运输性(transportability)理论存在三个局限：一是逐查询工作，一次只能判断一个查询是否可迁移；二是当查询不可迁移时无法提供任何有用的输出；三是当目标域完全没有数据时束手无策。作者希望从模型层面整体回答"源与目标之间的因果结论是否可对齐"这一问题，并在不可精确对齐或目标数据缺失时仍能提供有保证的量化结果。

Method: 将运输性转化为因果抽象(Causal Abstraction)理论中的同层映射问题。源与目标共享变量、图和干预，仅在一组已知机制上不同，因此运输性是同层抽象的特例。作者表征了Markovian和semi-Markovian两种设置下存在单映射对齐源和目标的条件；在无精确映射时，通过分布鲁棒优化(distributionally robust optimisation)对未见目标进行机制与环境扰动建模，得到认证的查询区间，将抽象误差重新解释为近似可迁移性的定量度量。

Result: 在合成Markovian和semi-Markovian基准及真实生态数据集上进行了评估，结果表明认证的区间确实涵盖了真实的干预查询值，验证了框架在不可迁移查询的边界估计和目标不可知(target-agnostic)设置下的保证有效性。

Conclusion: 本文以模型级视角统一处理可迁移性的精确与近似情形，使所有目标查询可同时转运，并首次为不可迁移查询和目标数据缺失场景提供有理论保证的认证区间，将抽象误差与可迁移性建立定量联系。

Abstract: Transporting a causal conclusion from a source study population to a target one is a fundamental problem in causal inference. The theory of transportability provides a criterion for when this is possible: given experimental data from the source and observational data from the target, it determines whether a target query is identifiable and does so completely; i.e. if the query can be transported, the criterion finds the exact formula. However, it works one query at a time and returns an expression rather than the value itself. It is also silent in two practically important regimes: when the query is not transportable and when no target data exist at all. To tackle both, we take a model-level perspective grounded in Causal Abstraction theory. Source and target share variables, graph, and interventions, differing only at a known set of mechanisms, which makes transportability a special case of same-level abstraction. Thus, instead of asking whether one query transports, we ask whether a single map aligns the source and target across their interventional behaviour. We characterise when such a map exists in both the Markovian and semi-Markovian settings; when it does, every target query transports at once. Our main contribution lies in the approximate case. When no exact map exists, the best approximate one still yields certified query intervals, recasting abstraction error as a quantitative notion of approximate transportability. We formulate model-level transport as distributionally robust optimisation over mechanism and environment perturbations of the unseen target and derive certificates for both challenging regimes: bounds for non-transportable queries, and guarantees under target-agnostic settings. We evaluate our framework on synthetic Markovian and semi-Markovian benchmarks and a real ecological dataset, and we show that the certified intervals bracket the true interventional query.

</details>


### [330] [Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization for Product Media Ranking in E-Commerce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15662)
*Prasenjit Dey,Frank McIntyre,Arnab Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SMEO是一个两阶段的效用引导框架，用于电商平台中异构产品媒体（图片、视频、3D渲染）的排序优化。它先学习轨迹效用模型估计有序证据如何帮助用户做出购买决策（同时缓解位置偏差和可变深度不平衡），再训练自回归排序策略配合生存加权reward-to-go，将最决策相关的信息优先展示。离线评估显示相比基线提升了5.5%的预估转化率，并减少15%的滑动次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的媒体排序系统往往优化点击或停留时间等短视的参与度代理指标，忽略了产品媒体资产是同一商品下相互协作的信息组件，共同按顺序帮助顾客找到所需信息并促成购买决策。需要一个以顾客为导向、考虑媒体序列整体协作效果的排序框架。

Method: SMEO采用两阶段框架：(1) 第一阶段从消费过的媒体前缀学习轨迹效用模型，估计有序证据对购买决策的贡献，同时缓解日志数据中的位置偏差和可变深度不平衡；(2) 第二阶段训练自回归排序策略，使用生存加权reward-to-go，优先呈现决策相关信息，减少顾客认知资源消耗。通过将效用学习与策略优化解耦，实现从有偏日志中的稳定离线学习以及无需显式媒体级标签的事后媒体归因。

Result: 在大规模电商会话上使用双重稳健离策略评估进行离线评估：SMEO相较现有基线提升了5.5%的预估转化率，并帮助顾客以少15%的滑动次数达成购买决策。

Conclusion: 通过解耦效用学习与策略优化，SMEO能够在有偏日志中实现稳定的离线学习，并支持无需显式媒体级标签的事后媒体归因。该框架在提升转化率的同时显著降低了顾客的交互成本，验证了顾客导向媒体排序的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: On modern e-commerce stores, customers consume ordered slates of heterogeneous product media, such as images, videos, and 3D renders, before making purchase decisions. Existing media-ranking systems often optimize myopic engagement proxies such as clicks or dwell time, even though product media assets are cooperative informational components of the same item that together help customers find the information they need through sequential interaction. We present Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization (SMEO), a two-stage utility-guided framework for customer-oriented media sequencing. SMEO first learns a trajectory utility model from consumed media prefixes to estimate how ordered evidence helps customers reach a purchase decision, while mitigating position-bias and variable-depth imbalance in logged data. Recognizing that customer attention is a limited resource, it then trains an autoregressive ranking policy with survival-weighted reward-to-go that prioritizes the most decision-relevant information early, so customers can find what they need with less effort. By decoupling utility learning from policy optimization, SMEO enables stable offline learning from biased logs and post-hoc media attribution without explicit media-level labels. Evaluated offline on large-scale e-commerce sessions using doubly robust off-policy estimation, SMEO improves estimated conversion by 5.5% and helps customers reach a purchase decision with 15% fewer swipes than existing baselines.

</details>


### [331] [SubZero+: Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Large Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15665)
*Ziming Yu,Shuyao Xiao,Xingyu Zhao,Sike Wang,Pan Zhou,Peiyu Zang,Xiangda Yan,Yongjie Yang,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SubZero+是一种改进的零阶（ZO）优化框架，通过三层互补机制（多查询梯度估计、子空间Adam优化器、QR子空间符号校正）降低梯度估计方差，提升大语言模型微调的稳定性和收敛性，在1.3B到32B规模模型上优于现有ZO基线并缩小与一阶方法的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的零阶优化方法用于大语言模型微调时，梯度估计器存在高方差问题，导致收敛不稳定且对学习率高度敏感，亟需一种更稳定的ZO优化框架来弥合与一阶方法的性能差距。

Method: SubZero+通过三个互补策略提升稳定性：(i) 在层特定低秩子空间内进行多查询梯度估计以减少方差并避免多查询悖论；(ii) 引入子空间Adam优化器，利用子空间内的多查询梯度统计进行自适应更新；(iii) 对基于QR的子空间构造进行符号校正，确保投影矩阵服从Haar分布，消除实现相关的方向歧义。

Result: 在1.3B至32B规模的模型上，基于SuperGLUE基准、涵盖全参数微调和LoRA两种设置，SubZero+一致性地优于现有ZO基线，扩大了稳定学习率范围，并以极小的额外内存开销缩小了与一阶方法的差距。

Conclusion: SubZero+通过系统性地解决ZO优化中的方差、自适应更新和子空间构造歧义三个核心问题，为免反向传播的大语言模型微调提供了一个更稳定、更实用的高效优化方案。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables backpropagation-free fine-tuning of large language models, but existing ZO methods suffer from high-variance gradient estimators, making convergence unstable and highly sensitive to learning rates. We propose SubZero+, an improved SubZero framework that improves stability in three complementary ways: (i) multi-query gradient estimation within layer-specific low-rank subspaces to reduce variance without exhibiting the multi-query paradox; (ii) a subspace Adam optimizer that performs adaptive updates using in-subspace multi-query gradient statistics; and (iii) a sign correction for QR-based subspace construction to ensure Haar-distributed projection matrices, eliminating implementation-dependent orientation ambiguity. Experiments on models from 1.3B to 32B across SuperGLUE, under both full-parameter tuning and LoRA, show that SubZero+ consistently outperforms prior ZO baselines, enlarges the stable learning-rate range, and narrows the gap to first-order methods with minimal extra memory overhead.

</details>


### [332] [Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15669)
*Zhongwei Yu,Yan Song,Xue Yan,Anjie Liu,Xingyu Lu,Yihang Chen,Huichi Zhou,Siyuan Guo,Luoyang Sun,Sihan Chen,Xiangning Yu,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Large Discovery Model (LDM)，一种将生成式模型与贝叶斯非参数奖励代理模型耦合的循环架构，用于在开放假设空间中进行科学发现。LDM在神经网络训练、抗体设计和分子优化三个场景中显著优于LLM-only反思和传统统计搜索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现常需要在庞大、结构化且开放式的假设空间（如分子、蛋白质序列、程序）中优化昂贵的评估目标。虽然LLM提供了强大的先验，但其似然度和自我评估在分布外的新颖候选上不可靠，无法作为目标和校准后认知不确定性的代理。现有的LLM-only方法和传统统计搜索方法均存在不足，需要一种能同时利用生成模型的表达能力和不确定性量化的机制。

Method: LDM是一种经验驱动的循环架构，包含两个核心组件：1）生成式模型负责提出和完善候选设计；2）贝叶斯非参数奖励代理模型（reward surrogate）预测候选性能并量化不确定性，生成不确定性感知的价值函数来引导候选的生成、精炼和选择。随着每个新实验观测到来，发现记忆（discovery memory）和代理模型会被持续更新。

Result: 在三个不同设计模态和目标的场景中评估LDM：神经网络训练（验证BPB降低2.4倍）、抗体设计（结合能相对降低18.2%）、分子优化（多目标性能相对提升超60%）。所有指标均显著优于LLM-only反思和传统统计搜索基线。

Conclusion: 结果表明LDM可作为通用发现引擎，在开放假设空间中实现高效搜索，兼具生成模型的表现力与贝叶斯代理模型的不确定性感知能力。

Abstract: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs. Generative models such as large language models (LLMs) provide expressive priors over such spaces, but their likelihoods and self-assessments are unreliable proxies for the objectives and calibrated epistemic uncertainty, especially for novel candidates outside the observed data distribution. We introduce the Large Discovery Model (LDM), an empirically grounded recurrent architecture that couples a generative model with a Bayesian non-parametric reward surrogate model. The generative model proposes and refines candidate designs, while the surrogate predicts their performance and quantifies uncertainty, yielding an uncertainty-aware value that guides candidate generation, refinement, and selection. The discovery memory and the surrogate model are continually updated as each new experimental observation arrives. We evaluate LDM on three scenarios spanning different design modalities and objectives, including neural-network training, antibody design, and molecular optimisation. Compared to LLM-only reflection or traditional statistical search across these domains, LDM achieves a $2.4\times$ greater reduction in validation BPB, an $18.2\%$ relative decrease in binding energy, and more than $60\%$ relative gains in molecular multi-objective performance. These results suggests that LDM could serve as a general-purpose discovery engine for effective search over open-ended hypothesis spaces.

</details>


### [333] [PL-Guard: Probabilistic Logic Reasoning for LLM Guardrails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15673)
*Satchit Chatterji,Shihan Wang,Giovanni Sileno,Erman Acar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PL-Guard，一种神经符号护栏架构，将语义接地（局部LLM将提示-响应对映射为谓词概率）与策略推理（ProbLog概率逻辑推理）分离，在XSTest上显著降低不安全合规率（从22.0%降至0.5%），但代价是过度拒绝率升高（14.4% vs 5.2%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM护栏（如策略提示、LLM-as-a-judge）将语义接地和策略推理重叠在同一个模型中，导致对有害提示的不安全顺从或对良性提示的错误拒绝。作者旨在通过分离这两个角色来提高安全性与帮助性之间的可控权衡，并使中间推理步骤可审计。

Method: PL-Guard采用神经符号架构：1）符号策略接口由谓词和ProbLog规则定义；2）局部LLM通过重归一化的True/False token得分将提示-响应对接地为谓词概率；3）ProbLog对符号策略执行显式概率规则推理，生成合规判定。

Result: 在XSTest基准上，使用手工策展策略的PL-Guard将不安全合规从基础模型的22.0%降至0.5%，低于LLM-as-a-judge基线的6.0%；但过度拒绝率更高（14.4% vs 5.2%）。

Conclusion: 分离神经接地与概率符号推理可以暴露安全-帮助性权衡，同时使护栏的中间推理步骤显式化、可审计，为构建更可控、可解释的LLM安全机制提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language model guardrails can be viewed as policy-consistency problems: a system must determine which policy-relevant facts hold in a prompt-response pair and what those facts imply under a given policy. Common approaches, including policy prompting and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, often overlap the tasks of semantic grounding and policy reasoning: the model both interprets the prompt-response pair and reasons about whether a policy has been violated. This can lead to unsafe compliance with harmful prompts, or refusals to assist benign ones. To separate grounding and reasoning roles, we propose PL-Guard, a neurosymbolic guardrail architecture. Using a symbolic policy interface consisting of predicates and ProbLog rules, a local LLM grounds prompt-response pairs into predicate probabilities using renormalized True/False token scores, while ProbLog performs explicit probabilistic rule inference over the symbolic policy. On the XSTest benchmark, an offline Qwen-based evaluator finds that PL-Guard with a hand-curated policy reduces unsafe compliance from 22.0% for the base model to 0.5%, and below the 6.0% rate of an LLM-as-a-judge baseline. This comes at the cost of higher over-refusal than the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, 14.4% versus 5.2%. These results suggest that separating neural grounding from probabilistic symbolic reasoning can expose the safety-helpfulness tradeoff while making the guardrail's intermediate reasoning steps explicit and auditable.

</details>


### [334] [Learning Auditable Classifier Models: Source-Disjoint Tree Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15725)
*Srikumar Krishnamoorthy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RPTE（残差模式树集成），一种三阶段可审计的预测模型学习方法，通过有界特征预算、源不相交性和系数分离估计三个原则，确保每个预测可分解为命名的、非重叠的规则贡献之和。在12个临床二元分类基准上，RPTE性能与调优的黑盒集成和可解释基线相当，同时相对于XGBoost将模型检查单元减少9倍到87倍，并在全部12个数据集上比EBM具有更低的审计复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床和受监管场景中的预测模型需要既准确又可完全审计。树集成虽然准确性强，但顺序提升将结构发现与系数估计耦合，难以进行紧凑的逐预测审计。可解释替代方案如广义可加模型限制交互为成对项，事后规则提取器产生重叠规则阻碍紧凑解释。因此需要一种既保持预测性能又保证可完全审计的方法。

Method: RPTE采用三阶段学习流程。阶段1构建监督式符号特征词汇表。阶段2在源不相交约束下生长浅层树——每个原始变量最多分配给一棵树，仅保留发现的树结构。阶段3在叶区域指示符上求解单一的L1正则化逻辑回归，获得联合最优的稀疏系数。其三个核心原则为：有界特征预算、源不相交性、独立的系数估计。

Result: 在12个临床领域二分类基准上使用重复分层5折交叉验证评估，RPTE的性能与调优的不透明集成和可解释基线相当。RPTE相对XGBoost将模型检查单元减少9倍至87倍，在全部12个数据集上比EBM具有更低的审计复杂度。RuleFit在三个规则数量较少的数据集上需要相当或更少的检查单元，但缺乏源不相交性保证。

Conclusion: RPTE通过设计确保了完整的可审计性：每个预测都能分解为命名的、非重叠规则贡献的代数求和，兼顾了预测性能与可解释性，为临床和受监管环境提供了一种可用的可审计预测建模方案。

Abstract: Predictive models in clinical and regulated settings must be accurate and fully auditable. Tree ensembles deliver strong accuracy on tabular data, but their sequential boosting couples structure discovery with coefficient estimation, making compact per-prediction auditing difficult. Interpretable alternatives impose structural constraints that limit expressiveness: generalized additive models typically restrict interactions to pairwise terms and post-hoc rule extractors produce overlapping rules that hinder compact interpretation. We introduce Residual Pattern Tree Ensemble (RPTE), a three-stage learning approach, that is built on three key principles: bounded feature budget, source disjointness, and separate coefficient estimation. Stage~1 builds a supervised symbolic feature vocabulary. Stage~2 grows shallow trees under a source-disjointness constraint, where each raw variable is allocated to at most one tree, and retains only the discovered tree structures. Stage~3 solves a single $\ell_1$-regularized logistic regression over leaf-region indicators, yielding jointly optimal sparse coefficients. This learning approach ensures that every prediction decomposes into an algebraic sum of named, non-overlapping rule contributions, enabling full auditability by design. Empirical evaluation on twelve clinical-domain binary classification benchmarks using repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation shows that RPTE performs competitively against tuned opaque ensembles and interpretable baselines. RPTE reduces model inspection units by 9$\times$ to 87$\times$ relative to XGBoost and maintains lower audit complexity than EBM on all 12 datasets. RuleFit requires comparable or fewer inspection units on three datasets where its rule count is small, but without source-disjointness guarantees. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/srikumar2050/hugiml-core}{this https URL}.

</details>


### [335] [FirstDiff: One-Step Diffusion-Based Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series via Initial Noise Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15727)
*Ali Boudaghi,Alireza Nemati,Hadi Zare*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FirstDiff框架，利用反向扩散初始阶段的预测噪声进行多变量时间序列异常检测，将完整反向扩散轨迹缩减为单次去噪网络评估，在5个公开数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的时间序列异常检测方法需在完成整个反向扩散过程后才进行检测，仅依赖最终重建信号，忽略了去噪过程中的中间表征。这不仅导致高昂的计算开销，也限制了中间扩散信息的利用。

Method: FirstDiff基于一个关键观察：初始反向扩散评估时预测的扩散噪声已包含足够信息用于准确异常检测。该方法利用验证数据对正常行为下的预测扩散噪声统计分布进行建模，从而只需单次去噪网络评估即可完成异常推断，无需走完整个反向扩散轨迹。去噪骨干网络采用Diffusion Transformer以建模复杂的时间与跨传感器依赖关系。

Result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FirstDiff达到了最先进的性能，同时将扩散推理从完整的反向轨迹缩减为单次去噪网络评估，大幅降低了计算成本。

Conclusion: FirstDiff验证了初始反向扩散阶段的预测噪声即包含足够判别信息用于异常检测，通过跳过完整反向扩散轨迹实现高效且高精度的多变量时间序列异常检测。

Abstract: Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for multivariate time-series anomaly detection by learning the distribution of normal data through iterative denoising. Existing diffusion-based approaches, however, typically perform anomaly detection after completing the reverse diffusion process, relying primarily on the final reconstructed signal and overlooking informative representations produced during denoising. This design incurs substantial computational cost and limits the use of intermediate diffusion information for anomaly detection.
  In this paper, we propose FirstDiff, a diffusion-based anomaly detection framework based on the observation that the predicted diffusion noise at the initial reverse-diffusion evaluation already contains sufficient information for accurate anomaly detection. FirstDiff models the statistical distribution of predicted diffusion noise under normal behavior using validation data, enabling anomaly inference from a single denoising-network evaluation rather than completing the reverse diffusion trajectory.
  To model complex temporal and inter-sensor dependencies, FirstDiff employs a Diffusion Transformer as the denoising backbone. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that FirstDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing diffusion inference from the full reverse trajectory to a single denoising-network evaluation.

</details>


### [336] [TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15767)
*Armin Steinhauser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TinyCast，一种无注意力机制的超轻量零样本预测器，仅用146,505个参数即可输出预测分布，利用零参数频谱检测器提供主导周期，通过相位折叠上下文并结合膨胀卷积编码器与块自回归分位数解码器建模，在GIFT-Eval等基准上定义了尺寸-精度前沿，且可导出静态INT8并直接在嵌入式设备上端到端预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者认为在极小参数规模下，上下文的周期结构应当被直接计算而非通过学习获得。当前零样本预测器普遍参数规模较大，缺乏在极轻量约束下既能输出预测分布又保持较高精度的方案，TinyCast旨在填补这一空白。

Method: TinyCast采用无注意力架构：首先使用零参数频谱检测器识别主导周期；然后将上下文按相位折叠（phase folding）；随后通过膨胀卷积（dilated convolution）编码器和块自回归分位数解码器建模残余信息。整个混合路径仅由卷积和矩阵乘法构成，因此可导出静态INT8模型。

Result: 在GIFT-Eval榜单中，TinyCast是参数规模可确定的零样本条目中最小者，并在概率精度上定义了尺寸-精度前沿。在无测试数据泄漏的零样本条目中，它是唯一低于1.4M参数且能输出预测分布的方法；在Chronos-ZS和fev-bench上，所有优于它的神经模型参数至少为其28倍。

Conclusion: TinyCast证明在极小参数规模下，将周期结构计算化而非学习化是一种有效策略。其纯卷积/矩阵乘法路径使其可部署于嵌入式设备并进行端到端静态INT8推理，无需逐信号拟合，展现了极端轻量预测分布的可行性。

Abstract: We introduce TinyCast, an attention-free zero-shot forecaster that emits a predictive distribution from 146,505 parameters, on the premise that at this size the periodic structure of a context is worth computing rather than learning. A zero-parameter spectral detector supplies the dominant periods, the context is folded on their phase, and a dilated convolutional encoder and a block-autoregressive quantile decoder model the rest. It is smaller than every zero-shot entry on the GIFT-Eval board whose parameter count can be established. On probabilistic accuracy it defines the size-accuracy frontier. Among zero-shot entries declaring no test-data leakage it is the only one below 1.4M parameters that emits a predictive distribution, and every entry scoring better carries at least that budget. On Chronos-ZS and fev-bench every neural model ahead of it carries at least 28 times its parameters. Because the mixing path is convolutions and matrix multiplications only, it exports to static INT8 and forecasts end to end on an embedded device without per-signal fitting.

</details>


### [337] [Temporal Graph Prototype-conditioned Conformal Prediction for Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15768)
*Xudong Chen,Shengbo Gong,Lu Cheng,Wei Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProtoCP是一个面向时序交互图边级欺诈检测的共形预测框架，利用学习到的原型抑制良性主导噪声，引入邻域相对评分机制和时间分数扩散，在保持目标覆盖率的同时生成比现有方法更紧凑的预测集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在边级欺诈检测中，错误的正/负预测都代价高昂，共形预测的分布无关覆盖保证很有吸引力。但直接应用现有图共形预测器在两个问题上产生低效预测集：(1)欺诈交互常嵌入良性主导的邻域中，稀释校准信号；(2)极端类别不平衡使校准集中标记欺诈样本稀少，导致类别条件阈值过于保守。

Method: ProtoCP框架包含两个核心机制：(1)利用学习到的原型（prototypes）抑制校准上下文中良性主导的噪声，聚焦于欺诈相关的子图上下文；(2)引入邻域相对评分（neighborhood-relative scoring）机制，并结合时间分数扩散（temporal score diffusion），在类别不平衡和时间漂移下实现稳定的类别条件校准。

Result: 在四个欺诈基准数据集（YelpChi、S-FFSD、FTFD和BankSim）上的实验表明，ProtoCP在达到目标覆盖率的同时，生成的预测集始终比最先进的基线方法更小（更高效）。

Conclusion: ProtoCP通过原型驱动的校准聚焦和邻域相对评分与时间分数扩散相结合的策略，有效解决了欺诈数据中良性主导邻域和极端类别不平衡带来的校准效率问题，为风险感知的时序图欺诈检测提供了更紧凑的不确定性量化工具。

Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees and has emerged as a principled tool for uncertainty quantification. In edge-level fraud detection on temporal interaction graphs, where false positives and false negatives both carry substantial cost, such coverage guarantees are particularly appealing for risk-aware decision making.
