TL;DR: 本文研究30M参数循环深度关系推理模型，发现行为阈值、隐藏状态可解码性和训练进程是三个不同且不可互换的可观测事件。在符号与口头两种训练表面上，三跳能力获取代价相差186.5倍（70 vs 13,055逻辑epoch），但内部探针在行为到达之前就能恢复未来答案身份（p=0.013），且该内部可达性在表面切换后仍存在（p=0.001）。作者强调行为能力、内部可访问性与训练时间发展是三个独立可观测量，因果干预是必要的下一步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能力发展通常从行为阈值、最终检查点或隐藏状态解码来推断，但这些问题未必指向同一事件。作者旨在严格分离训练时间与推理时间，通过预注册探针、显式未训练与阴性对照，证明行为表现与内部可访问性是不同可观测量，为理解训练实际习得何种计算提供更严谨的测量框架。

Method: 采用30M参数的循环深度关系推理器，在封闭的oracle定义世界中研究。方法包括：1）密集行为轨迹与两种训练表面（符号/口头）；2）预注册的行为到达前隐藏状态线性探针；3）前瞻性检查可评估性；4）显式未训练和阴性对照；5）严格分离训练时间与推理时间轴。用逻辑epoch衡量训练代价，用p值评估探针显著性与贡献类别数。

Result: 1）行为层面：三跳能力在符号表面需70个逻辑epoch，口头表面需13,055个（186.5倍差异），此后口头四跳能力仅需8个epoch；四跳行为在13,055个epoch的研磨中从未超过3/40，最终0/40。2）内部探针：口头表面上线性探针在行为到达前以0.056159恢复未来答案身份（均匀随机0.025，untrained对照0.024758，群体频率基线0.048309，p=0.012987，16/40类别贡献）。3）表面切换后可达性仍存在：上游结构位置0.1020（对照0.0460，p=0.000999），读出比较器0.0618（p=0.004），21/40类别贡献。4）跨训练追踪不可清洁评估，因探针资格由行为到达定义，测量群体随被测量变化。

Conclusion: 行为胜任能力、内部可访问性（decoder可读性）和训练时间发展是三个截然不同的可观测量。行为到达与探针可解码内部状态不必然同刻发生——内部探针可在行为之前捕获未来答案身份，且该现象跨表面转移。作者得出结论：行为和解码器可访问性都不能单独识别训练习得的计算，因果干预是必要的下一步。

Abstract: Capability development is routinely inferred from behavioural thresholds, from final checkpoints, or from what a decoder can read out of a hidden state. These quantities need not identify the same event. We study a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth relational reasoner in a closed, oracle-defined world, using dense behavioural trajectories, two training surfaces, preregistered pre-arrival hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, holding the training-time and inference-time axes separate throughout. Behaviour first: under one frozen acquisition criterion, three-hop competence cost 70 logical epochs on the symbolic surface and 13,055 on the verbal surface, a 186.5-fold contrast, after which verbal four-hop competence cleared in 8 logical epochs. Across the 13,055-epoch grind, four-hop held-out behaviour never exceeded 3/40 and ended at 0/40. Internal measurement next: on the verbal surface a linear probe recovered future-answer identity before behavioural arrival at 0.056159 against uniform chance 0.025, an untrained control of 0.024758 and a population frequency baseline of 0.048309 (p = 0.012987; 16/40 answer classes contributing). Analogous pre-arrival accessibility survived the surface change, reaching 0.1020 against a zero-step control of 0.0460 (p = 0.000999) at the upstream structural position and 0.0618 at the readout comparator (p = 0.004), with 21/40 classes contributing. Finally, the natural attempt to track that accessibility across training was not cleanly evaluable: probe eligibility is defined by behavioural arrival, so the measured population changes with the measurand. Behavioural competence, internal accessibility, and training-time development are distinct observables, and neither behaviour nor decoder accessibility identifies the computation training acquired; causal intervention is the necessary next step.

</details>


### [370] [Unifying Graph Neural Networks Through a Common Layer Equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16097)
*Sai Karthik Navuluru,Siddhartha Shankar Das,Bo Ni,Hongjie Chen,Yu Wang,Baris Coskunuzer,Nesreen K. Ahmed,Franck Dernoncourt,Mahantesh Halappanavar,Tyler Derr,Ryan A. Rossi,Lakshman Tamil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的图神经网络层方程，通过七个组件（更新域、通道集、传播库、逐通道消息映射、通道融合算子、自身/残差映射、更新映射）将超过200种GNN架构组织在共同的设计空间中，将信息"移动到哪里"（传播库）与"移动什么"（消息映射）解耦，并涵盖局部消息传递、注意力、谱滤波、全局通信、关系特定通道、高阶域和几何消息七大架构家族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络通常通过家族特定的方程来描述，这些方程掩盖了不同架构之间的共享计算和结构差异，导致难以进行跨架构的比较、分析和系统化理解。

Method: 提出一个统一的层方程，由七个组件构成：更新域、通道集、传播库、逐通道消息映射、通道融合算子、自身/残差映射和更新映射。核心因式分解将信息传播的位置（传播库）与传播的内容（消息映射）分离；通过函数值的填充将同一方程扩展到多种架构家族。采用固定的槽位纪律，按计算角色分配操作并定义框架覆盖边界。

Result: 实现了对主流层的可检验简化归约和组件分配，覆盖七大非互斥架构家族；在端点局部消息和节点局部更新假设下，证明了算子支撑集约束单层依赖关系，并给出了单层全局混合需要完整有效算子行成立的条件；组织超过200种架构，支持组件级比较和生成结构一致的架构，并将传播选择与过度平滑、过度压缩、异质性和表达能力联系起来。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个统一的设计空间来理解和比较GNN架构，同时揭示了经验上的逆问题：如何将可测量的图和任务属性映射到经验证的组件选择上。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are commonly described through family-specific equations whose notation obscures shared computations and structural differences. We introduce a common layer equation that represents covered architectures through seven components: an update domain, channel set, propagation bank, per-channel message maps, channel-fusion operator, ego/residual map, and update map. The central factorization separates where information moves, encoded by the propagation bank, from what moves, encoded by the message maps. Function-valued fillings extend the same equation across local message passing, attention, spectral filtering, global communication, relation-specific channels, higher-order domains, and geometric messages.
  We make this unification explicit and checkable through worked reductions of canonical layers and component assignments spanning seven nonexclusive architectural families. A fixed slot discipline assigns operations by computational role and defines the framework's coverage boundary. The decomposition also yields component-level theoretical insights: under endpoint-local messages and node-local updates, operator support bounds one-layer dependencies, and one-layer global mixing requires a full effective operator row under the stated hypotheses.
  The resulting framework organizes more than 200 architectures in a common design space, enables component-wise comparison and generation of structurally consistent architectures, and connects propagation choices to oversmoothing, oversquashing, heterophily, and expressivity. It further exposes the empirical inverse problem of mapping measurable graph and task properties to validated component choices.

</details>


### [371] [AsyTO: Asymmetric Temporal Operator for Parameter-Efficient Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16098)
*Xiachong Lin,Du Yin,Hao Xue,Wen Hu,Imran Razzak,Arian Prabowo,Matthew Amos,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AsyTO（非对称时间算子）模型，针对多元时间序列预测中"共享预测器效率高但灵活度低、独立预测器灵活但成本高"的结构性两难，通过压缩预测算子而非观测序列来化解矛盾。审计发现逐变量线性历史到未来映射中存在锁相季节性成分和紧凑残差算子，且残差传输具有方向性。基于此，AsyTO将逐变量算子的张量分解为共享但独立的历史读取与未来写入时间模式，配合低秩周期原型与循环可分离分解。在11个基准、44个数据集-预测区间设置中，AsyTO在30个设置中取得最佳轻量级误差，处于精度-计算帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多元时间序列预测存在结构性两难：共享一个时间预测器参数高效，但迫使异质变量通过相同的历史-未来映射；而每个变量学习独立预测器虽恢复灵活性，代价随变量数、上下文长度和预测区间乘积增长。作者认为一旦压缩对象从观测序列变为预测算子，这一两难可以被化解，从而在精度与效率之间取得平衡。

Method: AsyTO通过四个关键设计实现：（1）将逐变量算子的张量分解为共享但截然不同的历史读取与未来写入时间模式，配以逐变量的模式级增益；（2）引入低秩周期性原型捕获锁相季节成分；（3）采用循环可分离分解处理时间模式；（4）每个预测仅读取自身变量的历史，使参数和计算量与变量数呈线性增长。基于对标准基准中逐变量线性历史-未来映射的审计结果，方向性（非对称）残差算子优于滞后不变替代方案。

Result: 在11个多元时间序列基准和多个预测区间上，AsyTO在44个数据集-预测区间设置中的30个取得了最优轻量级误差，位于精度-计算帕累托前沿。审计还发现锁相季节性成分配紧凑残差算子在多数场景优于稠密相位无关基准，且滞后不变替代始终不如非对称历史-未来映射。

Conclusion: 通过压缩预测算子而非观测序列，成功化解了共享与独立预测器之间的两难。算子结构审计揭示了预测中的锁相季节性和方向性残差传输特性，AsyTO利用共享但非对称的时间模式结合逐变量增益，在线性成本下获得前沿精度，为多元时间序列预测提供了高效而灵活的解决方案。

Abstract: Multivariate time-series forecasting faces a structural dilemma: sharing one temporal predictor across variables is parameter-efficient but forces heterogeneous variables through an identical history-to-future map, whereas learning an independent predictor per variable restores flexibility at a cost that grows with the product of variable count, context length, and horizon. We argue that this dilemma dissolves once the object being compressed is the forecasting operator rather than the observed series. Auditing per-variable linear history-to-future maps across standard benchmarks, we find that a phase-locked seasonal component paired with a compact residual operator outperforms a dense phase-blind reference in most audited settings. The residual transport is also directional: lag-invariant alternatives consistently underperform asymmetric history-to-future maps. Guided by this structure, we propose AsyTO, an Asymmetric Temporal Operator that factorizes the tensor of per-variable operators into shared but distinct history-reading and future-writing temporal modes with per-variable mode-wise gains, complemented by a low-rank periodic prototype and a cycle-separable factorization of the temporal modes. Each forecast reads only its own variable's history, so parameters and compute grow linearly in the number of variables. Across eleven benchmarks and multiple forecast horizons, AsyTO attains the best lightweight error in 30 of 44 dataset-horizon settings, locating at the accuracy-compute Pareto frontier.

</details>


### [372] [RetroMPA: A Molecular Property-Aware Auxiliary Framework for Enhancing Retrosynthesis Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16111)
*Mianzhi Liu,Fan Xiao,Zhiliang Yu,Huayang Huang,Yuke Li,Yi Yang,Wenbo Liu,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RetroMPA是一个模型无关的分子性质感知后处理增强模块，通过注入化学知识到逆合成预测流程中，在不修改模型架构或重新训练的情况下，将八种代表性逆合成模型在USPTO-50K上的top-1准确率平均提升5.50%，并在USPTO-Full大规模数据集上实现约2.03%的平均提升，湿实验验证了其在经典反应范式中的实际可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的数据驱动深度学习逆合成模型虽然取得了显著进展，但它们从大规模数据集中自主学习反应模式，缺乏对既有化学知识（作为先验）的充分整合，限制了模型的预测能力和泛化性能。

Method: RetroMPA作为一个plug-and-play的化学过滤器，而非独立的SMILES序列生成器，通过性质感知的潜在嵌入空间来重新校准和优化现有逆合成算法的预测路径。该框架无需修改模型架构或进行资源密集的重新训练，即可与多种数据驱动逆合成方法无缝集成。

Result: 在USPTO-50K上，RetroMPA将八种代表性逆合成模型的top-1准确率平均提升5.50%；在USPTO-Full大规模数据集上，对模板基和模板自由架构平均提升约2.03%。湿实验验证了其在Suzuki-Miyaura偶联、Bucherer反应和Friedel-Crafts酰化等经典反应中发现此前未报道的可行底物组合的能力。

Conclusion: RetroMPA证明了将化学知识作为先验注入逆合成流程的有效性，其模型无关的即插即用特性使其具有广泛的适用性和实用性。湿实验表明该方法超越了纯粹的数据拟合，能够发现新的可行合成路径，为推动逆合成预测从数据驱动向知识驱动融合提供了有力支持。代码已开源。

Abstract: Retrosynthesis is a cornerstone of drug discovery and organic synthesis. While data-driven deep learning models have shown remarkable progress, they autonomously learn reaction patterns from extensive datasets with limited integration of established chemical knowledge as priors.
  To address this limitation, we introduce RetroMPA, a molecular property-aware, post-hoc enhancement module that injects chemical knowledge into the retrosynthesis pipeline. Rather than functioning as an independent SMILES sequence generator, RetroMPA is a broadly applicable, model-agnostic chemical filter designed to recalibrate and optimize the predictive pathways of existing algorithms.
  This plug-and-play framework integrates seamlessly with a range of data-driven retrosynthesis methods, enhancing outputs without modifying model architecture or requiring resource-intensive retraining. By leveraging a property-aware latent embedding space, RetroMPA consistently improves top-1 accuracy across eight representative retrosynthesis models by an average of 5.50% on USPTO-50K.
  Furthermore, we validate its scalability on the large-scale USPTO-Full dataset, achieving an average improvement of about 2.03% across both template-based and template-free architectures.
  Wet-lab experiments provide preliminary support for the practical utility of the framework. These syntheses confirmed viable, previously unreported substrate combinations for classic reaction paradigms---specifically, Suzuki-Miyaura coupling, Bucherer reaction, and Friedel-Crafts acylation---suggesting that RetroMPA can operate beyond mere data fitting. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/MengzhouLu/RetroMPA.

</details>


### [373] [Multi-Feature Riemannian Hypergraph for Online Test-Time Adaptation of Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16134)
*Siqi Li,Zhi Li,Tong Liu,Shuai Zhang,Yanfei Jia,Zhiqiang Yi,Jue Xie,Ni Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MRieHy框架，融合黎曼几何与超图学习，用于运动想象脑机接口(MI-BCI)的跨日在线测试时自适应解码，在私有ECoG和两个公开EEG数据集上超越现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MI-BCI解码面临两个关键挑战：跨日可迁移性和在线操作。现有超图方法虽能通过高阶样本关系提升迁移性，但忽略了黎曼几何在EEG迁移学习中的跨日优势。

Method: MRieHy首先计算跨日训练数据协方差矩阵的黎曼均值以对齐多日分布；随后用黎曼距离在协方差矩阵上构建超图，同时用余弦相似度在深度特征上构建第二个超图；两个超图通过自适应学习权重融合，并与标签投影矩阵联合优化。在线测试时，使用先进先出缓冲区维护近期样本，对缓冲数据执行黎曼对齐后再用学到的超图解码。

Result: 在私有四类ECoG数据集和两个公开四类EEG数据集上的大量实验表明，MRieHy相比现有最先进基线取得了显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: MRieHy通过将黎曼几何与多特征超图学习相结合，有效解决了MI-BCI解码中的跨日迁移性和在线测试时自适应问题，验证了该框架在跨日在线场景中的优越性。

Abstract: In clinical motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) decoding, cross-day transferability and online operation remain two critical challenges. Hypergraphs can improve transferability by capturing higher-order sample relationships, yet existing hypergraph-based methods for online emotion recognition neglect the cross-day benefits of Riemannian geometry widely adopted in EEG transfer learning. To bridge this gap, we propose the Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy), a framework tailored for online test-time adaptation in MI-BCI decoding that leverages Riemannian geometry to strengthen cross-day transferability. MRieHy first computes Riemannian means of covariance matrices from cross-day training data to align multi-day distributions. It then constructs a hypergraph over covariance matrices using Riemannian distance, complemented by a second hypergraph over deep features built with cosine similarity. The two hypergraphs are fused via adaptively learned combination weights, jointly optimized with the label projection matrices. During online testing, MRieHy maintains a first-in-first-out buffer of recent samples, performs Riemannian alignment on the buffered data, and decodes with the learned hypergraph. Extensive experiments on a private four-class ECoG dataset and two public four-class EEG datasets validate that MRieHy achieves notable performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [374] [REFLEX: Reflexive Equilibrium Fixed-point Learning for Endogenous eXchanges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16155)
*Vignesh Nagarajan,Shriraghav Ashok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出REFLEX框架，将执行性预测理论中抽象的稳定性条件转化为可直接测量的交易台稳定性裕度，用于预测做市商机器学习报价模型反复重训练是否会收敛或放大自身不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场外公司债券市场中，经销商使用机器学习设定报价并根据自身报价吸引的交易重训练模型，形成反馈回路。现有的执行性预测理论虽然给出了锐利的稳定性条件，但通过抽象的客观性质表达，交易台无法在部署前测量这些量。因此需要一种用可测量行为特征替代不可观测量的框架，以判断报价模型驱动的市场是否稳定。

Method: REFLEX框架用三个可测量的经销商行为特征替代不可观测的抽象量：(1)交易量对报价收紧的弹性；(2)经销商目标函数在最优解附近的弯曲程度；(3)知情交易流随价差收窄而增加的速率。三者合并为一个重训练模量（retraining modulus），作为部署前的稳定性裕度，从交易台自身的报价与执行历史中估计。

Result: 模拟中预测稳定性和实测稳定性一致度在8%以内；两个竞争对手使不稳定性增加1.74倍，三个竞争对手增加3.16倍，与预测吻合。普通重训练在模量1.21处失稳，而结构化锚定修正收敛时盲目重训练已崩溃。基于36年公开市场数据校准，从平静期到危机期，投资级稳定性余量下降约4.4倍，高收益级下降约4.3倍。

Conclusion: REFLEX将抽象收敛定理转化为市场层面的安全裕度，为做市商在部署机器学习报价模型前提供可操作的稳定性预判工具，弥合了理论稳定性条件与实务可测性之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: In over-the-counter corporate bond markets, dealers compete for client trades by quoting bid and ask prices. Tighter quotes attract more business, but also informed customers more likely to trade ahead of adverse price moves, leaving the dealer holding the risk. As dealers increasingly use machine learning to set quotes, they retrain these models on the trades their own quotes attract, creating a feedback loop in which each model reshapes the market that generates its next training data. The question is therefore not only whether a quoting model performs well, but whether the market it creates stays stable as the model learns from it. Existing performative prediction theory gives a sharp stability condition, yet expresses it through abstract properties of the learning objective a trading desk cannot measure before deployment. We introduce REFLEX, a framework that replaces those unobservable quantities with three measurable features of dealer behavior: how strongly trading volume responds to tighter quotes, how sharply the dealer's objective bends around its optimum, and how quickly informed flow increases as spreads narrow. REFLEX combines these into a single retraining modulus, a pre-deployment stability margin estimated from a desk's own quote and execution history that predicts whether repeated retraining will converge or amplify itself. In simulation, predicted and measured stability agree within 8%, and competing dealers increase instability by 1.74x with two and 3.16x with three, as predicted. Where ordinary retraining becomes unstable at modulus 1.21, a structurally anchored correction converges as blind retraining collapses. Calibrated over 36 years of public market data, stability headroom falls roughly 4.4x for investment grade and 4.3x for high yield from calm to crisis regimes. Ultimately, REFLEX turns an abstract convergence theorem into a market-level safety margin.

</details>


### [375] [A Tree-Structured Approach for Phishing Template and Attacker Attribution Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16158)
*Unai Agirre,Imanol Jerico,Felipe Castaño,Andrea Venturi,Francesco Zola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究利用HTML结构（DOM树）作为指纹来识别钓鱼网页模板复用，通过无监督聚类方法对结构相似的网页进行分组，以检测协同钓鱼活动和新出现的零日模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有钓鱼防御大多依赖被动的黑名单或针对单个钓鱼实例的监督分类模型，无法识别结构重用和检测协同钓鱼活动。由于钓鱼网站工业化程度提高，大量模板被重复使用，需要一种能够发现隐藏结构相似性的方法。

Method: 将网页建模为DOM树，提取结构特征（可选地加入基于HTML标签的内容信息），使用无监督学习算法进行聚类。评估三种聚类算法，分析DOM树深度对聚类结果的影响，并提出一种新的逐层Jaccard距离分数用于聚类质量评估。

Result: 结果表明，网页的结构表示能有效揭示钓鱼网站之间的隐藏相似性，实现新兴和零日模板的检测，并支持对协同钓鱼威胁的分析。定量和定性评估（包括新提出的逐层Jaccard距离分数和可视化工具辅助的手动检查）验证了聚类质量。

Conclusion: HTML结构（DOM树）可作为强健的指纹用于钓鱼模板复用识别，无监督聚类方法能够发现并被用于检测协同钓鱼攻击。

Abstract: Phishing remains a persistent and evolving cybersecurity threat, with attack volumes reaching record levels. This growth is driven by the industrialization of phishing through widely available phishing kits and reusable templates, which enable cybercriminals to rapidly generate and deploy large numbers of fraudulent webpages. Although surface-level attributes may differ across these websites, their underlying structures often exhibit significant similarities. However, most existing defenses rely on reactive blocklists or supervised classification models that focus on individual phishing instances, limiting their ability to identify structural reuse and detect coordinated phishing campaigns. To address this limitation, this study investigates whether HTML structure can serve as a robust fingerprint for identifying phishing template reuse. We model webpages as Document Object Model (DOM) trees and extract structural features, optionally enriched with HTML tag-based content information. These representations are then clustered using unsupervised learning methods to group structurally similar webpages. Three clustering algorithms are evaluated and compared, while also analyzing how the depth of the extracted DOM-tree affects cluster formation and overall clustering performance. Finally, cluster quality is also evaluated both quantitatively and qualitatively, including a novel level-wise Jaccard Distance Score and manual inspection supported by visualization tools. Results demonstrate that structural representations of webpages can effectively reveal hidden similarities across phishing sites, enabling the detection of emerging and zero-day templates and supporting the analysis of coordinated phishing threats

</details>


### [376] [Demystifying Oversmoothing in Sheaf Neural Networks: An Index-Theoretic Criterion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16180)
*Junwen Dong,Yuhan Peng,Hao Li,Huitao Feng,Kelin Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个关于Sheaf神经网络抗过平滑能力的相对几何刻画框架。指出现有基于$\ker\mathcal{L}$绝对维度的方法不可靠，因为某些sheaf配置会虚增维度但谐和截面仍然全常数。作者建立基于指标理论的比较判据，在茎传输与全局sheaf结构自然条件下判断一个sheaf的谐和空间是否真正包含另一个。并引入GyroSheaf（具有弯曲gyrovector空间茎的sheaf），通过局部切空间线性化将该判据推广至非线性领域。十个模型实验验证了该理论判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SNN的抗过平滑分析依赖于谐和空间$\ker\mathcal{L}$的绝对维度，但绝对维度并不可靠：某些sheaf配置会通过非本质方式虚增维度，而其谐和截面仍为全常数，并未提升判别能力。因此需要一种更精确、相对且几何化的度量来描述抗过平滑能力。

Method: 引入相对几何方法：在茎传输和全局sheaf结构的自然条件下，建立基于指标理论的比较判据（index-theoretic comparison criterion），判断一个sheaf的谐和空间是否真正包含另一个sheaf的谐和空间，而非通过平凡维度膨胀。进一步提出GyroSheaf，采用弯曲的gyrovector空间作为茎，通过局部切空间线性化将判据推广到非线性sheaf情形。

Result: 在十个模型上的实验证实了理论判据：违反该判据的sheaf模型尽管出现指标跳跃（index jumps）仍会塌缩（collapse），而符合判据的模型能保持深度稳定的表示。

Conclusion: 绝对维度不是可靠的抗过平滑指标，需要采用相对、几何化的判据。基于指标理论的比较判据能精确刻画sheaf的抗过平滑能力，且可通过GyroSheaf的局部切空间线性化推广到非线性设置。该判据得到实验验证，可为后续SNN设计提供理论指导。

Abstract: To combat oversmoothing in Graph Convolutional Networks, Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) were proposed as a generalization by equipping the graph with a sheaf structure and replacing the graph Laplacian with a sheaf Laplacian $\mathcal{L}$. Existing analyses connect sheaf diffusion to oversmoothing via the harmonic space ($\ker\mathcal{L}$), taking its absolute dimension as an indicator of anti-oversmoothing capacity. However, absolute dimension alone is not a reliable measure: certain sheaf configurations inflate $\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$ while their harmonic sections remain entirely constant, without enriching discriminative capacity. We instead introduce the first relative, geometric approach, yielding a precise characterisation of anti-oversmoothing capacity. Under natural conditions on stalk transportation and global sheaf structure, we establish an index-theoretic comparison criterion showing that one sheaf's harmonic space genuinely contains another's beyond trivial inflation. We illustrate this with a concrete instance and further introduce \textit{GyroSheaf}, a sheaf with curved gyrovector-space stalks, extending the criterion to the non-linear setting via local tangent-space linearization. Experiments across ten models confirm the theoretical criterion: sheaf models violating the criterion collapse despite possessing index jumps, while compliant models maintain depth-stable representations.

</details>


### [377] [Understanding and Stabilizing Deep Q-Learning via Controlled Bootstrapping and Regulated Value Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16182)
*Bozhou Chen,Yongyi Wang,Hanyu Liu,Xionghui Yang,Wenxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对深度Q-learning训练不稳定性进行了系统性分析，从算子级贝尔曼自举偏差、估计器级贪婪动作选择对回归噪声的敏感性、以及参数动态学失衡三个互补视角出发，识别出奖励触发的自我强化陷阱和特征性参数尖峰动态，并提出受控自举、集成分位数估计和基于尖峰的参数调节三种稳定化原则，在Atari-100K和Procgen上验证了竞争性性能和更好的训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度Q-learning虽在强化学习中取得了显著经验成功，但其训练过程极不稳定。现有研究往往将不稳定性归因于孤立因素（如过估计偏差或表征学习问题），缺乏对不同不稳定来源在递归值估计中如何相互作用的统一理解。

Method: 从三个互补视角系统分析深度Q-learning的不稳定性：(1)算子层面：贝尔曼自举中的偏差；(2)估计器层面：贪婪动作选择对回归噪声的敏感性；(3)参数动态层面：激进数据复用下的参数失衡。由此推导出受控自举、集成分位数估计、以及基于尖峰的参数调节三种稳定化原则。

Result: 在Atari-100K和Procgen基准上验证了提出方法的竞争性性能，并显著改善了训练稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过统一的三角色分析框架，识别了奖励触发的自我强化陷阱和参数尖峰动态等关键不稳定机制，并提供了可操作的稳定化原则，为深度Q-learning的稳定性问题提供了系统性解法。

Abstract: Deep Q-learning (DQL) has achieved remarkable empirical success in reinforcement learning, yet its training process remains notoriously unstable. Existing studies often attribute instability to isolated factors such as overestimation bias or representation learning issues, lacking a unified understanding of how different sources of instability interact during recursive value estimation. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of instability in deep Q-learning from three complementary perspectives: operator-level bias in Bellman bootstrapping, estimator-level sensitivity of greedy action selection to regression noise, and parameter-dynamics imbalance under aggressive data reuse. We identify a reward-triggered self-reinforcing trap and characteristic parameter spike dynamics, then derive stabilization principles for controlled bootstrapping, ensemble quantile estimation, and spike-based parameter regulation. Experiments on Atari-100K and Procgen demonstrate competitive performance and improved training stability.

</details>


### [378] [Multi-Granularity Sentiment Integration for LLM-Based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16201)
*Shanshan Lin,Yuesheng Wu,Chao Chen,Yizhe Yang,Zhihao Chen,Zexian Yang,Xiangwen Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MGSI框架，通过多粒度时间尺度编码音频和视觉信号、文本引导对齐和极性与强度增强，将多模态表示压缩为伪token以高效微调冻结的LLM，在多模态情感分析任务上显著优于冻结LLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多模态情感分析方法在融合音视频信号时存在不足：音视频情感线索在不同时间尺度上演化，但现有方法通过浅层投影或粗粒度池化压缩信号，削弱了跨模态对齐并丢失细粒度情感信息。同时，模糊和近中性样本的处理也是一个挑战。

Method: MGSI框架包含三个核心模块：(1) 多粒度编码：在短、中、长三个时间尺度上编码音频和视觉流，保留局部变化和全局情感趋势；(2) 文本引导对齐与增强：通过文本引导细化非文本特征，并应用极性和强度感知增强来处理模糊和近中性样本；(3) 伪token压缩：将多模态表示压缩为少量伪token，用于高效地条件化冻结的LLM。

Result: 在四个公开基准数据集上，MGSI显著优于冻结LLM基线，并与强多模态方法相比具有竞争力的性能。消融实验和敏感性分析验证了多粒度时间建模、文本引导细化和自适应情感校准的有效性。

Conclusion: MGSI通过多粒度时间建模和文本引导的情感增强，有效解决了LLM-based MSA中音视频信号融合不充分的问题，为多模态情感分析提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict sentiment polarity and intensity from heterogeneous inputs such as text, audio, and vision. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic priors for MSA, effectively incorporating audio and visual signals effectively remains challenging. A key challenge is that audio and visual sentiment cues evolve over different temporal scales, yet many LLM-based methods compress these signals through shallow projection or coarse pooling before fusing them with text, which can weaken cross-modal alignment and erase fine-grained affective information. We propose MGSI, a multi-granularity sentiment integration framework for LLM-based MSA. MGSI first encodes audio and visual streams at short-, medium-, and long-range temporal scales, preserving both local variations and global affective trends. It then refines non-text features through text-guided alignment, and applies polarity- and intensity-aware enhancement to better handle ambiguous and near-neutral samples. The resulting multimodal representation is finally compressed into a small set of pseudo-tokens for efficient conditioning of a frozen LLM. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that MGSI substantially outperforms frozen-LLM baselines and remains competitive with strong multimodal methods. Further ablation and sensitivity analyses support the effectiveness of multi-granularity temporal modeling, text-guided refinement, and adaptive sentiment calibration.

</details>


### [379] [Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16210)
*Zhi Zhang,Lingfeng Lyu,Yue Kang,Doudou Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LACE（局部增广控制变量评估），一种用于条件大语言模型评估的半监督估计器。通过"局部居中"技术，在目标画像区域减去廉价信号的条件均值后，任何线性增广的零条件均值不会改变估计目标，增广系数仅用于提升效率。局部岭控制变量将标注子集的黄金标签残差均值与全量条目池的廉价信号均值相结合，实现无校准偏差识别、分组画像是无偏的、局部最优性和一阶自适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合准确率掩盖了模型在不同子群体上的成败差异。从黄金标签估计条件性能画像成本高昂，而LLM裁判分数、成对比较、置信度分数等廉价辅助信号可以低成本采集但通常有偏或校准不良，因此需要一种能利用廉价信号提升条件评估效率同时保持无偏性的估计方法。

Method: LACE的核心创新是"局部居中"：先在目标画像区域内减去廉价信号的条件均值，使任何线性增广的条件均值为零，从而不改变估计目标。然后使用局部岭控制变量，将标注子集的黄金标签残差均值与全量条目池的廉价信号均值结合。增益公式由总体局部R²决定，该量刻画廉价信号在不同画像值上可达到的效率。还推导了直接配对模型差距和部署加权分数的对应估计器。

Result: 在MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K和ARC八个基准上对主要性能画像估计器进行了实证评估。

Conclusion: LACE通过局部居中实现了廉价信号的无偏增广利用，从理论上证明了无校准偏差识别、分组画像无偏性、局部最优性及一阶自适应性，为条件LLM评估提供了一种高效且可靠的半监督估计框架。

Abstract: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering: after subtracting the conditional mean of a cheap signal within the target profile region, any linear augmentation has zero conditional mean and therefore cannot change the estimand. The augmentation coefficient is used only for efficiency, and a local ridge control variate combines a gold-label residual mean from the labeled subset with a cheap-signal mean from the full item pool. We prove calibration-free identification, unbiasedness for grouped profiles, local oracle optimality within centered linear augmentations, and first-order adaptivity to the estimated coefficient. The resulting gain formula is governed by a population local $R^2$, which characterizes how the efficiency attainable from the cheap signals varies across profile values. We also derive corresponding estimators for direct paired model gaps and deployment-weighted scores. We empirically evaluate the primary performance-profile estimator on MATH-500, ScienceQA, MMLU, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, and ARC.

</details>


### [380] [Quantifying the Gap Between Laboratory Battery Test Patterns and Field Duty Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16212)
*Chunyang Zhao,Chresten Træholt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过对比六种证据来源（受控循环、驾驶循环测试、动态循环、NMC811实验室老化、真实电动汽车充电轨迹和车队级SOH数据），量化了实验室电池测试与实际现场工况之间的差距，并提出了基于Duty-Structure Index（DSI）和C-rate等指标的量化框架，证明电池性能指标高度依赖于其生成时的工况模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验室电池测试是电池性能和退化研究的主要实证依据，但其运行模式不能直接代表真实现场工况特征。现有研究缺乏对实验室与现场工况差异的系统量化，导致实验室结论在应用层面可能产生误导。

Method: 对比六种证据来源（受控循环、驾驶循环测试、动态循环、NMC811实验室老化、真实EV充电轨迹、车队级SOH数据），综合使用使用频率、使用强度、使用C-rate和基于标准化电流离散度与爬坡率的Duty-Structure Index（DSI）进行多维度分析。

Result: 现场源轨迹的单段DSI为0.630，NASA为0.699；而Oxford为2.936，Imperial为2.855。使用C-rate方面，Imperial/NASA/Stanford/Hyundai为0.14-0.40，Oxford高达2.00。长期老化差异显著：80%容量保持率分别出现在NASA约351次循环、Oxford 6292个检查点、Stanford约1019次循环。化学对齐的NMC/NCM证据中，Imperial在标准循环下保持0.813、驾驶循环老化下为0.865，现场源中位SOH为0.889且存在明显离散。现场运营还显示中位使用强度137.2 km/day，56.9%的充电结束于≥95% SOC。

Conclusion: 电池性能指标具有工况条件依赖性，应用导向研究应在报告中同时明确工况特征描述符以及化学体系、容量和老化指标，以确保研究结论的可迁移性和实际应用价值。

Abstract: Laboratory battery tests provide the main empirical basis for battery performance and degradation studies, but their operating patterns do not directly represent field duty profiles. This paper quantifies the gap by comparing six accessible evidence sources covering controlled cycling, drive-cycle testing, dynamic cycling, NMC811 laboratory ageing, a real electric-vehicle charging trace, and fleet-scale electric-vehicle state-of-health (SOH) data. The analysis combines usage frequency, usage intensity, usage C-rate, and a duty-structure index (DSI) based on normalized current dispersion and ramping. The representative single-segment DSI ranges from 0.630 for the field source trace and 0.699 for NASA to 2.936 for Oxford and 2.855 for Imperial, while usage C-rate ranges from 0.14-0.40 for Imperial, NASA, Stanford, and Hyundai to 2.00 for Oxford. Long-term ageing also differs: the 80 percent retention region occurs near 351 NASA cycles, 6292 Oxford checkpoints, and 1019 Stanford cycles. In chemistry-aligned NMC/NCM evidence, Imperial retains 0.813 under standard cycling and 0.865 under drive-cycle ageing, while the field source has median SOH 0.889 with visible dispersion. Field operation further shows a median use intensity of 137.2 km/day and 56.9 percent of charges ending at or above 95 percent SOC. These results show that battery performance metrics are conditional on the duty pattern that generated them; application-oriented studies should report explicit duty-profile descriptors together with chemistry, capacity, and ageing metrics.

</details>


### [381] [Beyond Peak Backlog: Conditional Energy and Temporal Geometry in Capacity-Constrained Delayed Bandit Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16216)
*Anling Xiang,Yuwen Yang,Yang Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究仅能追踪C个待反馈项的在线凸优化问题，提出调度器侧条件能量接口，将延迟复杂度从O(√(T·σ_max))改进到O(√(E_C·d_tot))，并给出强凸情形下延迟时序影响下界的完整刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单点bandit凸优化中，当学习者只能追踪C个待反馈项且丢弃的反馈永久丢失时，已有的延迟复杂度为O(√(T·σ_max))（依赖峰值积压），而无限追踪能力可获得更优的√(d_tot)依赖（总延迟）。作者希望在不完全追踪能力下弥合这一差距，并探究强凸情形下延迟时序（而非仅聚合量）对regret的影响。

Method: 引入调度器侧的条件能量接口（conditional-energy interface），它分离速率自适应与单点扰动过滤，并处理随机准入产生的依赖重要性权重。在同样的半明见oracle和路径级硬容量契约下进行设计。对强凸情形，推导时间代价H_A(d)=Σ_t σ_t/(A+t)；并通过构造延迟向量对（具有相同多重集、总延迟、峰值积压和容量）证明时序差异导致多项式级regret差异。最后构造连续困难族将追踪容量转化为零阶查询预算，获得容量匮乏下界端点。

Result: 获得免调参学习器，延迟项为O(√(E_C·d_tot))，仅含显式重启因子E_C；在公共常数因子峰值界下可去除该因子而d_tot仍未知。强凸下给出时间代价H_A(d)的刻画，证明延迟时序在曲率存在时确实影响最小最大regret（即使聚合延迟摘要一致）。给出容量匮乏的下界端点。上界需C≥ln T+1，未构成完整的容量最小最大刻画。

Conclusion: 通过条件能量接口弥合了有限追踪能力下延迟复杂度从√(Tσ_max)到√(E_C·d_tot)的差距，揭示了强凸情形下延迟时序（而非仅聚合量）对regret的关键影响，并为容量匮乏情形提供下界补充，但完整的容量最小最大刻画仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: What is the right delay complexity when a learner can track only $C$ pending feedback items and discarded feedback is permanently lost? Existing one-point bandit convex optimization guarantees in this model pay $\sqrt{Tσ_{\max}}$, where $σ_{\max}$ is the peak backlog, although unlimited tracking admits the sharper $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence on total delay. We introduce a scheduler-side conditional-energy interface that separates rate adaptation from the one-point perturbation filtration and handles the dependent importance weights created by randomized admission. Under the same semi-clairvoyant oracle and pathwise hard-capacity contract, this yields an untuned learner whose delay term scales as $O(\sqrt{E_C d_{\mathrm{tot}}})$, with only an explicit restart factor $E_C$; a public constant-factor peak bound removes this factor while $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ remains unknown. Under strong convexity, the same interface yields the temporal cost $H_A(d)=\sum_t σ_t/(A+t)$. Two delay vectors with identical delay multisets, $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$, $σ_{\max}$, and capacity can nevertheless have polynomially different minimax regret, showing that timing matters under curvature even when aggregate delay summaries agree. Finally, a continuous hard family converts tracking capacity into a zeroth-order query budget and gives a complementary capacity-starvation lower endpoint. The upper bounds require $C\ge \ln T+1$ and do not constitute a complete capacity minimax characterization.

</details>


### [382] [A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16236)
*Maximilian Andreas Hoefler,Karsten Mueller,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了协作推理（CI）中激活稀疏化对隐私的影响，发现稀疏化降低隐私泄露的程度远小于其降低通信成本的程度，且剩余隐私风险主要转移到激活值的位置信息上。位置信息本身即使在被截断和低效用的情况下仍可导致高保真重构和人脸重识别，因此应将位置视为敏感传输数据加以审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作推理在边缘设备和服务器之间分割模型，客户端需传输中间激活值，面临通信成本和隐私泄露双重问题。虽然稀疏化通过减少传输值来降低成本，并被直觉认为能改善隐私（传输更少的值意味着泄露更少），但这一隐私论点缺乏严格的实证检验。作者旨在验证稀疏化是否真的如其直观假设那样保护隐私，并揭示之前被忽略的位置信息泄露风险。

Method: 将稀疏激活分解为保留值和位置集合两个独立组件，分别从每个组件单独重建输入。在自然图像和人脸数据集上，分别评估保留值重构和位置重构的保真度以及人脸重识别能力，并与对应传输成本进行对比分析。

Result: 稀疏化降低隐私泄露的程度远小于其降低通信成本的程度。位置信息本身构成严重隐私风险，可独立实现高保真度重建和个体重识别；该泄露在传输成本和任务效用均较低的情况下依然存在。

Conclusion: 稀疏激活的位置信息应被视为敏感传输数据，需要在协作推理的背景下进行严格审计。此前将该位置视为解码附属信息（side information）的处理方式低估了隐私风险。

Abstract: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test this claim by decomposing the sparse activation into the retained values and the set of positions they occupy, and by reconstructing inputs from each component in isolation. We find that sparsification reduces the leakage far less than it reduces the transmission cost, and that the remaining risk shifts to the positions, which prior analyses treat as side information for decoding. Across natural-image and face datasets, the positions alone constitute a serious privacy risk, enabling high-fidelity reconstructions and re-identification of individuals. The leakage from the positions persists even when both the transmission cost and the task utility are low. We conclude that the positions of sparse activations should be treated as sensitive transmitted data and audited carefully in the context of collaborative inference. Code is available at https://github.com/an7123/Privacy-Study-Sparse-CI.

</details>


### [383] [Optimizing Multi-Market Participation of Battery and Electrolyser Systems Based on Field Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16238)
*Chunyang Zhao,Stoyan Trenchev,Shi You,Chresten Træholt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实验测量和建模，研究了55 kW/79 kWh电池储能系统（BESS）和三台2.4 kW单元的电解槽（PTX）的真实硬件特性（爬坡限制、效率、设定值跟踪精度），并将其嵌入价格驱动的优化框架中，基于2022-2025年丹麦真实市场数据评估多市场参与的经济效益。结果显示BESS和电解槽的日优化利润分别为1,749.27 DKK和289.46 DKK，证明纳入实验性能特征对多市场参与评估的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可再生能源占比提升，电力系统需要快速响应和灵活的调节资源配置。虽然电力市场和辅助服务产品的扩展为叠加多种收入创造了机会，但大多数研究忽略了真实硬件行为（如爬坡限制、效率、设定值跟踪精度），导致对灵活资源实际经济潜力的评估不准确。

Method: 首先对55 kW/79 kWh BESS和三台2.4 kW电解槽单元进行实验测量，识别关键硬件特性参数；将这些特性嵌入价格驱动的优化框架中；利用2022至2025年丹麦电力市场和辅助服务市场的实际市场数据进行多市场参与优化。

Result: BESS多市场参与优化日利润为1,749.27 DKK，电解槽为289.46 DKK，验证了两种灵活资源在丹麦电力及辅助服务市场多市场参与中的业务可行性。

Conclusion: 研究强调了在评估跨多市场和多年份参与时纳入实验性能数据的重要性，为BESS和PTX系统的商业案例提供了有力支撑。

Abstract: The increasing share of renewable energy in power systems creates a need for fast-response and flexible resources to maintain system stability. With the expansion of electricity markets and ancillary service products, opportunities arise to stack revenues across multiple services. Long-term Power-to-X (PTX) electrolysers and short-term battery energy storage systems (BESS) are prevalent flexible resources, yet most studies neglect real hardware behavior, such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy. This work presents experimental and modeling results for a 55 kW/79 kWh BESS and an electrolyser comprising three 2.4 kW units. Key characteristics are identified through measurements and embedded into a price-driven optimization framework for participation in the Danish electricity and ancillary service markets, utilizing real market data from 2022 to 2025. The optimized daily profits for multi-market participation are 1,749.27 DKK and 289.46 DKK for the BESS and electrolyser, respectively. With the demonstrated business cases for BESS and PTX systems, this work highlights the importance of incorporating experimental performance when evaluating participation across multiple markets and years.

</details>


### [384] [The Trade-off Between Covariate Dependence and Latent Structure in Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16245)
*Małgorzata Łazęcka,Ewa Szczurek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的监督式解耦表示学习框架，耦合潜在维度-协变量依赖与潜在结构约束。作者证明在该框架下存在固有权衡：强制潜在独立性或一对一潜在-协变量排他映射会牺牲潜在-协变量对齐。每个解耦体制对应一个闭式潜在空间变换，可应用于预训练模型（CLIP、DINOv2、ViT）的后处理对齐，以及嵌入到信息因子分析（iFA）中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督解耦方法仅追求潜在维度独立性，但无法保证维度与有意义的语义协变量对齐；监督方法利用观测协变量结构化潜在空间，但在协变量相关的情况下无法同时实现一对一的潜在-协变量对齐和潜在独立性。需要一种统一框架来理解并调和解耦学习中的上述矛盾。

Method: 提出统一监督式解耦框架，将潜在维度-协变量依赖性与潜在结构约束耦合。在该框架下证明存在固有权衡，并证明各解耦体制按潜在-协变量对齐强度排序，每种体制均存在闭式潜在空间变换。将这些变换以事后（post-hoc）方式应用于预训练模型（CLIP、DINOv2、ViT）表示，并整合进具有协变量知情因子（covariate-informed factors）的概率模型iFA中。

Result: 在模拟数据和真实多组学数据上，事后对齐和iFA均实现了结构化潜在表示的可控性，表明所提出的变换框架有效。

Conclusion: 解耦表示学习存在固有对齐-独立性权衡；通过闭式变换可以在不同解耦体制间转换，从而在不重新训练的情况下对预训练模型表示进行后处理对齐，也能在概率模型中实现可控的结构化潜在表示。

Abstract: Disentangled representation learning seeks latent representations whose indicidual dimensions each align with a distinct covariate. Unsupervised approaches typically target latent dimension independence, yet this gives no guarantee that the resulting dimensions align with semantically meaningful covariates. Supervised approaches structure the latent space using observed covariates, but under correlated covariates they cannot simultaneously control one-to-one latent-covariate alignment and latent independence. We introduce a unified, supervised framework that couples latent dimension-covariate dependence with constraints on the latent structure. Within this framework, we show an inherent trade-off, where enforcing latent independence or exclusive one-to-one latent-covariate dependence comes at a provable cost in latent-covariate alignment. We prove that the resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by the strength of that alignment. Each regime admits a closed-form transformation of the latent space. We apply these transformations post-hoc to realign the representations of pretrained models such as CLIP, DINOv2, and ViT, and we fold them into the inference of informed factor analysis (iFA), a probabilistic model with covariate-informed factors. On simulated and real multi-omics data, we show that both post-hoc alignment and iFA enable controllability of structured latent representations.

</details>


### [385] [SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16249)
*Jaewan Choi,Junyoung Yang,Sangdon Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAUL（Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning）将大语言模型机器遗忘形式化为带显式满足准则约束的最小化问题，通过增广拉格朗日控制器自适应调节遗忘侧压力，并结合锐度感知更新与双优化器设计来平衡遗忘效果与通用性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的机器遗忘面临关键权衡：既要擦除目标知识，又要保持模型的通用能力。现有方法通常通过优化目标隐式地设定遗忘程度，缺乏对"恰当地遗忘"这一准则的显式控制，导致遗忘过度或不足。

Method: SAUL将遗忘建模为带预设满足准则的显式约束，采用增广拉格朗日控制器根据约束违反程度自适应调节遗忘侧压力，并在准则持续满足时自动停用遗忘更新；同时在保留与遗忘两个目标上施加锐度感知更新，配合保持角色分离状态的双优化器设计来稳定遗忘动力学。

Result: 在TOFU、WMDP和MUSE三个基准上，SAUL相比代表性的基于锐度与扰动的基线方法展现了更优的遗忘-效用权衡；此外，在TOFU上将增广拉格朗日控制器作为即插即用修改器应用于基线方法，可提升其遗忘后的模型效用。

Conclusion: 显式的遗忘约束控制（而非隐式目标设定）对于实现"遗忘足够但不过度"具有实际价值，增广拉格朗日控制器可作为通用模块嵌入现有遗忘方法以改善遗忘-效用权衡。

Abstract: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically specify the desired level of forgetting implicitly through optimization objectives. An augmented Lagrangian controller adaptively adjusts forget-side pressure according to constraint violation and can eventually deactivate the forget-side update as the prescribed criterion remains satisfied. Sharpness-aware updates on both retain and forget objectives, together with a dual-optimizer design that maintains role-separated states, further stabilize the resulting unlearning dynamics. We evaluate SAUL on the TOFU, WMDP, and MUSE benchmarks, demonstrating favorable forgetting-utility trade-offs over representative sharpness- and perturbation-based baselines under benchmark-specific forgetting criteria. Beyond the complete SAUL framework, we further show on TOFU that applying the augmented-Lagrangian controller as a drop-in modifier to representative baselines improves their post-forgetting utility, demonstrating the practical value of explicit forgetting control.

</details>


### [386] [Efficient Coreset Selection via K-Nearest Neighbor Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16270)
*Yingfan Liu,Leiyu Zhang,Jiadong Xie,Mingzhe Wang,Jeffrey Xu Yu,Jiangtao Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KNNG-CS，一种基于K近邻图的轻量级核心集选择方法，利用局部邻域结构估计数据项重要性并贪心选择代表性节点，仅需线性存储，在四个真实数据集上将选择时间降低2.3-41.2倍，峰值内存降低至基线方法的0.3%-7.5%，同时保持与现有梯度逼近方法相当的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有梯度逼近核心集选择方法（如CRAIG及其聚类变体）虽能保持模型精度，但其选择阶段依赖稠密的成对距离矩阵或大规模项-簇绑定矩阵，在大数据集上导致高昂的时间与内存开销。

Method: KNNG-CS基于K近邻图：通过局部邻域结构估计每个数据项的重要性，并采用贪心策略选择代表性节点，避免维护二次距离矩阵，仅需与边数成比例的线性存储。

Result: 在四个真实数据集上，KNNG-CS达到与代表性梯度逼近核心集方法相当的精度，同时将选择时间降低2.3倍至41.2倍，峰值内存降至基线方法的0.3%至7.5%。

Conclusion: KNNG-CS证明了利用局部邻域图结构可以在大幅降低核心集选择的时间和内存开销的同时保持模型精度，为大规模数据集上的核心集选择提供了高效的轻量级解决方案。

Abstract: Coreset selection reduces the cost of model training by replacing a large training set with a small representative subset. Existing gradient-approximation coreset methods such as CRAIG and cluster-based variants can preserve model accuracy. Still, their selection stages often rely on dense pairwise distances or large item-cluster bound matrices, leading to high time and memory costs on large datasets. This paper proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on a $K$-nearest neighbor graph. KNNG-CS exploits local neighborhood structures to estimate the importance of each data item and greedily selects representative nodes without maintaining a quadratic distance matrix. The method requires only linear storage in the number of edges. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that KNNG-CS achieves accuracy comparable to representative gradient-approximation coreset methods, while reducing selection time by $2.3\times$-$41.2\times$ and peak memory to $0.3\%$-$7.5\%$ of the baselines.

</details>


### [387] [Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16273)
*Simon Ellershaw,Christopher Tomlinson,Zeljko Kraljevic,Spiros Denaxas,Harry Hemingway,Cathie Sudlow,Angela M. Wood,Anoop D. Shah,Richard Dobson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Foresight-E是首个国家级规模的电孑健康记录（EHR）生成式基础模型，专门用于COVID-19研究，在NHS England安全数据环境中从零训练，参数量为2.43亿，覆盖约6100万个体的纵向EHR数据。该模型以自回归方式预测患者时间线中的下一个医疗事件，在推理时零样本工作。由于NHS England暂停了数据访问，量化结果暂不可得，本文作为方法论模板和案例研究发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建首个国家级规模的EHR生成式基础模型，用于建模COVID-19疫情的直接和间接影响，并探索在真实世界人口规模数据上训练生成式医疗模型的可行性与挑战。

Method: Foresight-E是一个2.43亿参数的Transformer解码器，在NHS England安全数据环境内从头训练。数据来自约6100万个体（90%训练+验证，10%留出），涵盖初级/次级诊疗、死亡登记和COVID-19数据，时间跨度为2018年11月至2022年12月。模型自回归地建模患者时间线，预测下一个医疗事件。分词方案保留ICD-10、OPCS-4和SNOMED CT的临床粒度，联合表示绝对与相对时间。设计了30天COVID-19住院和死亡率的评估框架（含亚组分析），并对2023年（训练期外）的数据评估泛化能力，基准为逻辑回归和XGBoost。

Result: 由于NHS England暂停了Foresight-E项目的数据访问，量化结果目前无法获取。论文改为分享分词、架构、训练、推理和评估的策略，作为方法论模板和国家规模EHR基础模型构建挑战的案例研究。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了在国家规模、安全的数据环境中训练EHR生成式基础模型的技术可行性，但同时也揭示了在受监管的真实医疗数据环境中开展此类研究面临的重大数据和治理挑战。其方法论贡献可作为后续国家级EHR基础模型研究的参考模板。

Abstract: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.

</details>


### [388] [SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16287)
*Jiaming Hu,Yan Zheng,Tian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCALE方法，通过将端到端学习的LeWorldModel（LeWM）潜空间中的成对距离与标准化的任务相关状态空间距离对齐，赋予其类似DINO-WM的有利几何特性（即主成分保留更多状态信息），从而在不替换学习编码器、仅增加一个轻量训练时正则化的情况下，显著提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合嵌入预测世界模型在潜空间中评分目标嵌入与预测终端嵌入间的距离来规划。两种主流防塌缩策略（预训练特征空间如DINO-WM，与端到端反塌缩正则化如LeWM+SIGReg）在不同任务上各有优劣。尽管两种模型的完整嵌入中都可解码任务相关状态，但DINO-WM的前导主成分保留了显著更多的状态信息；由于欧几里得规划代价由高方差方向主导，这一差异影响状态对候选选择的驱动程度。因此，作者希望将端到端LeWM表示改造为具备DINO-WM的这一有利几何性质。

Method: SCALE（State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings）通过在训练时增加一个轻量正则化项，将采样的成对潜空间距离与标准化的任务相关状态空间距离相关联，从而诱导端到端LeWM表示获得DINO-WM的几何特性（状态信息集中在高方差主成分中），而不替换LeWM已学习的编码器。

Result: 在五个任务、三种规划求解器、五种计算预算下，SCALE在每个任务-求解器平均指标上均优于LeWM。对照实验（潜空间到状态的回归控制）显示，即使可解码性与SCALE相当甚至更优，其潜空间-状态距离对齐几乎不变且规划提升一致性较差，说明仅信息可解码性不足以保证规划增益。SCALE仅增加一个轻量训练时正则化器，无规划时额外开销。

Conclusion: 规划性能不仅取决于潜表示中是否存在任务相关信息，还取决于这些信息如何塑造规划器所消费的几何结构。SCALE证明了通过校准潜空间几何（使状态信息对齐高方差方向）可以显著提升端到端世界模型规划器的性能，且代价极小。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.

</details>


### [389] [Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16319)
*Adrian Hayler,Klemens Flöge,Alan Arazi,Rishabh Ranjan,Jure Leskovec,Felix Birkel,Brendan Roof,Anurag Garg,Kristina Collins,Lydia Sidhoum,Jonas Kübler,Siyuan Guo,Oscar Key,Jan Hendrik Metzen,Rylee Grace,David Salinas,Arthur Cahu,Simon Bing,Benjamin Jäger,Tuana Çelik,Mihir Manium,Vitor Monteiro,Jake Robertson,Jerry Chen,Eliott Kalfon,Tomás Pereda,Lilly Wehrhahn,Dominik Safaric,Tobias Schroeder,Georg Grab,Diana Kriuchkova,Clara Cornu,Philipp Singer,Nick Erickson,Vahid Balazadeh,Marie Salmon,Simone Alessi,Kürşat Kaya,Philipp Jund,Léo Grinsztajn,Yann LeCun,Bernhard Schölkopf,Madelon Hulsebos,Lennart Purucker,Sauraj Gambhir,Frank Hutter,Noah Hollmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prior Labs在关系学习中发布了三款开源软件：RelArena-α（统一的基准测试框架，标准化RelBench v1上的数据加载、评估协议和调优机制）、TabPFN-Rel（专为TabPFN-3设计的关系学习框架，目前在RelArena-α上排名第一，并验证了将关系数据库展平为单表的方法仍具竞争力）、以及RPI（Relational Predictive Interface，一个模型无关的开源接口，便于研究者和从业者在新数据库上定义问题并应用任意模型）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系学习领域涌现了大量数据集和任务，但社区尚未形成可靠、可复现的方法比较机制。此外，关系学习方法在研究和工业界的实际采用面临障碍。Prior Labs希望通过开源工具推动该领域走向有意义的现实世界影响，并促进社区协作发展。

Method: 论文提出了三个开源组件：(1) RelArena-α，参考TabArena等表驱动基准，统一标准化RelBench v1上的数据加载、评估协议、调优机制及自定义调优系统支持；(2) TabPFN-Rel，基于TabPFN-3构建的关系学习框架，对RDBLearn做了关键改进；(3) RPI，一个模型无关、开源的Relational Predictive Interface，帮助用户在任意新数据库上定义预测问题并部署模型。

Result: TabPFN-Rel目前在RelArena-α上排名第一，不仅是表现最好的模型，还作为一个强基线，提供了更多证据表明将关系数据库展平为单个表格在处理现实世界任务时仍然能够与专门的关系学习架构相抗衡。

Conclusion: Prior Labs计划基于社区的反馈进一步开发这些工具，将RelArena-α逐步发展为关系学习社区进步的核心催化剂，并通过RPI降低关系学习方法的采用门槛，推动其在研究和工业中的实际应用。

Abstract: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $α$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $α$-release, RelArena-$α$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. We plan to work with the research community to further develop RelArena-$α$ into a catalyst for progress in the relational learning community. We release the initial version of TabPFN-Rel, a purpose-built relational harness for TabPFN-3. Currently ranked first among models on RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel makes key improvements upon RDBLearn. Beyond its ranking, TabPFN-Rel serves as a strong baseline, adding to the growing evidence that flattening a relational database into a single table remains competitive with specialized relational architectures on real-world tasks.
  To facilitate adoption of relational learning methods in research and industry, we release an initial $α$-version of our Relational Predictive Interface, RPI, an open-source, model-agnostic interface that enables early adopters to easily define problems on new databases and apply any model implemented in RelArena-$α$, including TabPFN-Rel, to these problems.

</details>


### [390] [Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16334)
*Nuwan Kaluarachchi,Sevvandi Kandanaarachchi,Kristen Moore,Arathi Arakala,Conrad Sanderson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备用户认证系统，将在一台设备（如手机）上学到的击键动力学特征迁移到另一台设备（如平板），并利用扩展的击键特征集增强判别能力。在BBMAS数据集上实现了14.2%的等错误率，超越了现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 击键动力学作为行为生物特征在单一设备认证中表现良好，但跨设备场景下由于设备形态差异（如手机vs平板）导致打字模式发生变化，产生分布漂移，使得在一台设备上学到的动力学特征无法直接应用于另一台设备的认证。

Method: 提出基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备认证框架：首先将源设备（手机）上的击键动力学特征迁移适配到目标设备（平板）；将迁移后的数据与目标设备上有限的训练数据结合，用于稳健地训练二分类器；同时采用扩展的击键特征集以更好地捕获判别性动力学特征。

Result: 在BBMAS数据集上的跨设备场景实验中，所提出系统达到14.2%的等错误率（EER），超越现有的最先进方法。

Conclusion: 归纳迁移学习能有效解决跨设备击键动力学的分布漂移问题，结合扩展特征集和有限目标设备数据，可实现优于现有方法的跨设备用户认证性能。

Abstract: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. Furthermore, an extended set of keystroke features is used to better capture discriminative dynamics. Experiments on the BBMAS dataset show that proposed system achieves an equal error rate of 14.2% for the cross-device scenario, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [391] [Task-Anchored Representation Shaping for Pre-Trained Model-Based Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16345)
*Zhiming Xu,Huiyu Yi,Zhen-Hao Xie,Baile Xu,Furao Shen,Jian Zhao,Suorong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TAILS是一个轻量级的后PTM模块，通过固定任务锚点将样本特征解释为与已积累知识相关的潜在回忆，并在表示层面修正特征以解决跨任务预测歧义，可集成到多种持续学习器中，以较低的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本提升分类和任务推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练模型为持续学习提供了稳定的表示基础，但仅适配新任务并不能保证对所有已学任务的可靠推理。由于任务边界往往是人为的且语义上相互纠缠，即使拥有强大的PTM特征，来自未知任务的输入仍然存在歧义，因此跨任务预测成为关键瓶颈。

Method: TAILS提出了基于任务锚点的潜在塑造方法：使用固定的任务锚点作为已积累知识的持久参考，将每个样本的特征表示相对于这些参考进行解释，并在任务间组合相关证据形成潜在回忆。不同于选择任务特定路径或调整分类器输出，TAILS在预测前直接用潜在回忆修正特征表示，从而在表示层面解决跨任务歧义，同时保持原始PTM、方法特定模块和分类器不变。该模块通过解耦步骤进行优化。

Result: 在多种基于PTM的持续学习范式上的大量实验表明，TAILS能以适度的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本提升分类性能和任务推理性能。

Conclusion: TAILS有效解决了PTM持续学习中的跨任务预测瓶颈，通过表示层面的潜在修正而非分类器调整来消除跨任务歧义，是一种轻量、通用且高效的即插即用模块。

Abstract: Pre-trained models (PTMs) provide a strong foundation for continual learning by offering stable representations that facilitate lightweight adaptation to new tasks. However, adapting well to each task does not ensure reliable inference over all learned tasks. Since task boundaries are often artificial and semantically entangled, an input from an unknown task can remain ambiguous even with strong PTM features, making cross-task prediction a key bottleneck. We propose Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS), a lightweight post-PTM module that can be integrated into diverse continual learners and optimized through a decoupled step. TAILS uses fixed task anchors as persistent references to accumulated knowledge. It interprets each sample's feature representation relative to these references, then composes relevant evidence across tasks into latent recall. Rather than selecting a task-specific path or adjusting classifier outputs, TAILS uses latent recall to directly correct the feature representation before prediction. It therefore resolves cross-task ambiguity at the representation level, while leaving the original PTM, method-specific modules, and classifier unchanged. Extensive experiments across multiple PTM-based continual learning paradigms show that TAILS can improve classification and task-inference performance with modest parameter overhead and negligible inference cost.

</details>


### [392] [OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16373)
*Simon Donike,Ruben Cartuyvels,Antonino Ian Ferola,Elisa Carli,Diego Fernandez Prieto,Marie-Helene Rio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍OceanDepths，这是首个开放、全球、重网格化的AI-ready海洋数据集，将卫星观测的海表参数（SST、SSS、SSH）与EN4次表层温盐剖面以及GLORYS12再分析数据配对，覆盖2000-2024年，空间分辨率0.1°×0.1°，时间分辨率每周，包含超过950万个配对剖面并插值到50个标准深度层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海洋占地球表面70%以上，但观测严重不足。理解全球海洋需要联合观测表层和次表层结构，然而目前缺乏将卫星表层场与同位置的原位深度剖面配对的、标准化且高分辨率的AI-ready数据集。现有资源要么是基于模型重建的网格化产品而非观测数据，要么只覆盖单一变量或单一海盆，要么分辨率过低无法支持中尺度动力学研究。

Method: OceanDepths将卫星衍生的海表温度（SST）、海表盐度（SSS）和海表高度（SSH）L4产品与EN4次表层温度和盐度剖面进行配对，并辅以GLORYS12海洋再分析数据。数据集覆盖2000-2024年，空间分辨率0.1°×0.1°，时间分辨率为周，覆盖全球海面，包含超过950万个插值到50个标准深度层的配对剖面。系统采用可配置的方式将全球划分为等大小的空间片（patches）。

Result: 数据集呈现4D多元结构、高分辨率、长时间跨度和次表层观测的极端稀疏性（每个深度层约0.01%），使其成为测试新型AI方法的挑战性基准。作者以简单基线模型演示了次表层状态重建这一示例任务。

Conclusion: OceanDepths有望支持基于观测的预报方法开发及其他相关任务，为海洋科学中的AI应用提供标准化的基础设施。数据集可在Hugging Face上公开获取。

Abstract: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}

</details>


### [393] [Coverage-Maximizing Multinomial Subset Routing under Operational Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16375)
*Quan Zhou,Yiyan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的在线路由框架MSR（Multinomial Subset Routing），学习者维护一个K个专家的多项式路由策略，每轮从中采样M个专家组成路由子集，奖励仅取决于路由子集中表现最佳的专家。通过将在线镜像下降与Blackwell逼近方法相结合，提出OMD-Aproachability算法，在带约束的bandit反馈下实现了O(1/√T)的遗憾界和约束违背界，并在真实众包数据集上进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组合bandit或子集选择方法针对确定性子集进行优化，通常假设奖励是加性的，无法捕捉"路由奖励仅取决于子集中最佳专家"这一自然出现的奖励结构。在跨专业模型路由等实际场景中，需要一种能够处理这种奖励结构、同时满足长期双向运行约束的新框架。

Method: 提出MSR框架：学习者在K个专家上维护多项式路由策略，每轮i.i.d.采样M个专家形成路由子集。在此基础上提出OMD-Aproachability算法，将在线镜像下降（OMD）与Blackwell的逼近方法（Approachability）相结合，在仅观察获胜者奖励的bandit反馈下，同时优化奖励并满足长期双向运行约束。

Result: 理论上证明了OMD-Aproachability在奖励和约束违背两方面均达到O(1/√T)的遗憾界；在真实众包数据集上进行了实证验证，展示了框架在实际应用中的有效性。

Conclusion: MSR框架为路由策略提供了一种新的多项式策略视角，能够处理最佳专家奖励结构和长期双向约束，在理论和实证层面都表现出良好的性能，适用于跨专业模型路由等实际场景。

Abstract: We introduce Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR), a new online routing framework over $K$ experts in which the learner keeps a multinomial routing policy instead of a deterministic subset of experts. At each round, the learner samples $M$ experts i.i.d. from the multinomial policy, and the resulting set of distinct sampled experts forms the routed subset.
  The reward depends only on the best-performing expert(s) in the routed subset. This reward structure arises naturally in routing across specialized models but is not captured by standard combinatorial bandits or subset-selection methods, which optimize deterministic subsets and typically assume additive rewards. We require the selection to satisfy several long-term, two-sided operational constraints under bandit feedback, observing only the winner's reward each round. We propose OMD-Approachability, combining online mirror descent with Blackwell's Approachability, and prove it achieves $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ regret in both reward and constraint violation. We ground the framework in practical application domains and validate it empirically on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.

</details>


### [394] [FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16385)
*Chen-An Tai,Yujia Wu,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FETERS，一个少样本早期时间序列分类（ETSC）框架，通过类内留一法（LOO）在支持集上选择数据集级停止比率，用惩罚式奖励函数管理准确率-及时性权衡，避免训练额外的停止模块；结合Rocket特征与冻结的Chronos表示进行分类。在69个公共数据集（14个领域）上，5-shot设置下取得SOTA性能，HM均值最高，在38个数据集上HM最佳，在44个数据集上超越当前SOTA方法，同时在全样本设置下仍具竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ETSC方法大多假设有充足的标注训练数据，在标注有限的实际应用中不现实。在少监督条件下，学习额外的样本级停止模块和提取有效分类特征都面临挑战，因此需要一种能够在少样本场景下工作的ETSC框架。

Method: 1）通过类内留一法（LOO）在支持集上评估，选择数据集级的停止比率，避免训练额外的停止模块；2）使用基于惩罚的奖励函数来管理准确率-及时性的权衡；3）将Rocket-based特征与冻结的Chronos时间序列表示相结合用于分类。

Result: 在69个公共数据集（覆盖14个领域）上的大量实验表明：5-shot设置下，FETERS取得SOTA性能，最高平均谐波均值（HM），在38个数据集上HM最优，在44个数据集上超越当前SOTA方法；全样本设置下也保持竞争力。

Conclusion: FETERS证明了在少样本设定下无需训练额外停止模块即可有效管理准确率-及时性权衡，在两个设置下均表现优异，验证了其方法的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification. Extensive experiments on 69 public datasets spanning 14 domains show that FETERS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the 5-shot setting, with the highest average harmonic mean (HM) and the best HM on 38 datasets, while outperforming the current SOTA method on 44 datasets. FETERS also remains competitive in the full-shot setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the accuracy-earliness trade-off.

</details>


### [395] [SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16409)
*Zhoumin Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"全塑性"（total plasticity）原则：模型没有任何部分（包括结构本身）会被永久冻结，并据此派生出终身学习系统所需的治理框架。系统实现为可生长的软模型（growable soft model），由一组结构算子（宽度、层次、组合、输入接口、环路、注意力头）构成，每个算子都精确、受预算约束且可审计，其采纳与否完全由留出"现实门控"（reality gate）决定。该治理将参数变化和结构变化统一对待，使终身变化下的稳定性成为生命周期的一种审计属性，并使结构跟随需求以消除固定拓扑对后期能力的隐性上限。系统从零构建，由生产级LLM端到端操作。在被测场景中，新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观测，因此可行的增长治理采用事后（ex-post）形式。方法在标准持续学习基准上评估，经过调控的增长能沿长任务序列保持学习能力，并配有预注册实验程序以全面披露失败案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当今神经系统的标准范式是"训练-部署"两阶段，在此范式中模型被冻结两次：训练结束即冻结，且拓扑结构从一开始就不是自由度。这导致长生命周期模型在非平稳流上无法真正持续学习，稳定性依赖"不动"而非"治理"，能力受限于固定拓扑的隐性容量上限。作者以此相反前提为公理，探讨终身学习者所需的治理机制。

Method: 以"全塑性"为公理推导治理规则，构建一个可生长的软模型：定义结构算子代数（宽度扩展、层次增长、组件组合、输入接口调整、环结构生长、注意力头增减），每个算子均在应用时精确生效、受预算约束且可审计；采纳决策统一由留出的held-out现实门控判定，将参数变化与结构变化置于同一采纳标准之下。系统从零完整实现，其工厂界面由生产级LLM端到端操纵，并扩展到对评估信号本身的治理。通过预注册实验程序在标准持续学习基准上评估机制与价值主张。

Result: 三个结论：其一（由公理构造推出），终身变化下的稳定性成为生命周期的审计属性；其二（由公理构造推出），结构跟随需求消除了固定拓扑在容量下限束缚处的隐性能力上限；其三（实测得出），在被测世界中新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观测，因此可行的增长治理必须采用事后形式。在标准持续学习基准上，受治理的增长能保留沿长任务序列继续学习的能力。预注册实验报告了失败案例，正负结果共同构成贡献。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献不是单一机制的胜利，而是完整的"正+负"实验地图：它论证了全塑性终身学习在原则上可行且治理结构可推导，同时诚实披露了在被测问题上失败的方面。该工作为终身学习提供了一种以治理（而非冻结）保证稳定性、以结构增长跟随需求保证能力延续的新范式，将稳定性问题从"架构设计"转移到"生命周期审计"层面。

Abstract: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. A complete from-scratch system realizes the whole account; its factory surface is operated end-to-end by a production LLM. Two conclusions follow from the axiom by construction: stability under lifelong change becomes an audit property of the lifecycle, and structure that follows demand removes the silent cap a fixed topology places on later capability where the capacity floor binds. A third is measured: in the worlds where this was measured, the marginal value of new capacity was unobservable before adoption, so workable growth governance took its ex-post form. The same governance extends to evaluative signals, and the core method is evaluated on standard continual-learning benchmarks, where governed growth preserves the ability to keep learning along long task sequences. A pre-registered experimental program adjudicates the mechanism and value claims on the tested problems and reports its failures at full prominence; the map -- positive and negative -- is the contribution.

</details>


### [396] [TRACE-CASH: Trial-History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Configuration Exploration in Time-Series CASH](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16410)
*Yu-Han Huang,Yujia Wu,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization (CASH) searches a conditional space in which the selected model determines which hyperparameters are active. In time-series forecasting, temporal choices, chronological validation, and costly evaluations further complicate this search. Controlled comparisons of heterogeneous search methods under a shared time-series CASH (TS-CASH) evaluation protocol remain limited. Within this setting, we study TRACECASH, a task-local hybrid sequential optimizer combining grouped actor-critic candidate generation with fixed rules for model coverage, validation-guided exploitation, and exploration after stalled progress. A model actor proposes an initial forecasting model; three model-conditioned actors generate temporal, architectural, and training actions; and a modelspecific decoder constructs the configuration ultimately evaluated. We compare TRACE-CASH with six alternatives spanning random, Bayesian, evolutionary, multi-objective, and language-model-assisted search across 41 dataset-frequency task variants. TRACE-CASH has the lowest mean rank on both MASE and WQL. Descriptively, it also has the lowest window-averaged test-MASE rank in the predefined full and late windows. These results support the complete TRACECASH procedure as competitive among the evaluated methods.

</details>


### [397] [PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16419)
*Zhenchao Tang,Xiaogang Xu,Tianxu Lv,Jiahui Guan,Jiale Zhou,Haohuai He,Zhi Song,Hanbo Huang,Jiehui Huang,Jiafei Wu,Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PertMind框架，利用细胞扰动图谱作为强化学习环境，通过计算奖励训练大语言模型进行生物推理，仅训练前向扰动-响应预测任务，即可泛化到逆向扰动识别、双重扰动推理、表型筛选优先排序和生物过程解释等多种下游任务，同时保持通用语言能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能够描述生物学机制，但可扩展的后训练仍依赖昂贵、需人工整理的生物推理轨迹数据，缺乏可利用的实验数据作为训练信号的规模化途径。

Method: PertMind结合可信轨迹监督初始化与基因、通路、格式三个层面的强化学习信号，将细胞扰动图谱转化为强化学习环境，其中测量的基因响应作为可计算奖励；仅在前向扰动-响应预测任务上进行训练。

Result: 在未见过的细胞情境中改进响应推断，无需任务特定后训练即可迁移到逆向扰动识别、双重扰动推理、表型筛选优先排序和生物学过程解释等任务；生成的生物学配置文件在基因、细胞和供体表示上支持了多尺度下游任务的竞争性表现。

Conclusion: 结果支持"对实验端点的强化学习可以聚敛预训练模型中已有的可复用生物策略"这一假设；扰动衍生的强化学习为将不断扩大的实验图谱转化为通用生物推理训练环境提供了可扩展路径。

Abstract: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improved response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transferred without task-specific post-training to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generated biological profiles that supported competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.

</details>


### [398] [Localized TabICLv2: Scaling Tabular In-Context Learning through k-NN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16429)
*Beimnet Bekele Guta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Localized TabICLv2方法，通过为每个测试点仅检索k个最近邻训练邻居（基于模型Stage 2行表示空间的相似度），而非使用完整训练上下文，从而降低TabICLv2的注意力计算成本。该方法无需架构改动，通过额外的Stage 2和Stage 3微调可提升精度保持率。在TabArena分类任务上，微调后的局部模型保留了Full TabICLv2的98.64%精度，批量推理中位加速2.18倍，单查询服务场景下中位加速约249倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全上下文表格数据上下文学习（TabICL）存在注意力计算成本随训练上下文规模增长的问题，限制了其高效处理大型数据集的能力。现有TabICLv2虽然在多个表格分类任务上达到最先进水平，但其推理成本高昂，需要一种降低推理开销同时保持精度的方法。

Method: Localized TabICLv2通过在模型Stage 2行表示空间中计算相似度，为每个测试点仅检索k个最近邻训练样本作为上下文，替代原有的完整训练上下文。方法无需修改模型架构，并通过额外的Stage 2和Stage 3微调来改善精度保留率。

Result: 在TabArena分类任务上，微调后的局部模型保留了Full TabICLv2的98.64%精度；批量推理场景达到中位2.18倍加速；单查询服务场景达到约249倍中位加速。

Conclusion: Localized TabICLv2通过近邻检索策略有效降低了表格数据上下文学习的推理成本，在极小精度损失（1.36%）的前提下实现了显著的推理加速，为表格数据的可扩展上下文学习提供了一种高效且无需架构改动的解决方案。

Abstract: Foundational models for tabular data have made significant progress in recent years, with TabICLv2 reporting state-of-the-art performance on several tabular classification tasks. However, full-context tabular ICL still suffers from attention cost that grows with the training-context size, which limits its ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Localized TabICLv2 introduces a method that reduces the inference cost of TabICLv2 by retrieving only the k nearest training neighbours for each test point, measured by similarity in the model's Stage 2 row-representation space, rather than using the full training context. This requires no architectural changes, and we show that accuracy retention can be improved through additional Stage 2 and Stage 3 fine-tuning. On TabArena classification tasks, the fine-tuned localized model retains 98.64% of Full TabICLv2 accuracy and it achieves a median 2.18$\times$ speedup in batch inference, and reaches approximately 249$\times$ median speedup in the single-query serving setting.

</details>


### [399] [Reference-free logged energy-oracle recovery for neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems: conforming Riesz reconstruction and archive-level selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16473)
*Karim Bounja,Lahcen Laayouni,Boujemaa Achchab,Abdeljalil Sakat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对神经PDE训练产生的有限checkpoint档案，提出一种无需解析解（参考解）的"保形Riesz监视器"选择准则，通过计算能量误差的下界和上界（在饱和条件下），实现对近似解档案中"日志oracle误差"的收敛恢复与选择，并证明该准则在扩散与弹性问题（含非制造多孔板）上达到oracle级选择效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经PDE训练会产生有限个checkpoint档案，但其真实（能量）误差无法直接获取（因为没有精确解），而基于损失函数的checkpoint选择并不一定能恢复日志记录的能量误差oracle。因此需要一种不依赖精确解、计算可行且能在内在能量误差尺度上做后训练选择的准则。

Method: 针对对称强制的变分问题的可容许神经近似，构造一个可计算的保形Riesz监视器。利用精确残差-能量恒等式和保形投影，使监视器成为无条件下界，并在嵌套保形细化下单调收敛到各日志能量误差；在饱和条件下引入分层细化构造可计算上界，形成下-上区间。对于有限档案证明均匀恢复，从而在没有饱和时于足够细的辅助分辨率下收敛到logged-oracle误差并实现logged-oracle选择；在饱和下利用区间分离认证唯一logged-oracle选择。同时界定日志分辨率损失并认证指定比较轨迹上的oracle包含性。

Result: 在扩散与弹性数值实验（包括非制造的多孔板）中，该准则展示了能量尺度校准、oracle级别选择能力以及适度的后处理开销。关键发现是档案选择对顺序敏感：未解析的checkpoint相关分量在有限分辨率下可能反转oracle与非oracle的排序，因此逐checkpoint恢复单独并不充分，需要均匀恢复保证。

Conclusion: 本文提出的保形Riesz监视器将原本不可行的精确误差最小化选择，替换为计算可行、与训练无关的后训练选择准则，仅需已计算的候选解和变分问题本身。该准则在理论上保证收敛到logged-oracle误差，在实践中达到oracle级选择效果，具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Neural PDE training yields a finite checkpoint archive, yet its logged energy errors are inaccessible without the exact solution, while loss-based selection does not necessarily recover the logged energy oracle. For admissible neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems, we introduce a reference-free selection rule based on minimizing a computable conforming Riesz monitor. The exact residual-energy identity and conforming projection make the monitor an unconditional lower bound converging monotonically to each logged energy error under nested conforming refinement; under saturation, hierarchical enrichment yields a computable upper estimate and hence a lower-upper bracket. A key finding is that archive selection is order-sensitive: unresolved checkpoint-dependent components can reverse the oracle-non-oracle ranking at finite resolution, so checkpointwise recovery alone is insufficient. For finite archives, we prove uniform recovery, yielding convergence to the logged-oracle error and, without saturation, logged-oracle selection at sufficiently fine auxiliary resolution. Under saturation, the bracket gives a computable near-oracle bound and certifies unique logged-oracle selection upon interval separation. We also bound logging-resolution loss and certify oracle inclusion over prescribed comparison trajectories. The resulting criterion replaces inaccessible exact-error minimization by computable, training-independent post-training selection on the intrinsic energy-error scale, requiring only the computed candidates and the variational problem. Experiments on diffusion and elasticity, including a non-manufactured perforated plate, demonstrate energy-scale calibration, oracle-level selection, and modest post-processing cost.

</details>


### [400] [Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16477)
*Tianhang Ding,Jianchun Liu,Hongli Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Pallas是一个主动式KV缓存迁移框架，在移动用户发生蜂窝切换前，提前在预测的目标基站准备推理状态，通过将标记序列分为历史前缀（本地预填充重建）和演进后缀（源端流式传输KV块），在切换时组装成最新的KV缓存，从而大幅缩短服务中断时间（SIT）并降低跨token延迟（ITL）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在AI-RAN场景下，LLM服务靠近移动用户部署，但蜂窝切换会导致用户附着到目标基站时，大量且持续增长的KV缓存仍留在源基站。若在源端保留推理可保持服务连续性但增加ITL，若在目标端恢复状态则需KV缓存传输或重计算，且只能在切换后执行，直接延长SIT。现有方法无法同时兼顾服务连续性和服务局部性。

Method: Pallas采用主动式KV缓存迁移：1）在准备触发时，将token序列划分为稳定的历史前缀和演进的动态后缀；2）目标基站通过本地预填充（prefill）重建前缀，源基站并行流式传输后缀生成的KV块；3）切换时目标基站将两部分组装为最新KV缓存并本地恢复解码；4）在线调度器基于移动性预测和运行时遥测选择预取窗口（prefetching window），决定在切换前多早开始准备。

Result: 在三种LLM和100-500 Mbps的基站间链路上，基于vLLM的原型将平均SIT较目标端恢复方法降低2.28-89.68倍，并将平均ITL较源端转发方法降低16.0%-50.0%。

Conclusion: Pallas通过将KV缓存准备过程从切换后提前到切换前并行执行，实现了切换期间不中断的服务连续性，同时保留了目标端推理的局部性优势，为AI-RAN中的LLM服务提供了一种高效的切换管理方案。

Abstract: AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputation, or a combination of both only after handover, directly prolonging service interruption time (SIT).
  This work presents Pallas, a \textit{proactive} KV-cache migration framework that prepares the inference state at the predicted target before handover, in parallel with ongoing source-side inference and token delivery. At the preparation trigger, Pallas partitions the token sequence into a stable historical prefix and an evolving suffix. The target reconstructs the prefix through local prefill, while the source streams the KV blocks generated for the suffix. At handover, the target assembles both portions into an up-to-date KV cache and resumes decoding locally, leaving only unfinished preparation to contribute to SIT. An online scheduler selects the \textit{prefetching window}, which determines how early preparation begins before handover, based on mobility predictions and runtime telemetry. Across three LLMs and $100$--$500~\mathrm{Mbps}$ inter-gNB links, our vLLM-based prototype reduces average SIT by factors of $2.28$--$89.68$ over target-side recovery approaches and lowers average ITL by $16.0\%$--$50.0\%$ compared with source-side forwarding.

</details>
