### [401] [Graph Machine Learning: An Opportunity for Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16494)
*Martin Sadric,Sebastian Pütz,Christian Nauck,Veit Hagenmeyer,Frank Hellmann,Dirk Witthaut,Benjamin Schäfer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了近800篇图机器学习（GML）与电力系统交叉领域的研究论文，涵盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全六个方向。论文指出电力系统为GML提供了独特的基准测试场景（物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键性、数据稀缺），同时GML可作为经典求解器的可扩展、拓扑感知的近似补充。文章识别了主要挑战（真实部署不足、可解释性欠缺、标准化基准缺失、结果难复现），并提出了一套面向ML就绪电力网格基准的结构化需求目录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代电力系统因可再生能源接入、去中心化和实时决策需求而日益复杂，传统基于模型的方法虽然精确但在运行时间尺度上过于缓慢。机器学习（尤其是图机器学习）作为更快速的数据驱动替代方案应运而生。然而该领域缺乏系统性综述、标准化基准和可复现性保障，作者希望通过全面调研揭示研究现状、挑战与未来方向。

Method: 作者对近800篇图机器学习与电力系统交叉领域的论文进行了系统综述，覆盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全六个子领域。综述方法包括对现有工作的分类整理、识别开放挑战（如真实部署不足、可解释性需求）、分析标准化基准和数据集的稀缺性，并据此推导出面向ML就绪电力网格基准的结构化需求目录。

Result: 综述发现：电力系统为GML提供了独特且丰富的基准环境（硬物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键性、稀缺标注数据并存于同一明确定义的领域）；GML能够以可扩展、拓扑感知的方式补充经典求解器，具有良好的泛化能力和计算效率。但同时也发现：真实世界部署案例有限、安全关键场景下可解释模型缺失、标准化基准和开放数据集严重不足，导致大量结果难以复现，削弱了领域长期科学可信度。

Conclusion: 作者呼吁社区优先开展专门的基准研究，并发布开放数据集和开放模型。论文提出了一套结构化需求目录来指导未来ML就绪电力网格基准的开发，旨在提高跨研究的可复现性，从而巩固该交叉领域的长期科学可靠性和实际工程落地基础。

Abstract: Modern power systems face growing operational complexity driven by the integration of renewable energy sources, decentralization, and the need for real-time decision-making across a wide range of timescales. Addressing these challenges traditionally relies on model-based methods that, while accurate, can be too slow for operational demands. Machine learning (ML) has therefore emerged as a faster, data-driven alternative. As grid topology plays a central role in power system operation, graph machine learning (GML) methods offer a natural framework for incorporating topological dependencies as an inductive bias. We survey nearly 800 papers at the intersection of GML and power systems, covering forecasting, state estimation, optimization, control, fault diagnosis, and cybersecurity. Power systems constitute an unusually rich benchmark setting for GML, as they combine hard physical constraints, multi-scale dynamics, safety-critical requirements, and scarce labeled data within a single, well-defined domain. Conversely, power systems can benefit from utilizing GML to complement classical solvers, as GML provide scalable, topology-aware approximations with promising generalization and computational efficiency. We identify open challenges, including limited real-world deployment and the need for interpretable models in safety-critical settings. Despite the rapidly growing number of publications, standardized benchmarks and open datasets remain scarce, leaving many results difficult to reproduce and undermining the long-term scientific credibility of the field. We further derive a structured requirements catalog for ML-ready power grid benchmarks, intended to guide future dataset development and improve reproducibility across studies. We call on the community to prioritize dedicated benchmark studies and the release of open datasets and models.

</details>


### [402] [When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16502)
*Yiqi Liu,Joseph James,Yang Wang,Chenghao Xiao,Chenghua Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了大规模智能体在工具/API检索中的"源风格崩溃"（source-style collapse）现象：检索器在某个数据源切片上微调后，在同一个基准的其他数据源切片上性能显著下降。作者提出查询侧TF-IDF指纹作为崩溃风险的廉价信号，并设计ToolScout源感知路由方法来缓解该问题，将混合检索流上的覆盖率从22.3%提升至86.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模智能体依赖检索来获取外部能力（工具/API），但检索层可能在语料库固定时仍然静默失效。作者观察到同一基准中不同来源的切片会导致微调检索器产生性能崩溃，这种"源风格崩溃"是智能体可靠运行的潜在隐患，需要识别并缓解。

Method: 1）在ToolRet基准上，对Ferraretriever进行单源切片微调，验证其跨源崩溃现象；2）提出查询侧TF-IDF指纹作为源风格的判定信号，与语义和长度代理进行对比；3）设计ToolScout源感知路由方法，利用TF-IDF信号作为路由守卫，在混合查询流中判断查询所属源风格并路由到合适的检索器；4）将工具重渲染为可执行技能卡片以排除API格式作为唯一归因。

Result: TF-IDF指纹比语义或长度代理更能预测微调检索器的失败。在混合4,996条查询流上，TF-IDF路由将覆盖率从22.3%提升至86.1%；在五个崩溃源上，仅用20个匹配示例就将覆盖率加权的全局top-1代理从1.3%提升至53.9%。将工具重渲染为技能卡片后崩溃和路由行为依然存在，排除了原始API格式作为唯一原因。

Conclusion: 固定工具语料库下的检索失败并非不可预测：源风格是导致微调检索器崩溃的关键因素，TF-IDF指纹提供了一种廉价的检测信号，而源感知路由（ToolScout）能有效缓解此问题。该现象在工具重渲染为技能卡片后仍持续存在，表明这是更深层的检索泛化问题而非纯格式问题。

Abstract: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-1100 despite its higher lexical overlap with the gold tools. We call this failure mode source-style collapse. Query-side TF-IDF fingerprints flag source styles on which the fine-tuned retriever is likely to fail better than semantic or length-based proxies, giving a cheap signal for mismatch over a fixed tool corpus. We propose ToolScout, a source-aware routing method that uses this signal as a routing guard: on the mixed 4,996-query stream, TF-IDF-based routing raises coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%, and across five collapsed sources 20 matched examples raise the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy from 1.3% to 53.9%. The same failure and routing behaviors persist when tools are rerendered as executable skill cards, which rules out raw API-schema format as the sole cause.

</details>


### [403] [One Residual with Three Reuses: A Wristband Front End for Gesture Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16542)
*Sam Rifaki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于腕戴式手势界面的前端的协同设计研究，将MEMS惯性测量单元（IMU）与60 GHz FMCW雷达配对，通过单一片上残差生成器实现分类器唤醒门控、毫米波与IMU路由选择以及基于革新的EKF测量重加权三者的共享。该前端在Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus级MCU上仅占用14.4 KB程序存储和278 B状态，每帧运行110K次MAC，在四个公开数据集上达到P_D=0.72/0.80（1%虚警率），47%的分类器调用能量削减（90%手势检测召回），并将姿态跟踪RMSE相对自适应卡尔曼基线降低4.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续腕戴式手部感知（手势界面与运动症状监测）需要一个始终开启的前端，该前端必须在纽扣电池功率预算内运行，同时将MEMS IMU与60 GHz FMCW雷达配对，以在遮挡和身体漂移下保持鲁棒性。当前挑战在于如何在高精度感知需求与极低功耗约束之间取得平衡。

Method: 提出共享的单一片上残差生成器架构，统一服务于三个功能：1) 分类器唤醒门控（决定何时需要激活分类器）；2) 毫米波与IMU数据路由（根据场景选择传感模态）；3) 基于创新的EKF测量重加权（应对测量偏差漂移）。该设计在Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus类边缘MCU上实现，占用14.4 KB程序内存与278 B状态，每帧执行110K次MAC运算。

Result: 在IPN Hand、SHREC 2021、MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW雷达、EAT-Radar四个公开数据集上：检测概率P_D达到0.72/0.80（1%虚警率）；在90%手势检测召回率下实现47%分类器调用能量削减；在测量偏差漂移条件下，姿态跟踪RMSE相比自适应卡尔曼R-膨胀基线降低4.6倍。

Conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于完成了一项设计研究——验证了通过共享单一残差生成器来整合三种关键功能（唤醒门控、模态路由、EKF重加权）的可行性，可在严苛的功耗与资源约束下实现鲁棒的腕戴式感知。实际硅片功耗与穿戴采集留待后续硬件工作验证。

Abstract: Continuous wrist-worn hand sensing for gesture interfaces and motor symptom monitoring needs an always-on front end that fits inside a coin-cell power budget while pairing a micro-electro-mechanical-systems (MEMS) inertial measurement unit (IMU) with a 60 GHz frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar to stay robust under occlusion and on-body drift. We present a design study of such a wristband front end in which classifier wake-up gating, mmWave versus IMU routing, and innovation-based EKF measurement reweighting share a single on-chip residual generator. The shared generator occupies 14.4 KB of program memory and 278 B of state and runs at 110K multiply-accumulates (MACs) per frame on an Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus class edge microcontroller unit (MCU). Across four public sensor data corpora (IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW radar, EAT-Radar) the front end reaches detection probability $P_D = 0.72/0.80$ at a 1% false-alarm rate, sustains a 47% classifier invocation energy reduction at 90% gesture detection recall, and lowers pose tracking root-mean-square error by $4.6\times$ under measurement bias drift relative to an adaptive Kalman with $R$-inflation baseline. Measured silicon power and on-body capture are deferred to follow-on hardware; the contribution here is a design study.

</details>


### [404] [Learning Generalizable Reconstruction of High-Dimensional Neural Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16569)
*Anima Kujur,Zahra Monfared*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PCA-DMD框架，通过将LFP记录分割为重叠窗口、投影到PCA空间、学习Koopman线性演化，并逆投影重建连续信号，实现对高分辨率神经记录的准确重建。在多项数据集上表现出优越性能，包括零样本跨受试泛化、时间外推预测和大规模可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程神经记录的准确重建面临挑战，因为局部场电位（LFP）具有高分辨率、多通道、瞬态性强且跨受试者变异大的特点。现有方法（如Classical DMD, SpDMD, MrDMD, HODMD）在这些数据的重建上表现不足，需要更可扩展且泛化能力强的框架。

Method: PCA-DMD采用算子理论框架，核心步骤包括：(1) 将LFP记录分割为重叠窗口；(2) 将窗口投影到紧凑的PCA潜空间；(3) 在潜空间中学习线性Koopman演化算子；(4) 通过逆投影和重叠相加（overlap-add）聚合实现连续信号重建。

Result: 在200,000样本海马体记录上，PCA-DMD超越Classical DMD、SpDMD、MrDMD和HODMD，达到KLD=0.0761和HD=0.0847。300,000样本全配对跨受试零样本泛化中，相关系数达0.9504-0.9800。400,000-900,000样本可扩展性测试中均相关保持约0.965-0.968。外部验证在93通道Allen Neuropixels记录上平均相关0.7427、中位数0.7990。Koopman谱分析显示主要特征值集中在单位圆附近。

Conclusion: PCA-DMD提供了可解释、可泛化且计算可扩展的高维神经动力学重建框架，适合大规模神经数据的连续信号重建。

Abstract: Accurate reconstruction of long-duration neural recordings is challenging because local field potentials (LFPs) are high-resolution, multichannel, transient, and variable across subjects. We present PCA-DMD, a scalable operator-theoretic framework that segments LFP recordings into overlapping windows, projects them into a compact PCA space, learns linear Koopman evolution in the latent space, and reconstructs continuous signals through inverse projection and overlap-add aggregation. On 200,000-sample hippocampal recordings, PCA-DMD outperformed Classical DMD, SpDMD, MrDMD, and HODMD, achieving KLD=0.0761 and HD=0.0847. In all-pair cross-subject zero-shot generalization at 300,000 samples, correlations were 0.9504-0.9800, with HD=0.0010-0.0072 and KLD=0.0005-0.0022, without target-subject fine-tuning. Out-of-sample temporal prediction showed close one-step agreement on temporally held-out LFP segments across the unseen interval and multiple channels. Scalability analysis from 400,000 to 900,000 samples showed stable zero-shot reconstruction, with mean correlation remaining about 0.965-0.968 while computational cost increased predictably. External validation on an independent 93-channel Allen Neuropixels recording yielded mean and median channel-wise correlations of 0.7427 and 0.7990, respectively. Koopman spectral and mode analyses revealed dominant eigenvalues concentrated near the unit circle. PCA-DMD therefore provides an interpretable, generalizable, and computationally scalable framework for reconstructing high-dimensional neural dynamics.

</details>


### [405] [Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16606)
*Arslan Majal,Aamir Hussain Chughtai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种生成式高斯过程回归模型，该模型能够捕捉观测数据特定的污染信息并自适应地减轻异常值的影响，通过变分广义期望最大化算法进行学习，在多种污染设置下保持与鲁棒GPR基线相当甚至更好的预测精度，且计算复杂度同为三次方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统高斯过程回归（GPR）使用高斯观测似然，容易受到异常值的严重影响，导致模型学习和预测不准确。

Method: 提出一个生成式GPR模型，显式建模观测特定的污染（contamination），从而自适应地降低异常值的影响；采用变分广义期望最大化（variational generalized EM）过程来学习潜在变量和GPR模型参数。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的多种污染设置下，所提方法在预测精度上与鲁棒GPR基线相当，且在多种情况下优于基线；计算复杂度与对比的GPR方法相同，均为三次方。

Conclusion: 该生成式GPR模型通过显式建模观测污染，能有效抵抗异常值干扰，在保持与标准GPR相同计算复杂度的同时提升鲁棒性。

Abstract: Outliers can substantially distort Gaussian process regression (GPR) due to its conventional Gaussian observation likelihood, leading to inaccurate model learning and prediction. To address this limitation, this article introduces a generative GPR model that captures observation-specific contamination and adaptively mitigates the influence of outliers. Subsequently, a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is used to learn the latent variables and GPR model parameters. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets under different contamination settings demonstrate that the proposed method remains competitive with-and in several cases outperforms-robust GPR baselines in prediction accuracy. Moreover, the proposed method shares the cubic computational scaling of the compared GPR methods.

</details>


### [406] [Hoeffding adaptive splitting trees for data stream classification with concept drift and ensemble learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16659)
*Daniel Nowak Assis,Jean Paul Barddal,Fabrício Enembreck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种新型决策树模型（Hoeffding自适应分裂树），通过结合Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略与自适应分裂机制（利用变化检测算法识别性能衰退并决定分裂点），解决集成学习中自适应分裂树缺乏多样性的问题，实验证明该方法在数据流分类中达到了最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成学习中的Hoeffding树作为基学习器被广泛使用，但其标准分裂机制缺乏适应性；而自适应分裂树虽在性能上更优，但当作为集成基学习器时，变化检测器往往无法促进足够的集成多样性，这是一个被忽视的局限。

Method: 提出两种称为Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees的新型决策树模型，融合两大类策略：Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略（用于促进集成多样性）以及基于变化检测算法的自适应分裂机制（用于识别性能衰退并确定分裂点）。

Result: 实验结果表明，Hoeffding自适应分裂树能够提升集成性能，在基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应等全面评估中均取得了最先进的结果。

Conclusion: 通过将周期性分裂与自适应分裂机制有机结合，可以有效解决自适应分裂树在集成中多样性不足的问题，为数据流分类中的集成学习提供了更优的基学习器设计。

Abstract: Ensembles of decision trees are well-established methods for data stream classification. In ensemble learning, Hoeffding Trees are widely adopted as base learners, performing periodic split attempts according to the Hoeffding bound. Recent studies, however, indicate that this standard splitting mechanism lacks adaptability, while adaptive trees that trigger splits in response to performance degradation have achieved superior results. In this paper, we identify limitations in the use of adaptive-splitting decision trees as ensemble base learners, showing that change detectors often fail to promote sufficient diversity within ensembles. To address this issue, we propose two novel decision tree models, termed Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees. These models combine the periodic splitting strategy of Hoeffding Trees, which fosters ensemble diversity, with adaptive splitting mechanisms that employ change detection algorithms to identify performance decay and determine split points. Experimental results demonstrate that Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees enhance ensemble performance and achieve state-of-the-art results across a comprehensive evaluation, including benchmark comparisons, computational cost analysis, and concept drift adaptation.

</details>


### [407] [UniTAC: Universal Task-Aware Compression via Weighted Distortion Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16696)
*Homa Esfahanizadeh,Matin Mortaheb,Jinfeng Du,Harish Viswanathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UniTAC是一种单一学习的图像编解码器，可跨越通用（任务无关）到任务特化的操作范围，在运行时无需重新训练即可通过轻量级侧信息（任务重要性向量）重新定向。在0.034 bpp下，单个UniTAC模型在局部任务上达到91.4%的准确率，仅比任务特化编解码器低1.9%，显著优于通用编解码器（76.9%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理AI系统（如自动驾驶车辆和机器人）需要在带宽、延迟和能量受限的条件下及时交换高维传感信号。由于驱动下游决策的任务随时间演变，任务特化编解码器是脆弱的，而在现场为每个任务重新训练是不可行的。因此需要一种无需重训练即可适应不同任务的单一编解码器。

Method: 将任务抽象为每分量的重要性向量（可从任何下游模型的梯度归因导出），以低开销侧信息形式同时条件化编码器和解码器。在广泛的随机化向量族上以加权重建失真为目标一次性训练，保持固定骨干网络和单一人类可查看重建。设计了基于Vision Transformer（ViT）的编解码器，通过token级条件化天然实现权重驱动编码。同时分析了加权率失真问题，刻画了对角加权失真何时与任务一致以及权重与任务敏感性的关系。

Result: 在局部任务0.034 bpp条件下，单个UniTAC模型达到91.4%的准确率，仅比任务特化编解码器（93.3%）低1.9%，且高于通用编解码器（76.9%）。

Conclusion: UniTAC通过运行时注入任务重要性向量实现无需重训练的任务重定向，在通用性与任务特化性能之间取得了良好平衡，为物理AI系统中动态任务的实时感知通信提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Physical AI systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots rely on timely exchange of high-dimensional sensory signals under tight bandwidth, latency, and energy budgets. Because the task driving downstream decisions evolves over time, a task-specific codec is brittle and retraining one per task is infeasible in the field. We propose UniTAC, a single learned image codec spanning universal (task-agnostic) to task-specialized operation, re-targeted at runtime without retraining. The task is abstracted as a per-component importance vector, derived, e.g., from gradient attribution of any downstream model, and transmitted as low-overhead side information that conditions both encoder and decoder. Trained once over a broad, randomized family of such vectors against weighted-reconstruction distortion, UniTAC keeps a fixed backbone and a single human-viewable reconstruction whose fidelity is steered to the active task by swapping the injected vector. We analyze the underlying weighted rate-distortion problem, characterizing when a diagonal weighted distortion is task-consistent and how weights relate to task sensitivity. Guided by this, we design a Vision Transformer (ViT) codec whose token-level conditioning natively realizes this weight-driven code. On a localized task at 0.034 bpp, a single UniTAC model reaches 91.4% accuracy, only 1.9% below a task-based codec (93.3%) and above universal codecs (76.9%).

</details>


### [408] [Learning to Unlearn: Machine Unlearning via Learning the Unlearning Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16700)
*Hang Zhang,Kaifeng Zhang,Yixiao Ma,Weijie Xu,Ye Zhu,Kai Ming Ting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL)的机器遗忘方法，首次将"学习到优化"的思想引入机器遗忘领域，从分布视角学习模型遗忘行为，替代传统手动设计的遗忘函数U，从而在大型数据集和模型上实现高效且与重训练精度相当的遗忘效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法需要手动设计复杂的遗忘函数U，在处理大规模训练数据时面临高昂的计算成本，复杂结构本身成为性能瓶颈，即使对于参数较少的模型也是如此。因此需要一种更简单高效且与模型无关的遗忘方法。

Method: 借鉴Learning to Optimize的思想，L2UL是首个基于学习的模型无关方法，核心思路是从手动设计遗忘函数U转变为从分布视角学习遗忘行为，从而通过学习获得一个简单高效的U。

Result: 实验结果表明，L2UL的精度与重训练方法相当，同时在数据密集型场景中展现出显著的效率优势；并在更大的ResNet模型上验证了其性能和可扩展性。

Conclusion: L2UL通过学习的范式替代手动设计，成功实现了机器遗忘中的高效性与模型无关性，在保持精度的同时大幅提升效率，且具有良好的可扩展性，为大规模模型遗忘提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Various machine unlearning techniques have been developed in response to privacy legislation requirements, enabling individuals to exercise their legal right to have their data $D_f$ removed from a machine learning model. This process is typically accomplished via the use of an unlearning function denoted as $U$. Existing methods focus on designing an intricate $U$ to unlearn $D_f \subset D$ from a previous model $A(D)$, so that the unlearned model performs as closely as possible to the retrained model $A(D \setminus D_f)$. However, these methods often suffer from high computational costs when dealing with massive training data, as the complex structures of $U$ become a bottleneck even for models with fewer parameters.
  Inspired by Learning to Optimize, we introduce the first learning-based model-agnostic approach, Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL). Our core insight is to shift from manually designing $U$ to learning the unlearning behaviors from a distribution perspective, thereby acquiring a simple and efficient $U$ via learning. Our experimental results demonstrate that the accuracy achieved by L2UL is comparable to that of retraining while exhibiting impressive efficiency, particularly in data-intensive scenarios. Furthermore, we validate the performance and scalability of our method on larger models ResNet.

</details>


### [409] [The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16710)
*Thomas Mbrice,Ammar Ali,Sami Mian,Khai Hern Low,Eric Chen,Arshia Aghajani,Wolf Schäfer,Amin Shirangi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了伦理决策头（EDH），一个将伦理推理编码为可微分奖励信号的深度强化学习框架，在CARLA仿真环境中训练自动驾驶车辆学习道德对齐的驾驶行为。通过PPO算法和Bradley-Terry人类偏好模型，作者评估了功利主义和康德主义两种规范伦理框架，发现人类评分者在实践中奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，揭示了RLHF学到的伦理是"人类实际践行的伦理"而非"哲学家定义的伦理"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自动驾驶车辆迈向L4/L5级别，其决策系统不仅要处理安全关键的移动控制，还必须承担随之而来的道德权重。目前缺乏将伦理推理系统性地编码进强化学习决策框架的方法，以及对这些方法在真实人类偏好下表现的系统性评估。

Method: 1) 设计EDH：将伦理推理编码为可微分奖励信号，支持策略梯度智能体学习道德对齐的驾驶行为；2) 实例化两种规范框架：功利主义（最小化总伤亡）和康德主义（将保持航线作为绝对命令）；3) 使用PPO算法训练，针对从200个碰撞迫近场景的人类成对偏好标注中学习的Bradley-Terry奖励模型。

Result: 发现规范伦理框架在人类监督下存在可学习性的不对称性。康德条件退化为恒定预测任务，作为流程控制验证了训练稳定性，排除了基础设施故障解释。功利主义智能体学习到更令人不安的结果：人类评分者奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，模型忠实地学习了这一偏好。

Conclusion: 人类在理论上规定的伦理与实践中所奖励的行为之间存在分歧，表明RLHF学习的不是哲学家定义的伦理，而是人类实际生活的伦理。这挑战了将规范性伦理理论直接注入自动驾驶决策系统的假设基础。

Abstract: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.

</details>


### [410] [Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16739)
*Siddarth Venkatraman,Matthieu Dinot,Laurence Aitchison*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补策略以改进基于价值函数的强化学习在LLM训练中的表现：1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF)，通过注入额外的任务相关token级信号而不引入策略偏差；2) TETHER基线，根据价值函数精度自适应地在组相对基线与价值基线之间插值。实验表明两种策略在多个推理任务上均优于标准价值函数基线，并与均值基线GRPO相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM强化学习方法中，组相对方法（如GRPO）虽然通过多rollout采样降低梯度方差，但仅提供序列级信用分配，且受限于掉队rollout导致吞吐量下降和off-policy问题。学习价值函数理论上可同时解决这两个问题（提供token级优势且无需大组），但由于工程复杂性和无批评者方法的实践成功，其价值难以被证明。

Method: 1) PVF (Privileged Value Functions)：一种利用额外任务相关token级信号注入价值函数的机制，该信号不会使策略目标产生偏差。2) TETHER：一种自适应基线，根据价值函数的准确度在组相对基线与价值基线之间动态插值，兼顾两者的优势。

Result: 在两个策略下，多个推理任务上均一致优于标准价值函数基线，并且与均值基线GRPO相比具有竞争力或表现更优。

Conclusion: 通过PVF和TETHER两种机制，价值函数RL在LLM推理任务上的性能瓶颈可以得到有效突破，使其在无需牺牲功能的前提下能与无批评者方法（如GRPO）相抗衡甚至更优。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. We propose two complementary strategies to improve the performance of value function RL: 1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF) which provide an elegant mechanism to inject additional task-relevant token-level signal without biasing the policy objective; 2) TETHER, a baseline that adaptively interpolates between group-relative and value baselines depending on the value function accuracy. Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.

</details>


### [411] [Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16747)
*Adam Karvonen,Euan Ong,Subhash Kantamneni,Samuel Marks*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CHIVE（反事实假设编辑调查）流水线，用于自动发现并解释大规模语言模型在自然场景中的意外行为。CHIVE通过反事实提示编辑生成高质量解释及配套反事实证据。作者应用CHIVE评估常见可解释性技术，发现这些技术并未提升模型行为预测能力；同时用CHIVE生成训练数据，训练出的模型能泛化到多种分布外场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI研究（如语言模型可解释性和思维链忠实性）试图解释模型行为，但"什么才是好的解释"这一问题悬而未决。现有解释方法缺乏统一的评估标准，需要一种可量化的方式来衡量解释的质量，因此作者提出以反事实可模拟性（counterfactual simulatability）作为评估解释的准则。

Method: 作者提出CHIVE（Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits），一种智能体流水线，能够自动识别模型在自然场景中的意外行为，并通过反事实提示编辑进行深入调查。该流水线产出数千条高质量解释及其配套的反事实证据。CHIVE有两大应用：一是评估常见LLM可解释性技术是否提升预测反事实行为的能力；二是利用CHIVE生成的训练数据训练模型，使其能够预测反事实实验的结果。

Result: 实验结果有两个关键发现：第一，评估的各类常见可解释性技术均未能提升智能体预测反事实模型行为的能力，这一结果令人意外；第二，使用CHIVE生成的反事实实验数据进行训练，模型能够泛化到多种分布外（out-of-distribution）场景。

Conclusion: CHIVE能够自动发现并解释LLM的自然行为，为评估和改进模型解释方法提供了新平台。该工作为可解释性研究确立了以反事实可模拟性为核心的评价标准，并揭示了现有可解释性技术在预测模型行为方面的局限，同时展示了基于反事实数据训练的有效性。

Abstract: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpected model behaviors in the wild and investigates them with counterfactual prompt edits. This yields thousands of high-quality explanations for naturally-occurring model behaviors along with supporting counterfactual evidence. We apply CHIVE in two ways. First, we evaluate whether common LLM interpretability techniques improve an agent's ability to predict counterfactual model behaviors. Surprisingly, we find no uplift from any of the interpretability techniques studied. Second, we use CHIVE to generate training data. We find that training models to predict outcomes of CHIVE-generated counterfactual experiments generalizes to various out-of-distribution settings. Overall, CHIVE automatically discovers explanations of naturally-occurring LLM behaviors, enabling us to evaluate and improve methods for explaining LLM behaviors.

</details>


### [412] [On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16760)
*Yushun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本论文为Adam优化器建立了坚实的理论基础：揭示了其收敛与发散问题依赖的相变现象，阐明了Adam在Transformer上优于SGD的原因（Hessian的近块对角结构与块间异质性），并基于这些洞察提出了Adam-mini优化器，将内存占用减少50%且保持性能。研究还对基于矩阵的非凸问题中的局部结构有更广泛的启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam是现代LLM训练的默认优化器，但其理论基础薄弱。论文旨在为Adam提供原则性的理论支撑，解答其收敛/发散之争论，解释其在Transformer上优于SGD的原因，并据此设计更好的优化器。

Method: 论文采用理论分析与实证相结合的方法：(1) 通过相变分析证明在合适的batch-size相关超参数下Adam收敛，而小β₂区域可能发散；(2) 利用Hessian结构分析揭示训练中Hessian演化为近块对角形式并伴随强块异质性，证明这种结构使Adam的对角预处理有效；(3) 基于随机矩阵理论严格分析这种特殊Hessian结构的起源（来自大矩阵变量的连续乘法）；(4) 据此设计Adam-mini优化器。

Result: 证明了Adam存在依赖问题的相变（收敛/发散）；揭示了Hessian近块对角结构与块异质性使Adam在Transformer上优于SGD；从随机矩阵理论角度严格分析了Hessian结构的来源；提出Adam-mini将内存占用降低50%且不损失性能；这些发现还帮助理解和改进Muon等新型优化器。

Conclusion: 论文为Adam提供了原则性的理论基础，并展示了这些洞见不仅深化了对Adam的理解，还揭示了基于矩阵的非凸问题中新的局部结构，对优化器设计与理解具有更广泛的启示意义。

Abstract: Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs. First, we revisit Adam's divergence--convergence debate and show the existence of a problem-dependent phase transition: with properly chosen, batch-size-dependent hyperparameters, Adam converges, whereas under small-$β_2$ regimes it can diverge. Second, we investigate why Adam substantially outperforms SGD on Transformers through Hessian structure. We find that the Hessian evolves toward a near-block-diagonal form along training, accompanied by strong block heterogeneity. We prove that this structure makes Adam's diagonal preconditioner effective. We further show that this special Hessian structure originates from consecutive multiplications of large matrix variables, and we provide a rigorous analysis based on random matrix theory. Finally, these insights motivate Adam-mini, a new optimizer that reduces Adam's memory footprint by 50\% while preserving its performance. Our results also have broader implications beyond Adam: they reveal new local structures in matrix-based nonconvex problems, and also help understand and improve recent NN optimizers, such as Muon.

</details>


### [413] [Beyond $L_2$: Generalizing Abductive Latent Explanations to Diverse Prototype-Based Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16773)
*Jules Soria,Alban Grastien,Romain Xu-Darme,Julien Girard-Satabin,Zakaria Chihani,Daniela Cancila*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将归纳潜在解释（ALE）框架从欧几里得潜空间推广到非欧几里得原型网络架构（如球面度量、高斯密度、维度投影），为每种几何变体推导出映射到现有边界或构造新型架构特定边界算法的方法，并在训练好的图像分类器上验证了子集最小形式解释的计算效果，实现了首个跨架构可解释性的严格比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ALE形式化解释方法严格局限于欧几里得潜空间，而现代最先进的架构越来越多地采用非欧几里得表示（如球面度量、高斯密度、维度投影），导致现有形式化解释方法无法适用，存在关键空白。

Method: 将ALE框架推广到非欧几里得原型架构：针对每种几何变体，系统性地推导如何将架构映射到现有边界算法，或构造新颖的架构特定边界算法，以计算潜空间距离的紧致上界来生成形式化解释。

Result: 在完全训练好的图像分类器上，通过计算子集最小形式化解释验证了理论构造的有效性；将多样化的非欧几里得模型统一到单一形式框架下，实现了跨架构可解释性的首次严格比较。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了非欧几里得潜空间下形式化可解释性的空白，为不同几何结构的原型网络提供了统一的形式化解释框架，使跨架构可解释性比较成为可能。

Abstract: Prototype-based neural networks are hailed as interpretable-by-design architectures. Recently, Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE) were introduced to provide formal, mathematically guaranteed explanations that leverage the intrinsic structure of these networks to ensure both predictive safety and human readability. ALEs rely on computing tight bounds on latent space distances to produce formal explanations. However, existing ALE formulations are rigidly confined to Euclidean latent spaces. This leaves a critical gap: modern state-of-the-art architectures increasingly rely on non-Euclidean representations - such as spherical metrics, Gaussian densities, and dimensional projections - rendering current formal explanation methods incompatible. In this work, we generalize the ALE framework to support non-Euclidean prototype architectures. For each geometric variant, we systematically derive how to either map the architecture to existing bounds or construct novel, architecture-specific bounding algorithms. We validate our theoretical constructions by computing subset-minimal formal explanations on fully trained image classifiers. By unifying these diverse models under a single formal framework, we enable the first rigorous, cross-architecture comparison of their interpretability.

</details>


### [414] [GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16824)
*Junjie Chu,Ye Leng,Mingjie Li,Yun Shen,Xinyue Shen,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GEOFlagBench基准（3,200个网页、400个查询、8类GEO优化器），系统评估现有GEO检测方法并指出其局限（依赖作者捷径）。在此基础上提出干预配对训练（IPT），将ModernBERT的F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883。并开发GEO门控Agent系统用于审计，实测10,095个真实网页中GEO流行率为8.90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式搜索引擎将信息综合为直接答案而非列出竞争来源，使得GEO优化页面可获得与其权威性不成比例的可见度，甚至让虚假信息显得有据可依。然而现有缺乏系统化的GEO检测方法，且评估来源溯源和权威性需要额外用户交互，风险被进一步放大。

Method: 1) 构建GEOFlagBench基准，覆盖3,200个网页、400个查询、4个领域和8种GEO优化器家族；2) 提出干预配对训练（IPT），通过监督检测器对GEO干预和非GEO AI润色的不同响应来训练检测器；3) 开发GEO门控Agent系统用于审计检测到GEO页面中引用URL的来源层级（Source Tier）和可验证性；4) 在Google Search和Gemini检索结果上部署完整流水线。

Result: 最强基线在GEOFlagBench上达到聚合F1=0.880，但方法级和作者条件评估显示显著弱点，存在依赖作者捷径的潜在问题。IPT将ModernBERT的F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883。在10,095个真实网页上估计GEO整体流行率为8.90%，2026年修改的页面中达16.36%。

Conclusion: 这项工作建立了系统检测、审计和衡量真实搜索生态系统中GEO的基础框架，揭示现有检测方法的不足，并通过IPT和审计Agent实现了显著提升的检测能力与真实世界GEO流行率测量。

Abstract: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 webpages spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.

</details>


### [415] [CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16829)
*Jonathan Sadeghi,Jenny Seidenschwarz,Jesse Allardice,Sirish Srinivasan,Benjamin Graham,Jeffrey Hawke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CaliBench是一个用于评测视频世界模型细粒度随机不确定性的基准，将生成结果映射到物理可解释的离散结果空间（如箱位、骰子面、花色、颜色），并与已知闭合形式的参考分布进行精确校准检验，将性能分解为可评分性（scorability）和校准度（calibration）两个正交维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型评测基准只对单个生成结果打分或在整体数据集上粗略比较分布，未能测试特定物理现象中细粒度的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）。

Method: 提出CaliBench，将输出映射到物理可解释的离散结果空间（如高尔顿板的箱位、伯努利分叉、骰子/卡片/彩票的均匀分布、欧式轮盘颜色偏斜分布），参考分布具有闭合形式。定义两个正交指标：可评分性（生成结果中可计分结果的占比）和校准度（参考分布与样本的总变差距离），使用卡方检验评估显著性；对九个场景和六个图像到视频模型（WAN-2.7、SeeDance-2.0、HappyHorse-1.0、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5、Cosmos3-Super）各做32次生成验证。

Result: 模型系统性倾向于将概率质量集中在少数结果上而非复现参考分布；大多数场景-模型组合显著失准，极端情况下（如Veo 3.1在骰子场景）塌缩到单一结果；轮盘场景中生成常常使球位置模糊导致多个模型低可评分性；没有任何模型在全部九个场景中占优。

Conclusion: 发布评测协议和平均归一化总变差（mnTV）指标，用于将新模型与现有结果进行比较。

Abstract: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over a whole dataset, leaving the fine-grained aleatoric uncertainty of specific phenomena untested. We introduce CaliBench, which scores outcomes in a physically interpretable discrete space - a bin index, a die face, a suit, a colour - rather than a learned feature space such as in FID, so the distance from a known reference distribution is measured directly. We curate outcome spaces whose reference is known in closed form (binomial Galton boards, Bernoulli forks, uniform dice/cards/lottery, a skewed European-roulette colour), enabling an exact calibration test. We decompose performance into two orthogonal axes that a single accuracy metric conflates: scorability, the fraction of generations yielding a scoreable outcome, and calibration, the total variation distance from the reference on that sample. A chi-squared test assesses significance; as calibration is its null hypothesis it can evidence only miscalibration, and at N=32 per cell detects only large deviations. We apply it to nine scenes and six image-to-video models (WAN-2.7, SeeDance-2.0, HappyHorse-1.0, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen-4.5, Cosmos3-Super), 32 generations each. Models consistently concentrate probability mass on a few outcomes rather than reproducing the reference. Most scene-model combinations are significantly miscalibrated, in the extreme collapsing to one outcome, as Veo 3.1 does on dice. On roulette, generations often leave the ball ambiguously placed, giving several models low scorability. Performance varies by scene: no model dominates all nine. We release the protocol and a metric (mean normalised total variation, mnTV) for comparing new models against our results.

</details>


### [416] [Time-Aware Validation of Machine Learning Fuel Consumption Models: Evidence from 1\,Hz Operational Data, CCGS \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier}](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16833)
*Samarasimha Reddy Chittamuru,Ayhan Akinturk,Allison Kennedy,Joshua Barnes,Matthew Hamilton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文聚焦船舶燃油消耗（SFC）预测中验证实践的缺陷，指出多数研究采用随机训练-测试划分会在高频数据中导致时间泄漏和乐观结果。作者以加拿大海岸警卫队船只CCGS Sir Wilfrid Laurier为案例，使用时间感知评估方法（TSCV和BTSCV）对六种回归模型及一个物理基线进行调优，并在约388万条稳态1Hz记录的共同时间顺序留出集上评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SFC预测对船舶运营优化、排放估算和决策支持系统至关重要，但现有大量数据驱动燃油模型的验证实践存在关键缺陷：多数研究使用随机训练-测试划分，应用于高频记录时会造成时间泄漏，导致性能评估过于乐观，无法反映真实部署条件。作者旨在填补这一验证实践上的研究空白。

Method: 采用时间感知评估框架，具体使用时间序列交叉验证（TSCV）和分块时间序列交叉验证（BTSCV）两种方案。以CCGS Sir Wilfrid Laurier为案例，构建六种回归模型与一个物理基线模型，在三种时间感知方案和三种特征配置组合下进行超参数调优，最终在一个共同的时间顺序（chronological）留出测试集上评估性能。数据来源为约388万条稳态1Hz采样记录。

Result: 通过对比随机划分与时间感知评估的结果，揭示随机训练-测试划分在高频船只燃油数据上产生的乐观偏差；TSCV与BTSCV等时间感知方案提供了更贴近真实部署条件的性能估计。具体数值结果摘要中未完全给出。

Conclusion: 论文强调SFC预测模型验证需要采用时间感知策略以反映真实部署场景，避免随机划分带来的时间泄漏；研究为船舶燃油预测领域的评估方法论提供了改进方向。

Abstract: Ship fuel consumption (SFC) prediction supports vessel operation optimisation, emissions estimation, and decision support systems (DSS) for sustainable maritime transportation. Numerous data-driven fuel models have been developed over the past two decades, but a critical and often overlooked limitation lies in their validation practices: most studies evaluate performance using random train--test splits, which, applied to high-frequency records, admit temporal leakage and yield optimistic results that do not reflect deployment conditions. This paper examines that gap using time-aware evaluation, specifically Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV) and Blocked TSCV (BTSCV). Using the Canadian Coast Guard Ship (CCGS) \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier} as a case study, six regression models and a physics baseline are tuned under three time-aware schemes and three feature configurations, then evaluated on a common chronological hold-out set drawn from approximately 3.88 million steady-state 1\,Hz records.

</details>


### [417] [Proteus: Incremental Memory Activation for Long-Context Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16844)
*Reza Bayat,Ali Behrouz,Vahab Mirrokni,Aaron Courville*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"增量记忆激活"范式，通过渐进扩展记忆容量来替代静态记忆，并将其实例化为Proteus机制，可无缝集成到多种神经记忆架构中，在SWLA、Comba、Titans和Hope-Attention等SOTA模型上取得一致的性能提升，尤其是在长上下文场景下收益更显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆模型在整个序列中使用静态记忆，导致早期token缺乏压缩压力，占用过多自由度"污染"记忆状态，降低后期上下文的保留能力并增加干扰。

Method: 提出增量记忆激活范式：记忆的有效容量随上下文增长逐步扩展。早期施加瓶颈强制模型更有效地压缩历史，后续逐步释放新容量以降低干扰并增强后期上下文保留。将其实例化为Proteus机制，以零额外成本集成到各类神经记忆架构中。

Result: 在SWLA、Comba、Titans和Hope-Attention等SOTA模型上应用Proteus，在语言建模、推理、长上下文检索和理解任务上均获得一致改进，且收益随上下文长度增长而增大。

Conclusion: 静态记忆是次优的，调度有效记忆容量是一种简单且广泛适用的序列建模工具。

Abstract: The quadratic cost of attention-based sequence models for long contexts has motivated a growing line of research on memory-based models that can compress context into a compact state. However, most existing memory models expose a static memory throughout the entire sequence. Because early tokens face no compression pressure, they occupy too many degrees of freedom and "pollute" the memory state, leaving little capacity for later context and increasing interference between what is stored and what arrives next. We study a new paradigm of incremental memory activation, where the effective capacity of memory is progressively expanded as the context grows. Imposing an early bottleneck forces the model to compress history more effectively, while unlocking fresh capacity over time reduces interference and improves retention of later context. We instantiate this paradigm in Proteus, a straightforward mechanism that can be incorporated into a broad class of neural memory architectures at no additional cost. We apply Proteus to state-of-the-art models, including SWLA, Comba, Titans, and Hope-Attention, and observe consistent improvements on standard language modeling and reasoning, as well as on long-context retrieval and understanding, with gains that grow at longer context lengths. Overall, our results show that static memory is suboptimal and that scheduling effective capacity is a simple and broadly applicable tool for sequence modeling.

</details>


### [418] [Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16870)
*Serena Su,Yifan Wang,Senwei Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种可解释且数据高效的深度神经网络框架，用于基于轨迹的循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）分类。通过SubSeq靶向增强策略（在训练时随机提取局部轨迹片段）缓解数据稀缺问题，并利用Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping实现物理可解释性，识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征和微流控装置物理区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无标记微流控装置可通过流体动力学障碍物将CTC的尺寸和可变形性等生物物理特性转化为运动学轨迹，但高度非线性的流固耦合使得从轨迹反推细胞表型的逆问题解析上难以处理。虽然深度神经网络能解决该逆问题，但其有效性受限于轨迹数据稀缺和缺乏物理可解释性。

Method: 提出可解释且数据高效的DNN框架，包括：(1) SubSeq靶向增强策略，在训练过程中随机提取信息丰富的局部轨迹片段，促进从局部模式中学习；(2) 应用Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping（Grad-CAM）识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征及微流控装置的物理区域。

Result: SubSeq在分类准确率上优于所评估的基线和其它增强方法；可解释性分析表明局部轨迹片段包含实质性的生物物理信息，足以支撑准确分类。

Conclusion: 局部轨迹包含足够的生物物理信息，验证了SubSeq的合理性，同时揭示了全长度轨迹存在冗余。更广泛地，该框架将微流控几何结构视为细胞力学性质的物理编码器，为未来诊断装置的设计提供机制性见解。

Abstract: Accurate classification of circulating tumor cell (CTC) phenotypes can provide valuable information for assessing metastatic potential. Label free microfluidic devices provide a hydrodynamic obstacle course that transforms subtle biophysical characteristics of CTCs, including size and deformability, into distinct kinematic trajectories. However, the highly nonlinear fluid structure interactions governing these trajectories make the inverse problem of inferring cellular phenotype from trajectory data analytically intractable. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have emerged as a powerful approach for addressing this inverse problem, their effectiveness is constrained by the limited availability of trajectory data and the lack of physical interpretability.
  To address these challenges, we propose an interpretable and data efficient DNN framework for trajectory based CTC classification. To mitigate the scarcity of data, we develop Subsequence (SubSeq), a targeted augmentation strategy that randomly extracts informative local trajectory segments during training to promote learning from localized patterns. We further apply Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping to identify the trajectory features and physical regions of the microfluidic device that drive model predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SubSeq improves classification accuracy over the evaluated baseline and augmentation methods. Furthermore, interpretability analysis suggests that localized trajectory segments contain substantial biophysical information relevant to accurate classification. This provides justification for SubSeq and also highlights the redundancy of full-length trajectories. More broadly, the proposed framework views microfluidic geometries as physical encoders of cellular mechanical properties, providing mechanistic insights that may inform the future design of diagnostic devices.

</details>


### [419] [An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16873)
*Jiaming Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分析先验学习框架，通过复用低成本解析模型来提升高保真仿真数据稀缺条件下的预测效率，适用于侧分支亥姆霍兹谐振器的共振频率预测。实验表明，在仅86个仿真标注几何体和8,998个解析标注几何体的条件下，解析校正SVR将MAE从直接学习的3.375 Hz降至0.426 Hz，解析先验预训练MLP将MAE降至0.371 Hz，显著优于直接学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真有限元仿真能为侧分支谐振器提供精确的数值预测，但生成大规模仿真数据集成本高昂；当仿真标注数据稀缺时，纯数据驱动的代理模型可能不可靠。因此需要一种能在有限高保真仿真预算下提升预测精度的方法。

Method: 提出分析先验学习框架，包含两条互补路线：(1)解析校正路线——在推理时保留解析模型作为显式基线，仅用仿真数据学习解析模型与仿真之间的残差（通过SVR实现）；(2)解析先验蒸馏路线——先用大量低成本的解析模型评估蒸馏出学习先验，再用有限的仿真数据校准该先验（通过MLP预训练后冻结或微调实现）。

Result: 解析模型MAE为1.333 Hz；直接SVR为3.375 Hz，残差SVR降至0.426 Hz；直接MLP为1.109 Hz，而分析先验预训练在冻结先验残差适配下降至0.556 Hz，全模型微调降至0.371 Hz。在20至70个仿真训练样本的预算下，两种解析先验路线均一致提升了数据效率。

Conclusion: 分析先验信息在仿真数据稀缺时能显著提升高保真预测精度；解析显式校正和先验蒸馏两条路线互为补充，分别服务于推理时可调用解析模型和需要自包含预测器的不同部署场景。

Abstract: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogates may become unreliable when simulation-labelled data are scarce. This study develops an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model to improve data efficiency under limited high-fidelity simulation budgets. Two complementary routes are considered. When the analytical model remains available at inference, it is retained as an explicit baseline and the simulation data are used to learn only the analytical-to-simulation discrepancy. When a self-contained predictor is required, the analytical mapping is first distilled from abundant low-cost evaluations into a learned prior and then calibrated with the limited simulation data. The framework is evaluated on rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators using 86 simulation-labelled geometries and 8,998 non-overlapping analytical-only geometries. The analytical model achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.333 Hz. Direct support vector regression (SVR) achieved 3.375 Hz, while residual SVR reduced the MAE to 0.426 Hz. A direct multilayer perceptron (MLP) achieved 1.109 Hz, whereas analytical-prior pretraining reduced the error to 0.556 Hz with frozen-prior residual adaptation and 0.371 Hz with full-model fine-tuning. Across training budgets of 20 to 70 simulation-labelled cases, both analytical correction and analytical-prior pretraining consistently improved data efficiency relative to direct learning. These results show that analytical prior information can substantially improve high-fidelity prediction when simulation data are scarce, with explicit correction and prior distillation serving complementary deployment needs.

</details>


### [420] [Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16888)
*Ondrej Bajgar,Peter Tisnikar,Alessandro Abate,Konstantinos Gatsis,Maike Osborne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QVIRL是一种新颖的贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，通过主要学习最优Q值的变分分布来从专家行为中恢复奖励的后验分布，结合了可扩展性与不确定性量化能力，首次实现从原始像素观测进行贝叶斯IRL训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全且有益的AI需要系统能够学习并遵循人类偏好，但手工指定这些偏好往往不可行。IRL旨在从专家行为中推断偏好（奖励函数），然而现有方法难以同时兼顾可扩展性和不确定性量化，这限制了其在安全关键应用和主动学习中的使用。

Method: QVIRL通过主要学习最优Q值上的变分分布来恢复奖励的后验分布。这一策略绕过了以往在奖励空间上进行推断的难点，将推断聚焦于Q值空间，从而兼顾了贝叶斯不确定性量化与规模化训练的能力。

Result: 在多种任务上展示了强劲的学徒学习表现，包括gridworlds、Lunar Lander、Highway Environment以及两款ATARI游戏，并在静态专家数据和主动学习两种场景下均有效。该方法也是首个能从原始像素观测进行训练的贝叶斯IRL方法。

Conclusion: QVIRL成功将贝叶斯IRL的可扩展性和不确定性量化统一起来，为安全关键应用及主动学习提供了实用的奖励推断方案，并首次将贝叶斯IRL扩展至原始像素级别的视觉输入。

Abstract: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning. We demonstrate QVIRL's strong performance in apprenticeship learning across various tasks, including gridworlds, Lunar Lander, the Highway Environment, and two ATARI games both with static expert data and with active learning. It is the first method for Bayesian IRL that demonstrates training from raw pixel observations.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [421] [SpotlessGS: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting under Dynamic Illumination for Robotic Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14713)
*Liang Hong,Jiaxin Wei,Simon Schaefer,Stefan Leutenegger,Jaehyung Jung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了DarkGS的扩展框架，用于暗光或照明不均环境下机器人的可重光照3D重建。该方法将照明参数联合优化融入Gaussian Splatting，无需显式光校准；采用球谐函数的低频照明模型捕捉空间变化的残余与环境光照；并用MLP驱动的BRDF建模非朗伯反射。在合成与真实数据集上均优于先前方法，并在下游机器人感知任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在暗光或低照度环境中，机器人依赖机载光源照明，但机载光常产生不均匀照明，导致下游感知任务性能下降。先前的2D图像增强方法缺乏可靠的监督信号，且无法保持多视角几何一致性，因此需要一种更精确且灵活的3D重建框架来解决该问题。

Method: 1) 在Gaussian Splatting框架内联合优化照明参数，消除显式光照标定的需求；2) 引入基于球谐函数(SH)的低频照明模型，以捕捉空间变化的残余光照和环境光效应；3) 采用MLP驱动的双向反射分布函数(BRDF)建模非朗伯反射特性。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效减轻了照明伪影，相比先前方法在渲染质量和量化性能上均有提升，并在下游机器人感知任务中验证了实际应用价值。

Conclusion: 将照明参数联合优化、球谐光照建模和MLP-BRDF反射建模集成到DarkGS框架中，能够有效解决暗光不均匀照明下的3D重建问题，为机器人感知提供更可靠的基础。

Abstract: Robots operating in dark or poorly lit environments rely on onboard lights, which often produce uneven illumination that degrades downstream perception tasks. Prior approaches based on 2D image enhancement lack reliable supervision and fail to preserve multi-view geometric consistency. To address these limitations, we extend Dark Gaussian Splatting (DarkGS) toward a more accurate and flexible relightable 3D reconstruction framework. First, we eliminate the need for explicit light parameter calibration by jointly optimizing lighting parameters within the Gaussian Splatting framework. Second, we introduce a low-frequency illumination model based on spherical harmonics (SH) to capture spatially varying residual and ambient lighting effects. Third, we incorporate an MLP-based Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) to model non-Lambertian reflectance. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates illumination artifacts while improving rendering quality and quantitative performance over prior approaches. We further validate its benefits for robotic perception through a downstream task.

</details>


### [422] [MISTac: A Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for Minimally Invasive Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14772)
*Robin Koch,Annabella Mascot,Rayan Younis,Martin Wagner,Stefanie Speidel,Mark Cutkosky,Ingo Sieber,Roberto Calandra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了MISTac，一种专为微创手术（MIS）设计的低成本高分辨率视觉触觉传感器。该传感器具有8mm直径的可更换触头，光学分辨率176.68μm，触觉分辨率250μm，可检测低至24.3mN的力。通过活体实验验证了其可用性，并利用机器学习模型在组织分类任务上达到约84%的交叉验证准确率，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术和机器人辅助手术相比传统开放手术有许多优势，但剥夺了外科医生的触觉反馈和用手指触诊组织的能力。缺乏触觉反馈是MIS中的关键问题，需要一种能够适配trocar且高分辨率的触觉传感器来恢复触诊能力。

Method: 设计了一种基于视觉的触觉传感器MISTac，采用模块化3D打印外壳，可兼容笨重的商用照明和成像硬件且便于更换升级；配备直径8mm的可更换传感器探头以适配MIS的trocar；通过活体实验收集触觉数据，并训练机器学习模型用于组织分类任务，采用留一法交叉验证评估性能。

Result: 传感器达到176.68μm的光学分辨率、250μm的触觉分辨率，可感知低至24.3mN的力；活体实验验证了其在微创手术中的可用性；机器学习模型在组织分类任务上取得约84%的聚合准确率。

Conclusion: MISTac展示了视觉触觉传感器在微创手术中恢复触觉反馈的潜力，未来有望辅助外科医生进行组织分类和术中肿瘤定位等任务，是实现这一愿景的重要一步。传感器已开源。

Abstract: Minimally invasive and robot-assisted surgery offer many advantages over traditional open surgery, but deprive surgeons of tactile feedback and the ability to palpate tissue with their fingers. To address this lack of tactile feedback, we introduce the MISTac, a high resolution vision-based tactile sensor specifically designed for palpation in MIS. The sensor has a replaceable sensor tip with a diameter of 8 mm which allows it to fit through the trocars used in minimally invasive surgery. Its modular 3D-printed case design allows the use of bulky off-the-shelf illumination and imaging hardware that can easily be exchanged and upgraded. The sensor has an optical resolution of 176.68 $μm$, a tactile resolution of 250 $μm$, and can resolve forces as little as 24.3 mN. An in vivo study with the sensor shows its usability in minimally invasive surgery. We trained a machine learning model with the tactile data collected in the trial on a tissue classification task achieving an aggregate accuracy of ~84% in a leave-one-out cross validation. Tactile sensors have the potential to one day aid surgeons during minimally invasive surgery with tasks such as tissue classification or intra-operative tumor localization; MISTac is a small step towards this vision. We open-source MISTac at https://github.com/lasr-lab/mistac

</details>


### [423] [Imagining Recovery: Inference-Time Counterfactual Realignment for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14822)
*Yanyan Zhang,Disheng Liu,Kai Ye,Chaoda Song,Xinpeng Li,Mohsen Hariri,Vikash Singh,Yu Yin,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CoRe是一种免训练的推理时恢复框架，通过想象策略从最近可行状态向当前目标的延续方式，合成观测而非实际执行，然后让机器人与场景最小化对齐以重新接入该想象延续，从而在无需失败数据或策略重训练的情况下恢复冻结的VLA模型，统一处理中期指令变化和物理扰动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽提升了机器人操作的灵活性和泛化性，但对在线干扰（如任务目标变化、场景配置改变或机器人状态扰动）仍很脆弱。现有恢复方法需要失败数据、策略重训练或外部纠错智能体，带来额外数据需求和执行风险。

Method: CoRe的核心是Counterfactual Realignment：在检测到偏差后，策略不进行物理试错，而是从最近一个可行的状态出发，通过合成观测想象策略会如何朝当前目标继续执行，然后最小化地调整机器人和场景以重新接入这一想象的延续轨迹，最后将控制权交还给原策略。整个过程无需训练，统一处理指令更改和物理扰动两类干扰。

Result: 在多个仿真器、多种VLA主干及真实世界场景中，CoRe将成功率提升最多85.0个百分点至接近名义水平，同时物理恢复操作减少42.2%，且无需策略微调或针对失败的恢复训练。

Conclusion: CoRe证明无需失败数据或重训练的免训练推理时恢复是可行且有效的，能够在保留已完成任务进度的同时，以统一框架应对中期指令变化与物理扰动，为VLA模型的在线鲁棒性提供了一种低成本的通用解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have improved the flexibility and generality of robotic manipulation, yet they remain fragile to online disruptions, such as changes in task goal, scene configuration, or robot state. Existing recovery methods often require failure data, policy retraining, or external corrective agents, introducing additional data requirements and execution risks. We propose Counterfactual Realignment (CoRe), a training-free framework that recovers a frozen VLA at inference time without failure data. Upon detecting a deviation, CoRe imagines how the policy would continue toward the current goal from a recent viable state, using synthesized observations in place of physical execution, and then minimally realigns the robot and scene to rejoin this imagined continuation before returning control to the policy. Recovery is therefore planned without physical trial-and-error, preserves completed task progress, and handles both mid-episode instruction changes and physical perturbations in a unified manner. Extensive experiments across multiple simulators, VLA backbones, and real-world settings show that CoRe improves success rates by up to 85.0 percentage points to near-nominal levels while reducing physical restorations by 42.2%, without policy fine-tuning or failure-specific recovery training.

</details>


### [424] [Modeling and Control of an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot for Design Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14860)
*Zhangjingyi Jiang,Mark Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于有限元弹性杆模型与流体动力模型耦合的鳗鲡式仿生软体机器人仿真模型，用于设计和控制优化，并发现轻微非对称设计在保持相近游速的同时具有更高的机动性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鳗鲡式游泳是一种高效游泳模式，软体材料的新进展使得开发鳗鱼启发式软体机器人成为可能；需要一个仿真模型来辅助设计优化以及支持基于模型的估计、推理和控制系统的开发。

Method: 采用弹性杆的有限元方法来捕捉软体鱼机器人的软材料特性（该模型便于随时间变化以适应材料属性变化），并将材料模型与流体动力模型耦合，以模拟软体细长机器人在水中的行为。

Result: 模型证明了所提出的控制方法在实现期望游泳行为方面的有效性，并提供了设计决策方面的见解，包括不同系统配置的鲁棒性以及材料退化与失效的影响。结果表明，轻微非对称设计更具优势，能提供相当的游泳速度但更高的机动性。

Conclusion: 该模型可用于指导未来的机器人设计决策，以针对特定任务优化性能。

Abstract: Anguilliform locomotion is a highly efficient swimming mode; the advent of new materials for soft robots enables the development of an eel-inspired soft robot. This paper presents a simulation model of an eel-inspired soft robot designed for anguilliform swimming. This model can aid in design optimization and the development of model-based estimation, reasoning, and control systems. A Finite Element Method (FEM) model of an elastic rod is used to capture the soft materials of the robotic fish, which makes it particularly amenable to variation over time as the material properties change. The material model is coupled with a hydrodynamic force model to simulate the behavior of a soft, elongated robot in water. The model is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control approaches in achieving desired swimming behaviors. It also provides insights into design decisions, including the robustness of different system configurations and the impact of material degradation and failure. The results show that slightly asymmetric designs are advantageous, offering comparable swimming velocities but greater maneuverability. This model can be used to guide future robotic design decisions aimed at optimizing performance for specific tasks.

</details>


### [425] [Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health (REACH) on an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14865)
*Zhangjingyi Jiang,Myungsun Park,Michael T. Tolley,Mark Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出REACH算法，用于软体游泳机器人执行器的健康状态实时估计。该算法结合软体机器人模型、sigma point滤波器和统计假设检验，能很好地捕捉非线性特性和时间变化。实验比较了三种传感器类型、不同传感器数量与布局以及三种游泳步态，并在鱼形机器人弯曲传感器数据上验证了其在噪声和制造差异下的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下机器人的作业环境恶劣，且软体机器人材料和执行器容易发生退化。在发生执行器退化或失效时，机器人需要准确估计执行器功能状态，以完成既定任务并安全返回基地。

Method: 开发了名为REACH（Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health）的架构，由软体机器人模型、sigma point滤波器（无迹卡尔曼滤波类方法）和形式化统计假设检验组成，用以捕捉非线性动态及时间变化。实验设计包括：比较三种传感器类型（GPS、IMU、弯曲传感器），评估IMU和弯曲传感器的数量与放置位置，对比三种游泳步态（直线游泳、大转弯、急转弯），并采用滤波验证方法检验故障估计算法的统计一致性。

Result: 弯曲传感器和IMU都是合适的传感器选择；IMU仅需两个传感器即可，而弯曲传感器需要三个；REACH在三种游泳步态下均能成功预测执行器健康状态，性能差异很小；滤波器验证方法表明故障估计算法在统计上能一致地找到正确的退化；在鱼形机器人的弯曲传感器实测数据上，REACH在噪声数据和制造差异条件下仍能成功估计执行器健康。

Conclusion: REACH算法能够实时、准确且统计一致地估计软体游泳机器人执行器的健康状态，对传感器类型、数量、布局和步态具有较强的鲁棒性，且在实际噪声数据和制造变化场景下依然有效，为软体水下机器人的可靠运行与安全返航提供了保障。

Abstract: An actuator health estimation algorithm for a soft swimming robot that can perform anguilliform swimming is developed. Due to harsh operational environments of underwater robots, and the common degradation of soft robot materials and actuators, accurate estimation of actuator functionality is necessary for robots to perform their missions as well as return to base in the event of actuator degradation and failure. Termed REACH (Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health), the architecture employs a soft robot model, sigma point filter, and a formal statistical hypothesis test to adequately capture the nonlinearities and changes over time. The performance of REACH using three sensor types (GPS, IMU, and Bend Sensor) with one sensor on each actuator is compared, demonstrating that both bend sensor and IMU are adequate choices. Sensor quantity and placement are evaluated for IMU and bend sensor, showing two sensors are sufficient for IMU, whereas three sensors are needed for bend sensor. Three swimming gaits (linear swimming, wide turning, tight turning) are compared, demonstrating that REACH can successfully predict actuator health for all three gaits, with minimal differences in performance. A filter validation method shows the fault estimation algorithm is statistically consistent in finding the correct degradation. The approach is experimentally evaluated using bend sensor data collected from a fish robot, demonstrating that REACH can successfully estimate actuator health with noisy data and variations in manufacturing.

</details>


### [426] [Geometry-Aware Online Mapping for 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14902)
*Thai Luu,Quan Tran,Hieu Phan,Tuan Dang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对3DGS-SLAM系统中从离线重建继承的初始化和密度控制启发式在在线SLAM严格优化预算下脆弱的问题，提出三种几何感知方法（透射率保持的稠密化、基于相机内参和深度的尺度初始化、误差引导的稠密化），在解耦的3DGS-SLAM映射线程中提升渲染质量且开销可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS-SLAM系统需要对高斯地图进行增量扩展和细化，但大多数管线直接沿用离线3DGS重建的初始化和密度控制启发式方法。这些启发式方法在离线长优化调度下可以摊销，但在在线SLAM严格的每关键帧优化预算和增量地图增长条件下变得脆弱，导致渲染质量和映射稳定性下降。

Method: 在解耦的3DGS-SLAM映射线程中提出三种几何感知方法：1) 透射率保持的稠密化（transmittance-preserving densification），避免过度稠密化并保持几何一致性；2) 相机感知的尺度初始化（camera-aware scale initialization），利用深度和相机内参为高斯原语初始化合理的尺度；3) 误差引导的稠密化（error-guided densification），将新原语聚焦在高残差区域。

Result: 实验结果表明，三种方法在渲染质量上取得一致性的改进，且计算开销可忽略不计，同时揭示了在线SLAM中光度残差与位姿不确定性之间的耦合关系。

Conclusion: 重新审视并设计适配在线SLAM几何特性的初始化与密度控制策略可以有效提升3DGS-SLAM的渲染质量，代码将开源以促进社区发展和结果可复现性验证。

Abstract: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient photorealistic view synthesis and is rapidly being adopted in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) systems for online mapping. In these systems, a Gaussian map must be expanded and refined incrementally while tracking runs in real time, so initialization and density control directly determine where limited computation and iterations are spent. This contrasts with offline 3DGS reconstruction, where such heuristics can be amortized over long optimization schedules. However, most 3DGS-SLAM pipelines inherit initialization and density-control heuristics from offline reconstruction, which can become brittle under the strict per-keyframe optimization budgets and incremental map growth of online SLAM. In this work, we revisit these heuristics in a decoupled 3DGS-SLAM setting and propose three geometry-aware methods that operate in the mapping thread: transmittance-preserving densification, camera-aware scale initialization from depth and intrinsics, and error-guided densification that focuses new primitives on high-residual regions. Our results show consistent improvements in rendering quality with negligible overhead, highlighting the coupling between photometric residuals and pose uncertainty in online SLAM. We will open-source our code to the community to foster growth and validate reproducibility.

</details>


### [427] [From Continuous Design to Delay-Aware Discrete Synthesis: Guaranteed High-Bandwidth Joint Control for PMSM Drives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14937)
*Edmundo Pozo Fortunić,Mehmet C. Yildirim,Sami Haddadin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种任务感知、考虑延迟扩展的离散时间关节模型，用于直接合成具有指定带宽和延迟保证的离散PI电流控制器，并解析确定最小采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压需求，相比传统连续时间设计方法可显著降低采样频率和母线电压要求，仿真与实验均验证了该框架的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器人关节的动态需求日益提高，要求电流控制器在高带宽下运行于较宽的速度、加速度和转矩工作范围，此时通信、计算和离散时间效应不可忽略。而传统PMSM电流控制器通常在连续时间域设计后再离散化，采样频率和实现延迟的影响主要依靠启发式选择和迭代验证来确定，缺乏系统化的设计方法。

Method: 提出任务感知、延迟扩展的离散时间关节模型，显式建模物理通信和计算延迟；基于该模型直接综合离散PI电流控制器，给出带宽和延迟保证；解析推导最小采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压的确定公式，以满足指定的电机与关节性能要求。

Result: 仿真结果表明，相比传统连续时间设计方法，所提框架在满足相同动态要求下可显著降低采样频率和直流母线电压需求；在自主开发的自定义机器人关节上的实验进一步在真实嵌入式实现条件下验证了该框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的延迟扩展离散时间关节模型及相应的离散PI控制器直接综合方法，为机器人关节电流控制器提供了一种系统化、任务感知的设计途径，在保证带宽和延迟指标的同时有效降低采样频率和母线电压资源需求，并在实际嵌入式平台中得到验证。

Abstract: The increasing dynamic demands of modern robotic joints require current controllers to achieve high bandwidth over wide operating ranges of speed, acceleration, and torque, where communication, computation, and discrete-time effects can no longer be neglected. Conventional PMSM current controllers are typically designed in continuous time and subsequently discretized, leaving the sampling frequency and the impact of implementation delays largely to heuristic selection and iterative validation. This paper introduces a task-aware, delay-extended discrete-time joint model that explicitly accounts for physical communication and computation delays and enables direct synthesis of a discrete PI current controller with prescribed bandwidth and delay guarantees throughout the operating envelope. The framework analytically determines the minimum required sampling frequency, controller gains, and DC-link voltage needed to satisfy the specified motor and joint performance. Simulations across a range of dynamic requirements validate the methodology and demonstrate substantially reduced sampling-frequency and DC-link-voltage requirements compared with conventional continuous-time-based design. Experiments on a newly developed custom robotic joint further validate the proposed framework under real embedded implementation conditions.

</details>


### [428] [SkillComposer: Learning Reusable Skills for Natural-Language Robot Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14944)
*John Woods,Hasti Seifi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkillComposer是一个交互式自然语言机器人编程系统，采用生成-测试架构，让LLM迭代生成并修正机器人程序，并将成功的程序通过在线库学习算法压缩为可复用的宏技能，从而持续学习可重用的程序抽象。在操作和机器人照护任务的消融实验及12名参与者的用户研究中，评估者引导的生成和学习到的抽象提高了成功率与可用性，同时减少了用户编程努力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言接口可以降低机器人编程门槛，但现有系统在处理复杂任务时表现不佳。虽然LLM擅长简单指令，但在生成多步骤任务代码、分解高层指令以及复用先前解决方案方面存在困难。作者旨在解决这一瓶颈，使机器人编程系统能够处理复杂、多步骤的用户请求。

Method: SkillComposer采用生成-测试（generate-test）架构：LLM迭代地生成并修订机器人程序，直到通过执行验证。成功的程序被存储，并通过在线库学习算法（online library-learning）将重复出现的函数序列压缩为可复用的宏技能（macro skills），供未来任务使用，从而实现持续的技能抽象学习。

Result: 通过消融实验和12名参与者的用户研究，在机器人操纵与照护任务上评估了系统有效性。结果显示，评估者引导的程序生成和学习到的抽象技能显著提升了任务成功率与系统可用性，同时降低了用户编写自然语言机器人程序所需的努力。

Conclusion: SkillComposer证明了结合LLM的生成-测试架构与在线技能库学习能够有效提升自然语言机器人编程在复杂多步任务上的表现，持续学习的可重用宏技能是减少用户负担和提升系统实用性的关键因素。

Abstract: Natural-language interfaces can lower the barrier to programming robots, but existing systems struggle when users request complex tasks. While large language models (LLMs) perform well with simple commands, they often struggle to generate code for multi-step tasks, decompose high-level instructions, or reuse prior solutions. We present SkillComposer, an interactive natural-language robot programming system for simulation environments that continually learns reusable program abstractions. SkillComposer uses a generate-test architecture in which an LLM iteratively generates and revises robot programs before execution. Successful programs are stored and processed by an online library-learning algorithm that compresses recurring function sequences into reusable macro skills for future tasks. We evaluate SkillComposer through ablation experiments and a user study with 12 participants to determine its effectiveness on manipulation and robot caregiving tasks. The results show that evaluator-guided generation and learned abstractions improve success rates and usability while reducing user effort in natural-language robot programming.

</details>


### [429] [Evidence of Absence: Cross-Modal Abductive Risk Perception to Sustain World Models When Vision Fails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14952)
*Cong Xu,Ravi Sankar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模态无关的溯因推理框架，通过将"预期共证缺失"视为隐藏原因的证据，利用声学模态在视觉退化和遮挡条件下维持世界模型。麦克风阵列前端估计声源方位与接近率，触发对隐藏道路使用者的溯因推断并发出校准后的风险提示。在真实遮挡路口测试中，该方法比视觉通道提前1.7秒预警，误报率降低42%，定位中位误差3.4度，校准误差0.034，且在视觉严重退化下保持高态势感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的结构化世界状态模型依赖视觉观测来填充实体、关系和上下文，但当主要视觉模态被遮挡或退化时，观测缺失导致世界模型无法维持。需要一种能够从互补模态中持续维持世界状态的方法，将缺失的共证视为隐藏原因的线索。

Method: 构建模态无关的溯因推理框架，在声学场景中实例化：麦克风阵列前端估计发动机和轮胎声源的方位，提取接近率证据（稳态音调用多普勒，宽带信号用临近读出）；当"签名存在但视觉共证缺失"时触发隐藏道路使用者的溯因推断。隐藏状态可恢复性通过可辨识性分析（区分共享与模态独有信息）评估，提示以奈曼-皮尔逊检测形式在显式误报预算下实现。

Result: 在真实盲区路口的遮挡接近录音中：平均比视线进入提前1.7秒预警；与已发表声学基线的持续窗口变体检测率匹配但误报减少42%；一旦进入视野中位定位误差3.4度；校准良好（ECE=0.034）；在分级视觉退化下态势感知保持在0.87以上，而纯视觉通道降至0.03。校准可几乎无损迁移到未见路口，但签名分类器不可迁移；移动自我噪声是部署的约束瓶颈。

Conclusion: 溯因推理能够从声学互补模态有效维持隐藏道路使用者的世界状态，并提供校准的风险提示而非控制指令。方法在预警时间、误报率、定位精度和校准质量上表现优异，但存在局限性：签名分类器的跨场景泛化不足以及移动自我噪声的干扰，这些是未来部署需解决的核心问题。

Abstract: A structured world-state (entities, relations, context, and predictive cues) is designed to preserve prediction-critical content when perception degrades, but it presumes observations to populate it; when the primary visual modality is occluded or degraded, those observations may be missing. We address how to sustain the world model from a complementary modality by treating the absence of expected co-evidence as evidence of a hidden cause. The abductive framework is modality-agnostic; this article instantiates it acoustically. A microphone-array front-end estimates the bearing of engine and tire sources and extracts approach-rate evidence (Doppler when a stable tone exists, a broadband looming readout otherwise); the event "signature present, visual co-evidence absent" then triggers abductive inference of a hidden road user, emitting a calibrated risk advisory rather than a control command. Recoverability of the hidden state is analyzed as an identifiability question separating shared from modality-unique information, and cueing is cast as Neyman-Pearson detection under an explicit false-alarm budget. On real occluded-approach recordings at blind junctions, the method warns a mean 1.7 seconds before line-of-sight entry, matches the sustained-window variant of the published acoustic baseline's detection rate with 42% fewer false alarms, localizes to 3.4 degrees median once in view, is well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.034), and keeps hazard awareness above 0.87 under staged vision degradation that collapses a vision-only channel to 0.03. We also measure the method's limits: calibration transfers to an unseen junction almost losslessly, the signature classifier does not, and moving-ego noise is the binding deployment constraint.

</details>


### [430] [GaussMemory: Task-Driven 3D Gaussian Scene Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14986)
*Zhiqiang Hu,Shouren Huang,Masatoshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GaussMemory，一种将机器人3D空间记忆从被动存储转变为主动、任务驱动的范式。通过端到端学习如何"记住"（哪些物体需精确追踪、如何激进更新、该丢弃什么），并将记忆更新与读取统一为同一认知过程的双向流动。基于3D高斯泼溅实现，在LIBERO和VLABench上均超越现有最强方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D记忆系统只是被动记录器，采用固定手工规则存储观测，对关键抓取目标和无关背景等所有场景元素一视同仁，缺乏任务驱动的选择性记忆能力，限制了长时程机器人操作任务的性能。

Method: 提出主动任务驱动空间记忆范式，将记忆更新与读取统一为同一认知过程的两个侧面，实现任务需求与更新策略之间的双向信息流动。具体实例化为GaussMemory，以3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）作为持久几何基底，端到端学习记忆策略（追踪哪些对象、更新多激进、丢弃什么），无需手工设计规则。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上，GaussMemory在Goal和Long-10任务上超越MemoryVLA；在VLABench基准上，相比π₀-FAST在Track 1提升+5.2%，Track 6提升+6.0%。

Conclusion: 实验验证了主动、任务驱动的空间记忆范式在长时程机器人操作中的有效性，证明记忆系统应从"记录所见"演进为"学习如何记忆"，通过更新与读取的双向耦合理解提升任务表现。

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally relies on persistent spatial memory. However, existing 3D memory systems function merely as passive recorders: they store observations using fixed, hand-crafted rules, treating every scene element--whether a critical grasp target or an irrelevant background wall--with equal importance. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from passive storage to active, task-driven spatial memory. We argue that a robot's memory should not simply record what it sees, but actively learn how to remember--discovering which objects to track precisely, how aggressively to update them, and what to discard, all learned end-to-end without hand-designed rules. Crucially, this active paradigm is realized by unifying memory update and readout as two sides of the same cognitive process, enabling bidirectional flow where task needs shape update strategies and vice versa. To instantiate this vision, we introduce GaussMemory, which leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting as a persistent geometric substrate. On LIBERO, GaussMemory outperforms MemoryVLA on Goal and Long-10; on VLABench, it surpasses $π_0$-FAST by +5.2% (Track 1) and +6.0% (Track 6).

</details>


### [431] [HP2-SLAM: Adaptive Hybrid ICP for Robust and Efficient LiDAR SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14996)
*Nam Tran,Thu Tran,Hieu Phan,Thai Luu,Toan Nguyen,William J. Beksi,Tuan Dang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HP2-SLAM是一个极简且鲁棒的LiDAR SLAM框架，核心是基于邻域大小自适应的混合ICP（结合点到平面与点到点残差），通过平面感知的自适应阈值动态分类对应关系，在无需特征工程、学习模块或数据集特定调参的情况下，在结构化与退化环境中均能稳定对齐，并在多个公开数据集上超越强几何基线，同时保持实时性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LiDAR SLAM中同时实现鲁棒性、精度和效率仍是一大挑战。学习式方法虽然基准性能强，但需要大量训练和计算资源且难以泛化到未知或退化环境；几何方法虽高效可解释，但在平面或重复场景中因标准ICP表述的限制而性能下降。作者旨在通过精心设计的几何自适应方法，在不牺牲简洁性和效率的前提下达到强泛化与鲁棒性。

Method: 提出HP2-SLAM框架，核心是邻域大小自适应的混合ICP。关键洞察在于设计了一个平面感知的自适应阈值，依据局部几何结构和密度动态分类对应关系，从而在点到平面与点到点残差之间建立原理性的平衡。该框架集成进完整的SLAM流程，包含子图管理、回环检测和位姿图优化，且无需特征工程、学习模块或特定数据集的调优。

Result: HP2-SLAM在多个公开数据集上持续优于强几何基线方法，同时在 commodity 硬件上保持实时运行性能。实验结果验证了精心设计的几何自适应策略能够在保持简单和高效的同时实现强泛化与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过纯几何自适应的巧妙设计，HP2-SLAM证明了在无需引入学习模块的前提下，可以有效平衡点到平面与点到点残差以适应不同几何结构，从而同时解决鲁棒性、精度和效率的三重挑战，为LiDAR SLAM提供了一种简洁而强有力的解决方案。

Abstract: Achieving robustness, accuracy, and efficiency simultaneously remains a central challenge in light detection and ranging (LiDAR) simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). While learning-based approaches deliver strong benchmark performance, they often require extensive training, substantial computational resources, and struggle to generalize to unseen or degenerate environments. Geometry-based methods are efficient and interpretable, yet their performance degrades in planar or repetitive scenes due to limitations of standard iterative closest point (ICP) formulations. We present HP2-SLAM, a minimalist yet robust LiDAR SLAM framework built around a neighborhood-size adaptive hybrid ICP. Our key insight is a planarity-aware adaptive threshold that dynamically classifies correspondences based on local geometric structure and density, thereby enabling a principled balance between point-to-plane and point-to-point residuals. This formulation stabilizes alignment in both structured and degenerate environments without feature engineering, learning modules, or dataset-specific tuning. Integrated into a complete SLAM pipeline with submap management, loop closure detection, and pose graph optimization, HP2-SLAM consistently outperforms strong geometry-based baselines across publicly available datasets while maintaining real-time performance on commodity hardware. Our results demonstrate that carefully designed geometric adaptation can achieve strong generalization and robustness without sacrificing simplicity or efficiency.

</details>


### [432] [NPU Offloading of a Frozen Visual Encoder for Robot Policy Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15002)
*Hyojun Yun,Seungjae Won,Hyungpil Moon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究将冷冻视觉编码器的计算从GPU迁移到低功耗NPU（Mobilint Aries2）上，以降低机器人策略训练能耗。通过构建GPU+NPU异步训练流水线（AR-Actor专家），在四种卸载条件（L1-L4）下对比GPU-only基线，结果显示能量每样本降低17.1%-27.9%，但训练时间每样本增加15.2%-37.7%，GPU内存峰值降低19.8%-20.7%，政策成功率下降0.44-1.89个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人策略训练中，冷冻视觉编码器虽可跳过反向传播，但每步仍需前向计算并占用GPU资源。作者希望探究将这些前向计算迁移到低功耗AI加速器（NPU）是否能降低总能耗，同时评估其对训练时间和策略性能的影响。

Method: 构建了GPU与NPU异步训练流水线：冷冻视觉编码器以A8W8 INT8精度运行在Mobilint Aries2 NPU上，FP32动作专家在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU上训练。设置四种NPU卸载条件（L1：ResNet18+1层编码器；L4：ResNet18+全部4层编码器），每个条件训练30,000步、3个随机种子，测量GPU/NPU板级功耗，并用300个环境种子评估策略（共4,500次模拟回放）。

Result: 相比GPU-only基线：L1能量每样本降低17.1%，L4降低27.9%；训练时间每样本L1增加15.2%、L4增加37.7%；GPU内存峰值降低19.8%-20.7%。成功率方面，GPU-only为93.33%，NPU条件为91.44%-92.89%，下降0.44-1.89个百分点。

Conclusion: NPU卸载冷冻视觉编码器可以显著降低训练能耗并减少GPU内存占用，但代价是训练时间延长和策略成功率轻微下降。该结果表明能耗优化与训练效率、策略性能之间存在权衡，NPU卸载是减少训练计算能耗的可行方案。

Abstract: When a robot policy is trained for a new task or dataset, its visual encoder can be frozen and only its action generation module trained, reducing training cost. Freezing removes the encoder's backward pass, but its forward pass must still run at every training step because the input images change, so it keeps consuming GPU compute. We therefore ask whether moving this computation to a low power AI accelerator such as an NPU can reduce total energy despite the added data transfer and longer training time, and how it affects policy performance. We built an asynchronous training pipeline that uses both a GPU and an NPU for the AR-Actor specialist. The frozen visual encoder runs in A8W8 INT8 on a Mobilint Aries2 NPU, while the FP32 action expert is trained on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU. We compared a GPU-only baseline with four conditions, L1 to L4, which gradually extend NPU offloading from one to four Transformer encoder layers. Each condition was trained for 30,000 steps with three random seeds. We measured GPU board power for the GPU-only condition and combined GPU and NPU board power for the NPU conditions. Energy per sample decreased by 17.1% in L1, which offloaded ResNet18 and the first encoder layer, and by 27.9% in L4, which offloaded ResNet18 and all four encoder layers. In contrast, training time per sample increased by 15.2% in L1 and 37.7% in L4, and peak allocated GPU memory decreased by 19.8 to 20.7%. The 15 resulting policies were each evaluated with the same 300 environment seeds, for a total of 4,500 simulator rollouts. The combined success rate was 93.33% for GPU-only and 91.44 to 92.89% for the NPU conditions. These results show that NPU offloading of a frozen visual encoder can reduce training energy, but it increases training time and lowers policy success rate by 0.44 to 1.89 percentage points compared with GPU-only training.

</details>


### [433] [ForceU-VLA: A Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Ultrasound Scanning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15009)
*Xingzheng Wu,Cheng Zhang,Guihao Yan,Xifeng Hu,Zhi Liu,Qing Cai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ForceU-VLA，一种力感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过力信号与超声图像反馈的协同融合以及阶段自适应调制机制，实现自主具身超声扫描，并配套发布了包含约10万帧多模态数据的真实世界力感知超声数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身超声扫描方法存在两个关键缺陷：一是力模态与超声模态之间的建模耦合松散，难以捕捉动态的探头-组织交互；二是缺乏对扫描阶段的自适应感知，导致在不同扫描阶段无法灵活调整策略。

Method: 提出ForceU-VLA模型，包含两个核心组件：1）Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM)，协同融合超声视觉信息与力反馈信息，为探头运动提供稳定可靠的引导；2）Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM)，通过自适应调制多模态特征以适应不同扫描阶段的任务需求。此外还构建了ForceU-VLA-Data真实世界力感知超声数据集。

Result: 实验结果表明ForceU-VLA在具身超声扫描中显著提升了接触稳定性和探头压力调控能力，有效增强了任务执行质量和系统整体可靠性。数据集包含两个器官、五种临床扫描视图、450条专家采集轨迹及约10万帧同步多模态帧。

Conclusion: 通过力感知的多模态融合与阶段自适应调制，ForceU-VLA有效解决了超声扫描中力-超声模态松散耦合和缺乏阶段感知的问题，为自动化超声检查提供了更可靠的技术方案。

Abstract: Embodied intelligent ultrasound scanning enables the automation and standardization of the ultrasound examination process by integrating perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. However, existing methods suffer from loosely coupled modeling between force and ultrasound modalities and lack awareness of scanning stages, which limits their ability to capture dynamic probe-tissue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ForceU-VLA, a force-aware Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous embodied ultrasound scanning, which leverages force signals and ultrasound image feedback throughout the scanning process to enable accurate and high-quality ultrasound acquisition. Firstly, we propose a Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM) that synergistically fuses ultrasound visual and force-feedback information to provide stable, reliable guidance for probe motion. Secondly, a Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM) is proposed to accommodate the task requirements across different scanning stages by adaptively modulating multimodal features to enhance their representation quality. Additionally, we introduce ForceU-VLA-Data, a real-world, force-aware embodied ultrasound dataset that integrates visual, force, and action signals, including data from two organs across five representative clinical scanning views, and comprising 450 expert-collected trajectories with approximately 100,000 synchronized multimodal frames. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that ForceU-VLA significantly improves contact stability and probe pressure regulation in embodied ultrasound scanning, thereby effectively enhancing task execution quality and overall system reliability. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/ForceU-VLA.

</details>


### [434] [MotionGS-SLAM: Event-Modulated Gaussian Splatting for Motion-Blur Robust SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15024)
*Zhiqiang Hu,Shouren Huang,Masatoshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MotionGS-SLAM提出一种范式转换：不试图去模糊，而是将运动模糊建模为渲染管线中的前向问题。利用事件相机的高时间分辨率，通过事件调制的高斯核（空间各向异性椭圆调制+时间曝光积分采样密度调制）实现模糊感知的SLAM，联合优化曝光内相机轨迹和3D场景几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于视觉的SLAM系统在运动模糊条件下性能灾难性退化，因为它们尝试解决从退化观测中恢复清晰内容的病态逆问题（ill-posed inverse problem），这本质上是不适定的。

Method: 1）将模糊处理从逆问题重构为良态前向问题，在渲染管线中显式建模模糊生成过程；2）利用事件相机微秒级时间分辨率，提出事件调制高斯核（event-modulated Gaussian kernel）；3）双调制机制：空间调制将2D高斯投影从各向同性点变换为沿运动方向对齐的各向异性椭圆笔触，时间调制根据局部速度自适应调整曝光积分采样密度；4）通过模糊感知的光度约束和事件约束联合优化曝光内相机轨迹与3D场景几何。

Result: 在剧烈高动态运动条件下，与最先进方法相比，在轨迹精度和地图质量方面取得了显著改进。

Conclusion: 物理驱动的模糊建模与事件相机结合是一种有效且鲁棒的SLAM运动模糊处理方案，证明了将降质过程纳入渲染前向建模而非逆恢复是更优的技术路线。

Abstract: Current Vision-based SLAM systems fail catastrophically when motion blur corrupts the visual input, as they attempt the ill-posed inverse problem of recovering sharp content from degraded observations.
