We present MotionGS-SLAM, which fundamentally reimagines motion blur handling through a paradigm shift: rather than removing blur artifacts, we reformulate the challenge as a well-constrained forward problem that generatively models blur formation within the rendering pipeline. By leveraging event cameras' microsecond temporal resolution and immunity to motion blur, we introduce a novel event-modulated Gaussian kernel that dynamically adapts each Gaussian's rasterization based on precise motion cues. Our dual-modulation mechanism transforms 2D Gaussian projections from isotropic dots into anisotropic, motion-aligned elliptical brush strokes (spatial modulation) while adaptively varying exposure integral sampling density based on local velocity (temporal modulation). This physics-based approach enables joint optimization of intra-exposure camera trajectories and 3D scene geometry through blur-aware photometric and event-based constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods in trajectory accuracy and map quality under severe high-motion conditions.

</details>


### [435] [PACE: Phase-Progress-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15026)
*Chengye Song,Jiawei Zhang,Rui Song,Shengqi Wang,Xiangrong Zhang,Ziyi Wang,Huanbin Zhou,Hongzhou Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PACE是一个面向长时程操作任务的信用分配框架，通过阶段进度感知评论家（GLC-Critic）和渐进式策略蒸馏（PPD）实现步骤级信用分配，在仿真和真实机器人实验中均显著超越最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程操作任务中，单个episode跨越数百个控制步骤和多个阶段，但成功/失败仅在episode结束时才揭晓，缺乏步骤级信用信号来区分推进任务与停滞或倒退的行为，因此需要信用分配机制来促进策略改进。

Method: PACE包含两个核心模块：(1) GLC-Critic（全局-局部协作价值修正评论家）：在局部时间窗口内聚合视觉和运动差异特征，推断每步的阶段和阶段内进度，并对离散化的剩余成本分布进行残差修正，实现步骤级信用分配；(2) PPD（渐进式策略蒸馏）：通过任务级阈值将信用转化为正负条件，训练信用条件化的动作生成策略，先用高信用正样本保护预训练策略，再结合正负信用学习质量边界，推理时通过条件输出的差异放大高信用行为。

Result: 在大量仿真实验和多种真实机械臂实验中，PACE一致性地实现了对最强基线的显著改进。

Conclusion: PACE通过阶段进度感知的信用分配有效解决了长时程操作中策略后训练缺乏步骤级监督信号的问题，验证了其在仿真和真实环境中的广泛适用性和有效性。

Abstract: Post-training of vision-language-action (VLA) models typically relies on expert demonstrations and policy interaction trajectories. However, in long-horizon manipulation, a single episode often spans hundreds of control steps and multiple phases, while success or failure is only revealed at episode termination. Policy improvement therefore requires step-level credit signals to distinguish behaviors that advance the task from those that stall or regress. We present PACE, a credit-assignment framework for post-training on long-horizon manipulation, centered on a phase-progress-aware critic. PACE consists of two key modules: (1) the Global-Local Cooperative Value-Correction Critic (GLC-Critic) aggregates visual and motion-difference features within local temporal windows to infer the phase and intra-phase progress of each step, and applies residual correction to a discretized remaining-cost distribution accordingly, enabling step-level credit assignment; (2) Progressive Policy Distillation (PPD) converts credit into positive and negative conditions via task-wise thresholds and trains a credit-conditioned action generation policy: it first protects the pretrained policy with high-credit positive samples, then incorporates all positive and negative credits to learn the quality boundary, and at inference amplifies high-credit behaviors through the difference between conditional outputs. Extensive simulation experiments and diverse real-world robotic-arm experiments demonstrate that PACE consistently achieves significant improvements over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [436] [Max-Q Selective Imitation for Human-in-the-Loop Online Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15088)
*Zihang Wang,Yishan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于人机交互（Human-in-the-loop）在线强化学习的机器人训练方法，包含两个核心组件：MC Q-chunk评论家（通过蒙特卡洛回报进行分块级行动值回归，对干预轨迹进行样本平均策略评估）和最大Q选择性模仿（在每状态以硬胜者全取规则在高Q动作与策略动作间选择，实现干预学习与自主改进的自动切换）。在真实USB插拔任务中，该方法仅需30分钟训练即达99%成功率，远超HIL-SERL的5小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机交互在线强化学习需要在快速吸收人类干预的同时，还能持续超越人类先验知识进行自我改进。现有方法存在两个核心问题：干预轨迹被当前策略的TD备份稀释，无法被直接充分利用；以及策略与目标样本分布之间的差距导致执行时分布偏移。

Method: 该方法由两部分组成：(1) MC Q-chunk评论家：将分块级动作值回归到重放缓冲区的蒙特卡洛回报上，执行样本平均（行为）策略评估，使干预轨迹被直接计分而非被当前策略TD备份稀释。(2) 最大Q选择性模仿：在每个状态下，以硬胜者全取规则在当前策略动作与缓冲区样本之间选择较高Q值的动作来更新actor。当自主策略更强时，目标与策略分布对齐，从而减少策略-目标样本间隙。实践中使用标准critic集成均值进行候选评分以降低比较噪声，不软化目标也不引入分数差距阈值。

Result: 在真实USB插拔任务上（20个演示），ACT QChunk-MCBC在30分钟HIL训练内达到99%成功率，而HIL-SERL需约5小时收敛。在仿真Peg Insertion和Square任务中，ACT/Flow Q-chunk变体在约半小时有效训练内达到不低于96%的成功率，在成功率-时间前沿上优于HIL-SERL、EXPO和E2HiL。

Conclusion: 实验证明该训练方法能同时实现快速吸收人类干预与持续自主改进，在真实和仿真机器人任务上均显著优于现有HIL强化学习方法，验证了MC Q-chunk评论家与最大Q选择性模仿的有效性。

Abstract: Human-in-the-loop (HIL) online reinforcement learning for real robots must absorb human interventions quickly while continuing to improve beyond the human prior. We present a training method for this setting based on two components. First, an \emph{MC Q-chunk} critic regresses chunk-level action values onto Monte Carlo returns from the replay buffer, performing sample-average (behavior) policy evaluation so that intervention trajectories are credited directly rather than diluted by current-policy TD backups. Second, \emph{max-Q selective imitation} updates the actor by imitating, at each state, the higher-$Q$ action between the current policy action and a buffer sample under a hard winner-take-all rule. This rule automatically switches between learning from interventions and on-policy self-improvement: when the autonomous policy is stronger, targets align with the policy distribution, reducing the policy--target-sample gap that otherwise induces execution-time distribution shift. In practice we score candidates with a standard critic ensemble mean to reduce comparison noise, without softening targets or introducing score-gap thresholds. On a real USB pick-and-insertion task with 20 demonstrations, ACT QChunk-MCBC attains 99\% success within 30 minutes of HIL training, whereas HIL-SERL requires about 5 hours to converge. In simulation on Peg Insertion and Square, ACT/Flow Q-chunk variants similarly reach $\ge$96\% success within roughly half an hour of effective training, outperforming HIL-SERL, EXPO, and E2HiL on the success--time frontier.

</details>


### [437] [StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15139)
*Jiarui Yang,Bin Zhu,Jingjing Chen,Na Zou,Yanwei Fu,Jianggang Zhu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出StructRL，通过将策略随机性从扩散/流模型的去噪链内部迁移到动作空间（采用确定性ODE解码器、动作空间结构化噪声注入和最后一步重放），避免了结构化噪声在去噪过程中被稀释的问题，从而提升基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在在线强化学习中的探索效率与分布外（OOD）性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于流模型的VLA模型在在线RL中通常通过在去噪链内部注入各向同性或时间无关的噪声来引入随机性，但这种随机性缺乏结构（时间平滑性、不同动作组的不同尺度），不利于机器人高效探索。更关键的是，作者发现即便将链内噪声换成结构化形式，中间流时间点注入的噪声也会被后续去噪步骤削弱，即"结构化噪声稀释"现象，导致探索效果不佳。

Method: StructRL通过三个耦合的设计避免噪声稀释：(i) 采用确定性ODE解码器；(ii) 将结构化噪声直接注入动作空间；(iii) 采用最后一步重放（last-step replay），即策略梯度更新时只对最终被执行的动作为中间去噪状态分配似然，从而既保持结构化探索与执行动作直接关联，又为流解码器提供可处理的训练信号。

Result: 在三个基于流的VLA模型上，结合多个仿真操作基准和两个真实世界任务，StructRL相比之前的链内（in-chain）基线方法显著提升了探索效率和OOD性能，证明了结构化动作空间探索在基于流的VLA模型RL适配中的有效性。

Conclusion: 结构化动作空间探索是适配基于流的VLA模型的有效方案，通过将随机性从去噪链迁移至动作空间并结合最后一步重放，能够避免结构化噪声稀释并取得更好的探索与泛化效果。

Abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are now widely used for continuous robotic manipulation, and online reinforcement learning (RL) is emerging as a key technique for adapting them to new tasks. Existing RL methods typically inject stochasticity inside the denoising chain, often through isotropic or temporally independent noise. However, effective robot exploration calls for structured noise: temporally smooth and scaled differently across action groups. We show that simply switching the in-chain noise to a structured form does not suffice: noise added at an intermediate flow time can be weakened by the remaining denoising steps before execution, a phenomenon we call \emph{Structured Noise Dilution}. We propose \textbf{StructRL}, which avoids dilution by relocating policy stochasticity to the action space via three coupled choices: (i) a deterministic ODE decoder, (ii) structured noise injected directly in the action space, and (iii) last-step replay, where policy-gradient updates avoid assigning likelihoods to intermediate denoising states. This keeps structured exploration tied to the executed action while providing a tractable training signal for the flow decoder. Across three flow-based VLA models on multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and two real-world tasks, StructRL improves exploration efficiency and OOD performance over prior in-chain baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured action-space exploration for adapting flow-based VLA with RL. \textbf{Project page:} https://flyfaerss.github.io/structrl/

</details>


### [438] [Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15156)
*Yang Liu,Yuming Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文在受控两目标/二维碰撞环境中研究循环世界模型（192维隐藏状态）的可干预性，发现秩4的隐藏状态补丁足以将12步自主推演重定向到预期的反事实轨迹，且无需未来观测或教师强制。同时强调"成功的编辑"不等于"动力学有效"，通过位置编辑压力测试提供负对照。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型能够预测未来，但无法明确其隐藏状态中的哪些部分驱动这些预测。作者希望探究能否通过小型、可直接寻址的隐藏状态修改，将世界模型置于预期的反事实轨迹上，并让其自主推演后续未来。这关系到模型可解释性与可控性的核心问题。

Method: 在192维循环世界模型、两目标二维碰撞环境中：(1) 验证模型能原生表征并推演有界局部速度编辑的未来；(2) 从训练数据中提取事实到反事实的隐藏差异，构建候选低秩载体；(3) 学习从事实状态和请求编辑到载体系数的映射；(4) 在注册的秩网格上评估，秩4为满足全套开发面板标准的最小秩；(5) 引入位置编辑压力测试作为负对照，区分"成功编辑"与"动力学有效"干预。

Result: 秩4是满足开发面板全部标准的最小秩；单个秩4补丁足以重定向12步自主推演，无需未来观测、teacher forcing或重复修正；该冻结流程在独立训练的检查点上满足预注册复制规则，且在邻近干预时间保持可用；随机等范数、错误对象、错误时间对照均不能解释该效应。位置编辑压力测试显示：意图位置补丁虽可通过原始推演标准，但无补丁和随机对照同样可通过，且错误对象特异性未确立，表明成功编辑本身不足以证明干预有效。

Conclusion: 秩4结果识别了速度编辑家族的一个紧凑干预接口，但明确这不是一个封闭的四维状态或内在状态维度。"动力学有效"（干预在自主推演下以持续且目标特异的方式改变模型未来计算）是比"可成功编辑"更强的有效性判据。该工作为世界模型的可干预性与可解释性提供了方法论框架。

Abstract: World models may predict the future without making clear which parts of their hidden state actually drive those predictions. We ask whether a small, directly addressable hidden-state change can place a learned world model on the intended counterfactual trajectory and then let the model continue that future on its own. We study a recurrent world model with a 192-dimensional hidden state in a controlled two-object, two-dimensional collision environment. For a bounded family of local velocity edits, we first verify that the model can natively represent and roll out the edited future. We then construct candidate low-rank carriers from training-only factual-to-counterfactual hidden differences and learn a map from the factual state and requested edit to carrier coefficients. On the registered rank grid, rank 4 is the smallest tested rank that satisfies the full development-panel criteria. A single rank-4 patch at the anchor is sufficient to redirect a 12-step autonomous rollout, with no future observations, teacher forcing, or repeated correction. The frozen procedure satisfies the preregistered replication rule across independently trained checkpoints and remains usable across nearby intervention times. Random equal-norm, wrong-object, and wrong-time controls do not explain the effect. A position-edit stress test provides a negative contrast: the intended position patch can pass the raw rollout criteria, but no-patch and random controls can pass the same criteria, and wrong-object specificity is not established. Thus, successful editing alone is not enough. We use dynamics-effective to describe an intervention that changes the model's future computation in a sustained and target-specific way under autonomous rollout. The rank-4 result identifies a compact intervention interface for the tested velocity-edit family, not a closed four-dimensional state or an intrinsic state dimension.

</details>


### [439] [LAPF: LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder Using the UAVScenes Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15175)
*Yousef Emami,Mohammadhossein Homaei,Hao Zhou,Miguel Gutiérrez Gaitán,Atefeh Hajijamali Arani,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为LAPF（LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder）的框架，用于城镇规模户外环境中的自主无人机导航。LAPF将感知、记忆、规划与动作模块整合为闭环认知架构，利用LLM智能体结合先前导航经验、思维链推理和对每个检测到的危险进行有界修正动作，实现自适应航点决策。实验表明，LAPF在两个场景中分别达到97.1%和98.1%的路径效率（平均路径长度512.83m和506.37m，接近直线最优497.33m），相比CoT提示方法路径长度减少17.2%和15.6%，且是唯一将所有检测到危险与有界修正动作一一对应且保持近目标稳定性的方法（零钳位事件，对比CoT从9.7增至14.0）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机自主导航方法存在明显局限：优化方法、机器学习方法和强化学习方法依赖预定义模型或任务特定训练，难以在不确定场景中泛化；LLM辅助方法虽有推理能力，但缺乏足够的智能体功能（如记忆、规划和工具交互机制），无法充分应对城镇规模复杂户外环境中的动态条件与任务需求。

Method: LAPF框架采用闭环认知架构，将感知、记忆、规划与动作四大模块整合。智能体利用先前导航经验进行经验积累，执行思维链（CoT）推理来处理复杂决策，将每个检测到的危险与一个有界修正动作进行耦合映射，并根据环境反馈动态精炼航点决策，实现自适应导航。

Result: 在开放场地和障碍物注入两个场景中各进行三次独立试验，LAPF平均路径长度为512.83m和506.37m（直线最优为497.33m），对应路径长度比CoT提示减少17.2%和15.6%，绝对路径效率达97.1%和98.1%。LAPF是唯一在每个危险检测后都能做出有界、度量中立的修正动作且保持近目标稳定性的方法，两个场景中钳位事件均为零，而CoT提示从9.7增加到14.0。

Conclusion: LAPF通过整合LLM智能体的感知-记忆-规划-动作闭环架构，显著提升了无人机在城镇规模户外环境中的导航性能，实现了接近理论最优的路径效率和更强的危险响应能力，为LLM辅助自主导航提供了可行的扩展方案。

Abstract: Uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous navigation in complex outdoor environments, where dynamic conditions and mission requirements require intelligent adaptive decision-making. Existing optimization-based, Machine Learning (ML), and Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches often rely on predefined models or task-specific training, limiting their generalization and adaptability in uncertain scenarios. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted approaches offer promising reasoning capabilities but remain constrained by limited agentic functionality, including insufficient memory, planning, and tool interaction mechanisms.This paper proposes an LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder (LAPF) framework for autonomous UAV navigation in town-scale outdoor environments. LAPF extends LLM-assisted navigation by integrating perception, memory, planning, and action modules into a closed-loop cognitive architecture. The proposed agent leverages prior navigation experiences, performs Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, couples each detected hazard to a bounded corrective action, and dynamically refines waypoint decisions based on environmental feedback.The three independent trials per method demonstrate that LAPF achieves mean path lengths of 512.83 m and 506.37 m, compared to the straight-line optimum of 497.33 m, corresponding to path length reductions of 17.2% and 15.6% relative to CoT prompting and absolute path efficiencies of 97.1% and 98.1% in open-field and obstacle-injected scenarios, respectively. Furthermore, LAPF is the only evaluated approach that couples every detected hazard to a bounded, metric-neutral corrective action while maintaining near-goal stability, with zero clamp events in both scenarios, whereas CoT prompting increases from 9.7 to 14.0 events.

</details>


### [440] [Remember Smarter: Visual History Compressor and Hyperbolic Experience Space for Robotic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15269)
*Dai Zhou,Jiexi Yan,Tong Li,Yuxuan Wang,Cheng Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RS模块，通过双向空间Mamba和因果时序Mamba压缩多视图补丁历史，配合Poincare VAE空间中的双曲经验记忆分支，在不扩展VLA上下文的前提下提升长视野机器人策略性能，在LIBERO-Plus上将成功率从53.6%提升至70.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野机器人策略需要紧凑地访问近期观测和可复用经验，但传统方法会扩大VLA上下文窗口，导致计算开销和性能瓶颈。现有方法缺乏同时对视觉历史压缩和经验记忆组织的系统性设计。

Method: RS由两个互补分支组成：(1) 视觉历史分支——使用双向空间Mamba和因果时序Mamba压缩多视图补丁历史，通过残差交叉注意力将压缩后的记忆暴露给面向动作的隐藏状态，同时保持VLM视觉token流不变；(2) 双曲经验记忆分支——在Poincare VAE空间存储成功的VLM最终层状态，进行分层组织，并通过异步方式将检索到的经验转换为测地线提示token，不阻塞动作推理。

Result: 在适配pi0后，RS将LIBERO-Plus上的总成功率从53.6%提升至70.6%，在真实机器人实验中同样取得了显著的记忆保持和经验利用性能提升。

Conclusion: RS作为即插即用模块，通过视觉历史压缩和双曲经验记忆两条互补路径，在不改变VLM视觉token流和不阻断动作推理的前提下，有效增强了长视野机器人策略的记忆能力与经验复用能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot policies require compact access to recent observations and
  reusable experience without expanding the vision-language-action (VLA)
  context. We introduce Remember Smarter (RS), a plug-and-play module with
  complementary visual-history and hyperbolic experience-memory branches. Its
  visual branch compresses multi-view patch histories using bidirectional
  spatial Mamba and causal temporal Mamba, then exposes the resulting memory to
  action-facing hidden states through residual cross-attention while leaving the
  VLM visual-token stream unchanged. Its experience branch stores successful
  final-layer VLM states in a Poincare VAE space, organizes them hierarchically,
  and asynchronously converts retrieved experience into geodesic prompt tokens
  without blocking action inference. When adapted to pi0, RS increases total
  success on LIBERO-Plus from 53.6% to 70.6% and
  achieves substantial
  performance gains in real-robot experiments designed to evaluate memory
  retention and experience utilization.

</details>


### [441] [VTInstructor: Visual Trajectory Prompting for Navigation Instruction Generation in Continuous Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15284)
*Haolin Yang,Yuxing Long,Zihan Yang,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VTInstructor是首个面向连续环境的VLN指令生成框架，通过将隐式轨迹几何转化为显式视觉轨迹提示（EDTC关键帧提取、VTP轨迹叠加、VTMod视觉注入、VT-GRPO空间校准），无需导航图或预建地图，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上刷新SOTA，生成的指令能将冻结follower的成功率提升14.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续环境中的指令生成面临核心挑战：先前的指令生成器依赖离散视角图与全景观测，轨迹结构显式可知；但在连续环境中，智能体仅接收密集RGB流，轨迹线索难以恢复。这阻碍了大规模数据集构建和人机交互应用。

Method: 提出VTInstructor框架，核心思想是将隐式轨迹几何转化为显式视觉轨迹提示。具体包含四个组件：EDTC将长RGB轨迹压缩为导航关键帧；VTP在这些关键帧上叠加路径、转向和目标线索；VTMod将轨迹信号注入视觉编码器；VT-GRPO在训练中校准空间注入。整个框架无需导航图、预建地图或场景重建。

Result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val Unseen基准上，VTInstructor在所有标准NLG指标上取得SOTA，分别以+0.357 CIDEr和+0.109 CIDEr超越最强基线。在导航验证中，其生成的指令使冻结follower的成功率达到63.3%（+14.7个百分点），并在下游导航任务的数据增强中获得+3 SR的提升。

Conclusion: VTInstructor证明在连续环境中可由RGB视频直接生成高质量导航指令，通过显式化轨迹视觉提示有效弥补了无显式图结构带来的挑战，同时为下游导航任务提供了有价值的数据增强来源。

Abstract: Navigation instruction generation from ego-centric RGB video in continuous environments is an important yet challenging task for human-robot interaction and scalable dataset construction. Prior instruction generators assume discrete viewpoint graphs with panoramic observations, where trajectory structure is explicit; in continuous environments, however, the agent receives only a dense RGB stream, making trajectory cues difficult to recover. We propose VTInstructor, the first VLN instruction generation framework for continuous environments. Our key idea is to convert implicit trajectory geometry into explicit visual trajectory prompts: EDTC condenses long RGB trajectories into navigation-critical keyframes, VTP overlays path, turn, and goal cues onto these anchors, VTMod injects the resulting trajectory signals into the visual encoder, and VT-GRPO further calibrates this spatial injection during training, all without requiring a navigation graph, pre-built map, or scene reconstruction. On the challenging R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val Unseen benchmarks, VTInstructor sets a new state of the art across all standard NLG metrics, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.357 CIDEr and +0.109 CIDEr, respectively. Beyond automatic metrics, VTInstructor-generated instructions raise a frozen follower's success rate to 63.3%, a +14.7 percentage-point gain over the best competing instruction source, and provide consistent data augmentation gains of +3 SR points on downstream navigation tasks.

</details>


### [442] [PhaseLoRA: Control-Regime-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation for Continuous-Action Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15285)
*Yufei Guo,Yinan Wu,Haoran Duan,Guiguang Ding,Jungong Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PhaseLoRA是一种轻量级LoRA参数化方法，通过利用两个弱监督描述符（精细控制倾向和事件/边界强度）在每个动作块预测步骤条件化适配，使LoRA左因子在动作专家中随时间变化，从而为连续动作VLA策略提供跨轨迹内的阶段感知微调。在LIBERO基准上，PhaseLoRA相比匹配参数的高秩LoRA基线将平均成功率提升12.2个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法大多在整个控制轨迹中施加时间上静态的更新，忽略了连续动作操作中固有的阶段依赖性。操作策略会经历接近、接触过渡、抓取、运输和放置等不同阶段，每个阶段需要不同的自适应行为，而静态适配器无法捕捉这种动态变化。

Method: PhaseLoRA提出一种轻量级LoRA参数化方法，在动作专家的LoRA左因子上进行调制，使有效低秩更新方向随时间变化。具体采用两种弱监督描述符——精细控制倾向和事件/边界强度——在每个动作块预测步骤条件化适配，同时保持主干网络大部分冻结。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上，PhaseLoRA相比匹配参数的高秩LoRA基线平均成功率提升12.2个百分点，并优于更强的LoRA变体。消融实验表明随机时间调制和标量门控无法复现完整模型性能，更新方向分析揭示了与预测控制描述符相关的结构化时间变化。

Conclusion: 轨迹内条件化被确立为连续动作VLA策略的一种有效的轻量级PEFT新维度，为在控制过程中按阶段动态调整适配行为提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is a natural way to adapt pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but most adapter designs apply temporally static updates throughout a control rollout, overlooking the phase-dependent nature of continuous-action manipulation. Such policies traverse distinct regimes, including approach, contact transition, grasping, transport, and placement, each requiring different adaptation behaviors. We propose \textbf{PhaseLoRA}, a lightweight LoRA parameterization that conditions adaptation at each action-chunk prediction step using two weakly supervised descriptors: fine-control tendency and event/boundary intensity. PhaseLoRA modulates the LoRA left factor in the action expert, allowing the effective low-rank update direction to vary over time while keeping the backbone largely frozen. On LIBERO, PhaseLoRA improves average success rate by 12.2 points over a matched-parameter high-rank LoRA baseline and outperforms stronger LoRA variants. Ablations show that random temporal modulation and scalar gating do not reproduce the performance of the full model, while update-direction analyses reveal structured temporal variation associated with the predicted control descriptors. These results establish within-trajectory conditioning as an effective lightweight PEFT axis for continuous-action VLA policies.

</details>


### [443] [SCORE: Shape-Conforming Regions for Flight in Enclosed, Degraded Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15289)
*Eric Minwoo Kim,Jong-Kook Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于符号距离场(SDF)定义非一致性评分的形状自适应保持区域(keep-out)方法，用于自主无人机在封闭环境中的安全导航。该方法能生成非凸的、紧贴障碍物几何形状的保持区域，相比传统凸包方法减少了对狭窄通道的侵占，同时通过体素级传感器融合和自适应安全边距，在感知退化时仍能保持分布无关的安全保证。在真实地下数据上的实验表明，该方法在相同认证覆盖率下保留了更多可用自由空间，并实现了更安全的闭环飞行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主无人机进入洞穴等封闭环境时，感知受限且空间受限。现有的基于共形预测的保持区域使用凸基元（如球体、长方体），其凸出部分会侵占狭窄通道，且当感知退化时该问题会加剧。需要一个既能严格服从障碍物几何形状、又能在感知退化时保持安全保证的非凸保持区域方法。

Method: 核心方法：1) 在符号距离场(SDF)上定义非一致性评分，产生非凸、紧贴障碍物几何的保持区域，避免等距凸区域的不必要膨胀；2) 通过体素级传感器观测并集互补，认证单一传感器遗漏的体素；3) 安全边距根据测量到的能见度自适应调整，无需天气标签或在线地面真值反馈。该方法属于分布无关(distribution-free)的共形预测框架。

Result: 在真实地下场景数据上的实验表明：该方法在相同认证覆盖率下比凸基线保留了更多可用自由空间；与传统凸包保持区域相比，产生了更安全的闭环飞行表现。

Conclusion: 基于SDF的共形预测非一致性评分能够在不牺牲覆盖率保证的前提下，生成形状适应的非凸保持区域，在受限空间（如洞穴、坍塌结构）中为自主无人机提供更安全且空间利用效率更高的导航方案。

Abstract: Autonomous UAVs enter enclosed environments such as caves and collapsed structures that confine the vehicle and degrade perception. Conformal prediction provides a distribution-free guarantee by calibrating how far an obstacle keep-out must expand to absorb perception error at a target coverage level. However, existing keep-out regions use convex primitives whose bulges consume narrow passages and grow as perception degrades. Our main contribution defines the nonconformity score on a signed distance field (SDF). This produces a non-convex keep-out that tightly follows obstacle geometry and avoids the unnecessary bulging of equal-margin convex regions. Two supporting components keep this geometry usable as perception degrades. First, a voxelwise union of complementary sensor observations certifies voxels that any single sensor misses. Second, the margin around the obstacle adapts to measured visibility without weather labels or the online ground-truth feedback that single-pass flight cannot provide. Results on real subterranean data show that the resulting distribution-free, shape-conforming keep-out retains more usable free space than convex baselines at the same certified coverage, and produces safer closed-loop flight.

</details>


### [444] [MM-BEV: Enhancing Timeliness by Computing Where and When it Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15437)
*Liangkai Liu,Kang G. Shin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MM-BEV是一个实时多模态BEV感知系统，基于"在重要的时间和地点进行计算"原则，将感知任务划分为安全关键性（强制）和非紧急（可选）两类，通过关键性排序的ROI选择器、稀疏特征提取、延迟感知协调器和异步调度器四种机制，在nuScenes数据集上实现1.96x推理延迟降低和2.93x端到端延迟降低，在真实机器人平台上实现2.11x平均延迟降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态BEV感知方法存在三大未被利用的机会：相机和LiDAR输入中的结构化稀疏性、模态间的时间对齐偏差、以及许多检测对象并不影响规划器即时决策的事实。传统方法仅压缩单个检测器，忽视这些结构性优化空间，导致计算成本高且难以实时部署。

Method: MM-BEV将感知划分为两类工作：对刹车距离内且TTC短的避险关键对象执行强制计算，对不紧急区域执行可选计算。集成四种机制：(1)基于运动外推检测的关键性排序时间ROI选择器；(2)稀疏ROI感知特征提取，使用共享形状相机裁剪（上下文自适应分辨率）和ROI感知LiDAR体素化；(3)延迟感知协调器，根据场景动态和TTC自适应调整LiDAR扫描、图像分辨率和关键帧；(4)异步调度器，解耦感知与推理过程并跳过过时帧。

Result: 在nuScenes上，MM-BEV将推理延迟降低1.96倍，端到端延迟降低2.93倍，几何关键召回率无损失，安全关键召回率仅下降0.2个百分点。在搭载Ouster-128 LiDAR、BEV相机和Jetson AGX Orin的Clearpath Husky A300平台上，平均延迟降低2.11倍。

Conclusion: MM-BEV通过"计算何处何时重要"的简单原则，利用结构化稀疏性和任务优先级实现高效的实时多模态BEV感知，在保持安全关键性能的同时显著降低延迟，展现了在真实自主系统中的部署潜力。

Abstract: Multimodal bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception combines LiDAR depth accuracy with dense camera semantics, but its high computational cost and imperfect sensing conditions make real-time deployment challenging. Existing methods largely compress individual detectors and overlook three opportunities: structured sparsity within camera and LiDAR inputs, timing misalignment between modalities, and the fact that many detected objects do not affect the planner's immediate action. We present MM-BEV, a real-time multimodal BEV system guided by a simple principle: compute where and when it matters. MM-BEV divides perception into mandatory work for safety-critical objects within braking distance of the ego vehicle and with short time-to-collision (TTC), and optional work for less urgent regions. It prioritizes mandatory work and reduces or sheds optional work under tight compute budgets. MM-BEV integrates four mechanisms: (1) a criticality-ranked temporal ROI selector based on motion-extrapolated detections from prior frames; (2) sparse, ROI-aware feature extraction using shared-shape camera crops at context-adaptive resolution and ROI-aware LiDAR voxelization; (3) a latency-aware coordinator that adapts LiDAR sweeps, image resolution, and keyframes according to scene dynamics and TTC; and (4) an asynchronous scheduler that decouples sensing from inference and skips stale frames. On nuScenes, MM-BEV reduces inference latency by 1.96x and end-to-end latency by 2.93x, with no loss in geometry-critical recall and only a 0.2 percentage-point drop in safety-critical recall. On a Clearpath Husky A300 equipped with an Ouster-128 LiDAR, BEV cameras, and a Jetson AGX Orin, MM-BEV further reduces mean latency by 2.11x, demonstrating its potential for real-world autonomous systems.

</details>


### [445] [Accelerating Mixed Discrete-Continuous Motion Planning via Neural Graphs of Convex Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15440)
*Ananya Trivedi,Sarvesh Prajapati,Mohamed Khalid M Jaffar,Zhexin Xu,David Rosen,Taskin Padir*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于学习的策略来加速Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS)运动规划框架。通过用Graph Attention Network进行单次前向传播预测高概率候选路径，并用轻量级排序网络按估计成本排序，从而提前终止搜索，在保持100%成功率的条件下实现比名义GCS快两个数量级的求解速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCS框架虽然能有效处理耦合离散决策与连续轨迹的运动规划问题，但在线重规划时，其所需的凸松弛步骤计算开销过大，难以满足实时性要求。

Method: 提出Neural-GCS管线：(1) 用Graph Attention Network (GAT)替代GCS中昂贵的凸松弛步骤，通过单次前向传播预测图中高概率的候选路径集合；(2) 设计轻量级排序网络按估计轨迹成本对候选路径排序；(3) 按排序顺序评估候选路径，提前终止搜索，同时恢复近优解。

Result: 在3D四旋翼、7自由度机械臂的避碰规划以及平面推动的接触式规划等多样化机器人任务中验证。在凸与非凸的成本和约束设置下，相比名义GCS实现高达两个数量级的加速，同时保持100%成功率，代价是解存在一定次优性。

Conclusion: 基于图注意力网络的候选路径预测与排序策略能有效克服GCS的计算瓶颈，为在线重规划提供了一种高效可行的替代方案，在保证规划成功率的同时大幅降低计算延迟。

Abstract: Motion planning problems such as collision-free navigation and contact-rich manipulation can be naturally formulated as optimization problems that couple discrete decisions with continuous trajectories. The Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS) framework offers a practical solution to these problems. It represents discrete decisions as nodes of a graph and encodes continuous trajectories in the edges connecting them. However, the resulting optimization subproblems can become computationally prohibitive for online replanning.
  In this work, we propose a learning-based strategy to mitigate this limitation. Specifically, we replace the costly convex relaxation step required by nominal GCS with a single forward pass through a Graph Attention Network that predicts a set of highly probable candidate paths through the graph. A lightweight ranking network then orders these candidates by their estimated trajectory cost. Evaluating them in this order, we terminate our search early while still recovering a near-optimal motion plan. We validate the resulting pipeline across diverse robotic tasks, including collision-free motion planning for a 3D quadrotor and a 7-DoF manipulator, and planning through contact for planar pushing. Across both convex and non-convex cost and constraint settings, our approach yields up to two orders of magnitude speedup over nominal GCS while maintaining a 100% success rate, at the cost of some suboptimality in the recovered solutions. Code implementations and video demonstrations can be found at https://neural-gcs.github.io/.

</details>


### [446] [GUIDER: Evaluating Goal-Free Human Intent Inference for Teleoperated Manipulation on Real-Robot Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15446)
*Nicholas Kenny,Cesar Alan Contreras,Basile Ouedraogo,Rustam Stolkin,Manolis Chiou,Maria Kyrarini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文对GUIDER（面向机器人的全局用户意图双阶段估计）这一无目标概率框架在机器人操作中的人类意图推断能力进行了评估，在机器人手臂采集的数据上测试了操作阶段的表现，涵盖泡茶和取药等辅助场景，并新增了在线概率更新、工作区限制、支撑面过滤和抓取模式等支持功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器人辅助操作场景中，准确且及时地推断人类意图对于实现流畅、自然的人机协作至关重要。作者旨在评估一种无目标（goal-free）的概率框架在真实机器人操作数据上的表现，以验证其能否在多种辅助场景中可靠地预测人类意图。

Method: 部署GUIDER框架于机器人手臂采集的数据上，测试操作阶段性能。框架包含在线概率更新、工作区限制、支撑面过滤，以及优先考虑可行抓取区域的抓取模式。所有功能在保持原始时间顺序条件下对记录数据进行测试，覆盖三个场景共20个操作步骤。

Result: 在三个场景的20个操作步骤中，GUIDER在所有情况下均能在正确的抓取候选集内估计人类意图；达到可信预测的时间为3.7秒，首次抓取前的剩余时间为49.6秒，预测稳定性为96.4%，每个意图感知阶段的运行时间均值为4.857秒、中位数为4.474秒。

Conclusion: GUIDER框架在机器人辅助操作的人类意图推断任务中表现出色，能够在所有测试场景中准确锁定正确的抓取候选集，并具备较高预测稳定性与合理的计算效率，证明了该无目标概率框架在真实操作数据上的实用性与可靠性。

Abstract: This paper presents an evaluation of a goal-free probabilistic framework for human intent inference during robotic manipulation. We deploy the Global User Intent Dual-phase Estimation for Robots (GUIDER) on data collected from a robotic arm to test the manipulation phase across various assistance scenarios, including making tea and fetching medicine. To support operation, we add online probability updates, workspace limits, support-plane filtering, and a grasping mode that prioritizes feasible grasp regions, all of which are tested on the recorded data while preserving its original temporal conditions. Across 20 manipulation steps in three scenarios, GUIDER estimated human intent within the correct grasp-candidate set in all cases and achieved a time to confident prediction of 3.7 s, a remaining time before first grasp of 49.6 s, a prediction stability of 96.4%, and a runtime of 4.857/4.474 s (mean/median) per perceptual phase of intent.

</details>


### [447] [Detachable Wire Drive : Reconfigurable Robot Architecture with Shared Actuators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15461)
*Takahiro Hattori,Kento Kawaharazuka,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为"可拆式线驱动"（Detachable Wire Drive）的可重构机器人系统，通过"线缆分离单元"（Wire Detach Unit）将重型执行器集中到公共基座单元中，实现不同形态（2自由度刚性臂、连续体臂和两种夹爪）之间的执行器共享，从而减少系统重量、体积和成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统可重构机器人常采用集中式架构，每个模块需要专用执行器，导致系统整体的重量、体积和成本显著增加，限制了可重构机器人在多样化任务中的实际应用潜力。

Method: 提出一种可重构机器人系统"Detachable Wire Drive"，核心是"Wire Detach Unit"机构，该机构能够在物理上分离并重新连接线驱动路径，从而将电机统一整合到公共基座单元中。基于此构建了2自由度刚性臂、连续体臂和两种不同的夹爪，均通过可互换方式连接到同一套共享执行器集上进行驱动。

Result: 实验验证了线缆分离过程的机械可靠性以及控制系统在不同配置之间无缝管理切换的能力，证明了该系统在机器人形态转换和任务适应性方面的有效性与可行性。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过线驱动路径的可物理拆分与重连，可以实现执行器的跨形态共享，为构建更高效、多功能的可重构机器人系统提供了一条可行路线。

Abstract: Reconfigurable robots offer significant potential for adapting to diverse tasks; however, conventional centralized architectures often require dedicated actuators for each module, leading to substantial increases in overall system weight, volume, and cost. To address these challenges, this paper presents the "Detachable Wire Drive," a reconfigurable robotic system that enables the sharing of heavy and expensive actuators across various morphologies. The core of this system is the "Wire Detach Unit," a mechanism designed to physically split and reconnect wire drive paths, allowing motors to be consolidated into a common base unit. We demonstrate the versatility of this approach by developing a 2-DOF rigid arm, a continuum arm, and two distinct grippers, all of which are interchangeably attached to, and driven by, a single shared actuator set. Experimental results validate the mechanical reliability of the detachment process and the control framework's ability to seamlessly manage transitions between configurations, highlighting a path toward more efficient and multi-functional robotic systems.

</details>


### [448] [Vision-Based Tactile Intelligence for Robotics: Sensing, Learning, and Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15490)
*Peng Zhou,Jun Hu,Sihan Chen,Zeqing Zhang,Haofei Ma,Zhenyu Lu,Sichao Liu,Xueqian Wang,Pai Zheng,Xiang Li,Shan Luo,Jia Pan,David Navarro-Alarcon,Chenguang Yang,Michael Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了基于视觉的触觉传感器（VBTS）全流程，将传感硬件、学习方法、仿真与数据集视为一个集成的感测-学习系统，并指出开放挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多触觉传感器仅提供稀疏、低维的信号，无法满足复杂机器人感知与交互需求。基于视觉的触觉传感器将接触形变转化为图像，提供了高分辨率、信息丰富的触觉观测，但缺乏将硬件、学习、仿真与数据作为一个整体系统的全面综述。

Method: 1) 从弹性体设计、传感器尺寸形状、光学系统设计三个维度，对代表性VBTS进行硬件分类学组织；2) 提出从低层信号理解到任务级策略与基础模型的分层学习型触觉智能视角；3) 考察仿真平台与触觉数据集作为规模化层，并结合sim-to-real迁移与跨传感器适应进行训练、基准测试与部署。

Result: 形成了一套完整的VBTS综述体系：硬件分类学指导传感器开发，分层触觉智能框架涵盖从信号理解到基础模型，仿真与数据规模化层支持训练与部署，并识别了未来的开放挑战。

Conclusion: 通过全景式揭示硬件、AI架构、仿真与数据集之间的相互作用，本综述旨在推动高接触密集机器人任务中的触觉智能发展。

Abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for robots in contact-rich tasks, yet many tactile sensors still provide sparse, low-dimensional signals that do not capture sufficient information for complex robotic perception and interaction. Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTSs) offer a powerful alternative by con-verting contact-induced deformation of a soft interface into im-ages. The image-based formulation gives VBTSs high-resolution, information-rich tactile observations that enable complex robotic tasks. This review surveys the full VBTS pipeline and treats sensing hardware, learning methods, simulation, and datasets as an integrated sensing-and-learning system. We 1) organize representative VBTSs into a hardware taxonomy structured by deformable elastomer design, sensor size and shape, and optical system design to guide future sensor development; 2) present a hierarchical view of learning-based tactile intelligence from low-level signal understanding to task-level policies and foundation models; and 3) examine simulation platforms and tactile datasets as a scaling layer, together with sim-to-real transfer and cross-sensor adaptation for training, benchmarking, and deployment. Finally, we identify open challenges and future directions for VBTSs in robotics. By providing a holistic view of how hardware, AI architectures, simulation, and datasets interact, this review aims to advance tactile intelligence for contact-rich robotic tasks.

</details>


### [449] [Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15509)
*Hao Zhang,Zhangli Zhou,Zhen Kan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LOTUS是一个基于时序逻辑（LTL）的通用任务表示框架，可无缝集成到任何强化学习算法中，通过将LTL编码器视为策略来更新，并利用双模拟度量提供理论保证，在单任务、多任务和未见任务上均显著提升学习效率、泛化能力和表示质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的任务表示算法通常针对特定上下文定制，难以跨场景泛化，且依赖强化学习控制器的梯度信号来更新权重，这会导致表示质量下降和学习效率降低。因此需要一种通用、可无缝集成且不依赖RL梯度信号的统一任务表示框架。

Method: LOTUS提出一种受时序逻辑启发的通用任务表示架构，能够从LTL公式中建模关系并提取任务语义；引入一种更有效的更新机制，将LTL编码器视为策略从而提升表示能力；并利用双模拟度量（bisimulation metric）为LTL表示提供理论保证，涵盖行为等价性、最优性保真和轨迹鲁棒性。

Result: LOTUS在多种任务设定下优于大多数现有方法：单任务场景收敛速度提升超过20%，未见过的操作任务成功率提升15%-45%，在子目标深度或合取数量增加的复杂多任务环境中泛化性能提升超过25%。

Conclusion: LOTUS证明了一种基于LTL的通用任务表示框架能够有效替代依赖特定上下文或RL梯度信号的现有方法，在表示质量、学习效率和泛化能力上均取得显著改进，并提供了双模拟度量下的理论保证。

Abstract: Task guided agents demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of complex tasks. However, most existing task representation algorithms are tailored to specific contexts and struggle to generalize across diverse scenarios. Moreover, they typically depend on gradient signals from reinforcement learning controllers to update their weights, which can degrade both representation quality and learning efficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose LOTUS, a temporal logic inspired universal task representation framework that can be seamlessly integrated into any RL algorithm to enhance agent performance across diverse task settings. Specifically, we design a novel task representation architecture capable of modeling relationships and extracting task semantics from LTL formulas. We further introduce a more effective update mechanism that treats the LTL encoder as a policy, thereby improving representation capacity. To enhance stability and robustness, LOTUS leverages the bisimulation metric, which provides theoretical guarantees for LTL representation, including behavioral equivalence, optimality fidelity, and trajectory robustness. Experimental results show that LOTUS outperforms most existing methods in learning efficiency, generalization capability, and representation quality. Specifically, LOTUS accelerates convergence over 20% in single-task scenarios, achieves a 15%-45% higher success rate in unseen manipulation tasks, and improves generalization performance over 25% in complex multi-task environments with increased sub-goal depth or conjunctions. The corresponding code, videos, and appendix are available at: https://lotus-website.github.io/.

</details>


### [450] [Degenerate in Whose Frame? An Equivariance Condition for Degeneracy Detection in LiDAR Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15532)
*Yujie Zhang,Chunlei Zhao,Yuzong Lin,Yuxuan Guo,Xiaohui Jia,Jinyue Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文质疑LiDAR配准中退化检测常用的六轴二元标签（每轴是否退化）是否真正描述场景属性。通过李群伴随重参数化，点面信息矩阵的变换为合同变换而非相似变换，导致轴标签和阈值化谱不必不变。作者提出等变度量M=sum_i J_i^T J_i，其广义特征值Hv=lambda Mv具有框架不变性、尺度不变性和场景尺度不变性，但指出根本问题在于"每轴足迹"（per-axis footprint）这一报告量本身。实验表明重映射估计器在44.5-69.5%的帧对上因坐标系选择而产生0.7-87cm的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LiDAR配准退化检测方法通常输出六个每轴二元标签，但这些标签是否真正反映场景固有属性、是否依赖于坐标系选择的问题未被充分研究。作者旨在检验这些标签的坐标系不变性，并寻找一种真正帧无关的退化判据。

Method: 从点面信息矩阵在体坐标系变换下的合同变换性质（H'=Ad(T)^T H Ad(T)）出发，分析核子空间不变性但谱和每轴标签不不变的数学结论。据此提出等变度量M=sum_i J_i^T J_i，构造广义特征值问题Hv=lambda Mv，并推导该框架在何种条件下保持帧不变性。通过在噪声自由圆形隧道中平移原点、及365帧对4个公开序列上的实验验证。

Result: （1）噪声自由圆形隧道中，原点平移1米即改变被标记的退化自由度数；（2）广义判据Hv=lambda Mv在任意半正定信息形式下普遍帧不变当且仅当度量规则等变；（3）不存在固定度量满足要求，而rig自适应度量仅在零螺丝节距时存在（19个标定中仅1个满足）；（4）等变点位移度量M=sum_i J_i^T J_i产生无量纲、场景尺度不变的广义特征值，其阈值可跨序列迁移；（5）但每轴足迹即使在等变度量下仍会改变。

Conclusion: 当前常用的每轴退化标签不是场景的固有属性，而是坐标系相关的报告量。核心问题不在度量选择而在"每轴足迹"这一输出形式本身——它无法由场景属性唯一确定。作者建议重新审视退化检测的输出表示方式，而非简单更换度量。

Abstract: Degeneracy detectors for LiDAR registration commonly return six per-axis binary labels. We ask whether these labels are properties of the scene. Under a body-frame change, the point-to-plane information matrix transforms by congruence, H' = Ad(T)^T H Ad(T), not similarity. Congruence preserves nullity and, through the adjoint reparameterization, identifies the same physical twist subspace; the per-axis footprint and a thresholded spectrum need not be invariant. In a noise-free circular tunnel, shifting the origin by one metre changes which degrees of freedom are flagged. A generalized criterion Hv = lambda Mv is universally frame-independent over positive-semidefinite information forms if and only if its metric rule is equivariant. No fixed metric qualifies, while a rig-adapted one exists only at zero screw pitch, met in one of nineteen surveyed calibrations. The equivariant point-displacement metric M = sum_i J_i^T J_i yields dimensionless, scene-scale-invariant generalized eigenvalues. They are invariant to body frame, consistent changes of length unit and scene scales; the threshold also transfers empirically across sequences. Across 365 frame pairs from four public sequences, labels rarely change at practical extrinsic magnitudes, yet a remapping estimator's correction differs between body-frame choices on 44.5-69.5% of pairs, with a median of 0.7-4.0 mm and a maximum of 0.87 m. The per-axis footprint changes even under the equivariant metric, placing the fundamental issue in the reported quantity.

</details>


### [451] [Contact Modes Are Strata: What Geometric Structure Buys in Discrete-Continuous Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15541)
*Phone Thiha Kyaw,Jonathan Kelly*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种接触丰富的操作规划方法，将接触模式视为构型空间中的层（stratum），将规划问题转化为层上的行走问题，其中层内段为测地线。在推动T形块和灵巧手重定向立方体两个仿真任务中，无需预设接触序列即可在数秒内求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富的操作同时面临离散问题（哪些接触激活）和连续问题（接触保持时如何运动），二者通过维度变化耦合——每个接触将运动限制在低维流形上。现有方法未能将这种耦合作为规划的显式对象。

Method: 观察到接触模式不仅仅是构型空间层的类比，而是层本身。据此将规划形式化为在层上的行走（walk over strata），层内运动段为测地线，允许同时求解接触序列与轨迹。

Result: 在两个接触丰富的仿真任务（绕过障碍物推动T形块、灵巧手中重定向立方体）中，规划器在数秒内返回可行解，且无需预先给定接触模式、接触序列或层信息。

Conclusion: 将接触模式直接等同于构型空间的层，能够统一处理接触选择的离散性与运动规划的连续性，实现无需先验接触序列的高效规划。

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation poses a discrete question and a continuous one at once, namely which contacts are active and how to move while they hold. The two are coupled by a change of dimension, since each contact that a robot maintains confines its motion to a lower-dimensional manifold. We make that coupling the explicit object of planning by observing that a contact mode is not merely analogous to a stratum of the configuration space; it is one. A plan is then a walk over strata whose within-stratum segments are geodesics. On two contact-rich manipulation tasks in simulation, pushing a T-shaped block around obstacles and reorienting a cube in a dexterous hand, our planner returns solutions within seconds with no mode, contact sequence, or stratum given in advance.

</details>


### [452] [MistyPilot: Enabling Social-Robot Control through Multi-Agent LLM Skill Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15549)
*Xiao Wang,Lu Dong,Ifeoma Nwogu,Srirangaraj Setlur,Venu Govindaraju*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MistyPilot是一个多智能体LLM框架，用于将自然语言指令解释并编排为Misty社交机器人上的技能。通过任务路由器分派指令到物理交互智能体或社交交互智能体，在物理机器人上实现传感器绑定和技能调用，并在12名用户研究中表现出高精度和更低的方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编程小型社交机器人从自然语言指令执行交互任务需要结合反应式物理行为和有状态社交行为，但现有接口通常要求开发者手动组合API、配置参数、绑定传感器事件并管理任务状态，缺乏自动化框架。

Method: 提出MistyPilot，一个多智能体LLM框架：包含一个Task Router将指令分派到两个专业智能体——Physically Interactive Agent负责传感器触发控制与直接技能调用，Social Interaction Agent负责对话导向的任务状态管理和上下文相关的多模态响应生成。社交代理在适用时复用先前生成的结果，否则进行完整生成。在物理Misty机器人上执行传感器绑定和技能调用，并进行五组件级测试和12人用户研究。

Result: MistyPilot在路由、传感器-技能绑定、任务状态解析、结果复用和最多100个技能的扩展上均达到高精度，且相比单智能体基线具有更低的方差。用户研究报告了积极的可用性和交互质量感知。

Conclusion: MistyPilot验证了多智能体LLM框架在社交机器人自然语言编程中的有效性，实现了从高级指令到物理技能编排的自动化，代码将公开提供。

Abstract: Programming small social robots from natural-language instructions requires more than invoking isolated APIs. Interactive tasks combine reactive physical behaviors with stateful social behaviors, while existing interfaces often require developers to manually compose APIs into skills, configure their parameters, bind sensor events to skills, and manage task states at runtime. We present MistyPilot, a multi-agent LLM framework that interprets high-level natural-language instructions and orchestrates the corresponding skills on the Misty social robot. A Task Router dispatches each instruction to one of two specialized agents: a Physically Interactive Agent for sensor-triggered robot control and direct skill invocation, and a Social Interaction Agent for dialogue-oriented task-state management and context-dependent multimodal response generation. To improve efficiency, the Social Interaction Agent reuses previously generated results when applicable and invokes full generation otherwise. We evaluate MistyPilot on five component-level suites, with sensor bindings and skill invocations executed on the physical Misty robot, and a preliminary user study with 12 participants. MistyPilot attains high accuracy on routing, sensor-skill binding, task-state parsing, result reuse, and skill extension up to 100 skills, and lower variance than an otherwise identical single-agent baseline, while participants report positive perceptions of usability and interaction quality. The code will be made publicly available via the project page.

</details>


### [453] [ReForce: Learning Force-aware Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15560)
*Yuhang Wu,Lingqi Zeng,Changwei Jing,Jianglong Ye,Xiaolong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReForce是一种力感知的重定向方法，通过预测运动学重定向动作的残差来达到期望力，将人类演示中的运动与力信息转化为机器人的接触再现动作，支持在线力感知遥操作和离线数据转换，在模拟和真实硬件上均实现了更低的力跟踪误差和更强的多指接触参与度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体演示为灵巧操作提供了可扩展的数据来源，但由于具身差距，将其转移到机器人动作仍具挑战。现有重定向方法大多是运动学层面的，而灵巧操作本质上由力决定——力支配着手与物体的交互方式以及物体的运动方式，因此需要一种能同时捕捉人类运动与力的重定向方法。

Method: ReForce在运动学重定向的基础上，利用在大量仿真交互中训练的通用力跟踪器，为运动学重定向动作预测一个残差项，以逼近期望力。该方法同时支持在线力感知遥操作和离线数据翻译两种模式。

Result: 在仿真和真实硬件上，ReForce在接触丰富的任务（如纸杯抓取和钳子操作）中实现了更低的力跟踪误差和更强的多指接触参与度。

Conclusion: ReForce证明了将力信息纳入重定向过程可以有效弥合人体演示与机器人操作之间的具身差距，为接触密集的灵巧操作任务提供了更可靠的跨具身转移方案。

Abstract: Human demonstrations offer a scalable data source for dexterous manipulation, but transferring them to robot actions remains challenging due to the embodiment gap. Today's retargeting is mostly kinematic, yet manipulation is decided by force, which governs how the hand interacts with the object and how the object moves. In this paper, we present ReForce, a Force-aware Retargeting method that turns human motion and forces into robot actions that reproduce the intended contact. ReForce predicts a residual on the kinematically retargeted action to reach the desired force, using a general force tracker trained on large-scale simulation interactions. It supports both online force-aware teleoperation and offline data translation. In simulation and on real hardware, ReForce achieves lower force-tracking error and stronger multi-finger contact engagement on contact-rich tasks such as paper-cup grasping and tongs manipulation.

</details>


### [454] [Not All History Helps: Velocity-Aware Selective Memory for Long-Horizon End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15573)
*Yuchen Liu,Ziying Song,Shengkai Zhang,Jiannan Chen,Peiliang Wu,Lei Yang,Bin Sun,Yan Gong,Li Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: StableDrive 提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶可靠长时程规划的方法，通过选择性动量记忆（SMM）和运动阶段训练脚手架（MSTS）解决跨周期历史状态不可靠和时域内运动阶段演化的问题，在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶中的长时程规划仍面临挑战。现有方法使用自身生成的历史规划状态作为时序上下文，但自生成历史可能变得过时或与当前运动阶段冲突，引入不可靠的先验。需要解决跨周期历史可靠性和时域内运动阶段演化两个核心问题。

Method: StableDrive 包含两个核心组件：(1) 选择性动量记忆（SMM），利用 Mamba 选择性状态空间算子控制前一个自预测规划状态对当前周期的影响；(2) 运动阶段训练脚手架（MSTS），通过运动阶段、长时程轨迹和纵向运动监督引导阶段感知的未来运动学习，推理时移除。此外，通过两个结构对齐端点之间的固定参数中点获得单一可部署的 SMM 规划器，无需模型集成或额外推理计算。

Result: 在 nuScenes 的 MomAD 评估协议下，StableDrive 在 1 至 6 秒的所有规划指标上取得 SOTA，平均碰撞率降低 23.3%，TPC 降低 30.9%，L2 降低 11.8%。在 LT-nuScenes 上，6 秒碰撞率降低 23.81%，TPC 降低 10.90%，L2 降低 6.37%。在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 上，所有三个设置中均取得最高 PDMS/EPDMS，包括 v2 navhard 上 EPDMS 较先前最佳提升 5.7 个点。

Conclusion: StableDrive 通过引入选择性动量记忆机制有效解决了自生成历史状态过时的问题，并结合运动阶段监督引导长时程规划学习，在多个主流基准上全面超越现有方法，验证了所提方法的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Reliable long-horizon planning remains a key challenge in end-to-end autonomous driving. By accounting for future motion evolution and potential consequences, it provides forward-looking guidance for safe and consistent driving in evolving traffic environments. Existing methods use historical planning states as temporal context. Self-generated history may become stale or conflict with the current motion stage, introducing unreliable priors. We propose StableDrive to address cross-cycle historical reliability and within-horizon motion-stage evolution. Selective Momentum Memory (SMM), implemented with a Mamba selective state-space operator, controls the influence of the preceding self-predicted planning state on the current cycle. Motion-Stage Training Scaffold (MSTS) uses motion-stage, long-horizon trajectory, and longitudinal-motion supervision to guide stage-aware future motion learning and is removed before inference. A fixed parameter midpoint between two architecture-aligned endpoints yields a single deployable SMM planner without model ensembling or extra inference-time computation. On nuScenes under the MomAD evaluation protocol, StableDrive achieves SOTA performance across all reported planning metrics from 1 to 6 s, reducing average collision rate by 23.3%, TPC by 30.9%, and L2 by 11.8% over the best previously reported value for each metric. On the curated Longitudinal-Transition nuScenes (LT-nuScenes), StableDrive reduces 6-s collision rate by 23.81%, TPC by 10.90%, and L2 by 6.37%. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, StableDrive achieves the highest PDMS/EPDMS in all three reported settings, including a 5.7-point EPDMS gain on v2 navhard over the previous best.

</details>


### [455] [Algorithm-Architecture Co-Design for Efficient VLA Inference via Speculative Inference and Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15636)
*Chunyu Qi,Zhuoran Song,Jian Weng,Haozhe Jiang,Xueyuan Liu,Naifeng Jing,Guanghui He,Xiaoyao Liang,Haibing Guan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SpecVLA是一个算法-系统协同设计框架，通过状态感知的投机预测（在非活跃状态下生成长动作序列，在活跃状态下选择性验证）来降低VLA模型的推理延迟，同时保持任务成功率，实现实时机器人操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型计算成本高且预测动作长度有限，难以满足实时部署需求。现有的Dadu-Corki加速器未利用机器人与环境交互的内在模式（活跃/非活跃状态交替），导致预测动作长度较短。作者观察到机器人环境天然在需要精确动作的活跃状态和动作影响有限的非活跃状态之间交替，这启发了长动作投机预测的新调度机会。

Method: 算法层面：1) 提出状态感知的VLA推理执行范式；2) 利用差分残差和块级混合精度量化构建硬件友好的小型验证模型sVLA。系统层面：1) 开发由GPU和机器人专用硬件模块组成的异构架构；2) 设计投机数据流，通过并行执行解耦VLA和sVLA。

Result: 在OpenVLA和RDT模型上，针对LIBERO和ManiSkill基准的全面评估显示，SpecVLA显著降低了端到端延迟，同时保持了任务成功率。

Conclusion: 通过支持长动作长度的投机预测和及时验证，SpecVLA在保证高效率和高可靠性的同时实现了实时机器人操作。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in the field of embodied AI, but their high computational cost and limited predicted action length hinder real-time deployment. Although Dadu-Corki, a dedicated accelerator for efficient embodied AI, has been introduced, it does not exploit the inherent interaction patterns between the robot and its environment, which results in a relatively short predicted action length. We observe that robotic environments naturally alternate between active states-where precise actions are crucial-and inactive states-where actions have limited impact on task success. This insight enables a new scheduling opportunity: long-action-length speculative prediction in inactive states, paired with selective verification in active states.
  We propose SpecVLA, an algorithm-system co-design framework that adaptively balances action length, inference latency, and task reliability. On the algorithm side, SpecVLA introduces a state-aware VLA inference execution paradigm and a hardware-friendly construction of a smaller verification model (sVLA) using differential residuals and block-wise mixed-precision quantization. On the system side, we develop a heterogeneous architecture consisting of a GPU and a robotic-specific hardware module, along with a speculative dataflow that decouples VLA and sVLA through parallel execution. Comprehensive evaluations on OpenVLA and RDT across LIBERO and ManiSkill benchmarks show that SpecVLA reduces end-to-end latency significantly while preserving task success rate. By enabling long-action-length speculative prediction with timely verification, SpecVLA achieves real-time robotic manipulation with both high efficiency and reliability.

</details>


### [456] [Robo-Dopamine 2.0: History-Conditioned and OOD-Aware Process Reward Modeling for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15680)
*Yijie Xu,Haopeng Jin,Run Zhou,Shengbang Liu,Sixiang Chen,Hongyang Cheng,Sicheng Hu,Peterson Co,Jinwen Luo,Huajie Tan,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Robo-Dopamine 2.0，一种历史感知与 OOD 感知的过程奖励模型，用于强化学习微调预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。它通过源对齐参考面板和观测历史构建成对预测接口，并引入 OOD 感知的有符号进展空间与 Signed-Hop Curriculum 训练策略，在视觉顺序一致性（VOC）和下游机器人操控任务中均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型在机器人操控中易受复合误差、场景变化和偏离轨迹状态的影响。强化学习可微调预训练 VLA 策略，但稀疏的成功信号阻碍探索，而人工设计的稠密奖励代价高昂且任务特定。现有学习的视觉奖励模型依赖静态前后观测，导致时间歧义，且难以区分 OOD 执行下鲁棒性保持的变异与任务无效的失败。

Method: Robo-Dopamine 2.0 包含两个核心组件：(1) 历史条件成对奖励——合成 OOD 查询使用源对齐参考面板，在线查询使用观测轨迹历史，同时保留查询端点；(2) OOD 感知的有符号进展空间——对有效进展、鲁棒性、失败和恢复进行表征。训练采用 Signed-Hop Curriculum，结合过渡感知的重放机制，先学习粗粒度执行顺序再校准细粒度进展。此外构建了 OOD 轨迹数据集和五族基准测试集。

Result: 参考面板将平均视觉顺序一致性（VOC）从 0.967 提升至 0.986，OOD 鲁棒 VOC 从 0.906 提升至 0.958。在相同的 400K 成对奖励预算下，Signed-Hop 训练（25% 重放）达到 0.9872 平均 VOC，高于匹配池洗牌对照的 0.9858。下游 RL 中，完整模型实现 86.8% 的 RoboTwin 平均成功率，以及 71/80 次成功的真实世界插入任务。

Conclusion: Robo-Dopamine 2.0 通过历史条件成对奖励和 OOD 感知的有符号进展空间，显著增强了 VLA 策略微调中的奖励模型判别能力，在模拟基准和真实世界中均验证了其鲁棒性与有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models improve robotic manipulation but remain vulnerable to compounding errors, scene changes, and off-trajectory states. Reinforcement learning can refine pretrained VLA policies, yet sparse success signals hinder exploration, while engineered dense rewards are costly and task-specific. Existing learned visual reward models often rely on static before-after observations, causing temporal ambiguity and weak discrimination between robustness-preserving variations and task-invalid failures under out-of-distribution (OOD) execution. We introduce Robo-Dopamine 2.0, a history- and OOD-aware process reward model with a pairwise prediction interface. It combines (1) history-conditioned pairwise rewards that use source-aligned reference panels for synthetic OOD queries and observed rollout history for online queries, while preserving the queried endpoints, and (2) an OOD-aware signed progress space that represents valid progress, robustness, failure, and recovery. A Signed-Hop Curriculum with transition-aware replay learns coarse execution ordering before fine-grained progress calibration. We also construct an OOD trajectory dataset and a five-family benchmark. Reference panels improve mean visual order consistency (VOC) from 0.967 to 0.986 and OOD-robust VOC from 0.906 to 0.958. With the same 400K pairwise-reward budget, Signed-Hop training with 25% replay reaches 0.9872 mean VOC, compared with 0.9858 for a matched-pool shuffled control. In downstream reinforcement learning, the full model achieves 86.8% mean RoboTwin success and 71/80 successful real-world insertions.

</details>


### [457] [GAINS: Leveraging Inconsistent Human Intervention Signals in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15707)
*Xinyi Zhang,Yinuo Zhao,Pei Ren,Lechun Jiang,Huiqian Jin,Lei Sun,Dapeng Wu,Zhengping Che,Chi Harold Liu,Jian Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出GAINS框架，利用分布强化学习（分位数Q网络）建模人为干预信号在时间和状态空间上的不一致性，并通过悲观探索策略实现安全且样本高效的机器人操作策略学习。在四个模拟操作任务和两个真实世界场景中，GAINS在任务成功率上比RLIF高22%，故障恢复成功率提升最高达43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类操作者在干预机器人策略时不仅动作不完美（这一方面已被广泛研究），其干预信号的时序也常存在延迟且在不同时间与状态空间上不一致。在高控制频率下，这种不一致性尤为重要，但目前在强化学习中尚未被充分探索。现有方法忽略了人为干预信号的分布特性，导致训练效率和安全性能受限。

Method: GAINS框架核心包含两部分：（1）采用分布强化学习中的分位数Q网络（quantile Q-networks）对稀疏任务奖励和不一致人为干预所导致的回报可变性进行建模；（2）基于该分布表示引入悲观探索策略，在人类纠正信号下促进安全且样本高效的学习。该方法通过捕捉回报分布的完整形态而非仅期望值，来应对干预信号的不一致性。

Result: 在四个多样化模拟操作任务和两个具有挑战性的真实世界场景中，与最先进的基于干预的方法（如RLIF）相比，GAINS在任务成功率上提升22%，在故障场景中的恢复成功率提升最高达43%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，建模人为不完美性所引发的回报可变性对于干预式学习的实际部署至关重要。通过显式建模回报分布并使用悲观探索，可以显著提升机器人操作策略在人类干预下的鲁棒性和学习效率。

Abstract: Correcting robot manipulation policies through human intervention holds great promise for real-world deployment, yet human operators are inherently imperfect in both the actions they provide and the timing of their intervention signals. While the former has been extensively discussed in reinforcement learning (RL), the latter remains underexplored. At high control frequencies, human intervention signals are often delayed and inconsistent across time and state space. In this work, we present GAINS, a framework for leveraging inconsistent human intervention signals in RL. At the core of GAINS, we employ distributional RL with quantile Q-networks to model the return variability induced by sparse task rewards and inconsistent human interventions. Building on this distributional representation, we introduce a pessimistic exploration strategy that promotes safe and sample-efficient learning under human corrections. We evaluate GAINS on four diverse simulated manipulation tasks and two challenging real-world scenarios against state-of-the-art intervention-based methods. GAINS achieves a 22% higher task success rate than RLIF and improves recovery success by up to 43% in failure scenarios. These results highlight the importance of modeling return variability induced by human imperfection for real-world deployment of intervention-based learning.

</details>


### [458] [Some Modifications to Our End-to-End UAV Planner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15741)
*Junjie Lu,Bailing Tian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文总结了针对一阶段规划器YOPO的多项有效性改进，包括双段MINCO参数化、同伦类锚定、动态可行性障碍惩罚与自适应限速、以及排序损失替代评分回归，旨在提升轨迹表达的丰富性、避障安全性和飞行路径的直达性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: YOPO作为一种端到端一阶段规划器，通过可微轨迹代价反向传播训练，能从单张深度图和机器人状态直接预测候选轨迹。但其继承了软约束优化的病态问题：安全代价与平滑性和目标到达项相互竞争；代价函数在多个同伦类间非凸；单片多项式表达能力有限。这些因素限制了其规划能力与安全性。

Method: 1) 采用双段MINCO参数化，以时间换取平滑性，且不改变轨迹的空间轮廓；2) 将YOPO的多模态预测提升至覆盖不同同伦类，每个运动原语作为同伦锚，将轨迹约束在可行盆地内，无需显式安全飞行走廊或前端搜索；3) 对速度和加速度施加障碍惩罚，并引入曲率相关的限速机制，梯度仅作用于速度，在拥挤区域或急转弯处产生自适应减速行为；4) 用排序损失替代分数回归，防止微小分数误差导致候选集重新排序。

Result: 这些改进带来了更丰富的轨迹表示、更安全的障碍物规避以及更直接的飞行路径。

Conclusion: 通过上述一系列针对性修改，有效缓解了YOPO原有的软约束优化病态问题，在保持一阶段规划高效性的同时，提升了轨迹质量、安全性和可达性。

Abstract: The one-stage planner YOPO maps a single depth image and the robot state directly to a set of candidate trajectories, trained by backpropagating through differentiable trajectory costs. This yields dense, geometrically informative supervision, but inherits the pathologies of soft-constrained optimization: the safety cost competes with the smoothness and goal-reaching terms, is non-convex across homotopy classes, and the single-piece polynomial is limited in expressiveness. In this report, we summarize several effective modifications. We adopt a two-piece MINCO parameterization, trading time for smoothness without altering the trajectory's spatial profile. We further lift YOPO's multi-modal prediction to span distinct homotopy classes, treating each motion primitive as a homotopy anchor that confines the trajectory to a feasible basin - without explicit safe-flight-corridor construction or front-end search. For dynamic feasibility, we impose barrier penalties on velocity and acceleration together with a curvature-dependent speed limit whose gradient acts only on the velocity, producing an adaptive-speed behavior that decelerates in cluttered regions or sharp turns. We replace score regression with a ranking loss, preventing small score errors from reordering the candidate set. These yield richer trajectory representations, safer obstacle avoidance, and more direct flight paths.

</details>


### [459] [Making two action heads agree: coordination mechanisms and a runtime collapse certificate for flow-matching policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15748)
*Jinhui Sun,Wei Zhou,Bowen Yang,Xinliang Xiao,Li Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了双表示流匹配策略中两个分支（关节空间与末端执行器空间）的协调机制。独立采样分支在多模态任务中可能选择不同有效模式，导致残差信号误报。作者评估了四类协调机制，发现共享源噪声的效应随表示映射改变符号，训练支持的离散分区能达到近乎上限的协调性；并推导了基于Gini-Simpson多样性的机会校正协调界，用于无标签地区分协调与坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双表示流匹配策略将每个预测动作解码到关节和末端执行器两个空间，二者之间运动学等价的解码残差可提供物理可解释的运行时长信号。然而在多模态任务中，独立采样的分支可能选择不同的有效模式，产生误报。需要研究如何协调两个分支及其代价。

Method: 在两类机器人环境和一个非机器人测试平台上，测试了四类协调机制：(1) 共享辅助潜变量（被证明在总体最优处被擦除，是死路）；(2) 共享源噪声（可协调或反协调，效应随表示映射改变符号，与解码器模式盆地对齐程度相关）；(3) 一致性正则化（中等协调但降低有效对率）；(4) 训练支持的离散分区（接近上限且鲁棒）。并推导了基于分支Gini-Simpson多样性的机会校正协调界。

Result: 训练支持的离散分区实现近乎上限的协调性且鲁棒；共享源噪声的协调效应符号随表示映射变化；一致性正则化协调效果居中但降低有效对率；共享潜变量在总体最优处被擦除。在LIBERO-Plus上，良性多模态使残差误报增加1.57个百分点，但残差仍是最强的失败信号；预注册的token干预未达到误报标准也未产生种子稳健的检测变化。

Conclusion: 双分支协调的最佳方案是训练支持的离散分区，残差信号依然是评估过的最强失败信号。共享潜变量是理论死路，共享源噪声效果不稳定。作者提供了基于多样性的无标签协调证书，可区分协调与坍缩，代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: A dual-representation flow-matching policy decodes each predicted motion into joint and end-effector spaces, and the residual between the two kinematically equivalent decodings provides a physically interpretable runtime signal. On multimodal tasks, however, independently sampled branches may choose different valid modes, causing false alarms. We study how to coordinate the two branches and at what cost. Across two robot environments and a non-robotic testbed, the tested mechanisms fall into four classes. An auxiliary latent shared by both branches but absent from the flow-matching construction is erased at the population optimum, a provable dead end confirmed within a prespecified 2% equivalence band. Sharing source noise can coordinate or anti-coordinate: its effect changes sign with the representation map and tracks the alignment of decoder mode basins. Consistency regularization gives intermediate coordination but reduces the valid-pair rate, while training-supported discrete partitions achieve near-ceiling coordination robustly. We further derive a chance-corrected coordination bound based only on each branch's Gini-Simpson diversity, yielding an attainable region and a label-free certificate that separates coordination from collapse when zero mismatch is ambiguous. On LIBERO-Plus, benign multimodality adds 1.57 percentage points of false alarms to the residual, which remains the strongest evaluated failure signal; the preregistered token intervention does not meet its false-alarm criterion or produce a seed-robust detection change. Code, models, and per-run configurations are available at https://github.com/kimo423/dual-head-coordination.

</details>


### [460] [Tac4Loco: Learning Spatiotemporal Plantar Pressure Representations for Humanoid Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15766)
*Ziyun Liu,Sikai Guo,Zheng Li,Jiahang Cao,Haichao Liu,Pei Qu,Yinghong Zhang,Jinni Zhou,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Tac4Loco，一种利用多阵列足底压力作为直接反馈的触觉感知框架，用于人形机器人在复杂地形上的鲁棒运动控制。通过拓扑保持的序数表示将仿真与物理传感器信号映射到共享观测空间，结合双分支编码器提取时空特征，并与增强本体感觉集成到非对称演员-评论家架构中进行策略学习。实验证明在倾斜、部分、非对称和变化支撑地形上跟踪性能和支持适应能力提升，且能零样本部署到未见过的柔顺和结构化地形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人形机器人运动策略主要依赖本体感觉（仅提供足底支撑的间接证据）或外部地形感知（只能预测接触条件，无法实时观察实际支撑）。部分研究虽将足底接触作为辅助感知，但仅依赖汇总统计，忽视了足底压力空间拓扑这一直接表征实际接触状态的信息。本文旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出Tac4Loco框架：(1) 构建拓扑保持的序数表示将仿真和物理传感器信号映射到共享观测空间；(2) 使用双分支编码器分别提取空间和时间表征；(3) 将学习到的时空特征与包含地形估计线索的增强本体感觉集成；(4) 采用非对称演员-评论家架构进行策略学习。

Result: 在广泛仿真和真实实验中，所提出方法在倾斜、部分、非对称和变化支撑的地形上表现出改进的跟踪性能和支持适应能力。此外，在未见过的一致性和非结构化地形上实现了零样本部署，包括泡沫平台和砾石路面。

Conclusion: Tac4Loco证明了足底压力空间拓扑信息对人形机器人地形适应能力的关键价值，通过仿真到现实的映射实现零样本泛化，并且代码和实验配置将开源以促进可复现性。

Abstract: Humanoid robots are expected to traverse complex terrains, where the plantar support may vary dramatically due to foot placement errors, ground properties, and transient dynamics.
  To achieve robust locomotion, the robots are required to adapt to uneven terrain and uncertain foot--ground interactions.
  Existing locomotion policies rely primarily on proprioception or exteroceptive terrain perception, where the former provides only indirect evidence of plantar support, while the latter predicts contact conditions before touchdown but cannot observe the actual support in real-time.
  Although some studies incorporate plantar contacts as an auxiliary perception, they rely mainly on summary statistics, overlooking the spatial topology of plantar pressure, which provides a more direct characterization of the realized contact state.
  To bridge this gap, we present Tac4Loco, a tactile-perceptive framework that incorporates multi-array plantar pressure as direct feedback for humanoid locomotion.
  We formulate a topology-preserving ordinal representation to map simulated and physical sensor signals into a shared observation space,
  with a dual-branch encoder for extracting their spatial and temporal representations. Subsequently, the learned spatiotemporal features are integrated with augmented proprioception including terrain estimation cues, and provided to an asymmetric actor-critic architecture for policy learning.
  Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved tracking performance and support adaptation on terrains with inclined, partial, asymmetric, and changing support. We further demonstrate its zero-shot deployment on unseen compliant and unstructured terrains, including a foam platform and a gravel road. All code and experimental configurations will be released as open-source to facilitate reproducibility.

</details>


### [461] [Reliable Piezoresistive Strain Sensing Through Physical Limits and Uncertainty Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15784)
*Carmen Ballester,Víctor Muñoz,Dorin Copaci,Dolores Blanco*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种软压阻应变传感器的可靠性框架，将基于物理信息输入特征的概率逆模型与融合不确定性和应变/应变率限制的风险因子相结合，构建三态监控器，以区分"可信的置信度"与"真实的可靠性"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软压阻应变传感器的电阻响应具有非线性和迟滞特性，且可能超出校准工作区间或在内部失效，传统概率回归器只跟踪置信度却忽略了这些限制。一个看起来正常的预测均值可能来自超出适用范围的传感器读数或已内部失效的传感器，因此"看似有信心的估计"并不等同于"可信赖的估计"。系统需要一种不依赖标注失败样本（软材料难以收集此类数据）的可靠性评估方法。

Method: 提出一个可靠性框架，包含两部分：(1) 基于物理引导输入特征（physics-guided input features）的物理信息概率逆模型（physics-informed probabilistic inverse model），采用高斯过程作为回归器；(2) 风险因子（risk factor），将不确定性估计与应变和应变率限制相融合，生成三态监控器（three-state monitor）用于判断传感器状态。

Result: 在Nitinol（镍钛）丝和银涂层聚酰胺线上测试，拟合分数提升至0.90-0.95（RMSE为0.26%-0.15%），经验覆盖率96%（目标95%）。监控器在标称工况下保持可靠，能捕获95%的超范围条件和100%的异常状态。

Conclusion: 该框架使传感器在输出估计值的同时报告置信度，系统可据此选择暂停动作而非盲目执行。由于无需标注失败样本，该方法适用于难以收集故障数据的软材料传感场景，从"置信度"走向"可信赖度"。

Abstract: Soft piezoresistive strain sensors are one of the most common sensing solutions for wearable and soft robotic applications due to their flexibility and compliance. However, their resistance response is nonlinear and hysteretic, and a sensor can be pushed past its calibrated workspace or misbehave inside it, carrying that error into a decision or control loop. Probabilistic regressors track confidence but ignore those limits. A predictive mean can look unremarkable even when the reading comes from a sensor outside its admissible range or already failing internally, so a confident-looking estimate is not the same as a trustworthy one. This paper proposes a reliability framework pairing a physics-informed probabilistic inverse model, built on physics-guided input features, with a risk factor fusing uncertainty with strain and strain-rate limits into a three-state monitor. Tests on a Nitinol wire and a silver-coated polyamide thread with a Gaussian Process raised fit scores to 0.90-0.95 (RMSE 0.26%-0.15%) and a 96% empirical coverage against the 95% target. The monitor caught 95% of out-of-range and 100% of abnormal conditions while staying reliable under nominal operation. A sensor that reports confidence alongside its estimate lets a system withhold action instead, since it needs no labeled failure examples, which are hard to collect for soft materials.

</details>


### [462] [ViTaR: Visuo-Tactile Residual Adaptation for Foundation VLA Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15816)
*Yi Wang,Renjun Wu,Jinyan Liu,Xuesong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ViTaR框架，将触觉反馈从"动作生成感知输入"重新定义为"执行调制器"，在冻结的VLA模型上选择并缩放有界的残差修正，以保留预训练能力。在UniVTAC基准的七个接触丰富任务上达到61.3%平均成功率，较冻结VLA基线提升30.6个百分点，并通过物理机器人实验验证了其真实世界的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在接触丰富操作任务中存在关键盲区：它们编码了广泛的视觉-语义先验，但对局部接触事件不敏感，无论接触建立、丢失还是失稳都会产生相同动作。现有方案要么修改VLA内部结构导致灾难性遗忘风险，要么在近失败接触条件下要求在线强化学习。且两者都赋予触觉对动作生成的无限影响力，与VLA可泛化的先验相冲突。因此需要一种既能利用触觉信息、又不破坏VLA预训练能力的方案。

Method: ViTaR将触觉反馈从动作生成的感知输入重构为执行调制器，在冻结的VLA之上选择和缩放有界残差修正，从而在结构上保留预训练能力。方法分为两阶段：(1) Effect-Guided Modeling（效果引导建模）：通过结果导向的偏好证据判断是否及哪个修正局部合理；(2) Residual Action Modulation（残差动作调制）：将证据转换为残差选择，并利用实时视觉-触觉观测对增益进行连续缩放。

Result: 在UniVTAC基准的七个接触丰富任务上，ViTaR平均成功率达61.3%，较冻结VLA基线提升30.6个百分点，同时超越了专门的触觉基线方法。物理机器人实验确认有界触觉调制能够迁移到真实传感器噪声和动力学环境中。

Conclusion: ViTaR通过将触觉作为有界的执行调制信号而非动作生成输入，实现了在不牺牲VLA预训练泛化能力的前提下增强接触丰富操作性能，为大规模VLA模型在真实世界接触操作任务中的部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: As Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models scale toward real-world deployment, contact-rich manipulation exposes a critical blind spot: these policies encode broad visual-semantic priors yet remain unaware of local contact events, producing identical actions whether contact is established, lost, or destabilized. Existing remedies either modify VLA internals, risking catastrophic forgetting, or demand online reinforcement under near-failure contact conditions. Both grant tactile unbounded influence over action generation, conflicting with the priors that make VLAs generalizable. We introduce ViTaR, which reframes tactile feedback from an action-generating perceptual input to an execution modulator that selects and scales bounded residual corrections atop a frozen VLA, preserving pretrained capabilities by construction. ViTaR decomposes adaptation into two stages: Effect-Guided Modeling determines whether and which correction is locally justified via outcome-grounded preference evidence, and Residual Action Modulation converts this evidence into a residual choice with continuously scaled gain from real-time visuotactile observations. On the UniVTAC benchmark spanning seven contact-rich tasks, ViTaR achieves 61.3% average success, a 30.6 percentage-point improvement over its frozen VLA base that also surpasses purpose-built tactile baselines. Physical-robot experiments confirm that bounded tactile modulation transfers to real sensor noise and dynamics.

</details>


### [463] [Scaling Manual-Grounded Appliance Manipulation with Data Synthesis and Unified Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15863)
*Yuxing Long,Lei Kang,Ziyan Yu,Yuzheng Gao,Bin Cheng,Jiyao Zhang,Xiaoqi Li,Haolin Yang,Dongjiang Li,Hui Shen,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MAGE数据合成管线，通过分层电器图（HAG）自动生成部件定位、长时序规划与闭环恢复数据，构建了首个面向手册引导的电器操纵规划的大规模数据集UseAppliance（22类电器、89K+部件标注、53K+任务、33K+闭环调整步骤），并在此基础上开发了端到端模型AppliancePlan。该7B参数模型在RealAppliance-Bench基准上超越基线10倍以上，并在六种家用电器的真实机器人实验中验证了sim-to-real迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作家用电器需要依赖状态的长时序规划并对扰动具有鲁棒性，但现有大模型在此任务上表现不佳，根本原因在于缺乏足够多样且面向任务的数据集来支撑此类规划学习。

Method: 提出MAGE可扩展数据合成管线，其核心是分层电器图（HAG）结构，可自动从电器手册中生成三类数据：部件定位（part grounding）、长时序规划（long-horizon planning）和闭环恢复（closed-loop recovery）数据。基于该数据构建了AppliancePlan端到端模型。

Result: AppliancePlan（仅7B参数）在RealAppliance-Bench上开放环规划性能超过最优基线10倍以上，并在所有任务上持续超越现有最先进模型；在六种家用电器的真实机器人实验中确认了有效的sim-to-real迁移。

Conclusion: 该工作通过自动化的数据合成与端到端模型训练，有效解决了家电操纵规划中数据稀缺的瓶颈，验证了从仿真到真实世界的泛化能力，为通用家庭机器人操控迈出了重要一步。

Abstract: Operating household appliances requires long-horizon planning that is state-dependent and robust to disturbances, yet existing large models fall short, as no sufficiently diverse, task-oriented dataset exists to support such planning. To bridge this gap, we propose MAGE, a scalable data synthesis pipeline that introduces a novel Hierarchical Appliance Graph (HAG) to automatically generate part grounding, long-horizon planning, and closed-loop recovery data from appliance manuals. With MAGE, we build UseAppliance, the first large-scale dataset for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning, spanning 22 appliance categories with 89K+ part annotations, 53K+ manipulation tasks, and 33K+ closed-loop adjustment steps. Built on UseAppliance, we develop AppliancePlan, an end-to-end model for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning. On RealAppliance-Bench, AppliancePlan with only 7B parameters achieves over 10x the best baseline on open-loop planning and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models across all tasks. Real-robot experiments on six household appliances further confirm effective sim-to-real transfer, marking an important step toward general-purpose household robotics.

</details>


### [464] [GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15875)
*GigaBrain Team,Angen Ye,Axiang Sun,Can Jin,Chenxi Cheng,Chong Shi,Dengke Shang,Dingqian Zhang,Guan Huang,Guangqiang Wang,Guangqing Ding,Guo Li,Hangcong Li,Hengyu Zhong,Hongtao Lu,Jianbo Qin,Jiming Mao,Jing Zhu,Jindi Lv,Jingzhi Cui,Junjie Xie,Junyi Bao,Kai Liu,Lei Yuan,Limin Long,Lv Feng,Mingming Yu,Peng Li,Pengfei Yi,Qi Li,Qianli Zhang,Qingfang Li,Qitang Hu,Rui Zhang,Shaoyan Sun,Shibo Sun,Shiying Duan,Tenghui Chen,Tianze Liu,Weijie Ke,Wenyao Xue,Xiaofeng Wang,Xiaoyu Tian,Xinyu Liu,Xinze Chen,Yang Wang,Yankai Wang,Yejun Zeng,Yifan Li,Yifei Nie,Yilong Li,Yilong Liu,Yongchao Feng,Yumeng Wang,Yun Ye,Zhichao Liu,Ziheng He,Zonghai Yang,Zheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了GigaBrain-0.7，一个通过三系统架构、37,000小时异构具身数据预训练以及单阶段对齐训练大幅提升跨机器人本体泛化能力的具身基础模型，在零样本能力、指令跟随和任务成功率上显著优于此前模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管VLA模型已成为通用具身智能体的主流范式，但现有系统在架构设计有效性、异构大数据规模可扩展性以及跨任务和跨本体的泛化能力方面仍存在开放性问题。作者旨在探究并证明更优的架构设计、更大规模更多样的数据以及更有效的训练策略能否带来实质性的性能提升。

Method: GigaBrain-0.7采用三系统架构，统一理解、预测和动作生成三个模块；利用超过37,000小时异构具身数据进行大规模预训练；并引入单阶段对齐训练，联合优化视觉语言理解与多本体动作生成。

Result: 相比GigaBrain-0系列及π0.5等先前SOTA模型，GigaBrain-0.7在基础零样本能力、语言条件指令跟随和训练后任务成功率上均取得显著提升；在自研Maker H01平台及主流机器人本体上展现出强的任务适应性与完成能力，覆盖家庭和工业场景。

Conclusion: 研究表明更有效的架构设计、更大规模异构数据预训练和单阶段对齐训练能够实质性地提升VLA系统的跨本体泛化能力，GigaBrain-0.7验证了这一方向的可行性，并将开源全部训练代码和预训练权重以推动具身智能领域发展。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become a dominant paradigm for generalist embodied agents, demonstrating strong complex and long-horizon task completion in structured settings. Yet it remains an open question whether current VLA systems can benefit from more effective architectural design, scale to substantially larger and more heterogeneous data regimes, and achieve broader generalization across tasks and embodiments. To this end, we present GigaBrain-0.7, an embodied foundation model with substantially improved generalization across diverse robot embodiments. Specifically, GigaBrain-0.7 unifies understanding, prediction, and action through a three-system architecture, scales pretraining to over 37,000 hours of heterogeneous embodied data, and introduces one-stage alignment training that jointly optimizes vision-language understanding and multi-embodiment action generation. Compared with the preceding GigaBrain-0 series and prior state-of-the-art models including $π_{0.5}$, GigaBrain-0.7 achieves substantial improvements in foundation zero-shot capabilities, language-conditioned instruction following, and post-training task success rates. In particular, on our in-house Maker H01 platform and mainstream robot embodiments, GigaBrain-0.7 demonstrates strong task adaptability and completion ability across both home and industrial scenarios. All training code and pretrained model weights will be released.

</details>


### [465] [Grouping Auction-Consensus Algorithm for Decentralized Task Allocation in Multi-Robot Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15884)
*Jose Rodriguez,Sven Koenig,Wenjie Dong,Qi Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出GACA（分组拍卖-共识算法），一种去中心化多机器人任务分配框架。它继承了CBBA的两阶段拍卖-共识架构，但将竞标机制从单个任务级重构为对空间邻近任务分组进行结构化推理。经4000个测试环境和3280个可扩展性实例验证，GACA中位最优性约97%，显著优于CBBA的81-84%，且收敛迭代数相同或更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBBA作为广泛采用的去中心化MRTA基线，其逐任务竞标机制与最小化总团队行驶距离的min-sum目标不匹配，在空间分布环境中导致次优分配。作者旨在通过重构竞标机制来弥合这一差距，提升分配最优性。

Method: GACA采用CBBA的两阶段拍卖-共识架构，但将竞标机制重新设计为基于空间邻近任务组的推理。具体步骤：(1) 最近邻预处理将任务划分为空间连贯的组；(2) 智能体迭代提出结构化组级操作（认领未分配组、获取部分组、竞争其他智能体持有的组）；(3) 通过共识阶段解决竞争性操作。在MT-SR-IA问题类别中进行评估，以MILP作为最优性参考基准。

Result: 在四种蜂群规模和4000个测试环境中，GACA的中位百分比最优性约为97%，而CBBA为81-84%，且GACA以相同或更少的迭代收敛。在3280个额外实例（5-20个智能体，10-50个任务）的可扩展性评估中，确认这些增益能稳健泛化。

Conclusion: GACA通过在组级而非任务级进行竞标决策，显著提升去中心化MRTA的分配最优性，且不牺牲收敛速度，具有良好的可扩展性，为大规模去中心化任务分配提供了更优的方案。

Abstract: Decentralized multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) is essential for scalable and resilient autonomous systems. The Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithm (CBBA) is a widely adopted decentralized baseline. However, its individual task-level bidding is poorly aligned with the min-sum objective of minimizing total team travel distance, leading to suboptimal allocations in spatially distributed environments. This paper introduces the Grouping Auction-Consensus Algorithm (GACA). This decentralized MRTA framework adopts the two-phase auction-consensus architecture of CBBA while fundamentally redesigning its bidding mechanism to reason over groups of spatially proximate tasks. A nearest-neighbor preprocessing step partitions tasks into spatially coherent groups before allocation. Agents then iteratively propose structured group-level actions: claiming unassigned groups, acquiring partial groups, or contesting groups held by other agents. Competing actions are resolved through a consensus phase. Operating in the MT-SR-IA problem class, GACA is evaluated against CBBA using a Mixed-Integer Linear Program as the ground-truth optimality reference. Across four swarm sizes and 4,000 test worlds, GACA achieves a median percent optimality of approximately 97% compared to 81--84% for CBBA, while converging in equal or fewer iterations. A scalability evaluation over 3,280 additional problem instances spanning swarm sizes of 5 to 20 agents and task counts of 10 to 50 confirms that these gains generalize robustly across a wide range of problem configurations.

</details>


### [466] [Tactile Sim2Real without Tactile Simulation via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15897)
*Fan Yang,Youngsun Wi,Jinhao Yu,Nima Fazeli,Dmitry Berenson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SBLR框架，通过瓶颈潜空间重建将策略从模拟器原生oracle传感器对齐到真实触觉传感器，无需传感器特定建模即实现零样本部署，在插销插入和齿轮啮合任务上达到85-97.5%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触觉传感器种类繁多且演化迅速，逐一在仿真中建模需要大量领域专业知识，且计算近似会降低仿真信号保真度，导致Sim2Real迁移困难。

Method: SBLR框架分为两步：(1)在模拟器中原生oracle传感器（点云+指尖力）上训练策略；(2)推理时通过瓶颈潜空间重建，将真实传感器潜嵌入对齐到oracle传感器潜嵌入。策略两阶段训练：先学习oracle潜表示，再用瓶颈重建适应真实传感器的信息损失。对齐由rectified-flow变换网络基于最近邻伪配对在无配对随机数据上学得。

Result: 三个接触密集任务的仿真实验表明SBLR达到或接近直接访问触觉仿真的oracle性能。硬件实验中，GelSight Mini和DIGIT传感器在插销插入和齿轮啮合任务上实现85-97.5%零样本成功率，超出基于物理的触觉仿真基线7.5-15%。

Conclusion: SBLR成功绕过了传感器特定仿真，通过潜空间对齐实现了从oracle传感器到真实传感器的零样本Sim2Real迁移，无需任何传感器特定建模或校准，为多样化触觉传感器提供了通用高效的策略部署方案。

Abstract: Robot sensor designs, particularly tactile sensors, are highly diverse and evolve rapidly. Modeling each sensor in simulation demands substantial domain expertise and computational approximations can degrade the fidelity of the simulated signals. We propose Sim2Real via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction (SBLR), a framework that avoids sensor-specific simulation entirely by (1) training policies on a simulator-native oracle sensor that is easy to construct without modeling any particular sensor (e.g. we use a point-cloud and finger-tip forces as a tactile oracle), and (2) aligning real sensor latent embeddings to those of the oracle sensor at inference time. Policy training proceeds in two-stage: the policy first learns from the oracle sensor latents, then a bottlenecked latent reconstruction adapts it to the information loss expected when using the real sensor instead of the oracle. The alignment between oracle and real sensor is learned from unpaired random-play data collected in both simulation and the real world, using rectified-flow-based transformation networks trained on nearest-neighbor pseudo-pairs. Simulation experiments on three contact-rich tasks show that SBLR matches or approaches the performance of an oracle with direct access to tactile simulation. Hardware experiments on Peg Insertion and Gear Meshing with GelSight Mini and DIGIT sensors demonstrate 85-97.5% zero-shot success without requiring any sensor-specific modeling or calibration, outperforming a physics-based tactile simulation baseline by 7.5-15%.

</details>


### [467] [Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15917)
*Sarthak Kamat,Adam Rashid,Satvik Sharma,Aseem Doriwala,Chelsea Finn,Phillip Isola,C. Karen Liu*

Main category: cs.RO
